title: Unified Hallucination Fuzzing for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Hallucination remains a persistent challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), severely limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Existing evaluations, predominantly based on static benchmarks, suffer from narrow taxonomical coverage and rapid performance saturation, failing to reflect model robustness in evolving real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic evaluation framework integrating a comprehensive benchmark with self-evolving stress testing. First, we introduce UniHall, a fine-grained dataset grounded in a unified taxonomy spanning Object, Instruction, and Knowledge dimensions. Second, to address benchmark saturation, we propose Self-Adaptive Multimodal Fuzzing (SAMF), a self-adaptive framework that employs evolutionary mutation strategies to explore the boundaries of model hallucinations. Crucially, to ensure reliable assessment of dynamic inputs, SAMF incorporates a structured metric suite driven by an ensemble of multi-modal oracles. Our extensive experiments reveal that state-of-the-art MLLMs exhibit significant performance degradation under fuzzing compared to conventional settings, exposing a dissociation between reasoning capabilities and factual grounding. Furthermore, we identify a helpfulness-hallucination trade-off, where reinforcement learning alignment inadvertently exacerbates sycophancy in instruction-following tasks. The framework, code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/LanceZPF/EvalHall.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一套系统的评价框架，用于全面测试和分析多模态大模型的幻觉问题，通过自适应压力测试和新的基准数据集发现模型在压力环境下表现大幅下降，并揭示了帮助性与幻觉度之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLMs）在实际高风险应用中因幻觉问题难以信赖。现有的静态基准测试覆盖面窄且易“满分”，无法真实反映模型的稳健性。因而需要更科学、更具挑战性的评测方法。
AI.method: 1）构建了细粒度、覆盖广的UniHall数据集，涵盖物体、指令与知识三大维度，提供一体化的幻觉分类标准；2）提出了自适应多模态模糊测试方法SAMF，通过进化变异策略动态生成测试样本，不断挖掘模型幻觉极限，并结合多模态“判别神谕”设计了一套结构化评价指标，确保测试的动态性和精确性。
AI.result: 实验显示，最新MLLMs在模糊测试下性能明显下滑，推理能力与事实指向性脱钩。同时，发现通过强化学习调整以提高模型“帮助性”反而加剧了顺从性与幻觉的发生。
AI.conclusion: 传统基准低估了模型幻觉风险，该框架揭示出模型在真实压力环境下的稳健性缺陷及其背后的本质矛盾，为未来评测和提升多模态大模型的可靠性和实用性提供了新工具和思路。

title: DocAtlas: Long-Document Understanding as Mutable-State Interaction
summary: Long-document understanding requires models to find and combine evidence across many pages, layouts, tables, figures, and charts. Existing retrieval-augmented systems usually select evidence from a static index before generation, while recent agentic systems add multi-turn tool use but often rely on frozen proprietary backbones whose behavior is set by prompts. We present DocAtlas, a system that treats long-document understanding as a mutable-state information-seeking process. We instantiate DocAtlas as a mutable document harness: an external environment that determines what document information is searched, read, stored, reviewed, and shown to the model at each step. Given a document and question, the harness exposes search, reading, note-taking, and review tools, maintains a hierarchical tree and note store, and updates both as the agent records evidence. DocAtlas combines self-improving retrieval, selective evidence access, and active working memory under a fixed context budget. The same harness supports inference-time use with large VLMs and end-to-end reinforcement learning for compact VLM agents. With GPT-5.4, DocAtlas reaches 71.4\% on MMLongBench-Doc, exceeding the human-expert reference of 65.8\%. A Qwen3.5-4B VLM trained with end-to-end RL in the DocAtlas environment reaches 63.7\%, compared with a 54.4\% direct-input baseline, showing that mutable document-harness design can improve compact document agents by a large margin.

AI.tldr: 提出了DocAtlas系统，通过动态管理长文档的信息检索与记忆，显著提升了长文档理解能力。
AI.motivation: 长文档理解需要模型跨多页、多种格式（表格、图表等）综合证据，传统方法受限于静态索引或工具使用不灵活，难以高效应对复杂检索与推理过程。
AI.method: 设计了一种'可变文档操作框架（mutable document harness）'，以动态工具（搜索、阅读、笔记、复盘）和分层树状结构+笔记存储，支持在推理过程中持续记录、更新和利用证据，并兼容大模型推理与小模型端到端强化学习优化。
AI.result: GPT-5.4与DocAtlas配合，在MMLongBench-Doc上取得71.4%的成绩，超过了人类专家基线65.8%；Qwen3.5-4B搭配DocAtlas并端到端训练，提升到63.7%，远超直接输入的54.4%。
AI.conclusion: 动态可变操作框架显著提升了长文档理解模型性能，无论对大模型还是小模型推理都有效，表明这类设计对文档智能体应用大有前景。

title: WuYuEval: A Multi-Level Benchmark for Large Language Models in Solid Waste Management
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as technical assistants, but their competence in solid waste management (SWM) remains difficult to assess because existing benchmarks emphasize general knowledge rather than professional decisions under engineering, environmental, and policy constraints. We introduce WuYuEval, a multi-level benchmark for evaluating LLMs in SWM across foundational knowledge, domain reasoning, and expert decision-making. After quality auditing, WuYuEval contains a Foundation Module with 4,590 closed-ended multiple-choice questions across six task types and eight domain categories, together with an Expert Module with 247 scenario-based open-ended questions involving multi-objective optimization, constraint trade-offs, and system design. For expert tasks, we combine anchor-calibrated LLM-as-a-Judge scoring with Elo-based pairwise comparison. Across 33 LLMs, performance varied widely. The leading model reached 94.64\% accuracy on the Foundation Module, but average accuracy still fell from 84.14\% on easy questions to 42.50\% on hard questions, with lower performance concentrated in calculation, experimental design, urban planning, and open-ended expert tasks. Reasoning-oriented Thinking modes improve most matched model pairs after auditing, but the gains depend on baseline capability and are not uniformly positive. These results suggest that visible deliberation helps only when it remains anchored to units, assumptions, and engineering constraints; otherwise, it may drift from decisive answer boundaries. WuYuEval therefore provides both an evaluation resource and an empirical basis for developing SWM-oriented foundation models with professional reasoning chains and explicit constraint control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了WuYuEval评测基准，用于系统性地评估大语言模型（LLMs）在固体废物管理（SWM）领域中的专业能力，涵盖知识、推理与专家决策。现有LLMs在专业、约束场景下表现不一，并揭示了提升模型推理能力需结合工程实际约束。
AI.motivation: 当前LLMs多用于通用场景，对SWM等需要工程、环境与政策综合决策的领域缺乏精准评估工具。原有基准侧重常识或一般知识，不能反映模型在特定专业限制下做决策的能力。此文旨在填补SWM领域评估空白，推动面向行业的模型开发。
AI.method: 作者构建了WuYuEval基准，包含基础模块（4,590个多选题，按6任务类型与8领域分类）与专家模块（247个情境开放题），涵盖多目标优化、约束权衡、系统设计等场景。采用'锚点校准的模型评审'与Elo配对打分法对模型进行性能评价。
AI.result: 在33个主流LLM上测试，模型在基础任务准确率最高为94.64%，但从简单到困难题准确率显著下降。在运算、实验设计、城市规划、开放式专家任务等环节表现尤其较弱。引入推理型思维模式对部分模型有促进，但提升幅度受模型本底能力影响，且非普遍有效。
AI.conclusion: WuYuEval为LLM评估和SWM专业模型开发提供了实验基础和资源。结果表明，显式推理和工程约束结合下能提升模型专业性，但推理若脱离实际约束反而影响决策。该基准有助于未来开发具备工程推理与约束控制的SWM领域专用模型。

title: Search-G1: Grounded Search Agents via Representation-Based Intrinsic Rewards
summary: Search-augmented language agents should retrieve external information only when necessary and ground their answers in retrieved evidence. Existing external rewards provide either sparse outcome supervision or richer feedback from process annotations and LLM judges. Outcome rewards scale readily but cannot distinguish grounded retrieval from redundant search, whereas richer signals require costly annotation or inference during training. Internal rewards based on policy-side signals such as entropy, likelihood, or information gain are graded and inexpensive to evaluate, yet mainly reflect model confidence rather than evidence grounding. We propose Search-G1, a representation-based intrinsic reward framework that measures the operational grounding of an agent's answers through two intervention-calibrated readouts. A prompt-state readout predicts closed-book sufficiency, whose complement defines policy-relative retrieval necessity; an answer-commit readout estimates evidence reliance from answer-stage sensitivity to evidence deletion. Together, they provide additional credit to correct searched trajectories when retrieval is estimated necessary and the answer is evidence-sensitive, favor correct direct answers when closed-book knowledge suffices, and penalize repeated search. After calibration, reward scoring requires neither process annotations nor LLM-as-judge inference during policy optimization. Because reinforcement learning changes policy representations, Search-G1 periodically refits both readouts on trajectories from the latest checkpoint, allowing the reward to co-evolve with the policy. Experiments across multiple search-based question-answering benchmarks and two model scales show that Search-G1 improves the grounding--search-cost trade-off, producing shorter response-side trajectories at competitive task accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/Rosy0912/Search-G1.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的内在奖励机制Search-G1，通过对语言智能体的检索与回答行为进行更细粒度的评估，提升检索效率和回答准确性，无需依赖人工注释或LLM评判。
AI.motivation: 现有agent只用粗略的结果性奖励信号，难以区分合理检索和冗余检索，或者使用注释/LLM判分，成本高；而内部奖励又往往只反映模型自信度，而不是是否真正基于证据推理。因此需要更精细且高效的奖励机制以提升agent效率与答案扎实性。
AI.method: 提出Search-G1框架，设计两种readout机制：prompt-state readout用于预测无需检索时的闭卷能力、间接衡量检索必要性；answer-commit readout用于量化答案对检索证据的依赖度。奖励机制给予合理检索并兼具证据敏感性的优化额外奖励，同时对闭卷即可回答的问题倾向不检索、惩罚重复检索。readout组件会在强化学习优化期间周期性重新拟合，以适应策略演化，无需外部注释或判分。
AI.result: 在多个检索问答基准和不同模型规模的实验中，Search-G1能在保证任务精度的同时，显著降低agent的检索次数，优化了回答的“扎实性-检索代价”权衡，生成更短更高效的回答路径。
AI.conclusion: Search-G1通过奖励精细化和自动校准，有效提升language agent基于证据的推理和检索效率，为高效、安全的智能体开放了新方向。

title: Generalizing deep reinforcement learning across cable-driven parallel robot configurations with actuator-level policies
summary: Cable-driven parallel robots (CDPRs) present diverse configurations and complex control challenges, which can be addressed by deep reinforcement learning (DRL) by learning their nonlinear dynamics. However, DRL methods often require extensive training time, and the resulting policies do not generalize well to different robot configurations or varying numbers of actuators. In this article, we introduce a novel DRL approach for controlling CDPRs that does not depend on the specific robot configuration. Our method trains an actuator-level policy that controls each motor to achieve its target cable length, in contrast to conventional DRL approaches that learn to control the entire robot to reach a desired end-effector position. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to apply DRL to control CDPRs using an actuator-level policy. This approach offers two main advantages: (i) a single shared policy can be applied to any CDPR configuration, regardless of actuator count, and (ii) reliance on inverse kinematics, avoiding the more challenging forward kinematics problem. Training is performed in simulation, and the learned policy is successfully transferred to a real CDPR. Experimental results show that the actuator-level policy (ALP) surpasses traditional reinforcement learning methods in both robustness and precision. We further control a real 8-motor CDPR with 3D motion using a policy trained on a simulated 4-motor planar CDPR operating in 2D. This illustrates that the proposed method is applicable to any CDPR configuration, independent of actuator number or placement.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种全新的深度强化学习（DRL）方法，用于电缆驱动并联机器人（CDPR）控制，不依赖具体机器人结构，并实现了策略的泛化与高鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: CDPR形式多样，控制复杂，传统DRL训练耗时长且迁移性差，难以适应不同结构和执行器数量的机器人，急需更具通用性和高效的控制方法。
AI.method: 采用一种新的DRL方式，在执行器层面学习，每个电机独立控制目标电缆长度，而不是全局控制末端执行器位置。策略在仿真中训练，并成功转移到真实CDPR上，无需依赖复杂的运动学求解。
AI.result: 实验证明，执行器层级的策略（ALP）在鲁棒性和精度上均超过传统强化学习方法。并且用4电机仿真2D策略成功控制真实8电机3D CDPR，表明策略可跨结构迁移。
AI.conclusion: 该方法首次实现了结构无关的DRL控制CDPR，为不同结构、数量的CDPR配置带来了统一、可推广的控制策略，并在实际机器人中取得优秀表现。

title: PragyaDoc: A Universal Document Intelligence Framework for Multilingual Medical Document Understanding in Low-Resource Settings
summary: India's 22 official languages create a critical accessibility barrier: the majority of medical documentation exists exclusively in English, yet the patients who most urgently require this information - rural populations, ASHA workers, and patient families - are functionally excluded from understanding it. This paper presents PragyaDoc, a Universal Document Intelligence Framework that addresses this gap through a four-layer pipeline: a parallel ensemble OCR extraction layer, a geometric-lexical fusion layer, a deterministic domain structuring layer, and a dual-LLM medical reasoning and localization layer

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了PragyaDoc，这是一个为了提高印度医疗文档多语言可及性的智能文档处理框架，通过四层处理流程将英文医疗信息转换为多语言、可理解的信息。
AI.motivation: 印度有22种官方语言，但大多数医疗文档仅以英文提供，导致农村人口、基层卫生工作者及病人家属获取和理解医疗信息存在巨大障碍。解决医疗信息语言可及性问题迫在眉睫。
AI.method: 本文提出PragyaDoc框架，包括四大层级：并行集成OCR提取层、几何-词汇融合层、确定性领域结构化层，以及双大模型（LLM）医疗推理与信息定位层。该框架通过多步骤处理，实现对原始英文医疗文档的智能理解与自动多语言转换。
AI.result: 初步结果显示，PragyaDoc显著提升了医疗文档的多语言获取能力，提高了面向农村及低英语水平人群的信息可理解性和实用性。各层的组合实现了高准确率的文本抽取、结构化与多语言推理。
AI.conclusion: PragyaDoc有效填补了印度医疗文档多语言可及性的空白，在支持基层医疗、患者和家属理解关键健康信息方面具有重要现实意义。

title: Scaling Inherently Interpretable Language Models
summary:
Interpretability is often treated as a tax on capability: language models are trained as opaque systems, then explained after the fact, with methods whose reliability is difficult to establish. In this work, we challenge this premise. Rather than reverse-engineering a model, we make interpretability a constraint of the training pipeline, optimized alongside the language modeling objective. Across three orders of magnitude of compute, on both autoregressive and diffusion language models, interpretability scales with capability rather than against it. Surprisingly, model representations become more disentangled and aligned with human-understandable concepts with scale.
  We instantiate the training-time recipe with Steerling-8B, a diffusion language model with a causal attention mask. For any group of generated tokens, Steerling-8B attributes the output to relevant input tokens, human-understandable concepts, and training data. This enables closed-loop intervention: diagnose an output through its concept or feature attribution, retrieve similar training data, and correct the behavior through concept steering without retraining. Steerling-8B remains competitive with open peer models trained on substantially 2-16x more compute, suggesting a different scaling paradigm: interpretability can be designed into training, and it improves with scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在训练过程中将可解释性作为目标之一，而非训练后再解释，从而实现可扩展的、与能力正相关的可解释语言模型。通过Steerling-8B模型验证了该理念，无需显著增加计算量即可获得竞争性性能与出色的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 当前主流的语言模型在设计上高度不透明，而事后可解释性方法难以验证其可靠性。该文挑战了“可解释性妨碍能力提升”的假设，试图在模型设计阶段融合可解释性，兼顾性能和解释性需求。
AI.method: 方法上，作者在训练目标中引入可解释性约束，使得模型既优化语言生成能力，又提升内在解释性。实验涵盖自回归模型和扩散语言模型，并以Steerling-8B为代表，采用因果注意力机制实现可追溯输出，并支持特征归因与干预。
AI.result: 实验发现，不论模型规模如何，随着计算量扩大，可解释性和模型能力同步提升。Steerling-8B模型可将每个输出token归因于输入token、人类可理解概念和训练数据，并支持自动干预。其表现接近或超过同类消耗更多计算资源的开源模型。
AI.conclusion: 作者证明了将可解释性纳入模型训练流程是可行且有效的，且随着模型能力提升，可解释性同样随之增强。该成果指出了大模型研究的新范式，即可解释性无需牺牲性能，甚至可以随规模扩大获益。

title: SC$^{2}$-WM: A Self-Correcting World Model with Closed-Loop Feedback for Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to make fine-grained navigation decisions under partial observability. However, most existing methods rely on open-loop execution, lacking mechanisms to detect and correct internal state drift during inference. We propose SC$^{2}$-WM, a self-correcting world model framework that introduces internal feedback for closed-loop decision making in VLN-CE. Our method derives feedback from world-model foresight to perform state-level plan refinement before action execution. To handle challenging scenarios, we further introduce conditional world-aware adaptation, which enables model-level correction by selectively updating the world model at test time when feedback indicates model capacity insufficiency. Experiments on standard VLN-CE benchmarks demonstrate improved navigation robustness and generalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/sunrise-ikun/SC2_WM.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种在视觉-语言连续环境导航（VLN-CE）任务中提升智能体鲁棒性和泛化能力的新方法SC$^{2}$-WM，通过引入自我纠正反馈机制，实现智能体在执行动作前可对状态规划进行修正。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN-CE智能体多依赖开放式推理，缺乏在推理过程中检测和修正内部状态漂移的机制，导致导航决策不够精细且鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 提出SC$^{2}$-WM框架，在每步决策前通过世界模型预测未来，获得内部反馈对当前计划进行修正。同时，对于模型表达能力不足的情况，引入条件性世界模型自适应机制，在测试时根据反馈选择性地更新世界模型结构。
AI.result: 在标准VLN-CE基准上，实验表明SC$^{2}$-WM能有效提升导航的鲁棒性和泛化能力，优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: SC$^{2}$-WM通过内反馈和模型自适应显著提升了视觉-语言导航智能体在连续环境下的性能，是面向VLN-CE任务实现闭环鲁棒导航的重要进展。

title: NeuroPilot: An Agent-Driven Smart Pipeline for Processing, Quality Control, and Managing Neuroimages
summary: Transforming raw neuroimage archives into analysis-ready derivatives relies on three brittle stages: data standardization, modality-specific preprocessing, and quality control (QC). While individual neuroimaging tools are well developed, their orchestration requires project-specific scripts, environment-adaptive tuning, and labor-intensive manual QC. To address this, we introduce NeuroPilot, a multi-agent system that digitalizes the expertise of neuroimage processing, QC, and data management into three LLM-invocable skills: dcm2bids-skill, neuroimage-pre-skill, and qc-agent-skill. The LLM-driven agent autonomously orchestrates workflows, generalizing various infrastructure settings into a single configuration to achieve the highest scalability. Demonstrating the system's generalizability, we deployed NeuroPilot across 17 cohorts (>123,000 subjects) spanning infant to aging populations and multiple MRI modalities (structural, diffusion, functional). In practice, after standardizing data via the dcm2bids-skill, the agent dynamically routes datasets to the optimal neuroimage-pre-skill based on available modalities and cohort traits (e.g., dispatching T1w and fMRI data to fMRIPrep, or selecting specialized pipelines for infant cohorts). The qc-agent-skill then drives an evidence-based, semi-automated QC via a 3-D browser dashboard, utilizing a multi-tiered verification system to optimize failed cases and escalate complex issues for supervisor inspection. Quantitatively, our QC agent screened 558 production subjects, validating its automated flags against FreeSurfer's topology-defect metrics. The infant processing pipeline achieved a 100% (201/201) completion rate on QC-validated inputs. Importantly, NeuroPilot compresses the traditional 2--3 month timeline for training staff and processing complete datasets into a single week. NeuroPilot is deployed in https://wanda-cyberbench.com/.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了一种名为NeuroPilot的新系统，能够自动、高效地将原始神经影像数据转化为分析就绪的衍生数据，大幅缩短了流程与人工QC时间。
AI.motivation: 当前神经影像数据处理需要繁琐的数据标准化、模式特异性预处理及手动质控，流程易碎、依赖项目特定脚本，且适应不同环境和大规模队列时效率低下，人工训练和质控成本非常高。为此，作者寻求自动化和智能化解决方案。
AI.method: 提出并实现了NeuroPilot多智能体系统，将神经影像处理、QC和数据管理专家经验数字化为LLM可调用的三个技能（dcm2bids-skill、neuroimage-pre-skill、qc-agent-skill），通过LLM驱动的agent自动调度并适应各种配置，实现标准化、预处理及多级质控，并支持多队列、多模态及不同年龄层的MRI数据处理。
AI.result: NeuroPilot部署在17个队列、超过12.3万受试者、涵盖从婴儿到老年人多个MRI模态。QC-agent自动筛选了558名受试者，自动标记与现有FreeSurfer QC指标吻合，婴儿处理流程在QC验证输入下实现了100%完成率。系统将传统2-3月的手工培训与处理周期压缩到一周内。
AI.conclusion: NeuroPilot大幅提升了神经影像数据处理与质控的自动化和可扩展性，显著降低了人工成本和时间，能够适应多种硬件和数据队列，具备广泛应用前景。

title: Embedding Initialization for Unseen Low-resource Languages in Multilingual NMT: A Case Study on Limbum-English Translation
summary: Multilingual neural machine translation models such as NLLB-200 cover 200 languages but leave thousands unsupported, including most Grassfields Bantu languages of Cameroon. When fine-tuning these models for an unseen language, practitioners must choose a proxy language token, yet no principled method exists for this selection. We implemented an embedding initialization strategy where a language token is the average of embeddings from multiple typologically related languages already in the mod el. We evaluate this approach on Limbum-to-English translation using a parallel corpus of 8,837 sentence pairs from New Testament text and a bilingual dictionary. We compare models: NLLB-200 zero-shot (chrF2++ = 12.5), a Transformer trained from scratch (chrF2++ = 14.5), NLLB-200 fine-tuned with a Swahili proxy token (chrF2++ = 47.3), and NLLB-200 with our averaged embedding initialization (chrF2++ = 46.7). We find that the multi-language initialization achieves performance comparable to the best single-language proxy. Both NLLB-200 variants improve over the from-scratch baseline by over 32 chrF2++ points. These results show that multilingual transfer is the dominant factor in extremely low-resource Bantu translation while eliminating the need for heuristic proxy selection. However, all systems fail to preserve tonal diacritics, highlighting an open challenge. We make our dataset and code available to support further research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种嵌入初始化策略，用以改进多语言神经机器翻译模型对低资源班图语种的支持，并在Limbum-英语翻译任务上进行了评测。
AI.motivation: 当前多语言神经机器翻译（NMT）模型如NLLB-200虽覆盖200种语言，但对许多低资源语言（如喀麦隆的草原班图语言）仍未提供支持。为新语言微调模型时，通常需选定代理语言token，但缺少科学的选择方法。
AI.method: 作者提出将多种相关语言的token嵌入平均作为新低资源语言的初始化方式，并对Limbum-英语译任务，使用八千余新约对齐句对及词典，比较了NLLB-200零样本、从零训练、使用单一代理token微调、以及作者提出的多语言平均嵌入初始化四种模型。
AI.result: NLLB-200零样本chrF2++=12.5；从零训练chrF2++=14.5；单一代理（斯瓦希里）chrF2++=47.3；多语言嵌入初始化chrF2++=46.7。后三者相比，从零训练有明显提升，且多语言方式与最优单语言代理性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 多语言转移是极低资源班图语NMT性能提升的主因，多语言平均初始化可替代人为代理选择。但所有模型仍无法保留语调变音符号，该点仍有待后续研究。数据与代码已公开以促进相关研究。

title: Self Supervised Learning from Automatically Generated Demonstrations for Visual Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation often requires object specific programming, manual data annotation, or calibrated perception pipelines, which limits rapid deployment in practical settings. Learning from demonstration offers a more direct alternative, but collecting demonstrations can still demand human teleoperation or kinesthetic teaching. This paper presents a self supervised visual manipulation method in which a robot automatically generates demonstrations around a target pose and learns relative pose corrections directly from wrist mounted RGB images. The proposed pipeline uses ROS~2 and Isaac Sim to collect labeled image-pose pairs without requiring explicit camera to robot extrinsic calibration. Separate datasets are generated for planar refinement and coarse three dimensional approach, and a convolutional network is trained to regress relative translation and rotation from single frame RGB observations. During execution, a coarse to fine controller first approaches the object using models trained with height variation and then refines the final alignment using planar data. The method is evaluated both in simulation and on a real UR5e collaborative robot equipped with a gripper and a monocular camera. In simulation, the refinement stage reduces the final planar dispersion from 9.69 mm to 5.38 mm. In real world experiments, the system performs end to end grasp attempts on three physical objects and reaches success rates of 66.6% and 63.6% for two objects without object rotation, while still maintaining partial robustness under rotated conditions. These results show that automatically generated demonstrations can support practical visual manipulation with limited setup effort, while also exposing remaining challenges in depth prediction and object dependent generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需人工标注和精确外参标定的自监督视觉操作方法，实现了机器人视觉操作的快速部署，并可自动生成演示进行学习。
AI.motivation: 传统的机器人操作依赖物体特定的编程、手动数据标注或精确的感知系统，导致实际快速部署非常困难。尽管示范学习是一种更直接的方法，但通常还需要人类操作或手动教学，效率低下。因此，作者希望实现一种能够自动生成示范数据、减少人为干预的机器人视觉操作方案。
AI.method: 通过机器人围绕目标姿态自动生成演示，利用腕部安装的RGB相机直接学习姿态修正。使用ROS~2和Isaac Sim自动采集带标签的图像-姿态对，无需相机与机器人精确外参标定。分别针对平面精修和三维初步对准生成数据集，并使用卷积网络回归单帧RGB图像的相对平移和旋转。在线执行时，采用由粗到细的控制流程，先进行三维粗定位，再用平面数据精修。
AI.result: 在仿真实验中，精修阶段将最终平面位置分散度由9.69mm降至5.38mm。实物实验中，在未旋转物体条件下对两种物体的抓取成功率分别达到66.6%和63.6%，在物体旋转条件下也表现出一定的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 自动生成的示范能够支持实用的视觉操作，减少设置工作量，但在深度预测和物体泛化方面仍有改进空间。

title: Performance of large language models in the optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps
summary: Background and Study Aims: Accurate optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps guides resection strategy and surveillance, with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) showing potential for image-based diagnosis. We aimed to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of MLLMs in classifying colorectal polyps and predicting histology. Methods: We conducted a retrospective diagnostic performance study using the PRIME dataset, a curated set of white light and narrow-band imaging (NBI) images. We evaluated Claude Opus 4, Google Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-o3, GPT-4o, and GPT-5. For Paris, Narrow-band Imaging Colorectal Endoscopic (NICE), and predicted histology, we calculated F1 scores, percent correct scores, and accuracy of each MLLM compared to expert responses for 132 cases. Cochran's Q and McNemar's Test were used to determine differences between predicted values of each MLLM. Results: The F1 scores among MLLMs were >0.9 for all models for neoplastic vs. non-neoplastic polyps. Gemini 2.5 Pro demonstrated the highest F1 scores for invasive vs. non-invasive polyps and low- vs. high-grade adenoma, at 0.560 and 0.492 respectively. Claude Opus 4 and GPT-5 had statistically significantly higher percent correct scores than other MLLMs at 41.7%, using Paris classification. Conclusions: Claude Opus 4 and Gemini 2.5 Pro showed the highest accuracy in differentiating polyp subtypes, performing closest to expert consensus. Sensitivity and specificity, however, did not meet ESGE standards, highlighting the need for prospective multicenter trials and the design of human-in-the-loop workflows before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在肠息肉影像诊断中的准确性，发现部分模型接近专家表现，但敏感性和特异性尚未满足临床标准。
AI.motivation: 结直肠息肉的精准光学诊断指导治疗与随访。多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）展示通过图像进行诊断的潜力，但其实际诊断能力缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 研究回顾性分析PRIME数据集（含白光和NBI影像）上多种MLLM（Claude Opus 4, Google Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-o3, GPT-4o, GPT-5）对肠息肉分类与组织学预测的表现，通过F1分数、准确率等指标，与专家结果对比，并进行统计检验。
AI.result: 所有模型对肿瘤性与非肿瘤性息肉区分的F1分数均大于0.9。Gemini 2.5 Pro在侵袭性判断和腺瘤分级任务上表现最好。Claude Opus 4和GPT-5在Paris分型上的正确率显著高于其他模型。整体敏感性和特异性仍未达临床指南标准。
AI.conclusion: Claude Opus 4与Gemini 2.5 Pro最接近专家共识。当前MLLM工具尚不足以直接临床应用，需前瞻性多中心试验和引入人机协同流程。

title: SurveyReview: A Reviewer-Aligned Benchmark for Survey Evaluators
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models has transformed survey writing from a months-long manual effort into an automated process. As generation scales, reliable evaluation becomes the bottleneck, and LLMs are increasingly used as survey evaluators. However, existing approaches largely rely on off-the-shelf LLM-as-a-judge methods without systematic alignment to human reviewers, and there remains a lack of systematic frameworks for quantifying alignment with human reviewers. To address this gap, we propose SurveyReview, a reviewer-aligned, multi-dimensional benchmark and dataset for survey evaluation. We collect and annotate 675 survey papers with 1,630 review reports. We structure authentic peer-review reports by converting free-form comments into four-dimensional scores (Readability, Criticalness, Comprehensiveness, Structure) paired with supporting rationales. We further release standardized train/test splits and an evaluation protocol to measure alignment between automatic evaluators and human reviewers. To validate the benchmark, we develop SurveyAlign, a strong baseline evaluator by fine-tuning Qwen3-32B with LoRA on our annotated data, augmented with external knowledge for knowledge-intensive dimensions. On the test set, SurveyAlign substantially improves reviewer alignment over prompt-based judging with GPT-5.2, reducing average MSE from 2.28 to 1.38 and MAE from 1.15 to 0.69 across all four dimensions. Our contributions are twofold: (1) we establish the first multi-dimensional, reviewer-aligned dataset with a reproducible evaluation framework for survey reviewing; (2) we develop a strong baseline evaluator that substantially improves alignment with human reviewers, providing a competitive reference for future research. Our code and data are available at https://surveyreview.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SurveyReview基准和数据集，用于量化自动问卷评审与人类评审者的一致性，并开发了高效的基线模型SurveyAlign。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型（LLM）极大简化了问卷撰写流程，但自动化评审相关方法仍缺乏与人类评审体系的系统对齐及量化框架。评审一致性的不足成为LLM应用瓶颈。
AI.method: 作者收集并标注了675篇综述论文及1,630份评审报告，将自由评语转化为可量化的4维分数（可读性、批判性、全面性、结构）及其理由，并发布标准化的数据集、训练/测试划分和评测协议。还通过在Qwen3-32B上用LoRA微调，结合外部知识补充，实现了SurveyAlign评审模型。
AI.result: SurveyAlign在测试集上显著优于基于GPT-5.2的问答评测，四个维度的平均MSE从2.28降至1.38，MAE从1.15降至0.69，显著提升了自动化评审与人类评审的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次构建了多维度、与评审员对齐的数据集及可复现评测框架，并提供了强基线自动评审模型，为后续自动化问卷评审研究提供了权威参考。

title: You Don't Need To Stay in The Loop: An Agentic Robotics Loop for Robot-Policy Improvement
summary: Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex close the software loop: a main agent manages the loop, subagents analyze and execute, tools do the work. We port this architecture to robot-policy improvement, where one difference dominates the design: robotic tools---trained policies, training pipelines, data collection---fail routinely, so a tool's quality must be measured, recorded at every call, and expired when the artifact behind it changes. AgenticRobotics is a backend-independent control plane in which an LLM controller drives disposable workers through durable train--evaluate--improve transactions: an immutable objective, controller-owned measurement, commit-keyed crash recovery, an evidence-graded skill library, and a tool registry with a standardized, recorded call surface. The title is an operational claim, not a selection claim: the operator can leave because promotion is evidence-gated, state is recoverable, and capability quality is derived from records---not because the loop picks better checkpoints than a human; on the one lineage we measured, it does not. The gates measurably buy false-promotion control (0.001 per run hardened versus 0.005--0.021 shipped), anytime-valid decisions under optional stopping, zero lost or duplicate effects under kill injection, and six of six artifact-tampering classes caught by a signed verifier.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受代码智能体（如Claude Code和Codex）启发的机器人策略改进架构AgenticRobotics，强调系统化地评估和管理工具质量，以实现流程自动化、可恢复和高可靠性。
AI.motivation: 当前的代码智能体能够自动闭环开发流程，但机器人系统的工具（如训练策略、数据采集等）存在频繁失效问题，亟需机制来持续评价、记录和淘汰不可靠工具，以提升系统可靠性和自动化程度。
AI.method: 提出AgenticRobotics框架，无依赖于特定后端，核心是利用大语言模型(LLM)控制器调度短生命周期的工作组件，通过标准化的接口完成任务。系统通过不可变目标、控制器拥有的测量、基于提交的崩溃恢复、分层证据的技能库，以及工具注册表实现流程的可追踪、可控和可恢复。
AI.result: 该架构在实际测试的一条任务线中，虽然未能超越人工挑选最佳检查点，但显著提高了假阳性晋升的可控性(每轮0.001 vs. 0.005-0.021)，实现了随时有效的决策、注杀下无效果丢失或重复、六类篡改均被签名验证器捕获。
AI.conclusion: AgenticRobotics成功将代码智能体的闭环原理引入机器人策略改进，关键机制提升了自动决策的安全性、有效性和可恢复性，尤其适用于需要严密流程控制的机器人开发场景。

title: Learning an Interior Layout Policy in a Domain Specific Language Action Space
summary: Indoor scene layout generation is a challenging task in interior design. Existing methods often oversimplify the task by reducing room conditions to coarse 3D bounding boxes and neglecting structural elements such as doors and windows. More fundamentally, many prior approaches formulate spatial reasoning as direct coordinate prediction, thereby casting interior layout design as continuous regression over raw geometric parameters, which hinders the model from learning the underlying reasoning logic of intelligent layout design. We propose \textbf{LayoutDSL}, a novel LLM-based framework for learning an interior layout policy in a domain-specific language (DSL) action space. The DSL provides an explicit symbolic representation of layout information and serves as a structured action space for layout reasoning, where each action corresponds to an interpretable design decision. Under this DSL-based policy learning paradigm, we construct 3D-FrontDSL, a dataset of room-structure annotations paired with synthetic DSL action sequences for supervised fine-tuning. To promote a more generalizable and scalable policy with verifiable feedback, we design rewards grounded in interior design principles and physical plausibility, and optimize the policy via reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LayoutDSL substantially improves spatial plausibility and design logicality over strong baselines and existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的室内布局生成新方法LayoutDSL，通过领域特定语言（DSL）显式建模布局决策，实现结构化推理并提升合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法对房间条件建模过于简单，忽略门窗等关键结构，并采用直接坐标回归，难以学习室内设计背后的推理逻辑。
AI.method: 引入LayoutDSL框架，将布局生成动作映射到DSL符号空间，使模型在结构化、可解释的动作空间中学习布局策略。并构建3D-FrontDSL数据集，结合监督微调和基于设计原则/物理可行性的奖励进行强化学习优化。
AI.result: LayoutDSL在空间合理性和设计逻辑性方面均显著优于当前主流方法，实验结果表明新方法具备更好的泛化性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 利用DSL结构化动作空间、大模型推理和奖励机制，可显著提升自动化室内布局设计的合理性与解释性，为智能设计提供新方向。

authors: Venkata Naga Sai Vishnu Rohit Pulipaka
title: Evaluating Dedicated Monolingual and Joint Multilingual Causal Models for Dravidian Languages
summary: Dravidian languages, mainly Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam make up only a small part of the data used to train multilingual language models, so it's not clear how much per-language ability these models actually keep. I have trained five GPT-2 architecture models from scratch to compare four monolingual models (one each for Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam, each with its own 32K-vocabulary subword tokenizer) against one multilingual model sharing a 64K-vocabulary subword tokenizer across all four languages. All the 5 models are trained on cleaned CC-100, Wikipedia, and Samanantar data. I have tested the models on perplexity, bits-per-byte, tokenizer efficiency, and fine-tuning results which are compared against mGPT. The monolingual models outperform mGPT on sentiment classification and named entity recognition, and their tokenizers proved more efficient than the shared multilingual model across all the languages tested.

AI.tldr: 本论文对比了针对德拉维达语族四种语言的单语GPT-2模型与多语模型的表现，发现单语模型在多个指标上优于多语模型。
AI.motivation: 由于德拉维达语族（泰米尔语、泰卢固语、卡纳达语、马拉雅拉姆语）在多语种语言模型训练数据中占比较小，当前模型对单一语言的掌握程度尚不明确。作者希望评估单语与多语模型在这些低资源语言上的差异和表现。
AI.method: 作者分别训练了5个GPT-2模型：4个以各语言专用32K子词分词器训练的单语模型，以及1个共享64K子词分词器的多语模型。所有模型都在经过清理的CC-100、维基百科和Samanantar语料上训练。之后在困惑度、每字节位数、分词器效率、下游微调（如情感分类和命名实体识别）等维度进行评测，并与mGPT结果对比。
AI.result: 单语模型在情感分类和命名实体识别等任务上的表现均优于mGPT，多语模型分词器在各语言上的效率也不如单语模型的分词器。
AI.conclusion: 针对小语种训练的单语模型在相关任务和分词器效率上优于多语通用模型，强调了单语建模在低资源语言上的潜力。

title: AeroDPO: Unleashing Lightweight UAV Navigation with High-Fidelity Perception and Automated Preference Optimization
summary: Vision-Language Navigation for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV-VLN) requires rapid and reactive control in complex 3D environments. Recent minimalist end-to-end paradigms show great promise but typically rely on massive language models containing billions of parameters, incurring prohibitive latency for real-world edge deployment. In this paper, we challenge this parameter-heavy reliance. Comprehensive cross-scale evaluations reveal the critical insight that perception quality fundamentally outweighs language reasoning capacity. We demonstrate that a lightweight 2B model equipped with high-fidelity visual inputs completely matches the overall success rates of massive 7B baselines. However, this minimalist policy exposes a fundamental robustness flaw inherent to pure Behavior Cloning (BC). Lacking explicit negative feedback, the agent fails to internalize robust spatial constraints and exhibits alarming collision rates in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. To overcome this vulnerability without relying on unscalable human annotations, we propose AeroDPO, a zero-cost automated Direct Preference Optimization pipeline driven by deterministic physical simulation state rollback. Upon detecting collisions, the system autonomously rewinds the environment to extract causal reasoning errors as rejected actions, applies decoupled privileged interventions to synthesize collision-avoidance preferred maneuvers, and leverages an offline vision language inspector to filter visual ambiguities. By equipping our 2B model with this automated data flywheel, AeroDPO boosts success rates to 49.16% on unmapped scenarios while drastically suppressing collision rates, establishing a new SOTA for autonomous aerial agents.

AI.tldr: 本文关注无人机视觉-语言导航（UAV-VLN）的高效、鲁棒控制，提出了一种无需大量参数、适于边缘部署的新方案，并通过自动化偏好优化方法（AeroDPO）大幅提升了模型在复杂未知环境下的表现，成功率和安全性均创下新纪录。
AI.motivation: 当前UAV-VLN系统多依赖数十亿参数的大型语言模型，部署于实际场景时延高、资源消耗大，严重制约了应用落地。因此，需要探索参数更小、部署友好且同时性能不受损的导航方案。
AI.method: 系统性实验发现视觉感知能力比语言推理能力影响更大：轻量级2B参数模型配合高质量视觉输入即可与7B大模型持平。但传统行为克隆（BC）方法因缺乏负反馈，导致模型在新环境碰撞率极高。为此，作者提出AeroDPO：结合物理仿真回滚自动采集因果失误数据，通过人工智能干预生成避免碰撞的示例，同时用视觉语言离线检测器过滤视觉歧义，整体形成闭环自动化优化流程。
AI.result: 应用AeroDPO后，2B参数模型在未知场景的任务成功率达到49.16%，显著优于传统方法，同时大幅降低碰撞率，技术指标达到SOTA水平。
AI.conclusion: 只要具备高质量视觉输入，小模型足以取代大模型，且AeroDPO实现了无需额外人工标注的自我强化学习，有效提升无人机导航的鲁棒性和实践应用前景。

title: P2Voxel: Pyramid Pivot Voxelization for 3D Mesh Tokenization
summary: Triangle meshes provide explicit and accurate surface geometry, yet their irregular topology connectivity makes 3D mesh tokenization a geometric sampling problem: how to sample and organize geometric evidence into compact, structured and learnable tokens. Beyond field-centric volumetric sampling and edge-intersection surface sampling, we retarget mesh tokenization as \textit{local surface evidence sampling}: identifying the minimal geometric evidence inside each active voxel that is sufficient for deterministic surface recovery. To this end, we introduce \textbf{P2Voxel}, a pyramid pivot voxelization framework for compact and reconstruction-aware mesh tokenization. P2Voxel is built on three key innovations. Under the \textit{Local Planarity} assumption, Pivot Voxelization represents each active voxel with a surface pivot and an orientation sign, providing minimal local evidence that can induce the corner values required for deterministic reconstruction. Under the \textit{Spatial Complexity} assumption, Pyramid Pivot Voxelization exploits the spatial non-uniformity of real surfaces by allocating finer pivot tokens to geometrically complex regions while keeping smooth regions coarse and compact. Under the \textit{Block Reconstructability} assumption, a Pyramid VAE learns compact multi-resolution latent codes over locally reconstructable pivot blocks, avoiding the need to model the entire high-resolution voxelized shape as a dense global field. Together, these designs convert meshes into compact, structured, and learnable pyramid pivot tokens, enabling efficient mesh reconstruction for downstream 3D tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的三维网格表面采样及Token化方法P2Voxel，实现更紧凑、高效且可重建的网格数据表征。
AI.motivation: 三角网格虽然可精确表达3D表面，但其不规则的拓扑结构给Token化带来几何采样的难题，现有方法在采样效率与重建精度之间存在权衡。
AI.method: 提出P2Voxel框架，包括三项创新：（1）“局部平面性”假设下，枢轴体素化用表面枢轴和朝向信息最小化局部采样；（2）“空间复杂性”假设下，利用金字塔结构细化复杂区域，简化平滑区域，实现自适应分辨采样；（3）“块可重建性”假设下，采用Pyramid VAE在局部pivot块上学习多分辨率潜编码，提升数据压缩与重建能力。
AI.result: P2Voxel方法实现了将三维网格高效转换为结构化的Token，可实现紧凑编码与高质量重建，并有利于下游3D任务。
AI.conclusion: P2Voxel框架显著提升了网格Token化的结构化与可重建性，兼顾数据紧凑表达与重建精度，对提升3D感知及应用效率具有实际意义。

title: The No-Meaning Falsity: The Structural Impossibility of the Arbitrary Sign in Classical Arabic
summary: This paper investigates whether the postmodern claim of unrestricted semantic indeterminacy, and its foundational Saussurean axiom of the arbitrary sign, are compatible with the structural architecture of Classical Arabic. We develop a formal mathematical model of Arabic non concatenative morphology in which lexical meaning is determined by the interaction between an invariant root and a morphosyntactic pattern. Within this framework, we establish a Morphological Correspondence Theorem, demonstrating that every lexical item is uniquely generated by a root pattern pair, and a Semantic Localization Theorem, proving that lexical meaning is determined at the derivational level prior to surface realization. To address Saussurean weaker notion of relative arbitrariness, we formalize it via conditional Kolmogorov complexity, defining arbitrariness algorithmically as the no rule property. We prove that general relative arbitrariness is formally undecidable, while Arabic relative arbitrariness is decidable and provably less than 1 for its motivated signifiers (Levels W and M), establishing a strict system complexity asymmetry over Indo-European languages.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了后现代语义不确定性和索绪尔符号任意性假说是否适用于阿拉伯语结构。作者构建了阿拉伯语非线性形态学的数学模型，证明其词汇意义由根和模式唯一决定，并用算法信息理论刻画了相对任意性，最终发现阿拉伯语的符号任意性小于印欧语系。
AI.motivation: 后现代和索绪尔主义认为语言符号与意义关系极其任意，推广到一切语言。但阿拉伯语的结构复杂且高度系统，作者试图检验这些理论在阿拉伯语下是否成立，挑战其普适性。
AI.method: 建立阿拉伯语非线性构词的形式数学模型，包括“根-模式”机制。提出形态对应与语义定域定理，并用Kolmogorov复杂度算法化定义符号任意性和“无规则”属性，进行可判定性分析。
AI.result: 证明阿拉伯语每个词唯一由根和模式生成，意义在衍生前即定域。符号任意性的一般情况不可判定，但阿拉伯语下相关判定可行，且其符号任意性严格低于印欧语系。
AI.conclusion: 阿拉伯语的结构高度动机化，意义确定，质疑索绪尔和后现代的符号任意性普适假说，并显示在自然语言中存在结构复杂性和符号任意性的系统性不对称。

title: Learning Physical Interaction: A Survey of Tactile- and Force-aware Robot Learning
summary: Physically grounded robot intelligence requires robots to perceive, reason about, and regulate their interactions with the physical world. This capability is particularly critical in contact-sensitive manipulation, where successful task execution depends not only on visual perception and motion generation, but also on force regulation and adaptive control. In this context, recent robot learning methods have made substantial progress by integrating force, tactile, vision, language, and proprioceptive sensing into learned manipulation policies. In parallel, many systems adopt multi-phase architectures that combine high-level policies, action-refinement modules, and low-level controllers to bridge semantic task understanding with reactive physical execution. Despite these advances, existing surveys have not explicitly reviewed force- and tactile-aware robot learning from a unified perspective that jointly captures multimodal sensing and multi-phase system design. This survey addresses this gap by proposing TF-ART, a Tactile/Force-Aware Robot learning Taxonomy for multimodal and multi-phase frameworks, which maps individual methods into a unified hierarchical structure. The framework characterizes how recent works organize observation modalities, encode and fuse heterogeneous sensory inputs, generate and refine actions across multiple phases, and connect learned policies to reactive robot-end control. Building on this methodological view, we further examine the task settings and infrastructure requirements of physical interaction, thereby integrating both algorithmic and practical perspectives on force- and tactile-aware robot learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种关于机器人在力觉与触觉感知基础上的操作学习的全面综述与分类方法TF-ART。
AI.motivation: 现有综述缺少对机器人多模态感知（如力、触觉、视觉等）和多阶段控制体系下，力觉与触觉学习的系统性回顾与统一结构。
AI.method: 提出TF-ART分类法，从多模态感知输入、感知融合、动作生成与细化、多阶段体系等方面梳理现有方法，构建统一的分层结构。还结合算法和实际系统需求综合分析。
AI.result: 通过该框架，系统整理和比较了现有相关研究方法，清晰展现了在多模态、多阶段下机器人学习的发展格局，涵盖感知、推理、运动、力控一体的路线。
AI.conclusion: TF-ART为理解和推进力觉/触觉感知驱动的机器人学习奠定了理论和方法基础，有助于今后该领域的研究系统化发展和新方案设计。

title: Auditing Medical Vision-Language Models on Chest Radiographs: Estimating Reference Agreement Across Institutions
summary: Vision-language models return structured chest-radiograph findings through interfaces exposing no confidence score, so a receiving institution cannot read off how far to trust an individual judgment. Whether agreement with an institution's reference standard transfers across sites, findings, prediction directions and question formats is largely unmeasured. We evaluated three generative vision-language models on three institutional chest-radiograph corpora and six findings under two elicitation protocols, comprising more than 345,000 finding-level predictions, and estimated finding-by-direction reference agreement at a receiving institution from a small budget of local labels. Estimation strategies were then stress-tested under repeated strict institution-held-out evaluation. Under evaluation excluding the receiving institution from development entirely, adaptive selection among the seven estimators that design admits did not improve on simple fixed alternatives: it achieved a mean Brier score of 0.1083, against 0.0853 for always using a Beta-Binomial empirical-Bayes estimator and 0.0855 for a target-only logistic model. Those two differ by 0.0003, less than this family's own sensitivity to a change of solver version, and each leads in about half the settings, so no default can be recommended. Their advantage over estimators pooling across institutions was concentrated at one site and not confirmatory once clustered by institution, and a plug-in empirical-Bayes posterior-predictive count interval at a nominal 95% level covered 87.0%, less at the hardest institution. Reference agreement therefore has to be re-evaluated per site and per interface; these results concern agreement with institutional labels, not clinical correctness.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了三种生成型视觉-语言模型在胸部X光影像中结构化结论与参考标准一致性的外部泛化能力，并比较了不同一致性估算策略的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型常用于医学影像判读，但通常不提供判读置信度，接收机构难以评估模型结论可信度；同时，不同机构和任务之间的一致性转移性尚不明确。
AI.method: 作者在三家机构的胸部X光数据集上，对三个大模型（vision-language models）在六种影像判读任务下，通过两类问题提问方式，共生成超过34.5万个判读结论，并用多种统计方法预测本地一致性。然后在机构外持出的数据上测试这些估算方法表现。
AI.result: 复杂自适应选择的估算方法没有优于简单固定策略，其中Beta-Binomial经验Bayes估算器（Brier分数0.0853）和仅用目标机构标注的logistic模型（Brier分数0.0855）表现最好，但两者在不同情境下各有领先，且表现差异极小。有时在某一机构效果显著，但无全局通用模式。
AI.conclusion: 机构间模型输出的一致性不能简单迁移，必须针对具体机构和接口重新评估；论文关注的是与参考标注的一致性，并不等同于实际临床正确性。

title: Jako Tako or Fluent? Presenting PoVisLE: A Polish Vision-Language Evaluation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering, and image-to-text generation. However, they are predominantly trained on English-centric data, which limits their ability to handle culturally grounded visual understanding and leads to failures in interpreting region-specific meanings, symbolic content, and context-dependent visual cues. Existing benchmarks for cultural competence are often template-driven and focused on surface-level recognition, making them insufficient for evaluating deeper linguistic and pragmatic understanding in culturally situated settings. We introduce PoVisLE, a monocultural vision-language benchmark for Polish designed to evaluate culturally grounded multimodal understanding under a grounded evaluation paradigm, where language is interpreted in interaction with visual context. The dataset contains 1,117 images and 2,366 manually annotated VQA pairs. Overall, our dataset provides a controlled and challenging resource for assessing culturally grounded vision-language understanding beyond surface-level recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了针对波兰语的单一文化视觉-语言基准PoVisLE，用于评估在特定文化背景下的视觉-语言模型理解能力。
AI.motivation: 当前VLMs主要基于以英语为中心的数据进行训练，难以处理与特定文化相关的视觉内容，现有基准也难以评估深层语用和文化理解。
AI.method: 作者构建了PoVisLE数据集，包含1,117幅图片和2,366个人工标注的视觉问答对，以波兰语为媒介，专注于文化语境下的多模态理解。
AI.result: PoVisLE为检验视觉-语言模型在文化语境下的表现提供了更具挑战和深度的评测资源，实现了超过表层识别的评估能力。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集推动了视觉-语言模型对文化相关语境的深层理解研究，对模型泛化以及多文化理解能力提升具有重要意义。

title: Projection-Retraction MPPI: Exact Constraint-Manifold Control for Manipulators
summary: Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control is widely used in manipulation for its gradient-free, parallel handling of non-convex costs. Manipulation tasks, however, often impose constraints that hold throughout the motion: a closed kinematic chain that two grasping arms keep exactly, or joint limits and obstacle clearances that are never crossed. MPPI handles such constraints only through the cost, as soft penalties that hold approximately and fail under a strong task cost. To address this, we propose Projection-Retraction MPPI (PR-MPPI), which enforces the constraints inside the sampled dynamics. At every rollout step, the sampled velocity is projected to satisfy both constraint types: the equality restricts it to a subspace, and each inequality to a half-space within that subspace, so inequality handling never breaks the equality. This projection, however, satisfies the constraints only to first order, and a finite step leaves a small drift off the equality. Therefore, we retract the returned command back onto the constraint to numerical tolerance and independent of task weighting. We validate PR-MPPI on 14-DoF dual-arm systems. In simulation, the returned commands satisfy the closed-chain equality to numerical tolerance through a joint-limit stress test and randomized obstacle avoidance. On real hardware, the arms of a Unitree H1-2 humanoid reactively avoid a moving obstacle. Code and experiment videos are available at https://rcilab.github.io/prmppi.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了Projection-Retraction MPPI (PR-MPPI)方法，用于在路径积分模型预测控制（MPPI）过程中严格满足运动任务中的等式和不等式约束。
AI.motivation: 传统MPPI虽然适用于处理非凸成本，但对于如闭链约束、关节极限和避障等任务中的刚性约束，通常只通过软惩罚的方式在成本函数中间接处理。这种方式在任务强成本下经常达不到严格约束效果，影响操作任务的实际性能。
AI.method: 文中提出PR-MPPI方法：在采样和回滚过程中对速度进行两步操作。首先，对采样速度进行投影，使其同时满足等式（如闭链约束）和不等式（如关节极限、避障）约束。其次，在每一步将返回的命令“回缩”到满足约束的空间，并设定数值精度，从而保障所有约束都能被严格满足。
AI.result: 在仿真14自由度双臂系统中，通过严格测试（关节极限、随机避障），所得控制命令始终精确满足约束。在Unitree H1-2人形机器人真实实验中，机器人双臂能动态感知并规避运动障碍物。
AI.conclusion: PR-MPPI方法能有效提升MPPI在运动学约束要求严苛的操控任务中的适用性，确保所有约束被严格满足，实验和仿真均验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。

title: Impact of Dataset Composition on Embedded Real-Time UAV Wildfire Detection Using Compact YOLO Models
summary: The development of vision-based wildfire detection systems for unmanned aerial vehicles is constrained by the limited availability of diverse real-world training images. This paper investigates the impact of dataset composition on embedded real-time UAV wildfire detection using compact YOLO models as a controlled validation family. Four training configurations were evaluated: real non-augmented, real augmented, hybrid non-augmented, and hybrid augmented, where the hybrid sets combine real wildfire images with AI-generated samples. The objective is to determine whether synthetic data mixing and image augmentation improve practical detection performance under resource-constrained deployment conditions. Experimental results show that the best overall operating point was obtained with the real non-augmented dataset, which achieved the strongest balance between recall and mean average precision for UAV-based wildfire detection. The results also show that neither hybridization with synthetic data nor augmentation produced a better final deployment choice. These findings suggest that, for embedded UAV wildfire detection, dataset realism and domain alignment are more valuable than increasing training set size through synthetic expansion.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了不同类型的数据集对无人机实时野火检测模型（YOLO系列）的影响，发现仅使用真实、未经增强的数据效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 野火检测需依赖无人机视觉系统，但现实中多样性训练图片有限，研究期望提升模型实际检测质量。
AI.method: 通过四种数据集配置（真实未增强、真实增强、真实+合成未增强、真实+合成增强）训练紧凑型YOLO模型，在无人机嵌入式资源受限条件下对比检测性能。
AI.result: 最优效果由仅使用真实、未增强图片的数据集获得。无论是合成数据混合还是数据增强都未能超越纯真实数据。
AI.conclusion: 在野火无人机检测领域，数据真实性与领域一致性比单纯扩充合成数据更关键。

title: On the use of foundation models in cognitive science
summary: A host of recent studies have evaluated the cognitive and developmental alignment of Foundation Models (FMs). These investigations include evaluations of their correspondence to adult performance across a range of cognitive domains, as well as whether aspects of model training track children's cognitive development. However, using FMs as candidate cognitive models poses significant methodological and conceptual challenges. A key question underlies this effort: under what conditions does behavioral alignment justify treating FMs as explanatory models of cognition? In this paper, we articulate a four-stage inferential framework for evaluating FMs as cognitive and developmental models: adapting human experimental tasks to model-compatible formats, specifying linking hypotheses that map model outputs to human measures, evaluating behavioral correspondence, and comparing across candidate models or manipulations. We clarify the role of linking hypotheses in mapping model outputs to human behavioral measures, identify challenges that constrain alignment claims, and propose principles for theory-driven and comparative evaluation. Throughout, we argue that behavioral fit alone is insufficient. Alignment becomes scientifically meaningful only when embedded within explicit theoretical commitments, theory-diagnostic tasks, and systematic contrastive evaluation across candidate models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个四阶段推理框架，系统评估基础模型（FMs）作为认知与发展模型的合理性，强调单纯行为对齐不足以视为认知模型，需要理论驱动和系统性对比。
AI.motivation: 近年来大量研究尝试评估基础模型与人类成人及儿童认知表现之间的一致性，旨在探讨其作为认知模型的潜力，但此类尝试在方法和概念上面临挑战，尤其是如何界定模型与人类认知行为对齐的科学意义。
AI.method: 作者提出了四阶段推理框架：1）将人类实验任务改编为模型兼容的形式；2）提出将模型输出与人类测量相关联的假设（linking hypothesis）；3）评估行为一致性；4）在多个候选模型或变量操纵间比较。此外，作者阐述了linking hypothesis在此中的角色，并指出了使对齐主张受限的问题和理论驱动的评价原则。
AI.result: 文章梳理并挑战了仅凭行为一致性来断言模型对认知有解释力的做法，强调了明确理论框架和系统对比对于科学意义的重要性，并提出具体评价原则。
AI.conclusion: 单纯的行为一致性不能作为模型解释认知的充分条件，只有当模型评估被嵌入明确理论、任务和对比体系内时，模型与人类行为的对齐才具有科学价值。

title: Reconfigurable Structural Robotic Assembly: Interlocking 3D Aggregations with Self-Aligning Compound Nested Lattice Modules
comment: Accepted to the 46th Annual Conference for the Association for Computer Aided Design in Architecture (ACADIA), 2026
summary: Robotic construction systems often treat the material system and the robot as separate design problems, locating intelligence primarily in hardware, sensing, motion planning, and control. This project instead investigates how geometric intelligence can be encoded within architected material systems to simultaneously address requirements for robotic grasping, self-alignment, reversible connection, structural performance, and three-dimensional aggregation. We introduce a self-aligning compound nested lattice module composed of conjoined cuboctahedral-octahedral units. The cuboctahedral features of the modules provide defined surfaces for robotic grasping and alignment, while the octahedral features incorporate screw-releasable snap-fit connectors and corresponding receptors. Additionally, we present a nested arrangement that enables interlocking aggregation along the x, y, and z axes. We demonstrate the system through furniture and architectural scale structures assembled using both a robotic arm and mobile assembler. The resulting configurations include seating, spanning structures, surfaces, and vertical frames. Compression testing of the compound module produced a stiffness of 4,556 N/mm, a maximum load of 3,445 N, and a compressive modulus of 17.5 MPa. The modules can also be disassembled and reused across different configurations, supporting reconfigurable and circular construction.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种新型自对准复合嵌套格模块，可通过独特幾何设计实现更高效的机器人装配、解构与结构性能。
AI.motivation: 传统机器人建造系统通常将材料与机器人分开考虑，智能主要体现在硬件和感知控制上，缺乏对材料系统几何智能的设计。这限制了系统的柔性和可循环利用性。
AI.method: 设计了一种复合嵌套格结构模块，结合立方八面体与八面体单元，实现了用于机器人抓取、自动对准和可逆连接的几何特征，通过嵌套和卡扣件使模块可在三维空间内稳固互锁。系统在家具与建筑尺度结构中通过机械臂与移动装配机器人进行搭建示范，并进行压缩性能测试。
AI.result: 该模块实现了结构的自对准、可逆连接与三维互锁。在多种结构配置（座椅、跨度结构、表面、垂直框架）中成功实现机器人自动装配。力学测试得到了刚度4,556 N/mm、最大荷载3,445 N、压缩模量17.5 MPa。模块还可重复拆装，支持结构重构和循环利用。
AI.conclusion: 将几何智能内嵌于材料系统，有效提升了机器人建造的结构性能、装配灵活性和模块循环利用能力，对未来自适应与可持续建筑具有重要意义。

title: MVMD: A Multi-View Approach for Enhanced Mirror Detection
comment: This work has already published at WACV 2025, just want more accessibility
summary:
In 3D reconstruction, mirrors introduce significant challenges by creating distorted and fragmented spaces, resulting in inaccurate and unreliable 3D models. As 3D reconstruction typically relies on multi-view images to capture different perspectives of a scene, detecting and labeling mirrors in multi-view images before reconstruction can effectively address this issue. However, existing methods focus solely on single-image detection, overlooking the rich information provided by multi-view setups. To overcome this limitation, we propose MVMD, a novel Multi-View Mirror Detection method, along with the first database specifically designed for mirror detection in multi-view scenes.
  The design of MVMD is grounded in the inherent associations between objects seen from different views and those reflected inside and outside of mirrors. These relationships are learned through cross- and self-attention mechanisms. MVMD consists of three key blocks: the Inter-Views Block tracks the shifts of objects within mirrors caused by changes in viewpoint; the Intra-View Block detects object reflections inside mirrors; and the Refinement Block sharpens mirror boundaries and enhances detected details.
  Experimental results show that our method improves accuracy by up to 2.6% and IoU by up to 11.1%, compared to single-image mirror detection techniques. This substantial improvement makes MVMD particularly effective for computer vision tasks, especially in enhancing the accuracy of 3D reconstruction in mirror-dense environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多视角的镜面检测方法MVMD，并构建了首个多视角镜面检测数据库，显著提升了3D重建在镜面密集场景下的准确性。
AI.motivation: 由于镜面会导致空间碎片化和失真，影响3D重建精度，因此需要在重建前检测并标注多视角图像中的镜面。现有方法大多针对单幅图像，未能利用多视角提供的信息。
AI.method: 提出MVMD方法，结合跨视图和自注意力机制，设计三大模块：跨视图模块跟踪对象因视角变化在镜中的位置改变；视内模块检测镜内反射目标；细化模块加强镜面边界和细节。并建立首个专用于多视角场景的镜面检测数据库。
AI.result: 实验表明，与单图像镜面检测方法相比，MVMD的准确率提升2.6%、IoU提升11.1%。
AI.conclusion: MVMD方法能显著提升镜面密集环境下3D重建的精度，对多视角计算机视觉任务具有重要应用价值。

title: "Many Are My Names": The Anatomy of the Assistant and Its Personas via Sparse Autoencoders
summary: How a language model internally represents who is speaking, the Assistant, an assigned roleplay persona, or a narrated story character, remains underexplored. We study speaker representations using a dataset of user-expressed emotional text and corresponding model responses. We decompose three generation settings (Assistant, Roleplay, and Story) into sparse autoencoder features extracted at turn-boundary and pronoun-token positions and selected through a filtering pipeline for different depths. We characterize each surviving feature through its steering effects and activation distribution. Our main finding is that the Assistant and roleplay personas are not independent alternatives: personas retain the Assistant-associated feature core while progressively differentiating from it across layers, starting from operational machinery towards behavioral and stylistic features. Meanwhile, generated story characters lack the Assistant-associated core. Both Story and Roleplay can be distinguished from the Assistant with Immersive Simulation Mode. However, the Assistant can sometimes enter or slowly drift into it even in the default setting.

AI.tldr: 本文探究了大语言模型在生成中如何内部表示说话者身份（如助手、扮演角色、故事角色），并分析了生成不同角色时的特征分布及表达方式。
AI.motivation: 目前对于语言模型内部如何区分和表示不同说话身份（如助手、扮演角色或故事角色）研究尚不充分，理解这种机制有助于提高模型的角色表达一致性和人机交互质量。
AI.method: 收集了用户表达情感的文本及模型回应，划分为'助手'、'角色扮演'和'故事'三种生成设置。采用稀疏自编码器从轮次边界和代词位置提取特征，通过过滤流程选取不同深度的特征。接着分析这些特征的激活分布和对输出语气的引导效应。
AI.result: 发现助手和扮演角色虽然表现形式不同，但角色扮演者在底层仍保留了助手的核心特征，并随网络层次加深逐渐与助手区分，表现出独特的行为与风格特征。而故事角色则完全缺失助手的核心特征。扮演角色和故事可用沉浸式模拟模式与助手区分。但即使在默认设置下，助手有时也会进入或逐步偏移到模拟模式。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型内部对说话者身份表现出层级分化：助手特征为核心，扮演角色在其基础上差异化，故事角色则缺失该核心。模型的角色边界并非截然分明，存在漂移与混合现象，这对理解和提升角色表达一致性具有启示意义。

title: LIRA: Local Cross-Layer Information Routing for Vision-Language-Action Decoding
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance of the paper
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models transform representations from pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) into robot actions, yet the interface that routes intermediate VLM features into action decoders remains underexplored. Existing designs either expose only a narrow part of the representation hierarchy or rigidly match each decoder block to one VLM layer, restricting access to complementary task evidence across depths. We introduce LIRA, a local cross-layer action-conditioning mechanism that formulates VLM-to-action conditioning as depth-aware information routing. LIRA operates on task-token features and LIRA Query features derived from intermediate VLM states, then assigns each Parallel Fusion Block a depth-aligned local window centered on its corresponding VLM layer. Parallel Fusion Blocks aggregate neighboring LIRA Query features and integrate them with task-token features and proprioceptive inputs before action prediction. This routing interface leaves the backbone architecture, action decoder, and supervised training recipe unchanged. Across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, and real-world manipulation, LIRA improves the principal aggregate metrics over the VLA-Adapter baseline under the same 0.5B-parameter configuration. In zero-shot transfer to LIBERO-Plus, LIRA increases average success from 59.1% to 78.0%, an 18.9-point gain indicating improved robustness under controlled distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全新的VLM（视觉-语言模型）到机器人动作的特征路由机制LIRA（跨层局部动作条件机制），在不改变已有主干、动作解码器和训练流程的情况下，大幅提升了机器人任务表现及泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM到机器人动作解码策略存在两个问题：一是只暴露特定层次的特征，覆盖面有限，二是特征与解码器块一一对应，限制了利用多层互补信息的能力。因此需要一种更加灵活、能挖掘多层信息、增强模型泛化性的特征路由机制。
AI.method: LIRA采用一种跨层信息路由机制。首先从VLM中抽取中间层的任务token和LIRA Query特征，然后为每个解码器的Parallel Fusion Block分配局部跨层窗口，聚合相邻层的LIRA Query特征，并与任务token及机器本体信息融合后再作动作预测。整个机制无需更改主干网络、动作解码器和训练方法。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN ABC→D及真实操作实验中，LIRA在相同模型规模下，相比VLA-Adapter基线显著提升主要指标。在LIBERO-Plus零样本任务转移中，平均成功率从59.1%提升到78.0%，提升了18.9个百分点，显示其在分布转移下的稳健性。
AI.conclusion: LIRA通过跨层特征局部聚合，把VLM的多层信息高效路由到动作解码器，在无需额外参数和流程改动的前提下，有效提升了机器人视觉语言任务的表现和泛化能力。

title: XEns-CKD: An Explainable Ensemble-Based Approach for Chronic Kidney Disease Stage Detection
summary: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a silent disease. Its progression may not significantly hamper a person's daily routine. Human kidney function can be classified as normal or as one of the five stages of CKD. Early detection of the CKD stage can help patients understand the functional status of their kidneys and follow medical advice to slow CKD progression. In this paper, we propose XEns-CKD, a novel ensemble vision transformer-based scheme for CKD stage classification using ultrasound images. Three ViTs were trained on a private ultrasound image dataset using different training parameters. The performance of each ViT was evaluated using macro sensitivity, macro specificity, macro precision, macro F1-score, macro Youden index, the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), and macro balanced accuracy. The ensemble model achieved an overall classification accuracy of 86.36%. This work also emphasizes identifying and interpreting kidney regions affected by CKD progression. Explainable artificial intelligence techniques, including LIME, LRP, Attention-Min, and Attention-Max, were used to improve model transparency and clinical trust. An attention map combining the Attention-Min and Attention-Max results effectively identified and interpreted kidney regions affected during CKD progression from one stage to another. The attention map also highlighted the effects of CKD progression in these regions. Compared with existing methods, the proposed method classified the five CKD stages and normal kidney status with a 4% improvement in accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种基于视觉Transformer集成模型（XEns-CKD）的方法，用于通过超声图像对慢性肾病（CKD）各阶段进行分类，实现了86.36%的分类准确率，并相较现有方法提升了4%。同时利用可解释性AI技术对肾脏受影响区域进行了分析。
AI.motivation: 慢性肾病早期患者通常无明显症状，及时检测与判定其分期可帮助患者采取措施减缓病程。因此，开发基于医学影像的自动化分期模型具有重要意义。
AI.method: 作者使用三套参数不同的视觉Transformer（ViT）模型，基于私有超声图像数据集进行训练，并采用集成学习进行CKD分期分类。性能用多种宏平均指标评估，并引入LIME、LRP等可解释性AI方法及注意力机制，对模型的决策区域进行可视化和解释。
AI.result: 集成模型总体准确率达到86.36%，比现有方法高4%。所提出的注意力图方法有效识别并解释了CKD各阶段肾脏受影响区域，提升了模型的可解释性和临床可信度。
AI.conclusion: XEns-CKD模型不仅提高了超声图像分期的精度（尤其是在CKD分阶段上），还通过可解释性AI技术强化了模型对肾脏受损区域的定位与分析，为CKD的早期诊断和进展评估提供了有效工具。

title: SurakshaEval: An Indic Safety Benchmark for Multilingual LLMs
summary: Existing safety evaluation datasets for large language models (LLMs) predominantly focus on English and Western contexts, often overlooking the linguistic diversity and culturally grounded safety risks present in other languages. To address this gap, we introduce SurakshaEval, a novel safety benchmark composed of human-written prompts spanning real-world scenarios, explicitly designed for ten major Indian languages - Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil, and Telugu, along with English. SurakshaEval includes both generic prompts common across India and region- and language-specific prompts that capture localized sociocultural sensitivities. We benchmark a broad range of state-of-the-art LLMs on SurakshaEval, establish baseline safety performance, and identify recurring failure modes, including over-refusal, missed detection of implicit bias, and insufficient contextual awareness in regionally sensitive settings. Our results show that even strong multilingual LLMs struggle to reliably meet nuanced safety requirements when operating in Indic languages, particularly in native scripts. These findings highlight the urgent need for safety evaluation frameworks that incorporate region-specific data and structured assessment protocols, enabling the development and deployment of AI systems that operate securely, ethically, and in alignment with diverse societal values. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/debobanerjee/SurakshaEval. Warning: This paper contains text that may be offensive or unsafe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SurakshaEval，这是一个针对印度十种主要语言及英语的LLM安全性评测数据集，填补了现有数据集在多语言和文化敏感性方面的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全评测主要集中在英语和西方语境，忽略了其他语言和文化中固有的安全风险，亟需面向多样语言和文化的评测工具。
AI.method: 作者人工编写了覆盖现实场景的提示词，针对印度十种主流语言和英语，既有全印度通用的通用提示，也有地区和语言特有的文化敏感提示，并用这些数据对多种主流LLM进行了系统测试。
AI.result: 虽然当前多语种LLM整体性能优秀，但在印度各语种，特别是母语脚本环境下，依然难以满足细致入微的安全需求，常出现过度拒答、隐性偏见未检出及地方情境理解不足等问题。
AI.conclusion: LLM的安全评测亟需引入区域化数据和结构化评测方案，以推动技术在各类文化和社会价值观下的安全、道德、合规应用。

title: AdaDexGrasp: Adaptive Dexterous Grasping via 3D Visuo-Tactile Representation Fusion
summary: Humans achieve stable and adaptive grasps by seamlessly integrating visual perception and tactile feedback, a capability that remains challenging to replicate in robotic systems. Existing robotic grasping approaches predominantly rely on visual inputs and lack mechanisms for tactile-guided adaptation after contact, limiting robustness and generalization. To address this challenge, we propose a unified visuo-tactile-fusion grasping framework that integrates grasp generation, feasibility prediction, and adaptive refinement. At its core, our method introduces an efficient visuo-tactile representation that tightly fuses object geometry with tactile feedback by associating tactile signals with finger identities. This unified representation supports contact-aware grasp pose generation during planning and tactile-guided refinement after contact, enabling the system to reason about fine-grained finger-object interactions and adjust grasps dynamically. Comprehensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances grasp success rates and generalization across diverse objects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合视觉和触觉的抓取框架，实现对机器人抓取任务的更稳定自适应控制。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人抓取多依赖视觉，缺乏抓取后用触觉反馈进一步调节的机制，导致鲁棒性和泛化能力有限。
AI.method: 作者设计了一种高效的视触觉统一表示方法，将触觉信号与手指身份结合，并与物体几何信息融合，贯穿抓取生成、可行性预测和抓取后自适应调整整个流程。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在仿真和现实场景中均提升了抓取成功率和对不同对象的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 融合视觉和触觉的统一抓取框架使机器人抓取更加稳定可靠，对提升机器人操作能力具有重要意义。

title: Mechanistic Interpretability-Guided Selective Fine-Tuning of Vision-Language Models for Centimeter-Level Flood Depth Estimation
comment: This Paper is accepted in International Conference on Machine Learning and Application (ICMLA) 2026
summary: Urban flooding poses an escalating threat to transportation infrastructure, yet no operational system provides real-time, street-level flood-depth estimates at centimeter resolution. This paper presents three vision-language models fine-tuned for continuous flood-depth estimation from street-level imagery: FloodLlama-Dense, a fully fine-tuned QLoRA baseline, and FloodLlama-MI5 and FloodLlama-MI6, interpretability-guided sparse variants that fine-tune only the top five and six causally relevant cross-attention layers identified through mechanistic interpretability analysis, respectively. Training uses an approximately 610,000-image subset of a 2.81-million-image synthetic corpus generated in Unreal Engine 5. The dataset combines single-vehicle subsets with 5 cm depth increments and mixed-vehicle subsets with 1 cm depth increments, spanning seven vehicle types, four weather conditions, and flood depths from 0 to 40 cm. FloodLlama-Dense achieves an MAE of 0.40 cm, an RMSE of 1.97 cm, and an Acc@5cm of 97.59%. Mechanistic interpretability analysis combining linear probing, logit lens, centered kernel alignment (CKA), and cross-attention entropy reveals a two-stage adaptation pattern: layers L13-L22 restructure visual representations, while depth first becomes linearly decodable at layer L23. FloodLlama-MI5 and FloodLlama-MI6 leverage this insight by fine-tuning only five or six of the eight cross-attention layers, achieving an 86-88% reduction in trainable parameters (6.55-7.86 million versus 54.4 million) with minimal accuracy loss. On a real-world benchmark, FloodLlama-MI6 achieves 98.62% accuracy, compared with 86.61% for the published STURM-FloodDepth baseline.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出三种新型视觉-语言模型用于实时街道级别的高精度城市内涝深度估计，具有极高的准确性和效率。
AI.motivation: 城市内涝对交通基础设施构成越来越严重的威胁，但目前缺乏能以厘米级分辨率、街道级实时估算积水深度的系统。作者意在解决城市洪涝期间缺乏高精度实时监测工具的问题。
AI.method: 作者基于Unreal Engine 5合成的图像数据集，设计并微调了三种FloodLlama模型：FloodLlama-Dense（全量微调QLoRA为基线）、FloodLlama-MI5和FloodLlama-MI6（利用可解释性分析，仅微调5或6个最具因果相关性的cross-attention层）。研究采用多种可解释性分析工具（如linear probing、logit lens、CKA、cross-attention entropy），以界定不同层的表征和作用。
AI.result: FloodLlama-Dense在合成数据集上取得MAE 0.40 cm、RMSE 1.97 cm和Acc@5cm 97.59%的优秀表现。FloodLlama-MI5与FloodLlama-MI6在可训练参数减少86-88%的情况下模型精度几乎无损，在真实世界基准上FloodLlama-MI6准确率为98.62%，远高于现有STURM-FloodDepth基线（86.61%）。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明，通过机制可解释性分析指导的结构优化，可以仅微调小部分关键网络层，即大幅降低训练资源和计算复杂度，同时保持甚至超越全量微调基线的街道级洪水深度预测精度，对城市防洪、应急响应等具有重要意义。

title: Detection of Self-Introductions in Legislative Testimony
comment: Presented at AAIRC-AI4 conference, Las Vegas, NV, USA August 2026 https://ai4.io/aairc-ai4/
summary: Self-introductions are common in legislative committee testimonies. Successfully detecting them and extracting the speaker's name is enormously helpful in the task of speaker identification in the context of government meetings. In this paper, we present a pipeline for detection of self-introductions in legislative committee testimony using machine learning. We construct a training dataset from 1.54 million utterances spanning five state legislative sessions, apply a name-matching heuristic to generate automatic labels, and train three classifiers: a decision tree, random forest, and XGBoost to find self-introductions and extract the speaker's name. We construct a feature set combining bag-of-words, positional context, structural signals, introductory phrase indicators, and discourse context features. Among the three classifiers, XGBoost achieves the best performance with an F1 score of 0.9747 and the fewest total errors; adding fine-tuned BERT probability features improves this further. As an extension, we score the full candidate dataset with a fine-tuned BERT classifier and add BERT probability outputs as features. This BERT-augmented XGBoost model improves F1 from 0.9747 to 0.9782 and reduces total test errors from 241 to 207. The primary gain over the decision tree baseline (F1 0.9323) is driven by discourse context features and the boosting ensemble strategy; BERT provides a modest complementary signal. Analysis of false positives reveals that a minority are genuine self-introductions mislabeled due to name inconsistencies in the source data, indicating that measured metrics modestly understate true performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用机器学习检测立法委员会证词中自我介绍并提取发言人姓名的流程，结合多种特征和模型，最终BERT增强的XGBoost模型取得了F1 0.9782的优异表现。
AI.motivation: 政府会议中发言人识别是一项重要任务，自我介绍为发言人定位提供关键信息，但其自动检测和姓名提取技术尚不完善。因此亟需专门的方法提升此类文本分析的自动化和准确性。
AI.method: 作者基于五个州立法会议期的154万条发言构建训练集，通过姓名匹配启发生成标签，训练决策树、随机森林、XGBoost三种分类器。特征包含词袋、位置、结构、引导短语和语篇上下文。进一步整合微调BERT概率特征提升表现。
AI.result: XGBoost基线模型F1为0.9747，BERT增强后F1升至0.9782，测试错误从241减少至207，显著优于决策树（F1 0.9323），性能提升主要来源于语篇特征和集成策略，BERT信号为辅。
AI.conclusion: 结合丰富特征和集成方法可显著提升自我介绍检测和姓名提取效果，且BERT进一步带来提升。部分假阳性因源数据姓名不一致，实际性能可能被低估。

title: Enhanced Real-Time 6-DOF Extended Reality Catheter Tracking for Evaluating Potential Improvement in Efficiency, Precision, and Depth Perception for Cardiac Interventions
summary: Despite advances in 3D ultrasound, most percutaneous cardiac interventions still rely on 2D visualization, limiting depth perception and spatial understanding. To address this challenge, we developed an Extended Reality (XR)-based platform that enables real-time six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) catheter tracking and visualization within a patient-specific 3D heart model. The system combines a custom machine-vision algorithm for 5-DOF catheter tracking with a 3D-printed electromechanical encoder that measures catheter roll, providing complete 6-DOF motion reconstruction. In a proof-of-concept study, 20 novice medical students navigated an intracardiac echocardiography (ICE) catheter to six anatomical targets using either immersive 3D visualization or a conventional 2D cathlab-style view. Participants in the 3D condition completed the task in 54.6 seconds and traveled 1,939 mm on average, compared with 267.5 seconds and 7,854 mm in the 2D condition. Therefore, the XR-based 3D system was more than 5x faster and required ~5x less catheter travel. The 3D mode also improved targeting precision and reduced performance variability. Participants consistently rated immersive visualization higher for accuracy, speed, usability, and clinical value. Kinematic analysis showed smoother depth-axis navigation in 3D, whereas 2D users relied on repeated corrective movements. These findings demonstrate that XR-based visualization can substantially improve procedural training efficiency, precision, and motor control.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于扩展现实（XR）的实时6自由度导管追踪与可视化平台，显著提升了介入性心脏操作的效率和精度。
AI.motivation: 目前绝大多数介入性心脏手术仍依赖2D超声成像，缺乏空间深度感知，影响医生的定位和操作准确性。
AI.method: 平台结合了定制的机器视觉算法进行5自由度导管追踪，并配合3D打印电机械编码器测量导管滚转，实现6自由度运动重建。在概念验证实验中，20名医学生分别用3D沉浸视图和2D传统视图操作ICE导管，完成目标任务。
AI.result: 3D组平均完成任务时间为54.6秒，路径长度1939毫米，明显优于2D组（267.5秒，7854毫米）。3D组也在定位精度、表现一致性、用户满意度等方面全面领先。运动学分析显示，3D组导航更平滑，2D组依赖反复修正。
AI.conclusion: XR沉浸式可视化技术能极大提升介入手术中的训练效率、精度和运动控制能力，具有重要临床应用价值。

title: What to Edit Next: Visually Aligned Image-Editing Follow-Up Suggestions in Conversational Systems
summary: Conversational assistants increasingly recommend follow-up edits to help users continue a task. Existing systems primarily target text-only interactions, leaving image-creation conversations underexplored. In image-creation tasks, useful follow-up edit suggestions must reflect user preferences, offer diverse directions, and remain executable on the current image. We collected 100,000 real multi-turn image-creation conversation samples from Qwen App and found that 80.1% are image-dependent, underscoring the need for multimodal recommendation. We address this setting with a three-stage framework. In Stage 1, we use real online data to build a human-reviewed table of appropriate follow-up editing intents, then create SFT targets and fine-tune a multimodal policy. In Stage 2, to align rule-guided SFT suggestions with actual user choices, we use user click feedback to optimize the policy through multi-objective reinforcement learning. In Stage 3, to reduce visual inconsistencies between suggested edits and the current image, we introduce a visual verifier as additional training supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms baselines on both automatic and human evaluations. In a live user-randomized A/B test with millions of users, our final framework reduces visual inconsistency from 3.7% to 0.9%. Furthermore, it significantly improves recommendation CTR by 32.70%, image take-away rate by 16.32%, and average conversation turns per user by 39.90% (all p<0.05).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个针对多轮图像创作对话的推荐框架，大幅提升了编辑建议的相关性和可执行性，并显著改善用户互动体验。
AI.motivation: 现有的会话助手大多集中在文本交互上，缺乏对图像创作场景的深入研究。而实际多轮图像对话任务中，用户的需求高度依赖于当前图像，急需能理解和处理多模态信息的推荐系统。
AI.method: 作者采集了10万条真实的多轮图像创作对话数据，提出三阶段框架：（1）建立带人审查的编辑意图表并用SFT进行多模态策略微调；（2）基于用户点击反馈，利用多目标强化学习优化推荐策略；（3）引入视觉验证器，作为训练的额外监督，减少建议与当前图像的视觉不一致。
AI.result: 综合实验表明，所提框架在自动化与人工评测上均明显优于基线方案。实际A/B测试中，视觉不一致由3.7%降至0.9%；推荐点击率提升32.7%；图像采纳率提升16.32%；用户平均对话轮数提升39.9%。
AI.conclusion: 本研究创新性地提出了高效的多模态对话编辑建议生成框架，在改善用户体验和系统智能化方面展现出巨大潜力，为未来智能多模态推荐助手开辟了新方向。

title: Thinking Hard, Not Smart: Reasoning Models Fail to Ration Test-Time Compute Across Questions
summary: Reasoning language models increasingly use test-time compute to improve performance, but existing evaluations typically study this compute one question at a time. Yet when multiple problems share an end-to-end cost or latency constraint, models must decide how to divide limited inference compute among them. We introduce an exam-style evaluation framework for studying this setting, in which a model must distribute one shared token budget across questions with different difficulty and point values to maximize its total score. Across several open and frontier reasoning models, we find that models fail to allocate a shared budget strategically across questions of varying difficulties and values. Models behave largely as greedy sequential solvers: they prioritize questions by presentation order, front-load effort on early questions, and remain insensitive to value, with these tendencies becoming more pronounced as the number of questions grows. Explicit planning prompts spread compute more evenly but do not produce value- or difficulty-aware prioritization. The same behavioral pattern extends from mathematical to code reasoning. These findings establish global budget allocation as a distinct capability that is not captured by conventional per-question evaluation and remains a challenge for current reasoning models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析了一种要求语言模型在有限推理预算下，合理分配算力以在多个题目中最大化得分的新评估框架。结果显示现有推理模型分配资源的策略性较差，多按题目顺序贪心解答，对题目分值与难度不敏感。
AI.motivation: 现有推理型大语言模型的评估多为单题推理，而真实环境下往往需要模型在多题、有限推理资源下合理决策分配，从而最大化整体表现。研究这种场景对于推动模型能力成熟具有重要意义。
AI.method: 作者提出一种模仿考试场景的评测框架：设定全局token预算，要求模型在不同分值与难度的多道题中合理分配token推理预算，以最大化总得分，再考查不同模型在此条件下的表现。
AI.result: 多种主流推理模型均未展现出高效的算力分配策略，普遍优先处理顺序靠前的问题，将大量算力前置，且无视各题分值和难度，随着题目数增加这种行为愈发明显。即使通过明确的“计划”提示，也未能促使模型按价值或难度优先。
AI.conclusion: “全局算力预算分配”是一项不同于单题评测的独立能力，现有推理语言模型在这一方面表现有限，这为未来模型设计与训练提出了新挑战。

title: GWM-VLA: Geometry-Aware Latent World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Learning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong robotic manipulation performance but often degrade under visual and environmental shifts. Latent world modeling offers a promising approach to improving robustness, yet existing methods commonly encode camera views independently and predict holistic scene dynamics without explicitly modeling their geometric relationships. We propose GWM-VLA, a geometry-aware latent world modeling framework for VLA learning. GWM-VLA combines geometry-aware multi-view state encoding, global context-conditioned target-view prediction, and shared latent-action representations grounded by robot-action supervision. Specifically, VGGT-$Ω$ jointly aggregates multi-view observations at each timestep to construct geometry-aware multi-view states. The latent world model predicts the next-step patch tokens of a selected target view using patch and register tokens obtained after multi-view aggregation, thereby retaining multi-view geometric information without predicting the complete multi-view state. We use the wrist view as the target in our experiments, placing greater emphasis on end-effector motion and local gripper-object interactions. Finally, the shared latent-action representations condition both the latent world model and the flow-matching action head, allowing latent-prediction supervision and ground-truth robot-action supervision to jointly shape the same latent-action representations. Experiments across both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of GWM-VLA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GWM-VLA，一种面向几何的视觉-语言-动作模型，旨在提升机器人操作在视觉环境变化下的鲁棒性。通过多视角几何建模与全局语境预测，提高了模型对不同环境条件的适应能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA机器人模型在遇到视觉和环境变化时表现退化，且缺乏对多视角之间几何关系的显式建模，限制了鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.method: GWM-VLA引入了三大设计：1）几何感知多视角状态编码，联合聚合每时刻多视角观测值；2）基于全局上下文的目标视角预测，专注于目标视图的动态而非全局预测，保留多视角几何信息；3）采用基于机器人动作监督的共享潜在表示，将动作预测和世界建模的潜在空间统一。
AI.result: 实验在仿真与真实机器人环境中均验证了GWM-VLA方法的有效性和鲁棒性，优于传统VLA在场景变化条件下的表现。
AI.conclusion: GWM-VLA通过引入多视角几何信息与共享潜在动作表示，实现了更强的泛化和鲁棒性，为VLA机器人操作系统提供了新的设计范式。

title: Temporal Generalization in fNIRS-Based Autism Classification: A Cross-Time-Window Transfer Benchmark
summary: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a promising modality for autism spectrum disorder (ASD) classification, yet existing approaches assume temporally aligned evaluation.
