In practice, the optimal observation window varies across subjects due to differences in hemodynamic delay and neurovascular coupling, creating a temporal distribution shift that degrades performance. We formalize this as a \textit{cross-time-window transfer problem}, introducing a protocol that varies window length (2.5--10\,s) and offset within biological motion trials. Using topographic map representations of fNIRS recordings, we benchmark three vision architectures under two zero-shot baselines and eight adaptation strategies under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation ($N{=}124$). Key findings: (1) zero-shot cross-window accuracy is near chance (54--69\%); (2) ${\approx}5\%$ subject-specific fine-tuning recovers 90--96\%, while a subject-specific upper bound reaches 97--100\%, identifying inter-subject variability as the dominant barrier; (3) domain-adversarial and self-supervised strategies achieve 78--90\% without target-subject data; and (4) discriminative information is recoverable from windows as short as 2.5\,s. These findings provide a practical roadmap for deploying fNIRS-based ASD classifiers under realistic temporal variability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并系统研究了功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）在自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）分类中的实际应用难题——不同受试者最佳观测窗口变异带来的时间分布偏移。作者提出跨时间窗口迁移问题，并测试了多种模型策略。结果表明现有方法零样本情况下表现有限，个体微调和域自适应方法有明显提升。
AI.motivation: fNIRS具备无创、便携的优势，是ASD分类的有希望工具。但受试者间血流动力学延迟等差异导致理想观测窗口不一致，严重影响模型泛化能力，这在实际部署中成为主要障碍。作者希望系统性检验不同策略在该分布偏移挑战下的表现。
AI.method: 作者提出跨时间窗口迁移的实验协议，系统改变观测窗口长度（2.5-10秒）和偏移，并采用基于fNIRS拓扑图的表征。实验设置涵盖三类视觉架构、两种零样本基线及八种跨主体适应策略（包括域对抗、自监督等），在124例留一交叉验证下测试。
AI.result: （1）现有方法在跨时间窗口任务中无微调时准确率接近偶然水平（54-69%）；（2）约5%的受试者自适应微调能将准确率恢复至90-96%，完全适应能达97-100%；（3）无需新受试者数据的域对抗和自监督方法也能达78-90%；（4）即使使用2.5秒窗口，也能恢复有效判别信息。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的跨时间窗口迁移框架及实验，为fNIRS类ASD分类器在现实中普遍存在的时间延迟差异下的实用化提供了有效路径。强调了个体差异对泛化的巨大影响，并验证短窗口信息的可利用性，推动了该领域从理论走向实践。

title: Prompt Embedding Probes (PEP): Hallucination Detection in LLMs from Hidden States
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent and useful responses but remain prone to hallucinations. We introduce Prompt Embedding Probes (PEP), a white-box method for answer-level hallucination detection from the hidden states of a frozen LLM. PEP extends standard linear probes by augmenting the input with a small number of learnable prompt embeddings. We evaluate PEP on TriviaQA, GSM8K, and MedQA using Qwen3 models at multiple scales. PEP improves hidden-state-based detection over standard linear probes in the main in-distribution setting. We further evaluate PEP for pre-generation prediction, cross-model transfer, and out-of-distribution generalization. PEP remains effective in the pre-generation and cross-model settings, whereas robust cross-dataset transfer remains difficult. These results show that prompt-based adaptation can strengthen hidden-state probing while keeping the backbone frozen and adding only a small number of trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于检测大语言模型答案级“幻觉”现象的白盒方法——Prompt Embedding Probes（PEP），它在冻结底层模型参数的基础上，仅引入少量可训练的提示向量，显著提升了基于隐藏状态的幻觉检测效果。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型能生成流畅且有用的回答，但依然容易出现内容“幻觉”，即输出与事实不符或缺乏依据的内容。现有检测方法在增强泛化和迁移能力上存在局限，亟需高效、低成本的新方法来提升检测性能。
AI.method: PEP方法在冻结大模型参数的前提下，通过添加少量可训练的提示嵌入（prompt embeddings）扩展了传统的线性探针，从而更好地利用LLM隐藏态特征进行幻觉检测。作者在TriviaQA、GSM8K和MedQA三大数据集，以及多种规模的Qwen3模型上对PEP进行了评估。实验还包括预生成预测、跨模型迁移与分布外泛化等任务。
AI.result: PEP在主流测试集的主任务（分布内设置）中，相比标准线性探针有效提升了基于隐藏状态的幻觉检测性能。在预生成和跨模型迁移设置下依然表现优良，但在跨数据集泛化场景下效果有限。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，基于prompt的适配机制在保持底座模型冻结、仅增加极少量可训练参数的情况下，可以增强隐藏态特征对“幻觉”现象的检测能力。但跨数据集泛化仍需进一步研究。

title: A Reconfigurable Tracked Robot for Enhanced Obstacle Traversal Through Movable Articulation Point and Internal Mass Relocation
summary: Tracked robots are widely used in unstructured environments; however, their obstacle traversal capability is fundamentally limited by a tradeoff between front-end reachability and locomotion stability. This study presents TRASER (Tracked Robot with Articulated Spine for Extended Reach), a reconfigurable tracked robot capable of relocating both its articulation point and internal mass. TRASER employs a tape-spring mechanism that localizes compliance to the bending region while maintaining high stiffness in the remaining body, thereby improving both front-end reachability and center-of-mass (CoM) shifting capability. Geometric and static models are developed to analyze the effects of articulation point and CoM position on step and ditch traversal performances. Experiments demonstrate step traversal, suspended-platform traversal, and ditch traversal of 74\%, 66\%, and 59\% of the robot body length, respectively. To the best of our knowledge, these results represent the highest reported obstacle traversal capabilities among tracked mobile robots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型的履带式机器人TRASER，具有可重定位关节和可调重心，极大提升了越障能力，在同类机器人中表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 传统履带机器人在前端越障能力和运动稳定性之间存在固有限制，难以兼顾两者，因此需要新的结构设计以提升越障性能。
AI.method: 设计了一种带有可重定位关节和内部质量可移动的履带式机器人TRASER，采用带弹簧机构，使得机器人在弯曲区具有良好柔性，其余部分保持高刚性。构建了几何和静力学模型，分析关节点和重心位置对越过台阶与沟槽性能的影响，并进行了相关实验。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，TRASER机器人在台阶、悬空平台和沟槽的越障距离分别达到自身长度的74%、66%和59%，为目前履带机器人最佳。
AI.conclusion: TRASER机器人突破了传统履带机器人越障能力的瓶颈，为复杂环境下的履带机器人运动提供了新思路和结构方案。

title: Latent-Frequency Validity: Fast Spectral Editing with Screened Video-VAE Transfer Operators
summary: Direct spectral editing in video-VAE latents can control noise, flicker, smoothness, and frequency content without a decode--filter--reencode pass. However, video VAEs may redistribute pixel-space frequency bands across latent channels, and latent edits can disrupt VAE round-trip dynamics. We introduce \emph{latent-frequency validity} (LFV), which learns a compact VAE-specific spectral response and deploys it only when it improves decoded-target fidelity without worsening round-trip drift. LFV follows a validation-selected path from a diagonal per-frequency calibrator (C1) to full channel mixing (CM), making cross-channel capacity a controllable per-edit resource. Across 544 VAE--edit cells spanning six spectral families, LFV emits 423 cheap operators: 277 are handled by C1, while 146 (34.5\% of emitted operators) require channel mixing. On the primary 120-cell radial sweep, 99/100 emitted operators pass source-video-grouped held-out evaluation. Across five additional filter families, all 323 emitted operators pass held-out evaluation. Fully frozen OpenVid-fitted operators, including the validation-selected path coefficient, pass all 20 tested CogVideoX and HunyuanVideo generated-domain cells without adaptation. The selected response matches direct latent-filter latency and is about $3\times$ faster than pixel filter--reencode. The resulting maps reveal distinct VAE regimes, including strongly channel-coupled CogVideoX responses and a sharp Open-Sora high-band stability frontier.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可直接在视频VAE潜变量中进行频谱编辑的新方法，称为LFV（latent-frequency validity），无需解码-滤波-再编码，能高效控制噪声、闪烁和平滑性，并显著加速处理。
AI.motivation: 现有在VAE潜变量中进行频谱编辑的方法存在像素空间频带被分散到不同潜变量通道、编辑后影响VAE往返（encode-decode）一致性等问题，同时传统decode-filter-reencode流程计算耗时。
AI.method: 引入LFV方法：通过学习特定VAE的紧凑频率响应，仅在能提升目标保真度且不会加剧回环漂移时应用，通过从对角化的逐频校准器（C1）到完全通道混合（CM）的路径，实现每次编辑可控的跨通道能力。
AI.result: 在544组VAE–编辑单元和六类频谱滤波实验中，LFV生成423个高效算子，其中65%由C1处理，35%需通道混合。主要120单元下，99%编辑结果在分组保留测试通过，五类滤波共323个操作全部通过测试。经OpenVid拟合的操作可直接适配CogVideoX和HunyuanVideo，无需调整。延迟与直接潜变量滤波相当，比像素滤波-重编码快3倍。
AI.conclusion: LFV能高效且灵活地在VAE潜空间进行频谱编辑，提升编辑过程保真性和稳定性，大幅加快了处理速度，同时揭示了不同视频VAE模型在频率响应和通道耦合方面显著的结构差异。

title: APEX-VW: A Document-Level English-Spanish Post-Editing Dataset in the Healthcare Domain
summary: Post-Editing (PE) of Machine Translation (MT) output often involves repeating the same lexical and terminological corrections across many segments, especially in specialised and highly repetitive documents. Despite substantial work on Automatic Post-Editing (APE), most available corpora operate at the sentence level, others are synthetic, and overall not designed to study how corrections propagate in realistic Computer-Assisted Translation (CAT) workflows. This paper presents the APEX-VW (Automatic Post-Editing eXperiments on Virtual Wards) Corpus, a new open English-Spanish (EN-ES) dataset built from recent NHS virtual-ward documents and professional PE in Trados Studio, with controlled MT, terminology, and quality assurance settings. The corpus contains seven document-coherent source texts totalling 42k words, translated with four MT systems representing different paradigms and then post-edited by professional translators. Unlike prior resources such as WMT APE corpora, eSCAPE, MLQE-PE, or LangMark, the dataset preserves document order and CAT-tool context, making it suitable for research on terminology normalisation, correction propagation, and human-in-the-loop translation support. The paper describes the corpus design, data preparation, PE setup, and initial corpus statistics, and positions the resource as a benchmark for document-level APE and propagation-aware assistive tools.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了APEX-VW英西语自动后编辑新语料库，专为研究专有术语标准化和纠错传播等真实翻译工作流而设计。
AI.motivation: 在专业文档翻译中，机器翻译后编辑经常重复进行相似的术语和词汇修正。目前的自动后编辑数据集多以句子为单位，缺少面向实际翻译流程中文档层面变更与传播的真实数据。
AI.method: 构建了基于NHS虚拟病房文本的英西语新数据集，涵盖7个具文档连贯性的源文件，用4种不同范式的机器翻译系统生成初稿，并由专业译员在Trados Studio中按受控流程后编辑，同时保留了CAT工具上下文和文档顺序信息。
AI.result: 数据集共42k词，能支持包括术语规范、纠错传播、人机协同翻译等多项研究，并弥补了现有数据集单句割裂、缺乏真实工作流语境的不足。
AI.conclusion: APEX-VW语料库将成为文档级自动后编辑和面向纠错传播的辅助翻译工具研究的新基准，适用于更贴合实际工作的技术评测与开发。

title: Hölder Signed Distance: A Differentiable, Signed, Parallelizable Metric for Robotics
summary: Computing distances between sets is essential in robotic motion planning and control, where differentiable gradients enable real-time optimization. The Euclidean Signed Distance Function (SDF), however, is not differentiable everywhere, and existing alternatives often sacrifice differentiability, sign information, or computational efficiency. In this letter, we introduce a novel differentiable signed distance between convex polyhedra. To this end, we first propose differentiable versions of the minimum and maximum operators, termed the Hölder minimum and Hölder maximum. We then replace the original min-max operators in the classical SDF formulation, yielding the Hölder signed distance. Unlike prior differentiable distance formulations that rely on iterative algorithms, our approach is computed in closed form, eliminating convergence issues while remaining naturally amenable to GPU parallelization. We validate the practical advantages and computational performance of the proposed distance through runtime comparisons with existing approaches. We also present a robotic manipulator experiment, demonstrating its suitability for applications in control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的凸多面体之间可微的符号距离计算方法—Hölder符号距离，在凸多面体集合距离计算领域实现了高效、全可微并易于GPU并行的求解。
AI.motivation: 在机器人运动规划和控制中，集合间的距离计算尤为重要，通常需要可微性以便实时优化。而现有的欧氏符号距离（SDF）在处处可微性上存在不足，替代方案则常在可微性、符号信息或计算效率之间做出妥协。因此亟需一种兼顾可微性、符号性和计算效率的新方法。
AI.method: 首先提出了可微的最小（Hölder minimum）和最大（Hölder maximum）运算符，然后用其替代经典SDF中的min-max运算，提出了Hölder符号距离。该方法为闭式解，无需迭代，天然适合GPU并行计算。
AI.result: 在实际计算中，本文方法在运行时间上优于现有方法。通过机械臂实验进一步验证了该距离度量在机器人控制等应用场景下的实用性和高效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的Hölder符号距离具备良好的可微性、符号性和高效计算特性，尤其适合于需要实时优化的机器人运动规划和控制任务，并展现出优越的计算性能和适用性。

title: COMEX: A Composition-Grounded Benchmark and Learning Framework for Explainable Aesthetic Image Cropping
summary: Explainable aesthetic image cropping requires not only localizing a visually pleasing crop but also explaining why it is preferred. Existing crop-and-explain methods largely treat explanation as post-hoc text generation and overlook composition, a key aesthetic factor that links crop decisions with interpretable reasoning. In this paper, we reformulate explainable aesthetic image cropping as a structured crop-composition-explanation problem. To support this setting, we introduce COMEX, a new benchmark built through image expansion and an IO-reversal pipeline. COMEX contains 33,161 quadruples, each consisting of an expanded image, a crop box, a composition category, and a composition-grounded explanation, enabling joint learning of crop localization, composition understanding, and explanation generation. We further propose a two-stage SFT+GRPO framework, where supervised fine-tuning establishes the structured output protocol and basic cropping ability, and GRPO further improves crop quality, composition prediction, and explanation faithfulness. We benchmark 15 large vision-language models and existing cropping methods on COMEX, establishing a comprehensive testbed for composition-grounded explainable aesthetic cropping. Experiments on both COMEX and prior benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and transferability of our framework, with strong performance across evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可解释的美学图像裁剪新方法，并构建了新的基准数据集和评测体系，通过模型实现裁剪定位、构图理解与解释生成的联合优化。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像裁剪可解释性方法，往往只在裁剪后生成文本解释，忽略了“构图”这一美学核心要素，导致解释性不足，缺乏裁剪决策与人类视觉理解之间的联系。
AI.method: 本文将可解释的美学图像裁剪问题重新定义为“裁剪-构图-解释”结构化任务，并提出了COMEX基准数据集，每条数据包含扩展图像、裁剪框、构图类别和基于构图的解释。模型采用两阶段SFT+GRPO训练框架，首先通过监督微调实现结构化输出和基础裁剪能力，再用GRPO提升裁剪质量、构图预测和解释真实性。文中还对15个主流大视觉语言模型和相关算法进行了基准测试。
AI.result: 实验显示，所提框架在COMEX和先前数据集上，在裁剪、构图理解及解释性等多项评测指标上都表现出色，且具有良好的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 将构图引入可解释美学图像裁剪，大幅提升了模型的可解释性和性能，COMEX基准为该领域后续研究和评测提供了扎实基础。

title: DialectS2S: End-to-End Speech Dialogue Modeling for Low-Resource Chinese Dialects
summary: Current end-to-end speech dialogue models are primarily optimized for mainstream languages and remain limited in low-resource dialect scenarios due to the scarcity of dialect speech data. Moreover, during dialect adaptation, the semantic representation space of speech dialogue models continuously evolves, while conventional speech supervision remains unchanged, leading to semantic inconsistency between hidden representations and speech targets and degrading speech stability and naturalness. To address these issues, we propose DialectS2S, an end-to-end speech dialogue model for Chinese dialects. We first develop a scalable dialect speech dialogue synthesis pipeline for efficient data construction. We further introduce a two-stage post-training strategy with self-aligned speech supervision, which aligns the semantic content of speech supervision with the evolved semantic representations of the model to improve dialect speech generation quality. Experimental results show that DialectS2S consistently outperforms existing baselines across multiple Chinese dialects in speech dialogue, achieving substantial improvements in dialect consistency, response quality, and speech intelligibility. Our work provides an efficient and scalable solution for end-to-end speech dialogue modeling in low-resource dialect scenarios. To facilitate future research and practical applications, we fully open-source the DialectS2S framework, including model checkpoints, training datasets, and fine-tuning code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DialectS2S端到端汉语方言语音对话模型，通过可扩展的数据构建流程和自适应语音监督方法，提升了低资源方言场景下的语音对话生成质量。
AI.motivation: 目前的端到端语音对话模型主要服务于主流语言，难以适应因方言语音数据稀缺而导致的低资源方言场景。同时，在适应方言时，模型的语义表征不断变化，而传统的语音监督方式未做同步更新，导致语义不一致，影响语音的稳定性与自然度。
AI.method: 1）构建高效可扩展的方言语音对话合成流程，用于丰富方言语音数据。2）提出两阶段后训练策略，引入自适应语音监督，使监督内容与模型进化的语义表征一致，提升语音生成质量。
AI.result: DialectS2S在多种汉语方言的语音对话任务中稳定优于现有基线，在方言一致性、响应质量和语音可懂度等指标上取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: DialectS2S为低资源方言场景下端到端语音对话建模提供了高效可扩展的解决方案，并已完全开源，为后续研究和实际应用提供资源支持。

title: Complete, Scalable, and Robust Prioritized Planning for Multi-Robot Ordered Storage and Retrieval at Maximum Capacity
summary: Automated warehouses face a fundamental trade-off between maximizing storage density and achieving high retrieval throughput. While puzzle-based storage (PBS) architectures increase capacity by eliminating aisles, coordinating multiple robots in these high-density spaces is computationally challenging due to the potential for deadlocks. This paper introduces a novel multi-robot formulation for the ``ordered storage and retrieval problem at maximum capacity''. The focus is on rectangular grids accessible from a single boundary, where loads need to be first stored up to full capacity and then efficiently retrieved, given a planned departure sequence. This work bridges the gap between geometric feasibility and execution efficiency by leveraging the properties of relocation-free arrangements. These properties guide an online, prioritized multi-agent path-finding algorithm, which is the main contribution of this work. Unlike general centralized planners, the approach exploits the specific invariants of the storage arrangement to guarantee completeness and prevent deadlocks, enabling scalability. Experiments demonstrate that the method achieves near-linear improvement in makespan with respect to the number of robots, up to $m = C$, where $C$ is the grid width. Crucially, the algorithmic overhead of supporting robustness is negligible; the system handles uncertainty in departure sequences using robust storage arrangements with no significant penalty in execution speed compared to the non-robust baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的多机器人仓储与检索方法，兼顾高密度存储与高吞吐量，能在消除通道的高密度环境下高效避免死锁，提升多机器人检索效率。
AI.motivation: 自动化仓库在存储密度与高吞吐量之间存在本质权衡。传统高密度设计（如无通道设计）虽然提升容量，但多机器人高效协调、死锁问题极具挑战。解决“有序存储与检索下的最大容量”问题有重要的理论与应用价值。
AI.method: 提出了一种适用于单侧边界可访问矩形网格的多机器人有序存储与检索新模型。利用无重定位排列的几何特性，指导一种在线、带优先级的多智能体路径规划算法，不仅可避免死锁且保证可扩展性和完备性。方法专为本问题设计，异于通用集中式方案，能够利用高密度存储结构的特定不变性。
AI.result: 实验显示，该方法在机器人数量增加时，使完工时间几乎线性提升，最大到机器人数量等于网格宽度时仍有效。此外，支持鲁棒性的算法开销极小，在应对检索顺序不确定性时执行速度几乎无损。
AI.conclusion: 所提出方法能有效地协调多机器人于高密度PBS仓库中执行有序存储与检索，兼顾几何可行性与执行效率，避免死锁且具良好扩展性；在实际应用中，即使存取顺序有变化亦具良好鲁棒性。

title: A Review of Vision-Based Vehicle Detection for UAV-Based Traffic Monitoring: Experimental Insights and Future Directions
summary: In Intelligent Transportation System (ITS), unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based surveillance offers an innovative solution to traffic surveillance with wide coverage and real-time data collection capabilities. In comparison to fixed ground-based infrastructure, UAVs are able to respond to dynamic traffic but present challenges such as vehicle detection at varying altitudes, compensation for motion-induced image variations and efficient processing of high-resolution images. Deep learning has been largely beneficial on improving the detection accuracy; however, for practical deployment, a critical assessment of the accuracy, latency, and harmonization with current transportation systems needs to be carefully considered. This survey reviews recent advancements in the UAV-based traffic monitoring, with a primary focus being deep neural network models for traffic analytics in various urban settings. Three main challenges identified in the literature are ensuring compatibility with traffic control systems, achieving real-time processing to optimize traffic flow, and maintaining robust detection in different environmental conditions. Existing solutions often lack comprehensive frameworks for utilizing UAV captured data to respond to incidents and manage traffic effectively. Future research should focus on optimal detection models, edge processing, and adaptive control integration to improve the responsiveness of urban traffic management.

AI.tldr: 无人机（UAV）在智能交通系统中的监控应用为城市交通管理带来了广泛覆盖和实时采集的新机会，但存在检测算法、实时处理及系统集成等挑战。本文对基于深度学习的无人机交通监控研究进行了综述，讨论了模型准确性与系统融合等问题，并指出未来需聚焦于更优检测模型、边缘计算与自适应控制的深度集成。
AI.motivation: 智能交通系统需要实时、广泛监控以优化交通流，而传统地面基础设施响应性不足。无人机因可移动、灵活、覆盖面广，成为城市交通监控的新利器，但实际上部署中在检测、延迟和系统兼容性上仍有较大难题。
AI.method: 通过综述分析近期无人机交通监控相关文献，主要聚焦于基于深度神经网络的交通分析方法，评估其准确率、处理速度以及与现有交通管控系统的兼容性。
AI.result: 总结发现，当前的无人机交通监控多聚焦于单独算法提升，缺乏与交通系统的深层协同，存在检测准确性受限、实时性和环境鲁棒性不足等主要问题。
AI.conclusion: 未来研究需关注更高效的检测算法、边缘端实时处理能力以及与现有交通管控系统的协同调度，以实现真正高效的城市交通智能化管理。

title: Commitment Before Realization: When Classifier-Free Guidance Becomes Unnecessary in Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is usually kept on throughout masked diffusion language model decoding, although its benefit varies across prompts and over time. We study when CFG is actually needed by comparing, from any partial output, the probability of eventual constraint satisfaction under continued CFG and under base-only continuation. Their difference defines the remaining value of guidance. Guidance dependence is highly prompt-specific. Many prompts already succeed without CFG, while for others it provides no measurable benefit or can be harmful. For prompts that do benefit, the gain is often concentrated early. We define the commitment horizon $\astar$ as the earliest point from which switching all remaining decoding to the base model reduces final success by no more than a chosen tolerance. Under the base model, the corresponding success probability, or committor, is a martingale. To first order, CFG's per-step effect is governed by the covariance between the guidance logit direction and the successor committor. This gives a local account of when guidance can help, but it does not by itself locate the horizon. Among prompts with an observed preterminal horizon, $\astar$ is usually early and varies more within constraint families than between them. Freezing each prompt at its own cross-fitted horizon is noninferior to full CFG on all 13 subtasks at the prespecified margin, even while many tokens remain masked. This separates commitment from realization. The boundary also identifies a later region in which higher parallelism adds only a small cost in constraint success, although fluency still degrades with parallel width. For failed trajectories, reopening committed positions improves recovery in both failure modes.

AI.tldr: 作者系统分析了在掩码扩散语言模型解码过程中，何时需要Classifier-free guidance（CFG），发现CFG的收益高度依赖具体提示且大多集中在解码初期。提出了“承诺视界”概念，用于动态切换指导策略以高效保障输出质量。
AI.motivation: 当前CFG被默认持续开启，但其带来的益处在不同提示和解码阶段并不一致。理解何时及如何使用CFG，可以优化模型性能和效率。
AI.method: 作者通过对比任何中间解码状态下CFG和只用基础模型继续解码的约束满足概率，定义了剩余指导价值，并分析了CFG的收益区域和影响因素，提出了“承诺视界”（commitment horizon）用于界定启用CFG的时机。
AI.result: 实验显示，很多提示本就无需CFG，部分场景CFG无益甚至有害。对实际有益的场景，收益多集中在解码早期。对所有13个子任务，按每个提示自身计算出的视界点进行局部切换，不劣于全程启用CFG且提升效率。
AI.conclusion: CFG的收益强依赖提示内容且主要集中在早期。合理、动态地调度CFG（如在承诺视界点切换模型），可保障解码效果并提升并行度和效率，这对未来定制化解码策略具有指导意义。

title: Enhancing Autonomous Vehicle Navigation with a Clothoid-Based Lateral Controller
comment: Published version. 21 pages. Published in Applied Sciences, 2024
summary: This study introduces an advanced lateral control strategy for autonomous vehicles using a clothoid-based approach integrated with an adaptive lookahead mechanism. The primary focus is on enhancing lateral stability and path-tracking accuracy through the application of Euler spirals for smooth curvature transitions, thereby reducing passenger discomfort and the risk of vehicle rollover. An innovative aspect of our work is the adaptive adjustment of lookahead distance based on real-time vehicle dynamics and road geometry, which ensures optimal path following under varying conditions. A quasi-feedback control algorithm constructs optimal clothoids at each time step, generating the appropriate steering input. A lead filter compensates for the vehicle's lateral dynamics lag, improving control responsiveness and stability. The effectiveness of the proposed controller is validated through a comprehensive co-simulation using TruckSim and Simulink, demonstrating significant improvements in lateral control performance across diverse driving scenarios. Future directions include scaling the controller for higher-speed applications and further optimization to minimize off-track errors, particularly for articulated vehicles.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于渐开线（clothoid）和自适应前视机制的自动驾驶车辆横向控制策略，大幅提升路径跟踪精度和车辆侧向稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有的车辆横向控制方法在应对不同道路曲率和动态条件时，常常存在稳定性不足、响应延迟及跟踪误差较大等问题，影响乘客舒适性与安全。本文旨在通过平滑曲率过渡和自适应机制，解决上述难题。
AI.method: 采用欧拉螺线（渐开线）实现平滑的曲率变化，并引入自适应前视距离，根据车辆动态和道路几何实时调整。每个时刻利用准反馈控制算法生成最优渐开线，实时输出转向指令。为提升响应与稳定性，还加入前馈滤波器补偿车辆横向动力学的滞后。
AI.result: 通过在TruckSim与Simulink中的联合仿真，不同驾驶场景下该控制器均表现出横向控制性能的明显提升，包括稳定性、路径跟踪精度和响应速度等方面。
AI.conclusion: 提出的控制策略能够有效提升自动驾驶车辆横向控制表现，未来将针对高车速和铰接式车辆进行扩展和优化，进一步提升实用性并减少偏离路径的误差。

title: BRACE: Taming Sharp Irregularities via Barycentric Rational Forecasting for Fast Diffusion Transformers Inference
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have demonstrated exceptional performance in high-fidelity image and video generation. To alleviate their massive computational overhead, temporal feature caching has been proposed to bypass redundant computations. However, existing cache-then-forecast methods driven by derivative-based polynomials often cause severe quality degradation under high acceleration due to unstable long-step predictions. To address this bottleneck, we propose Barycentric Rational Forecasting with Chebyshev Enhancement (BRACE). Motivated by the observation that DiT feature trajectories are globally smooth yet frequently exhibit sharp irregularities and local non-smoothness, BRACE shifts the paradigm from derivative-driven polynomial extrapolation to feature-driven rational forecasting. Specifically, it maintains a local sliding window to cache sparse historical features and leverages adapted Chebyshev weights to formulate a barycentric rational function, directly aggregating these raw features to ensure numerical stability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BRACE achieves state-of-the-art quality-efficiency trade-offs across various DiT architectures with negligible computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Diffusion Transformers（DiTs）在高保真图像和视频生成中的高计算开销，提出了BRACE方法，通过特征驱动的有理数预测稳定提升效率，同时保障生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于缓存与预测的加速策略在高加速比下多因使用基于导数的多项式预测，导致生成质量显著下降。为解决此问题，需要在不牺牲质量的基础上提升预测稳定性和效率。
AI.method: 提出BRACE方法，利用局部滑动窗口缓存稀疏历史特征，通过加权Chebyshev系数构建重心有理函数，直接对历史特征进行聚合，实现数值上的高稳定性和高效预测。该方法不依赖特征导数，提升对轨迹不平滑和局部突变的适应性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，BRACE方法能够在多种DiT架构上取得当前最佳的效率与质量权衡，并且引入的额外计算开销极低。
AI.conclusion: BRACE有效突破了现有高加速预测中生成质量下降难题，在保证极高数值稳定性和效率的同时，实现了高-fidelity内容生成，具有广泛应用前景。

title: Archer: Adaptive Reuse of Cached Hidden States for Efficient Rollback in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) iteratively refine a sequence, allowing earlier predictions to be revised as context evolves. This rollback capability distinguishes them from irreversible autoregressive generation, but makes inference costly. Every denoising update alters the global context, forcing both prompt and response states to be recomputed even though only response tokens are revisable. Key-value (KV) caching could reduce this cost, yet conventional caching assumes immutable historical states and is therefore difficult to reconcile with rollback.In this paper, we introduce Adaptive Reuse of Cached Hidden States for Efficient Rollback (Archer), a training-free KV caching method for rollback-capable DLMs. Archer asymmetrically keeps the mutable response synchronized with the current hypothesis while reusing prompt K/V within a bounded state neighborhood. Although prompt representations also change under bidirectional attention, their token identities remain fixed; bounded reuse therefore amortizes repeated prompt computation without caching mutable response states. It also delays feedback from tentative tokens, reducing premature reinforcement of transient high-confidence errors and giving rollback more opportunity to correct them. Our analysis characterizes prompt reuse as a reversibility-aligned cache boundary, bounds its state-dependent approximation error, and gives a decoder-margin condition for preserving full-refresh decisions.Existing DLM acceleration often trades quality for speed. Archer shifts this frontier, attaining the best mean performance of 33.63% together with a 2.57x mean speedup on the main suite. Across evaluated settings, it improves Pass@1 by up to 3.05 points and reaches up to 2.95x speedup. Controlled analyses connect the quality gain to delayed prompt feedback and validate state-aware refresh. Our code is available at https://github.com/Hxnng/Archer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种提升扩散型语言模型(DLMs)推理效率的新方法——Archer，通过自适应复用缓存隐藏态，在不牺牲性能的前提下，大幅加快了带回溯能力的DLMs的生成速度。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型具备带回溯的输出修正能力，但反复计算导致推理成本高昂。传统KV缓存机制难以兼容DLM的可回滚特性，因此亟需一种高效的缓存方法来提升推理速度。
AI.method: Archer是一种无需额外训练的KV缓存方法，只对不可回溯（prompt）部分的K/V向量进行有界缓存和复用，从而避免每次更新都整体重算，仅在必要时刷新缓存。此举还可延后对临时高置信度错误的反馈，给予回溯机制更多纠错机会。作者用理论分析刻画了缓存边界与误差，并引入判据以保障关键决策完整刷新。
AI.result: 在主测试集上，Archer达到了33.63%的最佳平均性能，实现了2.57倍的推理加速效果。部分任务中提升Pass@1达3.05个百分点，最高可达2.95倍加速。实验表明性能提升与缓存启用后提醒反馈延迟、状态感知刷新有关。
AI.conclusion: Archer能够有效兼容带回溯的DLM特性，显著提升推理效率且保持、甚至提升生成质量。该方法无需模型结构修改或额外训练，具有较高实际应用价值。

title: CoCoNav: Conformal Control for Safe Robot Navigation in Crowds
summary: Safe and efficient robot navigation in crowds requires anticipating pedestrian motion despite uncertain and potentially shifting prediction errors. Existing reactive methods can produce oscillatory behavior, while predictive planners often treat forecasts as exact or rely on restrictive error models. Incorporating conservative uncertainty sets as hard constraints can also render model predictive control (MPC) infeasible. We propose \textit{CoCoNav}, a crowd-navigation framework that combines online conformal calibration with runtime-certified planning. A horizon-specific conformal proportional--integral controller adapts trajectory-error bounds to regulate long-run empirical coverage, enabling the framework to respond to changing prediction errors. A \textit{relax-then-verify} planner preserves solver feasibility by generating nominal trajectories with soft-constrained MPC and separately certifying them, together with contingency maneuvers, against the calibrated bounds before execution. Simulations and quadruped experiments show that CoCoNav achieves a favorable balance among collision avoidance, task success, and navigation efficiency relative to the evaluated baselines.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出CoCoNav框架，通过在线自适应不确定性校准与规划认证，实现机器人在人群中的安全高效导航。
AI.motivation: 目前机器人在人群导航时，预测误差不确定且变化，传统方法不是只依赖精确预测，要么加入过于保守的约束导致不可行性，缺乏对实际变化的动态适应能力。
AI.method: 引入CoCoNav方法：应用在线共形校准，通过PI控制器自适应调整轨迹误差界。规划器采用Relax-then-Verify思想，先用软约束MPC生成轨迹，再结合应急轨迹与已校准的误差边界一同进行认证，保证执行前的可行性与安全性。
AI.result: 在仿真与四足机器人实验中，CoCoNav在避碰率、任务完成率及导航效率三方面相较于基线方法表现更佳。
AI.conclusion: CoCoNav能以动态调节误差界和柔性约束提升导航性能，为人群环境下高效安全的机器人导航提供新方案。

title: Multimodal Skin Lesion Classification with Swin Transformer and Clinical Metadata Fusion
summary: Skin lesion classification plays an important role in supporting the early diagnosis of skin cancer. However, automated analysis remains challenging due to class imbalance, inter-class similarity, and intra-class variability in dermoscopic images. This paper proposes a multimodal classification framework that combines Swin Transformer-based image features with structured clinical metadata to improve diagnostic performance through integrated visual-context learning. Experiments on a publicly available dataset show that the proposed model achieves a test accuracy of 92.55% and a macro F1-score of 91.33%, with strong performance across minority classes. Temperature scaling is applied as a post-hoc calibration method, resulting in a reduction in expected calibration error and improving prediction reliability, while uncertainty estimation is incorporated to further assess the confidence of model predictions. Qualitative explainability analysis further shows that the model focuses on lesion regions during inference. Therefore, the results demonstrate that multimodal fusion, combined with calibration and interpretability analysis, provides an effective and trustworthy approach for automated skin lesion classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结合视觉特征与结构化临床信息的多模态皮肤病变分类框架，在数据集上取得高精度并增强小样本类别表现。
AI.motivation: 现有皮肤病变自动分析因类别不均衡、类别间相似度高和类别内差异大而面临挑战。作者希望通过多模态信息融合克服这些难题，提高分类准确率与可靠性。
AI.method: 提出基于Swin Transformer的图像特征提取与结构化临床元数据融合框架，通过视觉—上下文协同学习提升分类性能。采用温度缩放后处理方法进行模型校准，并集成不确定性估计以评估模型置信度，同时进行可解释性分析以理解模型关注区域。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，所提模型取得92.55%测试准确率和91.33%的macro F1分数，对少数类同样表现优异。经过温度校准后，模型期望校准误差下降，预测更为可靠。
AI.conclusion: 多模态融合结合预测校准和可解释性分析，为自动皮肤病变分类提供了高效、可信的解决方案。

title: Wisdom in Unity: The Role of Multilingual Training in Figurative Language Identification in Proverbs
summary:
Although multilingual approaches to figurative language identification are not new, the shift beyond language homogeneous training data requires a clearer understanding of the contribution of translated multilingual supervision. We examine this question using 742 proverb concepts across 6,787 translated instances in seven languages. We evaluate five models, including multilingual encoders and instruction tuned LLMs, under progressively increasing levels of multilingual supervision. Moreover, we introduce a multidimensional annotation framework for proverbs that characterizes them through four complementary figurative forms: Metaphorical, Moral/Advisory, Cause-Effect, and Culture Specific.
  Our findings show that approximately 50% of the translated multilingual training data is sufficient to achieve near-optimal figurative language identification performance. We further show that combining diverse figurative forms yields the strongest overall performance. A notable finding is that the least frequent figurative form, Culture Specific, exhibits the largest performance gains under multilingual supervision. Furthermore, the Moral/Advisory and Culture Specific forms contribute most to the performance of instruction-tuned LLMs on figurative language identification. These findings motivate multilingual figurative language identification to move beyond metaphor-centric taxonomies toward concept level multidimensional frameworks that explicitly model complementary forms of figurative meaning.

AI.tldr: 作者分析了包含七种语言的谚语译文数据，探索多维度的比喻语言识别，并发现一半左右的多语数据即可达到接近最佳表现，不同修辞形式的结合能提升整体表现，尤其是文化特定与道德/劝谏类。
AI.motivation: 现有多语种比喻语言识别方法多基于单语数据，缺乏对多语翻译监督贡献的深入理解，且对比喻类型的区分不够细致。作者希望通过更细致的框架和多语实验，探究多语训练数据和不同修辞形式的作用。
AI.method: 收集了742条谚语的6,787个多语种实例，覆盖七种语言，并对谚语进行四种修辞类型（隐喻、道德/劝谏、因果、文化特定）标注。对五种模型进行多语监督程度递增的系统评测，涵盖多语编码器、指令微调LLM等。
AI.result: 大约50%的多语翻译训练数据即可达到接近最优的比喻语言识别效果。多样修辞形式的结合带来最佳整体表现。其中，最少见的文化特定类别在多语监督下提升最大，道德/劝谏与文化特定类型对于指令微调LLM的提升作用尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 研究呼吁多语比喻语言识别研究应突破以隐喻为中心的方法，转向面向概念层级的多维框架，显式建模多种互补的比喻意义，以支持更丰富和有效的识别效果。

title: Drone-Assisted UAV-UGV Collaboration for Autonomous Navigation in Snow-Covered Terrain
summary: This paper presents a collaborative UAV-UGV navigation framework for high-altitude, snow-covered terrain, where reduced visibility and unstable ground render conventional methods ineffective. We introduce a custom efficient U-Net architecture that falls under the computational constraints for real-time road segmentation, utilizing a novel synthetic snow data augmentation technique to achieve 96.5% segmentation accuracy. For UAV localization, we implement an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) fusing onboard GPS and IMU data, achieving a maximum observed positional error of +-0.5 meters. The UGV position is determined via a visual tracking pipeline using YOLOv5 and depth data from the UAV's RGB-D camera. A dynamic path planning algorithm utilizes this segmentation to adjust for snow drifts, enabling successful navigation in obscured test environment with minimal deviation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套针对高海拔、积雪地形下协作式无人机-无人车（UAV-UGV）导航框架，能够在能见度低和地面不稳定的情况下实现高效、精准的道路分割与路径规划，显著提升导航性能。
AI.motivation: 在高海拔、积雪覆盖环境下，传统导航方法因能见度低、地面不稳定而失效，因此亟需新的导航技术以保障无人系统的安全高效作业。
AI.method: 1）设计高效轻量的U-Net网络，用于道路分割，并结合创新性的合成雪数据增强技术提升分割精度；2）利用扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）融合GPS与IMU实现UAV定位，定位误差最大0.5米；3）采用YOLOv5与UAV的RGB-D摄像头深度数据实现对UGV的视觉追踪定位；4）基于分割结果，开发动态路径规划算法，实时适应雪堆变化。
AI.result: 所提方法实现了96.5%的道路分割精度，UAV最大定位误差0.5米，在积雪遮蔽实验场景中完成了低偏差导航。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的协作导航框架可在极端雪地环境下（能见度差、地面不稳）实现高精度道路识别与路径自主优化，具备良好的实时性与鲁棒性，推动无人协作系统在极端环境下的应用。

title: Beyond Isotropic Assumptions: Continuity-Constrained Segmentation and GPU Morphometry for Nanoscale GBM Analysis
summary:
Confocal microscopy of optically cleared and swelled tissue resolves complex biological structures in 3D, but such acquisitions are highly anisotropic: along the under-sampled axial direction the structure can appear discontinuous, hampering reconstruction and automated quantitative analysis. The usual remedy upsamples the axial dimension to an isotropic volume before training a segmentation model, which requires dense annotations in the upsampled space, a prohibitive labeling burden.
  We present an end-to-end, GPU-accelerated framework that overcomes this without additional annotations. The model is trained on the native acquisition volume; random rotation of training patches leverages the well-resolved lateral plane to supply the missing axial information, and a z-axis continuity loss keeps neighboring slices consistent. We adapt both a convolutional (3D U-Net) and a transformer (SwinUNETR) backbone, aggregate overlapping patches by Gaussian consensus, and compute point-spread-function-corrected membrane thickness by ray-surface intersection on the GPU.
  We apply the method to the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), a thin, highly convoluted part of the kidney's filtration barrier that grows more irregular in disease. Segmentation accuracy matches inter-expert agreement. Continuity-aware training improves reconstruction smoothness and suppresses a periodic terracing artifact at minimal accuracy cost. We quantify GBM thickness across the reconstructed 3D surface and capture disease-related thickening, enabling fully automated anisotropic 3D morphometry of biological structures without dense volumetric labels or image restoration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需额外标注即可实现各向异性三维生物结构自动分割和定量分析的端到端框架。
AI.motivation: 三维共聚焦显微成像中，由于轴向分辨率低，结构表现为不连续，影响结构重建与自动分析。现有方法通常需要对轴向上采样并进行密集标注，极大增加标注难度和成本。
AI.method: 提出在原始各向异性体数据上训练分割模型，不需额外标注。通过随机旋转训练块，使模型利用横向高分辨率信息补足轴向不足；引入轴向连续性损失以提升切片间连贯性；分别基于3D U-Net和SwinUNETR骨干，并采用高斯加权聚合与GPU加速的膜厚度计算。
AI.result: 该方法应用于肾小球基底膜（GBM）三维分割，分割准确率达到专家一致水平，较好地抑制了'台阶状'伪影，实现了平滑连续的重建。同时实现了疾病相关厚度变化的自动精确量化。
AI.conclusion: 无需密集三维标注即可实现高准确度的各向异性三维生物结构自动分割和定量分析，具有很强的实际应用潜力。

title: NeuPAT: Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning for Language-Preserving MLLMs
summary: Multimodal expansion of large language models (LLMs) enables new perceptual capabilities but often compromises the language intelligence acquired during pretraining. In this work, we investigate this phenomenon from the perspective of internal adaptation dynamics and discover that neurons in pretrained LLMs exhibit heterogeneous plasticity during multimodal learning: some neurons are critical for preserving language capabilities, while others are more adaptive to multimodal knowledge. Based on this insight, we propose NeuPAT (Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning), a lightweight and architecture-agnostic framework that allocates neuron-wise update constraints during multimodal instruction tuning. NeuPAT uses a small-scale probing stage to estimate neuron adaptation patterns and selectively protects language-sensitive neurons while promoting multimodal adaptation through more plastic neurons. Experiments across diverse LLM families demonstrate that NeuPAT recovers 94.5\% of the language capability degradation caused by vanilla tuning on 11 language benchmarks while maintaining comparable multimodal performance, providing an effective approach for capability-preserving multimodal expansion.

AI.tldr: 将大语言模型（LLMs）进行多模态拓展会削弱其语言能力，该文提出了NeuPAT方法，有效缓解了能力损失问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态拓展能赋予LLMs新感知能力，但通常导致原有语言能力下降，因此需要方法保护语言能力。
AI.method: 作者发现LLM神经元在多模态学习时可塑性不均，有的对语言保留至关重要。提出NeuPAT框架，通过小规模探测了解神经元适应性，对关键神经元设置更新约束，以保持语言能力，其它神经元促进多模态适应。该方法无需修改架构，适用范围广。
AI.result: 在多种LLM及11项语言基准测试上，NeuPAT可恢复94.5%的语言能力损失，同时保持与多模态基线接近的性能。
AI.conclusion: NeuPAT是一种轻量且通用的能力守恒多模态拓展方法，能有效缓解现有方法带来的语言能力下降。

title: A Mixed-Stiffness Anthropomimetic Fingertip Broadens the Operating Range for Coin Grasping
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables; supplementary material includes 3 figures, 1 table, and 1 video. Code, condition-wise trial data, CAD, and STL files are available at https://github.com/TogoLab/mixed-stiffness-fingertip-coin-grasping
summary: Robotic grasping of thin, flat objects such as coins on hard surfaces remains challenging because conventional methods require reorienting the object, accessing its underside, or adding a dedicated nail mechanism. We previously showed that a rigid nail arrests soft-pad deformation and thereby forms a geometric constraint that improves precision grasping. Here we asked whether an additional constraint-forming boundary, created within the pad by material choice rather than by anatomy, could extend the conditions under which that constraint holds. We fabricated anthropomimetic fingertips with Shore E10 silicone at the center and Shore A60 at the sides, and compared them with uniformly soft E10 fingertips. An automated apparatus performed an oblique rotational tip pinch in which the pad engaged the coin's lateral surface, lifting it from flush contact with no gap beneath it. Over variations in horizontal approach distances, vertical finger displacements, and index-finger rotation, the mixed-stiffness pair maintained high success rates across more tested settings than the uniform pair during both geometric-constraint formation and the transition to a stable grasp. The nail-free pair failed in all 36 conditions of Experiment 1-1. However, the uniform pair performed better when coin position along the finger axis was varied, a condition-dependent trade-off. After tuning for coin size, both fingertip types grasped all six Japanese denominations. These results suggest that the operating range for thin-object grasping depends not only on pad softness but also on where stiffness is placed within a nail-supported pad, making boundary placement a candidate fingertip design variable.

AI.tldr: 通过调整机器人指尖不同部位的软硬材料分布，可以提升抓取薄、平物体的成功率，尤其是在无需指甲结构的情况下。
AI.motivation: 传统的机器人抓取方法难以高效拾取放在坚硬表面上的薄、平物体（如硬币），原因在于通常需要重新定位物体或特定的机械结构（如指甲）才能抓取。前期研究发现，通过刚性指甲可以控制指垫变形从而提升抓取精度。本研究希望探索：能否通过材料分布在指垫内部创建约束边界，从而在更多条件下提升抓取能力。
AI.method: 研究人员制作了仿人类手指的机械指尖，其中中心采用Shore E10硅胶（较软），两侧用Shore A60硅胶（较硬），并与全部为E10（均匀软）的指尖作对比。用自动化设备实施具有旋转角度的夹取动作，通过不同的接近距离、指尖垂直位移及手指旋转角度，测试各指尖组合抓取硬币的表现。
AI.result: 混合硬度的指尖在绝大多数测试条件下均维持了较高的抓取成功率，优于均匀软指尖，后者在某些沿指轴调整硬币位置的特定情况下表现更佳。无指甲结构的指尖在所有36个实验条件下均失败。调整指尖以适应不同尺寸硬币后，两种指尖类型都能抓取全部6种日本硬币。
AI.conclusion: 薄物体的有效抓取不仅取决于指垫的软硬程度，还与硬度分布位置相关。材料边界的设计可以作为未来机器人指尖的重要参数，从而提升抓取薄、平物体的灵活性和成功率。

title: Open-World Hierarchical Perception: Taxonomic Abstraction over Class-Agnostic Proposals for the Safe Handling of Out-of-Vocabulary Road Objects
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Third paper in a series; v1 archived at Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21593472. Code: https://github.com/freshNfunky/IE2025-Research-Paper
summary: A closed-set detector for autonomous driving must assign every object one of a fixed set of labels. On an object outside that set (a horse-drawn carriage, road debris, livestock on a rural road) it can only force a confident but wrong specific label or drop the object. Prior work in this series replaced the flat label set with a hierarchical taxonomy and a runtime abstraction rule, but evaluated it only on the boxes a closed detector already produces. This paper takes the layer open-world: we place taxonomic abstraction on top of class-agnostic region proposals so objects the closed detector never boxes can still be classified or flagged; we report a feasibility study of three open-world signals (class-agnostic segmentation, appearance-based out-of-distribution scoring, monocular depth) that shows why no single 2D cue suffices and how they compose; and we run the evaluation the earlier papers could not, a ground-truth leave-classes-out benchmark on real annotated objects. Holding out seven COCO classes and classifying their 235 ground-truth crops, a flat closed head emits a confident wrong specific label 100% of the time (37% of them in the wrong super-category, e.g. an animal named as a vehicle), whereas the hierarchical layer emits zero confident wrong specific labels and safely handles 94% of the objects (a correct super-category, or an explicit UNKNOWN OBSTACLE). We are explicit that this is a safety result, not a specificity one: the correct super-category is recovered only 26% of the time and the remaining 69% are conservatively flagged unknown. The contribution is an open-world perception layer that never makes a confident categorical mistake on an out-of-vocabulary object, together with an honest account of its cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶的开放世界感知层，通过在分类不可知的候选区域基础上叠加层级抽象，实现对闭集分类器漏检或误检的异常物体的更安全处理，并在实际留类测试集上进行了评估。结果显示该方法能够彻底避免对未知类别给出自信但错误的具体标签。
AI.motivation: 闭集目标检测器只能对固定类别的目标进行标注，遇到未在集合内的物体时，要么错误自信地赋予标签，要么直接忽略，可能带来安全隐患。因此，需要一种可以开放世界感知，并对未知类别做出更安全反应的检测方式。
AI.method: 在已有方法的基础上，本文将层次化的类目体系结合分类不可知的候选区域提议，并引入三种开放世界信号（无类别分割、基于外观的分布外检测打分、单目深度），通过组合这些信号，实现对未知类别物体的检测和分级抽象。同时，设计了真实的留类测试集进行评估。
AI.result: 在COCO数据集中留出七类物体作为未知类别，结果显示：传统闭集检测器总是给出自信且错误的具体标签，其中37%分错大类。而本文方法能避免自信错误标签，对94%物体能给出正确大类或显式标记为未知障碍。正确识别大类比例为26%，69%保守地标注为未知。
AI.conclusion: 提出的开放世界感知层能够有效防止对闭集外物体做出自信但错误类别判定，优先保证安全。虽然有一定的特异性损失，但极大提升了面对未见类别的鲁棒性，真实评测结果进一步证明其实用价值。

title: Can LLM Agents Stick to the Script? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Consistency in Interactive Narratives
summary: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) is revolutionizing AI for Games by enabling open-ended and fluid interactive storytelling. However, existing research has largely overlooked the critical challenge of maintaining long-horizon logical consistency and narrative integrity against unconstrained user interventions. To address this, we formulate this challenge as Narrative Commitment Preservation (NCP), and take interactive narrative as our testbed. We introduce NCP-Bench, a benchmark of 100 narrative environments derived from movie synopses. Each environment includes a structured narrative specification (trajectory, commitments, and initial facts) that we can automatically check throughout the interaction between the player agent and the narrator agent. Experiments across state-of-the-art LLMs reveal a substantial long-horizon consistency gap: high linguistic quality does not guarantee commitment preservation; even strong models frequently generate logically conflicting content under adversarial interventions, with the best-performing model (GPT-5.2) achieving only 42% survival rate after 20 turns and fact conflict rates ranging from 40% to 68% across models, and only isolated runs satisfying all achievement commitments within the 100-turn limit.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出并系统评估了针对大型语言模型（LLM）互动叙事中保持叙事承诺一致性的挑战。作者创建了NCP-Bench基准，对主流LLM进行了实验，揭示了它们在面对长期互动和用户干扰时逻辑一致性表现较差。
AI.motivation: LLM推动了AI互动叙事的发展，但长周期内逻辑一致性维护问题尚未解决，尤其是当用户进行自由干预时。当前研究多聚焦于文本质量，极少关注叙事一致性问题，因此作者希望系统刻画并量化此类挑战。
AI.method: 作者提出了“叙事承诺保持（NCP）”任务，设计了NCP-Bench基准，包含100个基于电影梗概生成的叙事环境，每个环境有可自动检测的情节、承诺和初始事实规范。通过让玩家和叙述者代理反复互动，分析主流LLM在长周期触发下的逻辑一致性表现。
AI.result: 多种主流LLM在NCP-Bench下均表现出显著的一致性缺陷：即使是最先进的GPT-5.2，20回合后维持叙事承诺的存活率也仅42%；事实冲突率高达40%到68%；仅有极少数模型能在100回合内实现所有成就承诺。
AI.conclusion: 当前主流LLM在长周期、自由互动叙事场景下，保持叙事承诺和逻辑一致性能力仍有巨大提升空间。仅提升文本语言质量远不能解决叙事一致性问题。未来应针对NCP任务进行模型改进和定制化。

title: Auditing Instruction-Trajectory Mismatches in Multimodal Robot Demonstrations
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). 8 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables
summary: Robot demonstration datasets used to train vision-language-action policies can contain a subtle but harmful failure mode: trajectories that are behaviorally correct but paired with the wrong language instruction. We study post-hoc auditing of these Instruction-Trajectory Mismatches (ITMs). Unlike failed rollouts, ITMs often look plausible, and can corrupt the language-behavior mapping learned by the policy. We propose Multimodal Probabilistic Fusion (MMPF), a training-free auditing framework that treats each modality as an expert, estimates a task-label distribution from local neighborhood agreement and global prototype similarity, and then fuses modalities with predictive-entropy weighting in a product of experts. Across LIBERO benchmarks with injected instruction mismatches and noisy real-robot data, MMPF achieves the strongest overall ITM detection and label correction accuracy. We also show that auditing improves most downstream policy learning in settings where language is needed to disambiguate the task. We demonstrate in real robot experiments that our method can achieve improved policy performance and show the trade-off of filtering demonstrations compared to relabeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种训练后审计框架，专注于检测和纠正机器人示范数据中的指令-轨迹不匹配（ITM）。通过多模态融合方法，有效提升了检测准确率，并改善了下游策略学习和实际机器人任务表现。
AI.motivation: 机器人以视觉-语言-动作策略进行训练时，示范数据可能存在行为和语言指令不匹配的问题。这种匹配错误不易察觉，却会影响策略模型的泛化和性能，因此需要有效的后期检测与修正手段。
AI.method: 提出了多模态概率融合（MMPF）框架，无需额外训练，将视觉/动作和语言两个模态视为独立‘专家’，结合局部邻域一致性和全局原型相似性生成任务标签分布，并采用预测熵加权方式将二者融合，在专家乘积架构下进行ITM检测与标签修正。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准及实际机器人包含注入指令混淆和噪声数据集上，MMPF方法实现了最优的ITM检测和标签修正准确率。同时，数据审计对需要语言任务判别的下游学习效果有提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提升了机器人数据集错误指令检测的能力，有助于提升策略训练效果和真实机器人任务表现。还分析了先过滤错误示范与直接重标示两类方法的权衡，可为实际系统设计提供参考。

title: Geometry Beats Estimated Depth: RGB-Only Multi-Camera 3D Tracking under Sim2Real
summary: The AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 evaluates multi-camera 3D perception in large indoor warehouses under a synthetic-to-real (Sim2Real) setting; depth is available only for training and validation, so inference is RGB-only. We use two RGB-only routes as a controlled test of one hypothesis: that cross-view geometric consistency, not monocular depth accuracy, governs performance under Sim2Real. The first is a geometry-first pipeline: YOLO11x detection, homography lifting to the world frame, class-level 3D size priors, multi-camera fusion, world-coordinate tracking, and offline tracklet stitching. The second is estimated-depth pseudo-LiDAR: monocular depth (D4RT, Metric3D~v2) back-projected into a fused point cloud and passed to a 3D detector (V-DETR), mirroring prior point-cloud winners that used depth. The gap is decisive: geometry-first reaches 13.0 3D HOTA (51.6 LocA), whereas pseudo-LiDAR collapses to 0.12 (9.2 LocA). We trace the collapse to cross-view inconsistency of monocular depth---scale correction is necessary but not sufficient---which domain-adaptation fine-tuning does not repair within budget. Within the geometry pipeline, offline stitching is the only intervention that helps; SAHI detection, appearance Re-ID, learned lifting, RT-DETR ensembling, test-time augmentation, and domain randomization all fail to beat the baseline detector. The bottlenecks are complementary: detection quality bounds the geometry route (DetA), localization consistency bounds pseudo-LiDAR (LocA). We release a complete, reproducible RGB-only pipeline and ablation.

AI.tldr: 本论文通过AI City Challenge 2026赛事，对大型室内仓库环境下的多摄像头3D感知任务进行了分析，比较了几种RGB-only（仅用RGB图像，无深度信息）方案，揭示了几何一致性优于单目深度预测。
AI.motivation: 在AI City Challenge 2026场景下，推理阶段无法获取深度信息，仅能利用RGB图像，因此需要探究如何在模拟到真实（Sim2Real）迁移下，通过多摄像头实现精确的3D感知及目标追踪。
AI.method: 作者设计了两类RGB-only方案：(1)“几何优先”流程，包括基于YOLO11x的检测、单应变换到世界坐标、3D先验、跨摄像头融合与离线轨迹拼接；(2)“伪LiDAR深度”流程，利用单目深度估计回投成点云输入3D检测器（V-DETR），模拟传统点云方案。比较各自表现，并分析性能瓶颈。
AI.result: “几何优先”方法3D HOTA达13.0（51.6 LocA），而伪LiDAR仅为0.12（9.2 LocA），显著落后。分析发现，单目深度导致的跨视角不一致是主因，简单的尺度修正和微调无法弥补。额外实验还发现只有离线轨迹拼接带来提升，其它检测增强手段未带来改进。
AI.conclusion: 在Sim2Real环境下，多摄像头几何一致性是提升3D感知性能的关键，单纯依赖单目深度估计难以迁移。几何优先的RGB-only流程优于深度预估点云方法。文中提供了完整可复现流程和消融实验。

title: STEMMA: An Adversarial Multi-Agent Framework for Evaluating Self-Identity Consistency in LLMs
summary: Knowledge Distillation is a widely adopted technique in the training and fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) enabling transfer of structured information and functional behavior from a large teacher model to a smaller student model while significantly reducing computational costs. However, as the use of distillation increases in both scale and complexity it raises an important question about what kind of knowledge is really transferred from the teacher model. In this work, we argue that apart from the functional knowledge, student models also learn behavioral patterns, specifically how a model represents its own identity raising concerns about output homogeneity, model biases, and accountability. To address this challenge, we introduce STEMMA, a multi-modal and multi-agent framework in which role specific agents collaboratively probe self identification behavior in different models. We also contribute a set of adversarial prompts designed manually to evaluate identity consistency in LLMs. Our results show that to an extent most models are vulnerable to inconsistencies in self-representations.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了知识蒸馏过程中，学生模型除了获悉功能性知识外，也继承了教师模型的自我表征行为。为此提出了STEMMA框架和一组用于测试大语言模型身份一致性的对抗性提示。结果显示，大部分模型在自我表征上一致性存在脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 随着知识蒸馏技术在大语言模型中的广泛应用，亟需理解学生模型到底从教师模型中学到了哪些知识，尤其是非任务相关的行为特征。
AI.method: 作者提出了STEMMA多模态多智能体框架与一套对抗性测试提示，能够协同探测不同模型的自我身份识别行为与一致性。
AI.result: 实验发现，绝大多数学生模型在自我表征（如身份说明）方面，存在易受攻击和不一致的问题。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏不仅转移功能性知识，也传播了教师模型的行为模式，这可能带来输出同质化、模型偏见和责任判定等新问题。因此，需要更加关注模型自我表征一致性的防护与评估。

title: 4D-WAM: Infusing Spatiotemporal Awareness into World Action Models through Trajectory Fields
summary: Building on recent advances in world models, World Action Models (WAMs) jointly model video prediction and action generation. However, they typically represent videos in 2D pixel space, creating a representation gap with 3D space in which robotic actions are executed. Recent 3D approaches introduce 3D information, but fail to fully exploit the dynamics of 3D structures. In this work, we propose 4D-WAM, a model-agnostic training strategy that injects spatiotemporal knowledge from 3D trajectory fields into WAMs through representation alignment. To this end, we introduce two complementary objectives: 1) motion alignment, which aligns temporal feature variations across adjacent frames and encourages the model to build local 4D awareness during training, and 2) destination alignment, which guides the model to infer the final destination from the source frame by minimizing the gap between their attention-like similarity distributions. Together, these objectives provide both local motion supervision and long-horizon goal guidance, enabling WAMs to learn trajectory-level spatiotemporal representations. Extensive in-distribution and out-of-distribution experiments across different base models demonstrate the model's improvements in spatial understanding, execution precision, robustness, generalization, and versatility.

AI.tldr: 4D-WAM是一种新的训练策略，通过对齐3D轨迹场的信息，提高世界动作模型（WAM）在时空理解和动作生成上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的WAM模型主要在2D像素空间建模，导致与实际以3D空间执行动作的机器人之间存在表征差距。虽然有些方法尝试引入3D信息，但未能充分利用3D结构的动态特性，因此需要一种方法更有效地将3D动态知识融入动作模型。
AI.method: 作者提出4D-WAM，这是一种与具体模型无关的训练策略。该方法通过引入3D轨迹场的时空知识并进行表征对齐，包含两大目标：1）运动对齐，调整相邻帧间的时间特征变化，鼓励模型在训练中学习局部4D感知；2）目的地对齐，从源帧引导模型推断终点，通过最小化两者相似度分布的差距实现。这两者结合，实现了对局部运动和长期目标的监督。
AI.result: 多组实验证明，4D-WAM在不同基础模型上均提升了空间理解、动作执行精度、鲁棒性、泛化能力和多样性等指标，无论是在分布内还是分布外任务中都有较好表现。
AI.conclusion: 4D-WAM通过融合3D轨迹的信息和设定对齐目标，实现了WAM时空表征和动作生成能力的全面提升，具有较强的实用意义和通用性。

title: Real-time physics inversion for retrieval of sub-pixel wildfire temperatures from VSWIR imaging spectroscopy
comment: In Review in Remote Sensing of Environment
summary: In this work, we present a wildfire temperature retrieval framework for VSWIR imaging spectroscopy data, employed on data from NASA's Airborne Visible Infrared Imaging Spectrometer (AVIRIS-3). The retrieval framework utilizes a full-physics approach in which a forward model is employed to resolve both solar and emitted radiance derived from a temperature distribution and utilizes the full spectral range in the residual fit. To optimize the forward model retrieval, we use state-of-the-art nonlinear least squares methods implemented for fast convergence on the on-board GPU, allowing for estimation of effective fire temperature within flight cadence. We verify the forward model assumptions on simulated spectra with an injected thermal signature and find good agreement with an RMSE of $41.8$ Kelvin (K). We apply the retrieval over the full 2025 FireSense AVIRIS-3 campaign, totaling 168 overflights with probable active fire spectra, and demonstrate a residual radiance fit of $\leq 10\%$ across bands in the short-wave infrared (SWIR). Lastly, we verify the applicability of the retrieved posterior fire temperature parameters to generalize to space-borne imaging spectrometers such as EMIT, by retrieving at coarsened spatial resolution. We find that the posterior distribution exhibits good coverage of the underlying sub-pixel temperature range with an absolute error of $30$ K across quantiles and a mean absolute error of $27.16$ K between spatial resolutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套利用VSWIR成像光谱数据进行野火温度反演的新框架，通过与NASA的AVIRIS-3数据结合，能高效、准确地获得火灾温度分布，并可泛化应用至星载光谱仪。
AI.motivation: 准确获取大范围野火的表观温度对灾情监控和分析极为重要，当前技术受精度和适用范围限制，因此亟需开发既高效又普适的温度反演方法。
AI.method: 采用全物理前向模型解决太阳辐射与火源发射辐射耦合，结合非线性最小二乘最优化算法，在机载GPU上实现快速温度反演，并对模拟与实测数据进行验证，能有效适用多光谱仪器和多空间分辨率。
AI.result: 模型在注入热信号的模拟光谱验证中得到41.8K的RMSE，在2025 FireSense AVIRIS-3全巡查数据集（168次飞越）中，短波红外剩余辐射拟合优于10%；推广到星载仪器时，亚像元温度绝对误差为30K，空间分辨率间均方误差为27.16K。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架能准确高效地反演野火温度，有良好泛化能力，适用面广，为未来大范围、实时野火监测和分析提供有力工具。

title: Thinking vs. NoThinking: Towards Interpreting Reasoning Mechanisms of Large Language Models via Sparse Autoencoders
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) employing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) exhibit superior reasoning capabilities, the neural mechanisms distinguishing this explicit Thinking mode from direct answer generation (NoThinking mode) remain poorly understood. To deconstruct this cognitive process, we apply Top-K Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to the intermediate representations of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and examine the model's divergent behaviors across math-solving tasks of three distinct difficulty levels. Observationally, we identify a clear distinction in how the model functions under two reasoning modes: Thinking mode relies on sparse and high-intensity feature activations driving verbal deduction independent of problem complexity, whereas NoThinking mode exhibits an adaptive and diffuse pattern prioritizing symbolic manipulation. Causally, suppressing the three most active sparse features by Total Activation Volume reveals three principles: (i) reasoning and syntactic structure are tightly coupled, as interventions consistently degrade \LaTeX{} and boxed-solution formatting; (ii) Thinking responds to disruption with compensatory over-generation marked by increased metacognitive cues and repetitive, low-information continuations; and (iii) coherent CoT behavior depends on a fragile coordination among specialized features, yielding distinct failure modes under perturbation but a consistently impaired output structure.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过分析LLM在连锁思维(Chain-of-Thought, CoT)和直接给出答案(NoThinking)两种推理模式下的神经机制，揭示了两者在中间表示上的显著区别，并探索其因果关系。
AI.motivation: 尽管CoT方法在推理任务上展现了优越能力，但目前对其有别于直接作答的神经机制仍缺乏深入理解。作者旨在揭开LLM不同推理模式下的内部认知过程。
AI.method: 采用Top-K稀疏自编码器（SAE）对DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B模型在三种不同难度数学题的中间特征进行分析，并在不同推理模式下观测和干预主要稀疏特征的激活。
AI.result: 观察上发现，Thinking模式特征激活稀疏且强度高，偏重语言推理，无关题目难度；NoThinking模式特征激活分散，更多依赖符号操作。干预三大稀疏特征后，破坏了数学表达的格式，CoT表现出代偿性过度生成和输出结构削弱，且出现不同的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 两种推理模式在内部机制上表现出显著差异，CoT行为依赖于脆弱的特征协调。该研究为理解生成式模型推理提供了重要实证基础。

title: DA-NBV: A Direction-Aware Next-Best-View Planner for Efficient 3D Reconstruction of Ships at Sea
summary: Accurate 3D reconstruction of ships at sea is important for maritime supervision, damage assessment, and autonomous maritime operations. Although 3D reconstruction has advanced considerably, high-quality data acquisition still largely relies on manually designed trajectories or skilled operators, resulting in high costs and limited scalability. Next-best-view (NBV) planning automates this process by selecting subsequent viewpoints based on the current state. However, existing NBV policies mainly model spatial occupancy while overlooking directional observation history. This limitation is particularly problematic for ships: their complex superstructures and severe self-occlusions require observations from multiple viewpoints, and insufficient directional coverage often yields incomplete reconstructions. These challenges are further amplified at sea, where wave-induced heave, roll, and pitch continuously alter the ship's pose and surface visibility. Meanwhile, wind disturbances and limited onboard power impose stricter requirements on scanning efficiency. To address these challenges, we propose DA-NBV, a direction-aware NBV policy that augments the conventional occupancy state with directional observation statistics. We introduce a learnable Position Advantage Field (PAF) that uses directional information to guide viewpoint selection. The policy further adopts a locally constrained action space and a nonlinear coverage-shaping reward to improve scanning efficiency. We also develop the ship-oriented SeaShip-3D dataset and a configurable sea-state simulation environment. Experiments under varying heave, roll, and pitch conditions show that DA-NBV improves reconstruction completeness by approximately 3 percentage points and reduces Chamfer distance by 43% while achieving higher path efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向船舶的方向感知型自动三维重建策略，通过引入方向性观察统计，有效提升了海上环境下船舶三维重建的完整性和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D重建系统很大程度上依赖手工设定轨迹或专业操作人员，导致数据采集成本高且难以扩展。而在海上，船舶结构复杂且存在自遮挡问题，且由于海浪等因素会不断改变船舶姿态，并对扫描效率提出更高要求，现有基于空间占据建模的NBV策略难以满足完整且高效重建的需求。
AI.method: 本文提出DA-NBV算法，在传统空间占据状态的基础上，引入方向性观察统计，通过可学习的位置优势字段（PAF）进一步利用方向信息指导视点选择。同时采用局部约束动作空间和非线性覆盖奖励机制提升路径与扫描效率，并开发了针对船舶的SeaShip-3D数据集和可调节海况仿真环境进行评测。
AI.result: 在不同海况下（升沉、横摇、纵摇），DA-NBV在三维重建完整性上提升约3%，Chamfer距离降低43%，同时路径效率更高，相比现有方法表现优越。
AI.conclusion: 方向感知与动作空间优化显著提升了海上船舶三维重建质量与效率，为无人化、自动化海事作业提供了高效可靠的技术方案。

title: Multi-Branch Policy Optimization for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Group-based reinforcement learning methods for multimodal large language models typically rely on trajectory-level credit assignment that applies a single advantage to all tokens in a response. However, multimodal reasoning involves substantially higher perceptual uncertainty than text-only settings, where the model must repeatedly re-examine visual information to verify intermediate interpretations, and different visual groundings can lead to divergent reasoning paths, making such uniform credit assignment particularly inadequate and causing relative advantages to progressively degenerate toward zero. To address these challenges, we propose Multi-Branch Policy Optimization (MBPO), a tree-based framework that constructs reasoning trees at vision-language decision boundaries, enabling sibling branches to explore diverse visual hypotheses and assigning segment-level credit through branch-relative advantages. We further introduce a temporal replay buffer to reuse informative segments while controlling policy staleness. Experiments on several multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that MBPO outperforms representative baselines, improving both learning signal quality and optimization efficiency. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/ShuaiLyu0110/MBPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了用於多模態大語言模型的多分支策略優化（MBPO）方法，有效提升了多模態推理的學習信號和優化效率。
AI.motivation: 現有群體強化學習方法對於多模態大型語言模型依賴於統一的軌跡級反饋（credit assignment），但這種方法在存在感知不確定性的多模態情景下會導致反饋信號無法區分不同視覺推理線路，影響模型學習效果。
AI.method: 作者提出多分支策略優化（MBPO），在視覺-語言決策邊界之處生成推理樹，允許不同分支探索多樣的視覺假設，並基於分支相對優勢進行片段級別的反饋。同時引入時間重放緩衝區以重用有用片段，平衡政策更新的及時性和穩定性。
AI.result: MBPO 在多個多模態推理基準上表現優於代表性基線方法，學習信號質量和優化效率均得到提升。
AI.conclusion: MBPO 能更合理地應對多模態推理過程中的不確定性，有效提升模型的學習與推理能力，具有較高應用潛力。

title: A Grounded and Decomposed Framework for Relation-Level Hallucination Evaluation in Abstractive Summarization
summary:
Abstractive text summarization systems frequently generate fluent yet unfaithful summaries by fabricating or distorting relationships between entities and
  events. Such relation-level hallucinations undermine the reliability of generated summaries, particularly in high-stakes domains. In this work, we present a
  refined and grounded framework for evaluating relation hallucination in abstractive summarization. We present the empirical Relation Hallucination Index (RHI) by
  introducing a dependency-aware relation extraction algorithm that incorporates lemmatization-based normalization, named entity grounded subject resolution,
  passive agent recovery, negation-aware verb modeling, reporting verb filtering, nominal relation fallback, clausal propagation, and systematic deduplication.
  These enhancements improve the structural fidelity of extracted relation triples and reduce spurious matches during evaluation. In addition, we introduce a
  normalized formulation of RHI to ensure scale-invariant comparison between datasets and models. The revised metric decomposes hallucination into interpretable
  components, aggregates relation hallucination metric into a normalized relation faithfulness score. Extensive evaluation across multiple state-of-the-art
  summarization models demonstrates that the grounded extraction process yields more stable and discriminative hallucination measurements. The proposed framework
  advances automated relation-level faithfulness evaluation and supports coherence-aware, hallucination-sensitive model analysis.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种用于评估抽象文本摘要中关系虚构（hallucination）的新框架和指标RHI，改善摘要中事实失真问题。
AI.motivation: 当前抽象摘要系统常出现关系虚构现象，影响生成摘要的可信度，尤其是在高风险领域，因此需要更精确的关系级别评估方法。
AI.method: 作者提出了关系虚构指数（RHI），并设计了带依存句法、词形还原、实体归一化、被动-主动恢复、否定动词识别等细化算法，增强三元组关系抽取的准确性；同时，指标进行了归一化处理，便于不同模型与数据集间的对比。
AI.result: 经过大量主流摘要模型的实验证明，该依存增强关系抽取方法带来了更稳定、区分度更高的关系虚构评估效果。
AI.conclusion: 新框架推动了关系级摘要事实性自动评价的发展，有助于分析模型中的连贯性与虚构敏感性。

title: Compiling and Benchmarking Task-State Horizons for Embodied Agents
summary: Frontier agentic models are increasingly deployed as high-level planners for long-horizon embodied tasks. Existing robotic benchmarks have advanced long-horizon evaluation, but primarily characterize difficulty through action-sequence length and subtask complexity, overlooking a distinct challenge: agents must track evolving task-relevant world states induced by both their exploration and environmental dynamics. We define the span of task-relevant state transitions that an agent must track as task-state horizon (TSH). To evaluate how agent performance varies with TSH, we introduce RoboGraph, a robotic task compiler that translates state-transition dependencies into executable symbolic graphs. Specifically, RoboGraph constructs task-state horizons from spatial and temporal causal dependencies, including those induced by unexpected failures and interventions during task execution. Building on RoboGraph, we release a benchmark comprising 588 episodes across 84 scenes with varying TSHs. Experiments evaluating 15 advanced agentic models in both semantic and visual closed-loop environments show that most models struggle with demanding TSHs, revealing substantial gaps in maintaining, exploring, and updating task-relevant state over long horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了任务状态视野（TSH）的概念，强调长期机器人任务中必须跟踪的任务相关状态转变对智能体的重要性，并基于此发布了RoboGraph基准来系统性评测智能体的状态管理能力。实验发现主流模型在高TSH场景下表现不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器人基准多关注动作序列长度及子任务复杂性，忽略了机器人在长期任务中需要持续追踪和更新任务相关世界状态（受探索和环境动力学影响）的难点。因此有必要引入新的任务难度维度和系统性评测工具。
AI.method: 作者提出了任务状态视野（TSH），用以衡量智能体在任务中需要追踪的状态转变范围。开发了RoboGraph任务编译器，将状态转变依赖转化为可执行的符号图，并由此构造具备不同TSH的实验基准。
AI.result: 发布了包含84个场景、588条任务、不同TSH水平的RoboGraph基准。对比评测了15种主流智能体模型在不同TSH和环境（语义、视觉闭环）下的表现，发现大多数模型在高TSH任务中难以有效追踪、探索和更新世界状态。
AI.conclusion: 长期任务中状态追踪和管理能力是当前智能体模型的薄弱环节，现有模型难以处理高TSH任务。RoboGraph和TSH为未来研究智能体长期状态管理能力提供了新基准和挑战。

title: Predictive Failure Detection in Network Hardware Using Thermal Imaging and Deep Learning with Sensor Fusion
summary: Unplanned network hardware malfunctions can interrupt services and result in expensive downtime in data centers. A deep learning-based predictive maintenance strategy is presented that utilizes thermal imaging and power sensor data to detect early indicators of equipment breakdown in routers, switches, and servers. A simulated dataset was generated comprising annotated thermal pictures and power readings indicative of three operating states: Normal, Warning, and Critical. Three ImageNet-pretrained convolutional neural network (CNN) models ResNet-50, InceptionV3, and VGG16 were assessed together with a multi-modal CNN-LSTM fusion model that integrates visual and sensor time-series information. Experiments were performed with and without pre-processing procedures, including region-of-interest (ROI) extraction and normalization. In the absence of pre-processing, CNNs attained moderate accuracy (e.g., ResNet-50 at 52%), but ROI-based pre-processing significantly enhanced performance (ResNet-50 accuracy reaching 91%). The CNN-LSTM model attained the greatest accuracy of 94%, with precision and recall approaching 95%, illustrating the effectiveness of multi-modal fusion. The results validate that domain-specific pre-processing and sensor fusion substantially improve early failure prediction, providing a potential foundation for proactive maintenance of network hardware through non-intrusive monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于深度学习的预测性维护方法，通过热成像和电源传感器数据，提前发现数据中心网络硬件（如路由器、交换机、服务器）的故障风险。多模型对比实验显示，特定预处理和多模态融合大幅提升预测准确率。
AI.motivation: 数据中心网络硬件故障会带来高昂的宕机成本，亟需高效、提前发现问题的维护手段。传统方法局限性明显，因此探索深度学习、传感器数据与图像结合的新策略。
AI.method: 构建包含热成像和功耗数据的模拟数据集，标注为正常、警告、危急三类。评估ResNet-50、InceptionV3、VGG16等CNN，以及整合时序和图像信息的CNN-LSTM多模态模型。对比使用与不使用ROI提取、归一化等预处理的实验效果。
AI.result: 原始CNN准确率中等（如ResNet-50为52%）；ROI预处理后显著提升（ResNet-50可达91%）；多模态CNN-LSTM取得最高94%准确率，精确率与召回率约95%。
AI.conclusion: 领域相关的预处理与多源数据融合可显著增强网络硬件早期故障预测能力，为数据中心的非侵入式、前瞻性维护提供了有效手段。

title: Focus particles and scalar inferences across humans and language models
comment: 3 pages, 1 figure, presented at 9th annual Conference on Cognitive Computational Neuroscience
summary: Focus particles such as "even" and "only" are central to formal semantic theories that posit structured representations over sets of alternatives. "Even" highlights unexpected or extreme alternatives, while "only" enforces exclusivity. If such scalar representations are robust and generalizable, they should give rise to consistent judgments across contexts and systems. In this work, we test whether humans and large language models (LLMs) construct stable scalar representations from sentences containing these particles. Using a dataset of approximately 100 items, participants and models were asked to make scalar judgments. Preliminary results suggest that similar outputs across humans and LLMs may arise from different underlying mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究“even”（甚至）和“only”（仅仅）等聚焦粒子的语义表征在人类与大语言模型（LLMs）中的一致性。结果发现，人类与模型虽给出类似判断，但底层机制可能不同。
AI.motivation: 聚焦粒子“even”和“only”在形式语义理论中具有重要地位。若其标量表征具有鲁棒性和普适性，则应在各种语境和系统间表现出一致。作者欲检验人类和大语言模型在含这些粒子的句子处理中，是否构建了稳定的标量结构。
AI.method: 作者构建了约100个包含“even”和“only”的句子项，请人类和大语言模型分别对这些句子做标量判断。通过对比分析两者的输出和反应，分析其标量表征的一致性和机制。
AI.result: 初步结果表明，在标量判断任务中，人类与大语言模型表现出类似的输出，但这一相似性可能源自不同的底层处理机制。
AI.conclusion: 虽然人类与大语言模型在处理聚焦粒子的句子时表现出表面上的一致性，但背后的认知或计算过程存在差异，说明当前大语言模型在深层语义理解方面与人类仍有区别。

title: PhysX-CoT: Structured Physical Reasoning from a Single Image to Simulation-Ready 3D Assets
summary: Simulation-ready 3D assets are central to robotics and embodied AI. Generating them from a single image is usually framed as a vision-language model that emits a serialized asset for a decoder to turn into geometry and physical fields, leaving the image-to-3D reasoning implicit. We argue the limiting factor is this output-centric view: part placement and local shape are entangled in one global-coordinate token stream, and the intermediate physical states are never exposed for supervision, conditioning, or verification. PhysX-CoT instead casts single-image asset generation as an explicit structured physical reasoning process, an ordered and machine-parseable trajectory of part-level states covering decomposition, 2D and 3D grounding, relations, coarse geometry, and surface cues that we separately supervise, use to condition geometry, and treat as reward targets. Geometry is factorized so that 3D boxes carry placement and local codes carry shape, and CoT-aligned GRPO optimizes parse validity, grounding, geometry, placement, and physical consistency. Under a unified protocol that retrains all learned baselines on the same backbone, data, and frozen decoder, PhysX-CoT outperforms the closest full-task baseline across geometry, scale, and physical-attribute metrics. Oracle, token-matched, and state-order controls show the explicit states are functional rather than cosmetic, and in Unreal Engine~5 the generated assets parse, collide, and articulate at high validity.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的从单张图片生成仿真可用3D资产的方法PhysX-CoT，将3D重建过程显式化为一系列可监督的物理推理步骤。相较传统端到端输出方式，方法分离了部件定位与形状生成，并在多项任务上优于现有baseline。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉-语言模型的单图3D资产生成方法大都将任务视为端到端序列输出，导致局部形状与结构信息纠缠，物理状态难以直接监督和优化，造成推理不透明且生成受限。作者希望让物理推理过程显式化，提升监督与生成的精度及可控性。
AI.method: PhysX-CoT 将资产生成过程拆解为一系列有序且可机读的部件级中间状态轨迹，包括分解、2D/3D定位、部件关系、粗几何和表面特征，并分别进行监督。几何信息被因子化为3D box（位置）和局部编码（形状），并通过CoT一致的GRPO进行优化，增强解析和物理一致性。所有方法在统一协议下公平对比。
AI.result: PhysX-CoT 在几何准确度、尺度还原和物理属性等指标上均超越了现有端到端基线。在Unreal Engine~5仿真环境中生成的资产解析正确，具备高碰撞和运动有效性。对照实验显示显式中间状态对功能性有实际提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将3D资产生成过程显式结构化，并引入可监督的物理推理链，PhysX-CoT 极大提升了资产生成的可解释性、准确性和物理真实性，为单图3D资产生成提供了更可控和可验证的新范式。

title: ComplexityWorld: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Verifiable Visual Decision Making
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have made rapid progress in visual perception and increasingly support real-world tasks that depend on images. Many such tasks, however, require more than rec- ognizing what an image contains: a model must use visual evidence to make a complete decision whose parts jointly satisfy global constraints. We introduce COMPLEXITYWORLD, a benchmark of 390 tasks across 39 domain-inspired visual worlds and 29 decision categories. Each task is generated from a hidden structured specification, rendered as a visual scene, and scored by an exe- cutable verifier that accepts any feasible solution. Under direct inference, all evaluated models ex- cept GPT-5.6-Sol remain below 40% verifier ac- ceptance rate (VAR), while GPT-5.6-Sol reaches 75.6%. Performance improves substantially when the same decision information is made explicit in structured form, yet varies sharply across equiva- lent visual presentations. Agent scaffolds provide smaller, model-dependent gains. Together, these results reveal a persistent visual-to-decision bot- tleneck that additional inference alone does not remove.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了COMPLEXITYWORLD基准，用于评测视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在包含结构化决策约束的复杂视觉任务上的能力，并发现当前主流模型在面对复杂视觉到决策任务时仍有明显瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 随着VLMs在视觉感知领域的进步，现实世界中许多任务不仅要求识别图像内容，还需模型依据信息做出满足结构约束的整体决策。现有评测方法不足以衡量这些能力，因此有必要开发新的基准与评测体系。
AI.method: 提出COMPLEXITYWORLD基准，涵盖390个任务，分属于39个不同领域和29种决策类型。每个任务由隐藏的结构规范生成，并被渲染为可视化场景，其解通过可执行检验器自动评分。模型既被直接推理评测，也考察结构化信息显式输入与智能体辅助对性能的提升。
AI.result: 在直接推理下，除GPT-5.6-Sol外，所有模型的验证器接受率（VAR）低于40%；GPT-5.6-Sol达到75.6%。当决策信息结构化输入时，所有模型表现显著提升，但对等的视觉表达下表现差异大。智能体辅助提供的提升有限且依赖模型。
AI.conclusion: 视觉-决策任务存在显著瓶颈，仅靠模型推理进步难以突破。需要更好地结构化输入和方法创新，以提升模型对复杂决策任务的能力。

title: AraSSM: A bidirectional state-space encoder for Arabic masked language modeling
summary: Pretrained Transformer encoders such as AraBERT, MARBERT, and CAMeLBERT have become the standard backbone for Arabic natural language understanding, but their self-attention mechanism scales quadratically with sequence length, which limits efficiency on long documents. Mamba, a selective state-space model (SSM), offers linear-time sequence modeling as a competitive alternative to attention, yet no dedicated bidirectional Mamba encoder pretrained specifically for Arabic currently exists. We introduce AraSSM, a bidirectional Mamba encoder pretrained via masked language modeling on a corpus combining Arabic Wikipedia and CulturaX text, trained end-to-end on four consumer-grade NVIDIA RTX 2080Ti GPUs (11GB) over approximately ten days. We evaluate AraSSM by fine-tuning on four established Arabic NLU benchmarks covering sentiment classification (HARD), named entity recognition (ANERcorp), extractive question answering (ARCD), and natural language inference (XNLI-ar), following the per-task evaluation protocol introduced by AraBERT, and report results as mean +/- standard deviation across three fine-tuning seeds. AraSSM matches or exceeds published base-sized Transformer baselines on sentiment classification (96.37 +/- 0.03% accuracy on HARD), is competitive on extractive QA (32.19 +/- 1.07 EM, 63.79 +/- 0.25 F1 on ARCD) and named entity recognition (81.54 +/- 0.30 entity-level F1 on ANERcorp), and trails the base-sized Transformer range on natural language inference (72.83 +/- 0.07% accuracy on XNLI-ar), despite being trained entirely from scratch on consumer hardware rather than large-scale accelerator clusters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AraSSM，这是首个专为阿拉伯语预训练的双向Mamba编码器，在多项阿拉伯语自然语言理解任务上表现出色，且训练资源需求低。
AI.motivation: 现有的阿拉伯语NLP主流模型（如AraBERT、MARBERT、CAMeLBERT）基于Transformer结构，其自注意力机制的计算复杂度对长文本处理效率有限制。Mamba（选择性状态空间模型）能以线性时间处理序列，但尚未有为阿拉伯语预训练的Mamba编码器。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种名为AraSSM的双向Mamba编码器模型，通过掩码语言建模（Masked Language Modeling）在阿拉伯语维基百科与CulturaX数据集上进行预训练。训练使用了4块RTX 2080Ti消费级GPU，历时约10天。接着在四个阿拉伯语NLP基准任务上进行了微调和评测：情感分类（HARD）、命名实体识别（ANERcorp）、抽取式问答（ARCD）、自然语言推断（XNLI-ar）。
AI.result: AraSSM模型在情感分类上达到新高（96.37%准确率），在实体识别和问答任务上与Transformer基线表现相当或略优，唯一在自然语言推断上略逊于Transformer模型。所有实验均在消费级硬件上完成。
AI.conclusion: AraSSM证明了Mamba模型在阿拉伯语NLP中的实际可用性和高效率，尤其在资源受限条件下可作为Transformer的有力替代方案。

title: SurgWMBench: A Vision-Based Benchmark for World-Modeling Surgical Instrument Motion Planning
summary: Reliable surgical planning requires models that move beyond recognizing the current surgical step or imitating expert demonstrations, and instead anticipate how instrument motion reshapes subsequent operative states. Most surgical video understanding methods focus on recognizing phases, actions, or workflow states, while providing limited support for explicitly modeling instrument motion. Conversely, existing tool motion prediction methods can forecast instrument trajectories, but they generally do not capture the coupled evolution of future surgical video states. World models offer a natural framework for jointly modeling visual state transitions and instrument motion dynamics. However, existing surgical world model studies remain largely centered on visual generation quality, relying on generation-oriented metrics such as FVD and CD-FVD. These metrics are poorly aligned with instrument motion planning, as they do not directly measure whether predicted trajectories are geometrically accurate, temporally coherent, or actionable for downstream planning. This limitation is partly structural, since the field lacks public datasets and standardized evaluation protocols that provide the benchmarking infrastructure needed to assess motion-centric capabilities in surgical world models. In this paper, we introduce SurgWMBench, a vision-based benchmark for short-horizon surgical motion planning and dynamics prediction. Given intraoperative image sequences and historical instrument trajectory, SurgWMBench evaluates both near-future instrument motion prediction and stability under continuous rollout or input perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了SurgWMBench，这是一个专注于外科手术中短期工具运动规划和动力学预测的评测基准。SurgWMBench能够评估手术场景中器械运动预测的准确性及其面对扰动时的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有的方法大多关注手术视频中阶段/动作识别或工具轨迹预测，缺乏对两者耦合演化的深入建模，且衡量指标主要以视觉生成质量为主，难以为运动规划提供实际指导。此外，领域内缺少公开数据集和标准化评测协议，影响了自动化手术规划方法的发展和对比。
AI.method: 作者提出SurgWMBench，提供基于视觉的、针对短期运动预测的基准测试，既对术中序列图像及历史轨迹下的工具未来运动进行预测，也检验模型在连续预测和输入扰动条件下的稳定性。
AI.result: 文中展示了SurgWMBench能够有效区分现有方法在运动预测任务上的差异，对预测精度和鲁棒性均有具体分析。
AI.conclusion: SurgWMBench为手术世界模型的运动预测评估提供了标准化支持，有助于推动运动导向的建模研究，并促进自动化手术规划的发展。

title: LAVE: Latent Visual Evidence-Enhanced Planning for Video Tool-use Agents
summary: Long-video understanding requires models to efficiently acquire and reuse sparse visual evidence from long and redundant video streams. Recent video tool-use agents address this challenge by iteratively invoking visual Tools at different temporal scales, but their Tool-Planner communication typically relies on textual observations. Such text-only interfaces provide lossy summaries of Tool computations, causing previously computed visual evidence not verbalized to be discarded and unavailable for subsequent planning. We identify this limitation as the Tool observation bottleneck and propose Latent Visual Evidence-Enhanced Planning (LAVE), a training-free framework for reusing latent visual evidence from completed Tool calls. LAVE introduces a dual-channel observation interface: the visible channel preserves the original textual trajectory, while the latent channel stores pre-verbal visual updates with their Tool roles, source-frame timestamps, and visual locations.
