During planning, LAVE retrieves evidence relevant to the current Planner state but not covered by textual observations, and integrates it through bounded timestamp-aligned latent updates with entropy-constrained frame-time routing. This enables video agents to reuse existing visual computation without additional training, frame replay, or modifications to the original orchestration. Extensive experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and CG-Bench show that LAVE consistently improves video tool-use agents across backbones. Under a comparable frame budget, LAVE improves the Video-MME overall score by 3.76 points over the strongest baseline, demonstrating the effectiveness of latent visual evidence reuse for multi-step video-agent planning.

AI.tldr: 提出LAVE框架，通过引入潜在视觉证据通道，提升长视频智能体的理解和规划能力，无需额外训练即可复用已有工具的视觉运算成果。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频工具智能体在处理长时序视频时，工具-调度器的信息交互主要依赖文本摘要，导致许多已有但未被表述的视觉证据无法被后续利用，产生信息瓶颈，限制了整体推理与规划能力。
AI.method: 提出Latent Visual Evidence-Enhanced Planning（LAVE），在保留文本轨迹的基础上，新增潜在通道，存储已用工具的视觉更新信息（含角色、帧时间戳和位置）。规划阶段检索当前未被文本涵盖、但相关的视觉证据，以有序、熵约束的方式动态整合到决策流程中，实现视觉证据复用，无需重新训练或重放帧。
AI.result: 在Video-MME、LongVideoBench和CG-Bench等多种基准上进行实验，LAVE带来了跨主干的性能提升。在相同帧预算下，Video-MME总分提升3.76，相比最强对比基线表现更优。
AI.conclusion: LAVE能够高效复用潜在视觉证据，缓解了工具-调度器通信的信息瓶颈，在不增加训练和系统更改的前提下，有效提升了多步视频智能体的推理与规划表现。

title: Do Evaluation Metrics Detect Errors in Classical Chinese to English Translations?
summary: Although large language models can translate some historical languages surprisingly well, their usefulness in digital humanities workflows is limited by the lack of reliable evaluation. We investigate whether existing automatic evaluation metrics developed for modern languages are reliable in this setting, using translation from Classical Chinese to English as a test case. We introduce a diagnostic framework based on minimal pairs capturing error types salient in scholarly use, probing both reference-based and reference-free metrics for error sensitivity and tolerance to valid variation. We find that all metrics exhibit blind spots, however MetricX24 performs best overall. Our findings highlight the need for more robust and interpretable metrics for historically and culturally distinct translation settings.

AI.tldr: 本文分析大型语言模型在历史语言翻译中的性能表现，特别是其自动评估指标在数字人文领域的适用性，发现现有评估指标存在盲点。
AI.motivation: 虽然大模型可较好地翻译部分历史语言，但缺乏可靠的评测手段，影响了其在数字人文工作流程中的实用性。
AI.method: 以古汉语到英语的翻译为例，提出一种基于最小对照组（minimal pairs）的诊断框架，用于分析各种自动评估指标（参考型和非参考型）在检测细粒度错误及处理有效多样性方面的能力。
AI.result: 所有自动评估指标均存在盲点，但MetricX24整体表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 强调了针对历史和文化上的特殊翻译背景，需要更健壮、可解释的自动评测指标。

title: Event-Time Hybrid Optimal Control for Robotic Table Tennis Serves
summary: Robotic table tennis serves require high ball velocity and spin while respecting the robot's kinodynamic limits. Unlike rally strokes, a valid serve must also bounce on the server's side and clear the net, yielding a hybrid system with nonlinear flight and impact dynamics. We formulate spin-controlled serve generation as an event-time \ac{OCP} that optimizes the racket impact velocity and orientation together with the bounce, net-crossing, and landing times, enabling direct enforcement at phase boundaries of table-bounce and net-clearance constraints. The racket velocity and orientation are then converted into a complete kinodynamically feasible motion through a second \ac{OCP} enforcing joint-position, velocity, and torque limits. We evaluate the method numerically and on a KUKA Agilus robot. Compared with a fixed-step formulation with root localization, the proposed event-time formulation reduces the median solve time by a factor of 4.1 while maintaining comparable landing accuracy, spin accuracy, and serve validity. Real-robot experiments demonstrate controlled placement and topspin, backspin, and sidespin serves, with a mean landing error of $13.1 \pm 7.3$~cm and spin rates up to 30~rps. These results show that event-time optimal control efficiently generates physically valid, kinodynamically feasible serves while accounting for nonlinear aerodynamic and impact effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对机器人乒乓球发球的最优控制方法，能够高效生成符合动力学、气动力学和规则约束的高速旋转发球，并在实物机器人上表现良好。
AI.motivation: 机器人执行乒乓球发球时，需要兼顾速度、旋转和动力学约束，同时还要满足发球规则（如球需落在己方球台、过网），传统方法难以同时高效满足这些复杂约束。
AI.method: 提出将发球问题表述为基于事件时刻的最优控制问题（OCP），优化球拍击球速度、方向以及球的碰桌、过网、落地时机，直接施加关键约束。随后转化为符合理想动力学限制的具体运动，通过第二个OCP保证机械臂姿态、速度、力矩等不超限。在数值模拟和真实KUKA Agilus机器人上进行评估，并与传统固定步长法对比。
AI.result: 该事件时刻OCP方法在保证类似落点和旋转准确率下，将求解时间缩短4.1倍。实物实验表明，发球能精准落在指定区域，并产生最大30 rps的旋转，平均落点误差为13.1±7.3cm，能实现各类旋转发球。
AI.conclusion: 事件时刻最优控制可高效产生同时满足动力学极限和发球规则的合法发球轨迹，适合复杂的乒乓球机器人应用。

title: MAGIC-SSCIL: Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration for Semi-Supervised Class Incremental Learning
summary: Semi-supervised Class Incremental Learning (SSCIL) is a severe challenge for neural networks, and it is hardest in the exemplar-free setting where no past data may be stored. Existing methods forget catastrophically due to feature drift, and their pseudo-labels become increasingly unreliable as the label space grows. In this paper, we propose MAGIC (Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration), a framework that stabilizes plasticity without storing exemplars. MAGIC's design centers on two components. The first is Soft-Weighted Geometry Calibration (SWGC), which uses graph-based label propagation on the learner's plastic feature space to weight and calibrate class means and variances computed on the frozen backbone; from these calibrated Gaussians, we sample phantom features that stand in for data from previous tasks. The second is a Geometric Structural Alignment (GSA) objective that preserves representation topology by matching the relational structure of student and teacher heads and aligning feature anchors with the fixed classifier prototypes, locking the orientation of the feature space. Together, these constraints keep the adapter from drifting, so geometric relations between classes remain stable as new classes arrive. We implement MAGIC with a frozen ResNet-18 backbone and a learnable plastic adapter. Across CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and ImageNet-R, at label ratios of 1%, 5%, and 10%, MAGIC improves average incremental accuracy over most of the supervised CIL methods equipped with FixMatch and native SSCIL baselines; the largest gains occur in the fine-grained, low-label setting, where confidence thresholding fails most clearly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新方法MAGIC，用于解决半监督类增量学习（SSCIL）中的遗忘与特征漂移问题，并在不存储先前数据的情况下取得了优异表现。
AI.motivation: 在SSCIL任务中，特别是在不允许保存历史样本的情况下，现有方法容易出现灾难性遗忘和伪标签不可靠的问题，尤其随着类别数增长更为严重。因此亟需有效方法来缓解特征空间漂移和伪标签失效。
AI.method: MAGIC框架包含两个关键部分：1）软权重几何校准（SWGC）：利用图结构在可塑性特征空间传播标签，并在冻结主干上校准类别均值和方差，从而采样出代表历史任务的虚拟特征；2）几何结构对齐（GSA）：通过匹配教师与学生的头部关系结构以及锚点与分类器原型的对齐，保持特征空间的几何拓扑结构，防止适配器漂移。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100、CUB-200和ImageNet-R等数据集上，在低标注比例（1%、5%、10%）下，MAGIC方法在平均增量准确率方面优于大多数配备FixMatch的CIL方法和原生SSCIL基线，尤其是在细粒度、极低标注情形下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: MAGIC方法无需保存历史样本即可显著减少SSCIL中的灾难性遗忘，有效稳定了类间几何关系，证明了其在低标注、困难环境下的优越性。

title: Safety Cost of Steering Vectors Is Separable and Reducible
summary: Steering vectors are a lightweight tool for controlling LLM behavior. However, emerging evidence shows that steering vectors can unintentionally compromise a model's safety mechanisms and increase compliance with harmful requests, while no effective mitigation yet exists. In this work, we show that this safety degradation arises from a separable component in the vector that disrupts the model's safety mechanisms but contributes little to the steering objective. We identify and remove this safety-degrading component, formulating the task as a constrained optimization problem solved through primal-dual updates, subject to preserving the intended steering effect and bounding false refusal. The resulting solution is both interpretable and surgical: the optimization recovers a single direction whose ablation from the steering vector restores model safety with minimal utility cost. Across models, steering behaviors, and attack suites, including unseen attacks types, our method substantially reduces steering-induced safety degradation while preserving the original steering effect with minimal impact on false refusal. Our method offers a post-hoc correction to steering vectors that mitigates their safety cost, and more broadly, it provides a general recipe for applying activation-level model interventions without paying a safety tax.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Steering vectors在LLM(大语言模型)中的安全隐患提出解决方案，可在不影响原始功能的前提下，有效降低引发的不安全风险。
AI.motivation: 现有Steering vectors在引导LLM行为时，可能无意中削弱安全机制，使模型更易顺从有害请求，且缺乏有效缓解手段，存在安全隐患。
AI.method: 作者发现Steering vectors中有一可分离分量会破坏安全机制而对目标引导作用有限。通过将其视为带约束优化问题，采用primal-dual方法，在保持用户期望引导效果及低误拒绝率的前提下，识别并删除该分量，实现精确修正。
AI.result: 实验证明，该方法适用于多种模型、引导行为和攻击方式，包括未知攻击场景。新方法显著减少了因Steering vectors而导致的安全性能下降，同时最大程度保留原始引导功能，对误拒绝率影响极小。
AI.conclusion: 本文方法为Steering vectors带来安全补救措施，实现安全性和功能性兼顾；更广泛地，为激活层干预提供通用思路，无需为模型安全性付出功能代价。

title: Multi-modal Interactive Control of Robotic Arm based on Offline Large Language Models
comment: This research work has been accepted for poster presentation at ICRA 2026 MEI (Multimodal Embodied Interaction in Robots) Workshop. (Here is the workshop-version short paper.)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly revolutionized the modern society with numerous advanced interactions between humans and AI agents, whereas the usage of most large language models including ChatGPT are not friendly open-sourced and must require the users paying a lot for such AI services continuously. Therefore, deploying open-sourced large language models on local servers can be considered as an efficient approach to design and implement creative embodied AI algorithms with lower cost and more stable free usage. Inspired by this ordinary motivation, we originally propose and implement the "Socratic Models-ChatGLM", which is a well-performed algorithm for multi-modal interactive control of robotic arm based on offline large language models via the facile PyBullet platform, even presents extraordinary potential to address complicated text-image integrated multi-step long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并实现了一种基于开源大语言模型的新方法，用于本地服务的智能机器人控制，降低成本并增强多模态交互能力。
AI.motivation: 当前主流大语言模型如ChatGPT大多不开源且需持续付费，限制了普及和创新，激发了作者使用开源模型本地部署以节约成本、促进自由创新的动机。
AI.method: 提出了“Socratic Models-ChatGLM”算法，在PyBullet平台下，基于离线开源大语言模型，实现了多模态（文本、图像）交互下的机械臂控制，并针对多步骤、长时间的复杂机器人操作任务进行了优化。
AI.result: 实验结果显示该方法在多模态交互及长序列、复杂任务的机器人控制方面表现优秀，展示出显著的创新潜力。
AI.conclusion: 基于开源大语言模型本地部署的方法不仅经济实用，还能提升机器人多模态交互与综合操作能力，为智能机器人发展提供了新思路。

title: NewtonGS: Physics-Structured Object-Level Neural Newtonian Dynamics for Gaussian Scene Animation
summary: Animating objects in a static 3D Gaussian scene requires an explicit object-level dynamic state and a controllable model of object motion. Existing dynamic Gaussian methods primarily reconstruct time-varying scenes or simulate deformation, rather than provide compact object states for direct control. To address this gap, we present NewtonGS, a physics-structured framework for object-level state rollout and Gaussian scene animation. NewtonGS represents each object with a 22-dimensional state covering pose, linear and angular velocity, anisotropic scale and its rate, mass, and contact properties. Its Gaussian Neural Newtonian Dynamics (Gaussian-NND) model combines analytic translation, quaternion kinematics, gravity, damping, and scale-restoration dynamics with learned continuous and contact residuals. A discrete event map handles floor contact. Predicted poses and scales define a shared affine transformation that updates the means and covariances of all Gaussians associated with each object. We construct two procedurally generated datasets: State-32 for state-rollout evaluation and Gaussian-32 for state-to-Gaussian transformation. On both the in-distribution and velocity-range-shift splits of State-32, NewtonGS achieves lower trajectory RMSE, final displacement error, and velocity RMSE than five analytic baselines. Experiments on Gaussian-32 further demonstrate effective conversion from predicted states to animated Gaussian objects.

AI.tldr: NewtonGS提出了一种新的3D高斯场物体动画方法，通过物理结构化对象状态，实现更精确和可控的动画生成，并优于多种基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的动态高斯方法无法实现对对象层级运动的直接控制，主要只能重建随时间变化的场景或做简单的变形，缺乏紧凑且可控的对象动力学状态表示。因此需要更物理结构化的方法来提升动画控制性和物理合理性。
AI.method: NewtonGS用22维状态向量描述每个对象，包括姿态、速度、缩放、质量和接触属性。提出高斯神经牛顿动力学模型（Gaussian-NND），结合解析物理运动（如平移、旋转、重力、阻尼等）和学习得到的残差项来预测对象动态。离散事件图用于处理地面接触。通过仿射变换统一控制对象内所有高斯体的均值和协方差，从而实现动画。并构建两个合成数据集：State-32用于轨迹预测评估，Gaussian-32用于状态到高斯体的转化测试。
AI.result: 在State-32数据集的分布内和速度分布外实验中，NewtonGS表现出比五种解析基线更低的轨迹RMSE、末端位移误差和速度RMSE。在Gaussian-32数据集上也能将预测状态高效地转化为高斯体动画。
AI.conclusion: NewtonGS不仅实现了物理一致的对象级动画控制，还在多个基准上优于现有方法，验证了其作为3D高斯动画物理驱动引擎的有效性和优越性。

title: Hidden Language Consistency Phenomena in Reasoning LLMs
summary: Multilingual reasoning models are commonly evaluated by whether they arrive at the correct answer, but not by whether they preserve the intended language while reasoning and responding. This omission conceals important multilingual behaviors that emerge as tasks become harder. In this paper, we study task difficulty, task accuracy, thinking-language consistency (TC), and answer-language consistency (AC) across reasoning models using PolyMath benchmark in eight languages and four difficulty levels. We uncover four findings: (1) language consistency exhibits four difficulty-dependent behaviors: output-language consistency remains aligned with input, remains misaligned, degrades gradually, or collapses abruptly. (2) We identify the language consistency breakdown effect, where increasing difficulty can cause a sudden drop in output-language consistency, especially in less strongly represented and non-Latin-script languages. (3) Due to this breakdown effect, accuracy can be preserved or even improved at a harder difficulty level as the model shifts to its internal dominant language. (4) Quantization can improve or degrade output-language consistency independently of its effect on accuracy, with GPTQ and AWQ often outperforming AutoRound under tolerance-based voting with ε = 1.0. These results show that multilingual capability cannot be characterized by accuracy alone; reliable evaluation should jointly consider task accuracy, language consistency, and task difficulty for multilingual benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多语言推理模型在难度提升时可能会输出非输入语言的答案，且仅以正确率评估会忽略这一重要影响。研究提出多维度评价方法，强调任务难度、准确率和语言一致性需联合考虑。
AI.motivation: 当前多语言推理模型的评估主要关注是否得出正确答案，却忽视了模型在推理、作答过程中是否保持了预期输入语言。随着任务变难，这种疏忽可能掩盖了多语言模型实际执行中的重要表现。
AI.method: 作者基于PolyMath多语言推理数据集，涉及八种语言和四个难度等级，系统分析了不同模型在任务难度、准确率、推理语言一致性（TC）和作答语言一致性（AC）上的表现，涵盖量化方法（如GPTQ、AWQ、AutoRound）对其影响。
AI.result: 主要发现：1）输出语言一致性受任务难度影响，表现为四种趋势，包括保持一致、保持不一致、逐渐下降和突然崩溃。2）揭示了“语言一致性崩溃效应”，即难度提高时对低资源及非拉丁文字语言影响大。3）模型可能为了保持准确率，在高难度时切换到其内部主导语言，准确率反而提升。4）模型量化对语言一致性影响不一，GPTQ和AWQ在一定设置下优于AutoRound。
AI.conclusion: 多语言推理模型仅依赖准确率评价是片面的，应将任务难度、准确率以及语言一致性三者结合，以更科学、全面地评估多语言任务中的模型表现。

title: Spatiotemporal Context-dependent Personalized Movement Compensation in Delayed Telemanipulation
summary: Communication delay remains a central challenge in telerobotics, where it disrupts visuomotor coordination and reduces task precision. Motion scaling is an effective countermeasure to delay-induced overshoot, yet typical deployments rely on uniform gains that neglect individual and contextual variability. We propose a human-centered method that fits personalized delay-, direction-, and distance-specific scaling parameters for each participant. We conducted experiments with twenty participants who performed delayed reaching tasks in a virtual simulator. Scaling gains were computed to minimize mean overshoot in simulation in each combination of experimental conditions. Evaluation was done in simulation and on a telesurgical robot to evaluate assistance benefits. Performance was assessed across multiple delays, distances, and movement directions using overshoot, endpoint error, trajectory smoothness, economy of motion, and a composite error-time metric. Motion scaling consistently improved performance relative to unassisted trials, yielding up to 20-25% performance gains in key metrics. Effects were most pronounced at longer delays. Personalization demonstrated additional accuracy benefits for inward reaching at a short distance under moderate delay. The results highlight the potential of personalized scaling as a foundation for more adaptive frameworks that integrate contextual information to improve the safety and precision of teleoperated procedures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了以人为中心的个性化运动缩放方法，以减轻遥操作机器人中的通信延迟对运动精度的影响。
AI.motivation: 遥操作机器人中，通信延迟会削弱操作者的视觉-运动协调能力，导致任务精度下降。现有的运动缩放方法主要采用统一参数，忽略了个体和具体情境的差异，因此需要更个性化的解决方案。
AI.method: 为每位参与者拟合延迟、方向和距离特异的缩放参数，并在虚拟仿真器中对20名参与者进行了有延迟的到达任务实验，通过模拟最小化超调来计算缩放增益。在仿真和远程手术机器人上评估运动缩放对不同实验条件下的辅助效果。
AI.result: 运动缩放在多种延迟、距离和运动方向下都显著提升了表现，关键指标提升20-25%。长延迟下效果尤为显著，个性化方案在中等延迟、短距离向内移动时带来额外精度提升。
AI.conclusion: 个性化的运动缩放有潜力成为集成情境信息、提升遥操作手术安全性和精确性的自适应基础方法。

title: HSMLA: Hierarchical Softmax Multi-scale Linear Attention for Efficient Vision Transformers
summary: Vision transformers face significant computational overheads in high-resolution dense prediction due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Linear attention offers efficiency but sacrifices local context modeling. We propose \textbf{HSMLA (Hierarchical Softmax Multi-scale Linear Attention)}, which combines ReLU-based linear attention for global context, selective softmax refinement for critical local features, and multi-scale token representations via depthwise convolutions. HSMLA achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs: up to $4.2\times$ inference-time speedup across dense prediction tasks, $87.3%$ Dice with $3.2\times$ speedup on CT organ segmentation, and $94.2%$ AUC with $4.1\times$ speedup on pathology WSI.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新型高效视觉Transformer架构HSMLA，大幅提升高分辨率任务的推理速度，同时保持优异精度。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉Transformer的自注意力机制在高分辨率密集预测任务中计算复杂度高（随输入平方增长），虽然线性注意力提升了效率，但削弱了对局部特征的建模能力，导致精度下降。作者旨在设计既高效又能保持优秀局部特征建模的新型注意力结构。
AI.method: HSMLA方法结合三方面创新：（1）基于ReLU的线性注意力用于高效全局建模；（2）对关键局部特征引入选择性Softmax精致建模；（3）使用深度卷积获取多尺度Token表示，实现全局-局部-多尺度融合。
AI.result: 在多个密集预测任务上，HSMLA推理速度提升高达4.2倍；CT器官分割中以3.2倍加速实现87.3% Dice分数；病理WSI任务中以4.1倍速度提升获得94.2% AUC。
AI.conclusion: HSMLA在保持精度的同时极大提高了推理效率，实现了优异的精度-效率权衡，适合高分辨率下的视觉密集预测任务。

title: Calling the Bluff: Detecting Ever-Shifting Harmful Chat Dialogue via Ordered Reasoning Chain Regularization
summary: Harmful chat dialogues are ever-shifting through type-shifting and lexical evasion, yet we find they share invariant principles, i.e., an Ordered Reasoning Chain (ORC) of recurring topics, harm language indicators, severity hierarchies, and type characteristics, which can help us capture the key information in the frequently changing lexical expressions. We propose BRACE, which encodes the ORC as four differentiable stages (Topic -> Indicator -> Severity -> Type) with intermediate supervision, serving as a structured regularizer blended with direct heads, and supported by prototype-based feature augmentation and feature path disentanglement. The evaluation results show that, across 4 domains and 5 harm categories, BRACE achieves harm-type macro F1 of 0.934 (RoBERTa-wwm-ext, 3-seed mean), with decoder backbones (Qwen3-1.7B LoRA) reaching 0.949. Ablation studies show that all components contribute to BRACE, and the structural decomposition of ORC enables BRACE to distinguish harmful types with semantic ambiguity. Disclaimer: This paper may contain content that is disturbing to some readers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种新方法（BRACE），通过结构化地识别有害聊天内容背后的规律，即有序推理链（Ordered Reasoning Chain, ORC），并借此提升对多变、有害对话检测的准确率，在多个领域及类别上取得了显著效果。
AI.motivation: 有害聊天文本的表达方式频繁变化，尤其通过词汇躲避和类型切换，导致传统检测模型难以准确、稳定地辨别其危害性。因此迫切需要一种能够抓住背后不变规律、适应高动态对话的检测模型。
AI.method: 提出BRACE模型，将有序推理链（话题-指标-严重性-类型）编码为四个可微分阶段，并在每一阶段添加中间监督信号。结合原型特征增强和特征路径解耦，将结构化信息作为正则项与直接判别头融合，实现对有害信息的高效识别。
AI.result: 在4个领域和5类有害类型的识别任务中，BRACE在RoBERTa-wwm-ext骨干模型上获得宏F1值0.934，在Qwen3-1.7B LoRA解码器骨干上提升至0.949。消融实验显示各组件均提升了模型表现。结构化分解方法可以有效区分存在语义歧义的有害类型。
AI.conclusion: 通过有序推理链对有害对话进行结构化分解，提高了对多变表达和有害类型的判别能力，新方法在多个领域展现了优异效果，对复杂对话安全检测具推广意义。

title: Action- and Language-Conditioned Video Assessment for Embodied Control
summary: Vision-based embodied agents executing multi-step natural language instructions require feedback mechanisms that assess task progress over complete trajectories. Conventional approaches based on final-frame matching or continuous embedding similarity may overlook intermediate transitions that are necessary for determining whether an instruction has been completed. We propose ALVA (Action- and Language-Conditioned Video Assessment), a trajectory evaluator that conditions its assessment on visual observations, the executed action sequence, and the natural language instruction. The method uses a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM) in two stages: it first summarizes frame-to-frame visual transitions conditioned on the executed actions and then assesses the generated summary with respect to the instruction to produce a discrete trajectory-level progress score. In simulated 3D household environments, ALVA exhibits a conservative assessment pattern with near-zero false-positive rates. When used as terminal feedback for closed-loop policy optimization, it provides more effective feedback than the evaluated static image and embedding-based visual baselines and reduces the performance gap to a ground-truth oracle. These results support action- and language-conditioned video assessment as an interpretable feedback mechanism for the evaluated simulated embodied-control tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出ALVA算法，结合动作和语言，对多步骤指令下的视觉轨迹进行评价，并用作智能体训练反馈，效果优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 以往的方法只通过最终帧匹配或连续嵌入相似度对视觉智能体任务完成情况进行评估，忽略了指令执行过程中的关键中间转变，导致反馈机制不够精确和全面。
AI.method: 提出ALVA评估方法，输入视觉观测、动作序列和自然语言指令，基于预训练视觉-语言模型两阶段处理：先根据动作总结帧与帧间的视觉转变，再将总结结合指令进行整体轨迹得分，实现对任务完成度的离散化评估。
AI.result: 在3D室内环境模拟中，ALVA显示出保守的评估风格，虚警率接近零。作为训练中的反馈信号时，ALVA比静态图像/嵌入相似度基线方法更有效，并减小了与理想评估器（oracle）间的表现差距。
AI.conclusion: 基于动作和语言条件的视频评估机制可以为模拟体感控制任务提供更可解释和有效的反馈，有助于提升智能体多步骤任务的训练与评估。

title: FlowErase-OPD: Multi-Concept Erasure via Anchored On-Policy Distillation in Flow Matching Models
summary: Recent advances in flow matching models have substantially improved the quality of text-to-image generation, but have also raised increasing safety concerns due to their potential to generate harmful or undesirable content. Existing concept erasure methods for flow matching models predominantly focus on removing individual concepts, while effectively erasing multiple concepts simultaneously remains challenging. We propose FlowErase-OPD, a framework for multi-concept erasure based on on-policy distillation (OPD). Our approach first distills multiple single-concept erased models into a unified LoRA module and introduces Anchored Multi-Teacher Distillation (AMTD), which incorporates a retention teacher to mitigate the trade-off between concept erasure and preservation of generative capabilities. To further improve the coordination of multiple erasure objectives, we develop Adaptive Retention Control (ARC), which dynamically adjusts the sampling frequency and loss weight of each erasure teacher, together with the relative contribution of erasure and retention teachers throughout training. Extensive experiments on nudity, object, and artistic-style erasure demonstrate that FlowErase-OPD consistently improves the trade-off between erasure effectiveness, image quality, and semantic alignment, achieving state-of-the-art performance across diverse multi-concept erasure settings. Furthermore, the resulting models exhibit strong robustness against adversarial attacks. These results highlight the potential of on-policy distillation as a principled framework for safe and controllable generation in flow matching models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FlowErase-OPD框架，实现了文本到图像生成模型中的多概念安全擦除，并达到了目前最优水平。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像生成模型尽管有较好的生成质量，但也带来了生成有害或不良内容的安全隐患。现有擦除技术多针对单一概念，多概念擦除难以兼顾擦除效果与生成质量。
AI.method: 作者提出基于on-policy distillation (OPD) 的FlowErase-OPD框架，通过将多个单概念模型蒸馏为统一的LoRA模块，引入以保留能力为目标的AMTD机制，以及动态调整擦除与保留目标权重的ARC策略，促进多目标擦除的协调。
AI.result: 在含色情、特定物体和艺术风格擦除的多场景实验中，FlowErase-OPD在擦除效果、图像质量及语义对齐方面均优于现有方法，并能抵御对抗攻击。
AI.conclusion: FlowErase-OPD框架为生成模型的安全可控提供了有效方法，展现出多概念擦除及模型鲁棒性的良好潜力。

title: Beyond Tables: Doc2DB-Bench for Relationally Faithful Document-to-Database Construction
summary: Practical AI systems increasingly need to turn long, heterogeneous documents into queryable relational databases, not isolated spreadsheets. In domains such as finance, healthcare, education, transportation, and enterprise operations, downstream workflows rely on normalized schemas, entity identities, keys, cross-table relationships, and integrity constraints for analytics, compliance, auditing, and SQL-backed decision making. Existing Document-to-Table benchmarks are insufficient for this setting: flattening evidence into single tables can duplicate entities, obscure many-to-many relationships, create sparse records, and avoid testing whether extracted facts form a valid database instance. This creates an urgent need to evaluate document understanding as database construction rather than field extraction. We introduce Doc2DB-Bench, a benchmark for Document-to-Database construction, containing 203 long-document instances across 42 schemas and seven domain groups, with 117 entity tables, 132 relationship tables, 7,341 rows, and 41,935 cells. Built through a controllable DB-to-Doc synthesis pipeline and organized by a taxonomy of intra-table extraction and inter-table reasoning, the generated documents undergo authenticity verification, proving indistinguishable from real-world references. Doc2DB-Bench thus provides a testbed for reliable, auditable, and relationally faithful LLM-based data systems. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/SetonLiang/Doc2DB-Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Doc2DB-Bench，一个用于评测文档到数据库（Document-to-Database）构建的新基准，聚焦长文档、多表结构、实体关系等真实场景，比以往的单表抽取任务更具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 现有文档转表格（Document-to-Table）的方法和基准只考虑单表抽取，无法满足实际AI系统将复杂异构文档转为规范关系型数据库的需求。现实应用（如金融、医疗、教育等）需要实体归一化、主键约束、跨表关系，依赖字段抽取远不能满足分析、合规、审计等任务。
AI.method: 作者提出Doc2DB-Bench，包含203个长文档，涵盖42种Schema和7个领域，共有117个实体表、132个关系表，结构复杂。基准通过DB到文档的可控合成管道生成，同时依据表内抽取及表间推理分类，生成文档经过真实性验证，难以与真实案例区分。
AI.result: Doc2DB-Bench成功构建了大规模多域、多表、多关系的文档到数据库基准，提供了可供可靠性、可审计性和关系一致性考核的测试环境。基准面向大型语言模型等系统的数据库构建能力评测更具现实代表性。
AI.conclusion: Doc2DB-Bench为文档理解向数据库构建这一更实际的任务场景奠定了基准基础，可用于更全面地评估和推动AI系统在关系型数据抽取和应用中的发展。

title: Scalable High-Speed Lateral Control for Single-Body and Articulated Autonomous Vehicles
comment: Presented as the plenary presentation at the 29th International Symposium on Dynamics of Vehicles on Roads and Tracks (IAVSD 2025), Shanghai, China, August 18-22, 2025. Proceedings forthcoming in Springer Lecture Notes in Mechanical Engineering
summary: This paper presents a scalable lateral control framework for robust path tracking of single-body and articulated autonomous vehicles at high speeds. A clothoid-based controller is extended with three key adaptations: 1) an integrated tangential check and Frechet distance method for optimized lookahead and oscillation mitigation; 2) real-time trajectory segment classification for dynamic adjustment of the lookahead search range; and 3) a dual-adaptive, rate-controlled lookahead mechanism responsive to cross-track error and upcoming path geometry. To support different vehicle configurations, the framework also incorporates flexible tracking point selection and curvature-to-steering lookup tables, enabling control of points such as the tractor rear axle, hitch point, or trailer-related locations without changing the core control architecture. The controller is evaluated using high-fidelity TruckSim and Simulink simulations for both standalone and articulated vehicles across dual lane changes and winding-road scenarios. Results demonstrate stable high-speed path tracking, reduced oscillations, effective lookahead adaptation, low cross-track errors, and acceptable lateral acceleration across different vehicle configurations. The results support the use of a unified lateral control architecture that can scale from single-body to articulated autonomous vehicles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可扩展的横向控制框架，能够实现单体和铰接式自动驾驶车辆在高速下的稳健路径跟踪。通过改进的曲线段预测和自适应机制，显著提升了跟踪性能与适应性，适用于多种车辆结构。
AI.motivation: 现有的横向控制方法在应对高速、大曲率路径及多类型车辆（如单体与铰接车）的路径跟踪时，面临稳定性、振荡和适配能力不足等挑战。作者希望开发一种统一、可扩展的控制框架，解决这些问题。
AI.method: 基于clothoid曲线的控制器，提出三项改进：(1) 集成切向检测与Frechet距离以优化前瞻点选择、抑制振荡；(2) 实时对轨迹段分类，根据道路情况动态调整前瞻距离范围；(3) 双自适应速率控制前瞻机制，根据横向误差与路径几何自适应调整前瞻距离。此外，通过灵活选择跟踪点和曲率—转向查找表，使该框架能兼容不同车辆结构，无需更改核心控制架构。
AI.result: 利用高精度TruckSim和Simulink仿真，分别针对单体及铰接车辆在双车道变换和弯道路况下进行验证。实验结果表明，该控制器能稳定实现高速路径跟踪，减少振荡，有效自适应前瞻距离，横向误差低，侧向加速度在可接受范围内，且适配多种车辆结构。
AI.conclusion: 该控制框架支持统一的横向控制架构，能够在单体和铰接式自动驾驶车辆间无缝扩展，实现了稳健、高性能、高适应性的路径跟踪控制。

title: HeatCast: A Benchmark for Neighborhood-Scale LST Forecasting across 124 U.S. Cities
summary: Land Surface Temperature (LST) is a widely used satellite-derived measure of urban surface heat, but there is no shared benchmark for forecasting it at 30 m. Prior studies usually cover one to three cities, use kilometer-scale products, or do not release data and code. We introduce HeatCast, a Landsat-based benchmark for monthly LST forecasting across 124 U.S. cities from 2013 through June 2025. HeatCast contains 30 m monthly tiles with LST, elevation, surfacereflectance RGB, three spectral indices, broadband albedo, quality masks, and Local Climate Zone (LCZ) labels, together with a fixed temporal split, LCZ-stratified metrics, and a reference evaluation harness. We evaluate a CNN+LSTM and Earthformer on next-month forecasting, where Earthformer reaches 7.74 K RMSE against 10.42 K for the CNN+LSTM. Forecasting from the eight nonLST channels alone reaches 7.72 K, against 8.15 K from LST history and 8.68 K from RGB. The data, code, and weights are released under MIT at https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/9889.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HeatCast，这是一个基于Landsat的数据集，用于在美国124个城市进行30米分辨率的月尺度城市地表温度（LST）预测基准研究，并发布了数据、代码和模型权重。
AI.motivation: 当前高分辨率（30米）的城市LST预测缺乏公开的基准数据集，已有研究要么覆盖城市少、分辨率低、或未开源数据和代码，影响了相关研究的对比和复现。
AI.method: 作者基于Landsat卫星数据，构建了HeatCast数据集，包含124个美国城市2013年至2025年6月的每月LST图像及相关辅助特征，并固定时间划分，设计LCZ分层评估指标，提供评测工具。以此数据集，作者评估了CNN+LSTM模型和Earthformer模型在下月LST预测任务上的表现，也对不同输入通道进行了效果对比。
AI.result: Earthformer模型预测下月LST的RMSE为7.74 K，优于CNN+LSTM的10.42 K。用8个非LST通道预测的RMSE为7.72 K，单用LST历史为8.15 K，用RGB为8.68 K。
AI.conclusion: HeatCast为LST预测提供了高分辨率、覆盖面广、可复现的公开基准，有助于推动城市热环境遥感监测方法的公平对比和进步。

title: VectraYX-Vision-1B: A Sub-2B Spanish/LATAM Cybersecurity Vision-Language Model with Structured Visual Reasoning and Native Tool Use
summary: We present VectraYX-Vision-1B, a sub-2B vision-language model (VLM) for Spanish/LATAM cybersecurity imagery, coupling a frozen SigLIP-so400m encoder to a 1.04B Spanish/LATAM security decoder via an MLP. To our knowledge, it is the first sub-2B VLM specialized for cyber UI (IDA, Ghidra, Wireshark, Nmap, Metasploit, Volatility) that answers in Spanish, emits structured reasoning via native <|think|> tokens, invokes tools via Model Context Protocol (<|tool_call|>), and exports to llama.cpp's LLaVA mmproj format for air-gapped deployment. We report a negative preliminary visual-grounding result: despite fully functional pipelines, the current vision SFT (400-1900 steps, ~16M tokens) yields near-zero B6 scores (0.08 tool-identification), ignoring image content. We specify remediation (longer SFT, >=60% replay, lower LR) and expose a checkpoint-loader bug (unstripped llm. prefix) masquerading as training collapse. Crucially, we introduce a 3-variant ablation matrix (V0: NoPE-every-4, V1: all-RoPE, V2: NoPE+learned 2D) to study if periodic no-positional-encoding (NoPE) layers help or hurt attention over the 729-token visual block. Code, configs, and weights are released to establish priority on this architectural question. We provide B1-B5 for the text backbone, text controls, preliminary B6/B7 scores, wall times, GGUF efficiency on CPU, and a corpus of 14,596 QA pairs across 10 domains. We open-source all models and trajectories: jsantillana/vectrayx-1b, jsantillana/vectrayx-vision-1b, and jsantillana/vectrayx-vision-1b-checks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了VectraYX-Vision-1B，这是一个专门用于西班牙语/拉美地区网络安全图像的sub-2B规模视觉-语言模型。模型能够在多种网络安全UI下以西班牙语作答、结构化推理，并具备离线部署能力。作者开源了全部模型及训练轨迹。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏专门面向西班牙语/拉美地区并聚焦网络安全界面的视觉-语言模型，同时AI在网络安全工具界面理解上的研究与开源资源也相对匮乏。为推动该领域发展，作者致力于开发和开放专精小规模模型。
AI.method: 采用冻结的SigLIP-so400m编码器与1.04B西班牙语安全解码器通过MLP连接，并与LLaVA中的mmproj格式兼容。提出了三种消融变体(V0, V1, V2)探究位置编码的影响，并进行了结构化推理和工具调用功能设计。
AI.result: 模型的文本能力和控制能力进行了初步评测，但在图片描述相关的视觉定位分数几乎为零（B6得分仅0.08），暂未能理解图片内容。作者定位到训练和加载流程中的潜在bug，并提出了改进措施（长训练、更高回放、调整学习率）。
AI.conclusion: VectraYX-Vision-1B展示了面向西语网络安全界面的新尝试和体系结构难题，初步结果暴露了视觉部分的薄弱和训练细节的重要性。工作已全部开源，为后续模型调优和研究奠定了基础。

title: Diminishing Returns of Intelligence: The Non-Linear Relationship Between LLM Scale and User Perception in Short-Duration Open-Ended Social Human-Robot Interactions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to drive embodied social agents, yet it remains unclear whether larger models improve user perception during brief human-robot encounters. This paper examines the effect of LLM parameter size on short-duration, open-ended social interactions with a robot interface. In a within-subjects study, 19 participants interacted with robot faces driven by Qwen3-VL models at 4B, 8B, and 30B parameters. Participants evaluated the interactions in terms of perceived intelligence, naturalness, enjoyment, and humor. Results showed no significant overall preference for the 30B model over the smaller variants, including no significant advantage over the 4B model in perceived naturalness or intelligence. A significant relationship between AI interaction frequency and intelligence rankings for the 30B model suggests that more experienced users may be more sensitive to differences in model capability. Overall, the findings indicate diminishing returns from model scaling in brief open-ended social HRI, where conversational flow, responsiveness, and socially appropriate behavior potentially matter as much as raw parameter count.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨不同参数规模的大语言模型（LLM）在简短人机社交互动中的表现。结果显示，较大模型（30B参数）在用户感知智力、自然度等方面，并未显著优于小模型（4B、8B参数），提升效果有限。
AI.motivation: 尽管大规模LLM正被广泛用于类人社交机器人，但“模型变大”是否真正提升用户短时互动体验，特别在感知智力、自然性等主观维度上的效果尚不明确，因此需要实证对比分析。
AI.method: 采用被试内设计，让19位参与者分别与由Qwen3-VL模型4B、8B、30B参数驱动的机器人面孔进行短时、开放式社交对话，并对每次互动在智力、自然性、趣味性等维度进行主观评价。
AI.result: 尽管30B模型参数最大，但在用户总体评分（智力、自然性等）上并未显著优于小模型。只有在高频AI互动用户中，30B模型的智力被评价较高。
AI.conclusion: 简单地增加模型参数规模，对短时、开放式人机社交互动体验的提升有限。对话流程、响应速度及社交合宜性等要素，与模型大小同样重要。

title: Data collection from highways: a geometric, class-agnostic approach to embedded vehicle counting
summary: Traffic data collection is dominated today by deep object detectors followed by tracking-by-detection, a pipeline that presupposes what is often missing in practice: a detector already trained on the class one wants to count. We revisit a purely geometric traffic-sensing pipeline for Single Board Computers in which detection is class-agnostic: moving objects come from background subtraction and thresholding, and counting is decided by a geometric rule on an imaginary line across the road, a software inductive loop detector. With no object model, training set or per-object trajectory, it runs faster than real time on Raspberry Pi class hardware. Two counting rules are described: a constant average speed rule, whose expected accuracy is derived analytically as about 86% under a Gaussian speed distribution, and a self-calibrating pre-calibration rule that recovers the lane geometry from blob statistics and counts edges of lane occupancy, additionally yielding per-vehicle average speed at no extra cost. Over four videos the latter counts with 83.3%-100% accuracy; in a field deployment it reaches 91% against 37.5% for a blob-tracking baseline under the same compute budget. We report the observations of that period in detail: the resolution floor below which accuracy collapses, the frame rate floor at which vehicles alias past the counting line, the gap between short curated clips and long uncontrolled footage, and the trade-off between Python (easier to tune, 100% CPU) and C++ (40% CPU, thermally viable). These are properties of the sampling geometry, not of the hardware of the time, and still constrain edge deployments. We close by arguing where motion-based, class-agnostic detection remains the right tool: open-set classes with no annotated data, tight power budgets, privacy-constrained installations, and the cold start of mining training crops to bootstrap a learned detector.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于几何规则、无类别检测的交通流量统计方法，可实时运行于树莓派等单板计算机上，无需已训练的对象检测器或训练集。通过背景减除和设定虚拟计数线，采用两种计数规则，实现了高效、准确的交通监测，适用于隐私、功耗等受限环境。
AI.motivation: 传统流量监测依赖于深度检测器和跟踪算法，但现实中往往缺乏已训练好且适用的对象模型，特别是边缘算力和新类型目标情况下。本文旨在探索无需对象类别模型、训练集的交通计数方案，满足算力、隐私等约束需求。
AI.method: 提出基于背景减除和阈值处理的运动物体检测，无类别区分。计数基于设定道路横向虚拟计数线的几何规则，提出两种计数方法：一、假设恒定平均速度，通过统计理论分析准确率；二、基于自动校准恢复车道几何，从blob统计中计数且可估算平均速度。所有算法均可在树莓派级别硬件实时运行。
AI.result: 恒定速度法理论准确率约86%；自动校准法在四段视频中准确率为83.3%~100%，实际部署中达到91%，明显优于同等运算预算下的blob跟踪方法（后者准确率为37.5%）。系统在分辨率和帧率不达标时准确率骤降，且Python易调优但高CPU占用，C++低CPU但更耐热。
AI.conclusion: 几何-运动基础、无类别交通检测在以下场景仍具优势：未知类别（无数据）、功耗极低、隐私受限、初始阶段自动挖掘训练数据。抽样几何（而非硬件）决定了系统局限性，因此该方法在特定边缘场景下仍具现实应用价值。

title: From Speech to Interaction: Analyzing Multimodal Systems in Cocktail-Party Scenarios
summary: Humans have the remarkable ability to engage in spontaneous informal conversations and selectively attend to individual speakers while filtering out competing speech from nearby conversations. This "cocktail party" scenario still presents severe challenges to speech recognition systems. The CHiME-9 MCoRec task provides a testbed where systems must recognize groups of speakers and transcribe each of their conversations from audio-visual input. In this work, we analyze a diverse set of systems, representing different design directions for addressing the cocktail-party scenario, where the best system achieves up to 57% relative error reduction. We identify three main strategies: (1) explicit or implicit audio-visual target speech separation, (2) improved audio-visual speech recognition for each target speaker, and (3) the use of large language models to group speakers into conversations and enhance conversational consistency. Our analysis shows that these directions address complementary failure modes of the cocktail-party problem, and that high speech overlap alone does not explain performance differences, challenging the common assumption that overlap is the primary source of difficulty in cocktail-party recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了在鸡尾酒会情景下，如何通过多种手段提升基于音视频输入的多说话人语音识别系统性能。
AI.motivation: 人类能够在嘈杂环境下辨识特定说话者并参与对话，但自动语音识别系统在“鸡尾酒会”场景下仍面临巨大挑战。CHiME-9 MCoRec任务为此类研究提供了测试平台。
AI.method: 作者分析了多种针对鸡尾酒会情景的系统，涵盖三种主要策略：（1）显性或隐性地进行音视频目标说话人分离，（2）针对每个目标说话人改进音视频识别，（3）利用大规模语言模型将说话人分组并提升对话一致性。
AI.result: 最佳系统在任务上实现了高达57%的相对错误率降低。作者发现三种策略解决了鸡尾酒会问题中互补的失败模式，并且高语音重叠并非主要性能瓶颈，挑战了以往的常见认知。
AI.conclusion: 多策略协同可显著提升鸡尾酒会场景下的语音识别表现。未来研究应关注重叠以外的问题，并结合多模态和大模型手段以进一步提升系统性能。

title: MPPI Planning with Gaussian Based Human Cost Function for Social Navigation
comment: Will appear in Springer's Proceedings in Advanced Robotics series
summary: Safe robot navigation in crowded spaces requires planning that accounts for where people will be, not only where they are now. Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control is an effective sampling-based planner, but many implementations encode humans as static point obstacles at their current positions, underestimating risk in dynamic scenes. We propose Predictive Gaussian Interaction Fields (PGIF), a spatiotemporal cost formulation that propagates pedestrian predictions forward over the full planning horizon and encodes them as anisotropic Gaussian repulsive fields aligned with each pedestrian's direction of motion. The forward spread of each field grows with the pedestrian's speed, creating a motion cone danger zone that penalises robot trajectories entering the pedestrian's path of travel more strongly than those approaching from behind. The formulation is closed-form and fully parallelisable across rollouts, adding no measurable computational overhead. Evaluated over 300 randomised crowd scenarios at three density levels, PGIF-MPPI achieves a 0\% collision rate at every density level, compared with up to 82\% for vanilla MPPI, while maintaining real-time planning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的行人建模方法，用于提升机器人在拥挤环境中避障的安全性和有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统MPPI规划器常将行人视为静态障碍物，忽视了其未来运动，导致动态场景下的风险被低估。
AI.method: 提出了预测高斯交互场（PGIF），将行人未来位置预测作为各向异性的高斯排斥场，依照行人方向对齐，且排斥场的前向扩展随速度增加。该方法为闭式表达式，并可完全并行计算，无额外计算负担。
AI.result: 在300个不同密度的随机人群场景中，PGIF-MPPI方法在各密度下均达到0%的碰撞率，而传统MPPI最高碰撞率达到82%，同时保持实时性能。
AI.conclusion: PGIF方法能有效提高移动机器人在人群中的安全导航能力，显著减少碰撞风险，且具备实用性和高效性。

title: Keep It Simple: Multi-Key Episodic Memory Retrieval for Ultra-Long Video Understanding
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026 (Oral). Project Page: https://choi-yeeun.github.io/MERIT/
summary: When videos extend from hours to days, directly processing them end-to-end becomes impractical for current Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs). This ultra-long setting necessitates a two-stage paradigm: query-agnostic memory construction followed by retrieval-based inference. Prior work invests in complex memory construction to pre-model high-level relations in videos, despite not knowing the downstream query at build time. We instead prioritize high-recall retrievability during memory building, and defer query-specific, high-level relation composition to inference time. To this end, we propose MERIT(Multi-key Episodic Retrieval with Inference-time Temporal expansion), a simple yet effective agentic framework for ultra-long video understanding. First, we formulate an episodic multi-key representation that enables precise retrieval of fine-grained memories through a simple key-matching mechanism. Second, we introduce a neighbor filtering mechanism to capture broader semantic context without the massive computational overhead of global memory construction. This is achieved by expanding the temporal scope exclusively around the retrieved segments at inference time. By leveraging simple key-matching with this on-demand temporal expansion, MERIT achieves state-of-the-art performance across three long-video benchmarks: EgoLifeQA, LVBench, and Video-MME (Long).

AI.tldr: MERIT提出了一种高效处理超长视频的两阶段检索框架，在内存构建阶段注重高召回率，推理阶段按需扩展时序信息，实现了在多项超长视频理解基准上的最佳表现。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大模型难以端到端处理数小时甚至数天的超长视频，传统做法依赖复杂的内存构建来预建视频高阶关系，效率和适应性均受限。
AI.method: 提出MERIT框架：第一阶段通过多key的episodic表示，高召回率地存储细粒度记忆，使用简单的key匹配实现高效检索；第二阶段引入邻域过滤机制，仅在检索到的片段周围按需扩展时序上下文，避免全局计算开销。
AI.result: MERIT在三个超长视频基准（EgoLifeQA、LVBench、Video-MME(Long)）上取得了SOTA性能，证明了方法优效。
AI.conclusion: 通过将复杂关系的建模推迟到推理时，并采用高效的episodic检索和按需时序扩展，MERIT为超长视频内容理解提供了高效且准确的新范式。

title: OpenVisTool: An Open Recipe for Synthesizing Instructive Visual Tool-Use Trajectories
summary: Visual tool use has emerged as a fundamental capability for multimodal agents to actively acquire evidence beyond a fixed image encoding. The prevailing recipe learns this capability from teacher-generated trajectories filtered for answer correctness, implicitly assuming that every successful demonstration provides effective supervision. We argue this assumption is flawed: a strong teacher often reaches the correct answer without needing its tool calls, and imitating such trajectories teaches a student that tool calls accompany correct answers, not that tool observations ground them. We present OpenVisTool, an open framework for constructing instructive visual tool-use trajectories that provide effective supervision for tool learning. The key insight is that a trajectory should be retained only if its answer is correct (outcome validity) and its tool observations causally contribute to that answer (causal utility). The framework operates in three stages: difficulty screening to select queries that are not reliably answerable without tools, domain-specific trajectory synthesis to elicit coherent tool-use trajectories, and supervision verification to jointly test both conditions. Rather than encouraging models to imitate tool calls, the resulting supervision teaches when and how visual evidence should be acquired. Using this framework, we construct OpenVisTool-42K, a dataset spanning five visual reasoning domains, together with OpenVisTool-Bench, a benchmark covering the same domains. Across four backbones (4B-27B), fine-tuning on OpenVisTool-42K consistently improves visual tool-use performance and yields gains on two out-of-distribution benchmarks; the larger models approach leading closed-source systems. The evidence suggests that effective visual tool use is learned from causally grounded supervision rather than tool-calling patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OpenVisTool，一个用于多模态代理有效学习视觉工具使用的新框架和数据集，强调工具观测必须因果地贡献于答案，而非仅仅模仿工具调用。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态视觉工具学习方法主要依据教师生成的正确答案轨迹进行模仿，默认每次成功都能带来有效监督。但作者发现：教师模型常常不靠工具也能得出正确答案，学生若无差别模仿，无法真正理解工具观测对推理的价值。
AI.method: OpenVisTool框架分三步：1）筛选出只有依靠工具才能解答的难题；2）合成因果连贯的工具使用轨迹；3）验证工具观测是否对答案有因果作用，从而只保留有“因果实用性”和“结果有效性”的数据，帮助学生学习何时如何采集视觉证据。
AI.result: 通过OpenVisTool框架构建了OpenVisTool-42K数据集和OpenVisTool-Bench基准。在4个主流多模态大模型主干（4B-27B参数量）微调后，均提升了视觉工具使用性能，对分布外测试集也有提升，大模型接近领先闭源系统表现。
AI.conclusion: 有效的视觉工具学习依赖于有因果基础的监督，而非简单地学习工具调用模式。OpenVisTool为视觉工具学习提供了更科学合理的数据与范式，推动该领域方法的改进。

title: Stochastic Physics-Informed Neural Networks on Lie Groups for Learning Underwater Vehicle Dynamics
summary: Accurate models of underwater vehicle motion are needed for autonomous execution of marine tasks like infrastructure inspection and scientific sampling. However, such motion is challenging to characterize using traditional physics-based methods. This paper presents a novel data-driven framework for learning stochastic underwater vehicle dynamics. Using Euler-Poincaré dynamics and the geometry of Lie groups, we develop a stochastic physics-informed neural network architecture that respects the physical and geometric constraints of underwater vehicles. Our approach leverages structure-preserving stochastic integration and builds upon moment matching and finite dimensional matching to ensure geometrically-consistent training. We evaluate our approach in simulation and on an underwater vehicle navigating dock pylons in a harbor environment. The results demonstrate that our method learns accurate and robust dynamics models, enabling safe model-based control in challenging marine environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的数据驱动框架，用于学习水下机器人动力学，突破传统物理建模的局限，实现了更加准确和稳健的动力学模型构建。
AI.motivation: 水下机器人在自主完成如基础设施检测和科学采样等海洋任务时，对运动模型的准确性有很高要求。但传统基于物理的方法难以对其运动进行精确建模。
AI.method: 论文结合Euler-Poincaré动力学和Lie群几何，提出了一种物理约束下的随机神经网络架构，利用结构保持的随机积分方法，在训练过程中采用动量匹配和有限维度匹配来保证几何一致性。
AI.result: 在仿真和实际港口环境中对水下机器人进行了实验，结果表明，该方法学到的动力学模型准确且鲁棒，能支撑模型预测控制的实际应用。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的学习框架有效提升了水下机器人动力学模型的准确性和鲁棒性，为在复杂海洋环境中实现安全的基于模型的控制提供了可行方案。

title: CosmosAlign: Adapting a World Foundation Model for Generative Traffic Video Forecasting
summary: Generative traffic video forecasting aims to synthesize long-horizon, temporally coherent future videos of traffic scenes from a short observation history and textual descriptions. In this paper, we present CosmosAlign, a generative traffic video forecasting framework built upon the pretrained Cosmos3-Nano world foundation model. Our approach is motivated by the observation that successfully adapting large pretrained world models to downstream forecasting tasks depends primarily on distribution alignment rather than increased model capacity. To this end, we propose a two-stage LoRA adaptation strategy that first aligns the conditioning-mode distribution with the target forecasting task, and then aligns the training captions with the model's native structured prompting interface through an LLM-based re-captioning pipeline. During inference, we further improve prediction quality using a fully training-free procedure consisting of consensus-based medoid sample selection and motion-adaptive blending of static scene regions. CosmosAlign achieves a final score of 76.49 on the AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5 benchmark, ranking first on the final leaderboard. Our code is publicly available at https://quangminhdinh.github.io/CosmosAlign/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了CosmosAlign框架，通过两阶段对齐策略和无训练推理过程，有效提升了交通视频生成预测的性能，并在AI City Challenge 2026获得第一。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在将大型预训练世界模型应用于交通视频预测等下游任务时，主要难点在于分布对齐而非模型扩容。希望通过优化对齐策略来提升性能。
AI.method: 提出了两阶段LoRA适应策略：（1）首先对条件分布进行对齐，使其适应目标预测任务；（2）通过基于LLM的重描述管线，将训练用描述和模型本身的结构化提示接口对齐。推理时又引入了基于共识的样本选择和静态场景区域的运动自适应融合，无需额外训练。
AI.result: CosmosAlign在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5基准测试上取得76.49分，排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 通过分布对齐而非简单扩展模型容量，能更有效释放大型世界模型在视频预测任务上的潜力，CosmosAlign的方法验证了这一点并取得了优异成绩。

title: Mitigating Gender Bias in English to Romanian Machine Translation
summary: Machine translation (MT) systems often fail to correctly translate gender, especially when converting from a gender-neutral language like English to a gendered target language such as Romanian. This bias results in translations that default to masculine forms or reinforce gender stereotypes. We propose a hybrid pipeline to mitigate this issue by combining large language model (LLM)-based gender classification with neural machine translation (NMT). Our system uses a fine-tuned LLM to detect the intended gender of target words in English sentences and insert inline gender hint tags. These tagged sentences are then passed to a Transformer model fine-tuned to generate morphologically correct Romanian translations. To support this, we introduce three novel datasets for gender disambiguation and translation. Our approach improves gender accuracy on the WinoMT and WinoGender benchmarks by over 40 percentage points compared to a baseline MT system. This is the first method to explicitly address and evaluate gender bias in English-Romanian MT using both LLM inference and tag-aware translation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对跨语言机器翻译中的性别偏差问题，提出结合大型语言模型和神经机器翻译的混合系统，显著提升了英-罗马尼亚翻译中的性别准确性。
AI.motivation: 目前主流的机器翻译系统在从英语（性别中性语言）翻译到罗马尼亚语（有性别区分语言）时，常常不能准确处理性别信息，产生男性默认或刻板印象偏差。因此，提升性别相关词汇翻译准确性亟需新方法。
AI.method: 提出一种混合式翻译流程：首先用微调后的大型语言模型对英文中的目标词义别（性别）进行判别，并添加内嵌性别提示标签；随后将带标签的句子输入经过微调的Transformer神经机器翻译模型，实现符合词形变化规则的罗马尼亚语翻译。此外，作者还构建了三套全新性别消歧和翻译相关数据集。
AI.result: 在WinoMT和WinoGender基准数据集测试中，该系统的性别准确率相比传统翻译系统提升了40个百分点以上。
AI.conclusion: 该方法首次将LLM推理与标签感知翻译结合，专门针对英-罗马尼亚机器翻译中的性别偏差进行纠正和评估，显著提升了翻译中的性别处理能力。

title: EsaacSim: A Multimodal Event Camera Add-on for NVIDIA Isaac Sim
summary: Event-based vision is becoming an increasingly important sensing paradigm for robotics, yet its adoption remains limited by sensor availability and the lack of integrated simulation tools for modern robotics platforms. This paper presents EsaacSim, a multimodal event camera add-on for NVIDIA Isaac Sim that enables online simulation of configurable event cameras with grayscale and Bayer RGGB event generation. The framework supports multiple event camera resolutions and provides synchronized RGB, APS, event, depth, and IMU outputs through native ROS2 interfaces. A motion-guided frame-gap synthesis strategy further increases the effective temporal resolution while preserving compatibility with the Isaac Sim rendering pipeline. Experimental evaluation demonstrates synchronized multimodal simulation across representative robotic scenes and efficient online performance over five event camera resolutions at effective event rates from 240 to 960Hz. Event stream generation requires 6.98--27.28ms for grayscale events and 7.58--29.16ms for Bayer RGGB events while using less than 400MB of additional GPU memory on an NVIDIA RTX~4060 GPU. These results show that EsaacSim enables supports online multimodal event-camera simulation for robotics research and synthetic data generation. We release an early version of the simulator and report its current architecture and performance.

AI.tldr: 提出并实现了EsaacSim，一款集成于NVIDIA Isaac Sim的多模态事件相机仿真工具，支持高效、同步的多模态输出，便于机器人领域相关研究和数据集生成。
AI.motivation: 虽然事件视觉逐渐成为机器人感知的重要手段，但受限于事件相机硬件普及度不高，以及缺乏与主流机器人平台兼容的仿真工具。这导致机器人研究和开发中难以充分探索、利用事件视觉的潜力。
AI.method: 设计并实现了EsaacSim插件，可在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中在线仿真可配置的事件相机，支持灰度和Bayer RGGB事件生成、不同分辨率、多模态同步(RGB, APS, event, depth, IMU)，借助运动导向的帧间合成策略提升时间分辨率，并通过ROS2接口输出数据。
AI.result: EsaacSim在多种典型机器人场景下支持同步多模态仿真，并能高效运行于五种不同分辨率事件相机，实际输出事件速率240~960Hz。事件流生成耗时在6.98--29.16ms之间，额外显卡内存消耗不超过400MB（NVIDIA RTX 4060），性能满足在线仿真需求。
AI.conclusion: EsaacSim能够为机器人研究和虚拟数据集生成提供高效、同步、多模态的事件相机仿真平台。当前已发布早期版本并报告了架构和性能。

title: SpikeWorld: Fast-State Adaptation for Frozen Spiking World Models
summary: A predictive model receives a self-supervised signal whenever the consequence of an action is observed. Using that signal after deployment is difficult when dynamics and semantics share parameters: freezing prevents adaptation, whereas weight updates require optimizer state and may alter the learned representation. Here we introduce SpikeWorld, a 1.45M-parameter sparse spiking model jointly trained for heterogeneous sensory prediction, semantics, image-text binding and action-conditioned dynamics. At deployment, all trained parameters are frozen. Delayed next-state residuals update two external paths: cumulative fixed-bank losses select the bounded action correction, while route-specific residual matrices refine next-state prediction. Neither path uses labels, teacher outputs, rewards, success signals or the true shift value. Joint optimization improves action next-state MSE by 17.10\% while also improving multimodal prediction, semantic accuracy and image-text retrieval. On held-out shear and attenuation streams, the combined external state improves aggregate prediction by 5.48\% and 30.01\%; its fixed-bank action path improves tracking by 24.20\% and 3.94\%, respectively. In a six-arm study comprising 450 new Meta-World trajectories (75 per arm), SpikeWorld raises frozen-policy reward by 7.90 (95\% CI [2.48, 14.06]); the 13.33-point success difference is descriptive (CI [0, 40]). For identical sensory inputs, model parameters and inherited semantic outputs remain bitwise unchanged. A 16-byte RLS estimator obtains the highest non-oracle reward on linear attenuation, showing that the contribution is not superior linear identification, but its integration with a frozen multimodal spiking checkpoint. Reference code is publicly available at https://github.com/Oooorca/SpikeWorld.

AI.tldr: SpikeWorld是一个稀疏脉冲神经网络模型，用于多模态感知预测、语义理解和动作动态学习，支持在部署后仅通过外部路径而非参数更新来利用自监督信号，提升了预测与任务表现。
AI.motivation: 部署后面对新环境变化时，模型参数冻结会失去适应新输入的能力，而继续训练则需优化器状态且可能损害已有表示。如何让已训练模型在参数冻结情况下，仍可受益于自监督信号，是本研究的核心动机。
AI.method: 提出SpikeWorld：一个145万参数的稀疏脉冲神经网络，同时进行多种感知、语义、图文绑定和动作预测任务训练。在部署阶段，所有参数冻结，根据延迟获得的下一个状态残差，仅更新外部累计损失库和线路特定的残差矩阵，辅助动作修正与状态预测，且无需标签、奖励或教师信号。
AI.result: 在动作-下状态预测MSE上提升17.10%，多模态预测、语义精度及图文检索也同获优化。持出剪切与衰减流评测下，外部状态路径分别带来5.48%和30.01%的总体预测提升。六臂Meta-World任务（450条轨迹）中，冻结策略下平均奖励增加7.90，成功率描述性提高13.33点。
AI.conclusion: SpikeWorld在冻结参数下，凭借自监督外部路径可有效改善多模态预测与动作决策，不改变模型本身的语义输出与参数。与附加16字节的RLS估算器集成，证明此方法并不依赖更强的线性辨识能力而是依靠自监督与冻结模型协同优势。

title: North Africa's Missing Framework: NLP-Driven Mental Healthcare in Algeria and Implications for Low-resource Settings
summary: Mental health disorders are a leading cause of disability worldwide, yet Natural Language Processing (NLP) research for mental healthcare has remained concentrated in high-income, English-language settings. North Africa, and Algeria in particular, is largely absent from this literature despite its unique linguistic, historical, and healthcare context. We present the first conceptual framework examining the potential role of NLP within Algeria's mental healthcare system. Drawing on narrative synthesis of global NLP mental health research, Algerian healthcare literature, and low-resource NLP methodologies, we identify four structural barriers to mental healthcare: the language-of-care gap, geographic inequities in access, stigma-related barriers to help-seeking, and the absence of research and digital infrastructure. We then map existing NLP capabilities to each barrier, outlining their potential applications, implementation constraints, and the technical, institutional, and governance requirements necessary for deployment. Based on this analysis, we propose a research and policy roadmap that prioritizes data resources, multilingual language technologies, evaluation frameworks, and regulatory capacity. Although grounded in the Algerian context, the framework addresses challenges common to many multilingual, low-resource, and post-colonial settings. This work provides a foundation for future research on culturally and linguistically appropriate NLP for mental healthcare and offers a practical roadmap for developing responsible AI-enabled mental health systems in underrepresented regions.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了阿尔及利亚精神卫生系统内NLP（自然语言处理）应用的首个概念框架，分析了NLP如何应对当地四大精神医疗障碍，并给出了未来研究和政策路线图。
AI.motivation: 尽管心理健康问题全球普遍存在，且造成重大残疾负担，NLP在心理健康领域的研究多集中于高收入、讲英语国家，像阿尔及利亚这样的地区缺乏相关研究。该地有独特的语言、历史和医疗背景，因此探讨NLP如何在阿尔及利亚精神健康领域发挥作用具有重要意义。
AI.method: 本研究采用叙述综合的方法，整合全球NLP心理健康研究、阿尔及利亚医疗文献以及低资源NLP方法学，提取精神卫生障碍和NLP适用点，梳理实施约束与配套条件，进而制定策略与路线图。
AI.result: 论文总结阿尔及利亚精神健康服务的四大障碍：语言差距、地理不均、求助障碍（如污名化）、数字/研究基础设施缺失。针对每一障碍，评估了现有NLP技术的匹配点、实际限制与必需的技术、制度、治理支持。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为阿尔及利亚及其他多语言、资源贫瘠、后殖民环境下开展NLP心理健康服务研究提供了基础框架和实践路线图，对促进文化与语言适应性强的AI心理健康系统具有重要推动作用。

title: Curriculum Generation under Structured Parametric Environments for Robust Navigation Policies
summary: Robust navigation policies for autonomous agents must generalize across continuously varying environmental conditions such as turn rates, obstacles, friction, pits, and slopes. Curriculum generation provides a principled mechanism for improving generalization by progressively adapting training environments, but designing such curricula in a sample-efficient and automated manner remains challenging. This paper proposes a reparameterized curriculum generation framework for structured continuous environment parameters using unidirectional gradient-based optimization. To improve robustness in multimodal observation spaces consisting of image-based and scalar inputs, a distribution-shift regularization objective is incorporated to encourage the learning of finer-grained latent representations. The proposed method is evaluated across two continuous-control OpenAI Gym environments: a 2D obstacle-based Car Racing variant and Bipedal Walker variant, where coupled environment parameters jointly influence policy performance. Across five random seeds, our method consistently outperforms vanilla policy training, random parameter sampling, manual curricula, frontier-based methods, Self-Paced Reinforcement Learning (SPRL), Absolute Learning Progress with Gaussian Mixture Models (ALP-GMM), and reverse curriculum learning baselines. Ablation studies further demonstrate the effectiveness of the reparameterized curriculum mechanism across both environments, while highlighting environment-dependent benefits of the auxiliary regularization objective.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的课程生成框架，通过梯度优化提升自主体在连续变化环境中的泛化能力，并结合分布转移正则化增强对多模态观测空间的鲁棒性，在复杂仿真环境中优于多种主流基线。
AI.motivation: 自主体需要应对如转弯、障碍、摩擦等不断变化的环境条件，现有课程学习虽然有助于泛化，但如何高效、自动设计课程仍具挑战。
AI.method: 方法采用对环境参数的重参数化和单向梯度优化生成训练课程，并在多模态输入（如图像和标量）中引入分布转移正则，以鼓励学习到更细致的潜在特征表示。该方法在两种OpenAI Gym连续控制环境（赛车和步行者）上进行评估。
AI.result: 在存在耦合环境参数影响的情形下，提出的方法在五组随机种子下稳定优于普通策略训练、随机参数采样、手动课程、前沿式方法、SPRL、ALP-GMM及反向课程学习等基线。消融分析证明重参数化课程机制在两种环境下均有效，并展示正则化目标的环境依赖性效果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出的课程生成机制能有效提升自治体在具有复杂干扰环境中的泛化和鲁棒性，并显示其对广泛基线方法的优势及灵活性。

title: Tokenizer Generator Coupling in Medical Image Generation
summary: Latent medical image generators usually treat the tokenizer as fixed preprocessing. We test whether this separation is valid in a controlled ChestMNIST study at 64x64, crossing discrete tokenizers, generator families, and sampler settings under a shared latent grid, with continuous-latent reference cells. In this controlled setting, rankings depend jointly on the tokenizer, generator, and sampler: the best quantizer changes with the generator, and validation-based sampler selection changes the apparent generator ranking. We retrain the vocabulary-1024 interaction block at three seeds and the interaction survives (6 of 9 pairwise quantizer comparisons exceed three seed standard deviations), and we scope the wider single-seed grid accordingly. Reconstruction PSNR alone is not a reliable selection criterion; we instead introduce a generator-free statistic, neighbour-conditional predictive gain, that separates the quantizer families by downstream generation quality (rank-AUC 1.00) where reconstruction PSNR and marginal token entropy do not. On LFQ-1024, retuning D3PM and SE-D3PM (selected on a held-out validation split) moves them from default FID-192 0.44/0.41 to 0.09/0.10 at lower NFE, replicated across seeds; the continuous references were not given an equivalent sampler sweep. We report FID-192 as an internal ranking metric; it ranks consistently with standard FID-2048 (Spearman 0.80) and with a label-free classifier two-sample test (0.78). We interpret these results through a rate-distortion-modelability framing, where modelability is conditional on the generator, sampler, and inference budget. All experiments are at 64x64 on low-resolution medical-style images, unconditional, and evaluated with non-clinical FID-based metrics, and we scope every claim to that setting. Code: https://github.com/liamchalcroft/medtokenizers and https://github.com/liamchalcroft/medlatents.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了在医学图像生成任务中，不同tokenizer、生成器和采样器的组合如何影响图像生成质量，发现这些环节需联合优化，而非独立处理。提出新评价指标用于更好区别模型优劣。
AI.motivation: 此前医学潜变量图像生成常将tokenizer视为固定预处理，缺少对tokenizer、生成器和采样器协同作用的分析。作者质疑这一假设，旨在通过系统实验验证各环节间的交互作用，并寻找更可靠的模型选择标准。
AI.method: 在ChestMNIST 64x64医学图像数据集上，组合多种离散tokenizer、生成器架构和采样器，采用统一的潜变量空间及连续参考，控制变量设计实验，对比不同组合的生成性能。引入“邻域条件预测增益”作为无生成器依赖的评价指标，横向比较各类tokenizer。
AI.result: 发现生成质量依赖于tokenizer、生成器和采样器的联合组合，最佳tokenizer随生成器而异。重建PSNR不足以作为模型优劣判据，提出的新指标能准确区分不同tokenizer家族。调整采样器后，主流生成器的FID由0.44/0.41大幅下降至0.09/0.10，显示性能显著提升，并在不同随机种子下得以复现。
AI.conclusion: 医学图像生成中的tokenizer与生成器需协同优化，简单的重建指标无法反映真实生成性能。新提出的评价指标在下游生成任务中更具代表性。研究限定于64x64非临床低分辨医学影像，并建议后续关注tokenizer与生成器、采样器的交互选择。

title: Enhancing Scientific Named Entity Recognition via Large Language Models: A Type-driven Multi-task Learning Approach
summary: Scientific named entity recognition (SciNER) plays a crucial role in information extraction and knowledge discovery from scientific texts. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated the capacity to achieve competitive SciNER performance with minimal human effort. Existing research highlights the importance of incorporating candidate entity type information for accurate entity recognition and classification by LLMs. However, when too many candidate entity types are provided in the prompt, LLMs struggle to accurately recognize and label entities in scientific texts, where entity types are more complex than in general domains. To address this challenge, we propose TdSciNER, a type-driven approach that effectively leverages entity type information to enhance SciNER performance. In TdSciNER, we first design an entity type filter model to identify the most likely entity types present in a given sentence. Subsequently, we introduce an auxiliary multi-class entity typing task within a multi-task learning framework alongside SciNER to obtain richer contextual representations. Then, we develop a novel demonstration selection strategy based on sentence similarity and entity type diversity to activate the in-context learning capabilities of LLMs, thereby improving entity recognition accuracy across diverse scientific domains. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our method achieves performance comparable to fully supervised models. Further analysis validates that each entity type-driven component in TdSciNER contributes to the improvement of SciNER performance. This work provides valuable insights for future advancements in SciNER and broader information extraction tasks in scientific text mining.

AI.tldr: 提出了TdSciNER方法，通过类型驱动有效提升大语言模型在科学命名实体识别（SciNER）任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在科学命名实体识别任务中，当候选实体类型过多时，识别和分类准确率下降，尤其是在实体类型更复杂的科学文本领域。
AI.method: 方法包括三步：首先用实体类型过滤模型筛选句中最可能出现的实体类型；其次在多任务学习框架下引入多类实体类型辅助任务，获取更丰富的上下文表示；再次提出基于句子相似性和实体类型多样性的新示例选择策略，激活LLM的上下文学习能力。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的实验表明，该方法性能与全监督模型相当。进一步分析显示，各类型驱动组件对性能提升都有贡献。
AI.conclusion: TdSciNER为科学文本挖掘领域的信息抽取任务提供了新思路，有助于今后相关技术的发展。

title: Vid2WAM: Distilling Video Diffusion Priors into World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by jointly modeling future visual dynamics and actions. However, their scalability and generalization remain constrained by their reliance on costly expert demonstrations. We challenge this by asking whether future supervision for WAMs must originate from target-task expert trajectories. In this paper, we propose Vid2WAM, an offline distillation framework that transfers visual diffusion priors from a large video foundation model into a compact WAM student. Given an observation and language instruction, Vid2WAM distills supervision through two complementary channels: task-conditioned future rollouts directly supervise the student's future prediction branch, while an inverse dynamics model recovers embodiment-specific pseudo-actions for action learning. To robustly integrate synthetic and real supervision, we introduce source-aware residual action adaptation that learns source-specific corrections around a shared action backbone and mitigates interference from noisy pseudo-actions. During inference, both the video teacher and inverse dynamics model are discarded, leaving only the WAM student for efficient deployment. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that Vid2WAM improves novel-task generalization and data efficiency under limited expert demonstrations while preserving low-latency inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的机器人策略学习框架Vid2WAM，通过从大规模视频基础模型中蒸馏视觉扩散先验到紧凑的世界动作模型（WAM），大幅减少对昂贵专家演示的依赖，提高了泛化能力和数据效率。
AI.motivation: 现有WAM依赖高成本专家演示，限制了其扩展性与泛化性。本文关注：WAM的未来监督是否必须来自目标任务的专家轨迹，希望降低监督数据成本。
AI.method: 提出Vid2WAM框架：离线将视频基础模型的视觉扩散先验蒸馏到WAM学生模型，具体包括：（1）用任务条件未来回滚直接监督WAM的未来预测分支；（2）用逆动力学模型生成具体机器人体的伪动作进行动作学习，同时引入源感知的残差动作自适应，整合真实与合成监督，减少噪声伪动作的干扰。推理阶段只用WAM学生模型。
AI.result: 模拟与真实机器人实验显示，Vid2WAM在专家演示有限情况下提升了新任务泛化能力与数据效率，同时保持低延迟推理。
AI.conclusion: Vid2WAM显著降低了高质量监督的门槛，并有效提升了WAM的实际部署价值，是一种更高效、通用的机器人视觉与决策学习方法。

title: Vision Meets WiFi: Physics-Grounded Estimation of Volumetric Mechanical Properties
summary: Estimating volumetric mechanical properties, including Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, and density at each voxel, is intrinsically ambiguous from vision alone, as visually similar objects may have substantially different material compositions and physical behavior. Existing approaches predict these properties independently across voxels, overlooking the piecewise-constant material structure of real objects and producing noisy or inconsistent estimates for voxels that share the same material, while lacking an explicit mechanism to resolve visual ambiguity. We introduce ViWi (Vision Meets WiFi), an object-centric framework for volumetric mechanical-property estimation. ViWi represents each object using a compact set of material slots that aggregate evidence from voxels with a shared material identity and produce coherent slot-level property predictions. To complement visual appearance, ViWi incorporates a compact RF descriptor generated through WiFi-band electromagnetic simulation using permittivity and conductivity. The RF descriptor conditions the material slots with global composition cues that may be unavailable from images, while visual features preserve voxel-level spatial localization. Across volumetric mechanical-property and mass-estimation benchmarks, ViWi improves over the prior state of the art on four of six per-voxel metrics, while its vision-only variant improves all mass-estimation metrics. These results demonstrate that combining object-centric material structure with complementary RF evidence enables more accurate and physically coherent volumetric property estimation beyond what is possible from visual appearance alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ViWi框架，将视觉和WiFi（射频）特征结合，用于更准确地估算物体体素级的机械属性（如杨氏模量、泊松比和密度），解决了仅靠视觉难以分辨材料和预测不一致的问题。
AI.motivation: 仅凭视觉很难准确推断物体的体积机械属性，因为外观相似的物体可能由不同材料构成，表现出不同的物理特性。传统方法通常忽视真实物体中分段常数材料结构，也无法有效解决视觉歧义，导致预测结果分散且不一致。
AI.method: ViWi框架采用'材料槽'机制，将对同一材料身份的体素进行聚合，产生一致的材料属性预测。此外，ViWi结合图像特征和通过WiFi波段电磁模拟得到的RF描述符，后者基于介电常数和电导率，提供无法仅从图像获得的材料全局信息，共同提升属性判别的准确性。
AI.result: 在体素级机械属性估计和质量估计基准测试中，ViWi在六项指标中的四项上超过了以往的最佳方法；其仅视觉版本在所有质量估计指标上也有提升。
AI.conclusion: 将面向对象的材料结构与WiFi等射频补充信息结合，可以有效提升体素级材料属性估算的物理一致性与准确率，优于仅使用视觉外观的传统方法。

title: The Evolution of Mixture-of-Experts Architectures in Large Language Models: Routing, Topology, Load Balancing, and Expert Parallelism
summary: Mixture-of-Experts models increase parameter capacity while keeping the computation activated by each token bounded, but their architectural evolution cannot be explained by a chronological list of model releases alone. This technical survey synthesizes primary papers, official technical reports, and prior surveys to organize modern Mixture-of-Experts systems along five coupled dimensions: expert granularity, expert topology, routing freedom, the scope of load balancing, and execution structure. We describe eight architectural milestones as a dependency graph with six mainline developments and two orthogonal branches, rather than as eight successive generations. We then analyze individual systems through four control planes: Expert Topology, Routing, Balance, and Expert Parallelism. These planes specify which experts exist, which experts process each token, how aggregate load is controlled, and how selected computation is mapped onto physical devices. The framework connects algorithmic choices such as Top-k routing, shared experts, fine-grained experts, and dynamic expert composition with systems concerns including token dispatch, device placement, all-to-all communication, and communication-computation overlap. We conclude with equal-budget pretraining experiments, quality and systems metrics, and open research questions. The main trend is a shift from merely activating more sparse parameters toward decoupling semantic routing, computational budgets, and physical execution.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了现代Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）模型的主要架构发展，通过多维度框架系统性地分析并总结关键进展与设计考量。
AI.motivation: 尽管MoE模型在参数扩展和计算效率方面具有突出优势，但其架构的演化过程复杂，仅靠模型发布顺序无法整体把握，因此需系统性梳理其发展脉络和设计趋势。
AI.method: 作者汇集了主要论文、技术报告与综述，将MoE模型的架构变迁归纳为专家粒度、专家拓扑、路由自由度、负载均衡范围和执行结构五个维度，通过依赖图描述八大架构里程碑，并用四个控制面详细剖析各系统的技术实现。
AI.result: 论文通过上述多维度对比分析，将主流MoE架构的发展过程以非线性方式展现，指出关键算法与系统实现之间的联系，并通过统一预算预训练实验与相关质量、系统指标进一步对比验证。
AI.conclusion: MoE模型的设计正从简单增加激活参数转向于语义路由、计算预算和物理执行的解耦。作者最后提出了当前领域的开放性问题，展望未来发展方向。

title: Knowledge-Distilled End-to-End Reinforcement Learning for Smooth 6-DOF Thrust Control and Rapid Adaptation to Ocean Currents in Remotely Operated Vehicles
summary: With the continuous improvement of computational capabilities, end-to-end reinforcement learning has been rapidly developed for remotely operated vehicles control. Nevertheless, existing end-to-end reinforcement-learningbased methods still face challenges in achieving optimal control under oceancurrent disturbances. In particular, there remains a lack of a unified control framework that can simultaneously achieve low steady-state tracking error, rapid transient response, energy-efficient operation, and smooth controlforce outputs under disturbances. To address the issue, this paper proposes the thrust smoothness rapid current adaptation proximal policy optimization (TSRCA-PPO) method which learns a near-optimal strategy by a twostage distillation learning framework. The core innovations of this work lie in the reward-function design and the privileged multi-encoder architecture. Ablation studies validate the effectiveness of each module. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed TSRCA-PPO method consistently outperforms the conventional cascaded P-PID controller across all evaluation metrics. Specifically, TSRCA-PPO reduces the steady-state position error, steady-state attitude error, settling time, energy index, and thrustsmoothness index to 42.7%, 76.5%, 10.6%, 93.5%, and 15.9% of the corresponding P-PID values, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的端到端强化学习方法（TSRCA-PPO），用于提升水下遥控航行器在海流扰动下的控制性能，并通过模拟实验验证了该方法优于传统P-PID控制器。
AI.motivation: 现有的端到端强化学习方法难以在海流扰动下，实现低稳态误差、快速响应、节能和平滑控制力输出，并且缺乏统一的控制框架。为解决这一问题，提出了新的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为TSRCA-PPO的强化学习框架，核心包括奖励函数设计和多编码器结构，并采纳两阶段蒸馏学习策略。通过消融实验评估了各模块作用。
AI.result: 在仿真测试下，TSRCA-PPO在所有评估指标上表现均优于传统级联P-PID控制器。其中TSRCA-PPO将稳态位置误差、姿态误差、调整时间、能量消耗和推力平滑度指标分别减少到P-PID的42.7%、76.5%、10.6%、93.5%、15.9%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的TSRCA-PPO方法在较大幅度提升水下航行器对扰动适应性、性能和能效的同时，能够有效减少控制输入波动，具有较强的实际应用潜力。

title: Ghost Features and Spooky Transfer Learning for Hypercomplex-Valued Neural Networks
comment: 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP 2026)
summary: Hypercomplex numbers extend the concept of complex numbers by introducing additional imaginary components. Besides increasing dimensionality, operations on the imaginary parts provide algebraic and geometrical properties that can be beneficial for solving machine learning problems. In this paper, we show how to create hypercomplex-valued neural network layers where the real part corresponds to the output of a traditional real-valued layer. The additional imaginary parts of these hypercomplex-valued layers produce what we call ``ghost features,'' which contain enhanced information that is not present in the output of the real-valued layer. Moreover, ghost features can be effectively integrated into a trained neural network through a process we refer to as ``spooky transfer learning.'' This approach allows us to harness the richness of ghost features, leading to more efficient neural networks. The source code and Jupyter Notebook are available at https://github.com/mevalle/v-nets/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了超复值神经网络层，通过引入额外的虚数部分（称为“幽灵特征”），提升信息表达能力，并通过所谓“spooky transfer learning”集成进已训练网络，从而提升神经网络效率。
AI.motivation: 传统神经网络仅利用实数空间，无法捕捉复杂的关联信息。引入超复数能增加表达维度和代数几何属性，有望提升模型的表现。
AI.method: 作者设计了超复值神经网络层，让实部对应原有的实值层输出，虚数部分生成额外的“幽灵特征”。这些特征通过特殊迁移学习（spooky transfer learning）整合进已训练网络，进一步增强模型表现。
AI.result: 利用幽灵特征和spooky transfer learning，能构建更高效的神经网络，并实现优于传统实值网络的信息表达能力。
AI.conclusion: 引入超复数和幽灵特征，为神经网络提供更多信息通道，有望带来更高效、更强表达力的模型架构。

title: LibraSpec: Dynamic Diffusion-Based Speculative Decoding via Marginal-Gain-Driven Optimization
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens for parallel verification, with efficiency critically determined by the speculative length selected at each decoding round. Existing dynamic speculation methods select the speculation length by estimating how many tokens will be accepted, which is reasonable for autoregressive drafters that generates tokens sequentially. The recent wave of diffusion-based drafters, however, generates candidate blocks in parallel at substantially lower drafting cost, shifting the key question from how many tokens to generate to how many generated tokens are worth verifying. We therefore reformulate dynamic speculative-length selection as expected-speedup optimization and derive a marginal criterion that extends the speculative sequence only when its acceptance gain outweighs the additional verification cost. Building on this criterion, we develop \textit{LibraSpec}, a training-free and plug-and-play algorithm that iteratively determines the speculative length using drafter confidence scores. Theoretically, we prove that LibraSpec monotonically converges toward the optimal speculative length. Experiments across six target models, three diffusion-based speculative decoding methods, and math, coding, and chat benchmarks show consistent improvements under both greedy and sampling settings, achieving a further $0.5\sim1.5\times$ improvement over baselines and up to $8.49\times$ speedup over autoregressive decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并理论证明了一种新颖的动态预测长度选择策略LibraSpec，用于加速扩散模型驱动的大语言模型推理，比现有方法在多项任务基准上进一步提升推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的speculative decoding主要用于自回归生成器，预测长度的选择依赖于预计token的接受数量。但扩散模型并行生成候选块，主瓶颈从“生成多少”转向“验证哪些值得”。现有方案不适用于扩散模型，需要新的长度选择机制以最佳化推理加速。
AI.method: 作者将动态预测长度选择重新表述为期望加速优化问题，推导了一个边际准则：只有当预测序列的接受收益大于额外验证成本时才延长。基于此，提出训练无关、可即插即用的LibraSpec算法，利用生成器置信分数动态决定预测长度。理论上证明了收敛性。
AI.result: 在六个目标模型、三种扩散式speculative decoding方法及多任务基准（数学、代码、聊天）上实验，在贪婪和采样场景均取得持续加速，相较于基线提升0.5~1.5倍，较自回归生成最高可达8.49倍。
AI.conclusion: LibraSpec为动态预测长度选择提供理论和实践支撑，适用于扩散式生成器，无需额外训练，简单易集成，并在多个任务上验证了其在加速LLM推理方面的有效性。

title: RAG-Based Auto-Configuration for Industrial Fieldbus Devices
summary: Industrial device commissioning requires engineers to manually extract hundreds of protocol-specific parameters from heterogeneous PDF manuals and transcribe them into supervisory control systems, a time-intensive, error-prone workflow. This paper presents SysName, a production-oriented pipeline that automates device configuration end-to-end for Modbus RTU, OPC-UA, Profibus DP, and CANopen. It builds a hybrid dense-sparse retrieval index augmented by an ontology graph derived from ECLASS, AAS, and SOSA/SSN, using a BGE-M3 encoder with a cross-encoder reranker to surface relevant manual passages. A local LLM (T=0.1) generates ontology-aligned JSON-LD configurations via protocol-specific prompts and a four-step repair pipeline. A two-stage abstention gate, combining a reranker-score threshold and an IRI resolution ratio, blocks unsafe LLM invocations and filters low-coverage configurations before SHACL validation. On a gold set of 28 field-level queries, the hybrid retriever reaches 0.96 HitRate@10, and the reranker raises MRR@10 from 0.56 to 0.63 with perfect score separation for abstention. The generator attains field-level F1=0.87 with exact match on 9 of 12 runs. End-to-end runs on an H100 GPU complete in 2.6-6.6s per device with zero unsafe writes and zero silent failures on a five-device benchmark; every unsuccessful run is flagged by abstention or deployment verification. Component-wise evaluation localises the single systematic failure to OPC-UA generation, invisible to end-to-end metrics alone. A case study commissions a physics-simulated Universal Robots UR5e robot from unmodified vendor documentation (254-page manual, 8-page register list, 496 chunks), reaching field-level F1=1.0 over three runs with read-back and joint-consistency verification. An ablation study and comparison with five industrial-LLM systems complete the analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套名为SysName的自动化工业设备参数抽取与生成配置方案，从PDF手册中自动读取协议参数并形成可部署的配置，大幅减少人工工时且避免出错。
AI.motivation: 在工业设备调试过程中，工程师需手动从多种格式的PDF手册中提取上百种协议参数，再录入至监控系统，过程耗时且易出错，急需一种精准高效的自动化解决方案。
AI.method: 提出SysName生产级自动化流程，涵盖Modbus RTU、OPC-UA、Profibus DP及CANopen协议。采用混合稠密-稀疏检索与本体知识图增强，用BGE-M3编码器结合交叉编码reranker检索手册片段，局域LLM生成本体对齐JSON-LD配置，通过两级拒答门与SHACL验证确保输出安全及高覆盖，还对系统各组件单独评估并设有异常检测。
AI.result: 在28项现场查询金标数据集上，混合检索器HitRate@10 达0.96，reranker将MRR@10由0.56提升至0.63并实现完美筛分。生成器字段级F1达0.87，9/12精确匹配。端到端H100 GPU实验中单设备运行2.6-6.6秒，无不安全写入和静默失败，失败案例均被检测拦截。对某机器人案例手册全自动配置达F1=1.0。
AI.conclusion: SysName在实际工业环境下表现出极高自动化、安全性与准确率，并对系统各环节表现与不足、与传统工业大模型方案进行全面对比，为行业设备自动化调试提供了可行且优越的端到端解决思路。

title: BRUCE: Benchmarking Robustness Under Corruption Escalation for Scientific Vision-Language Reasoning
summary:
Visual-language models (VLMs) frequently struggle with robustness issues in real-world situations due to low- or varying-quality input images. In this paper, we aim at analyzing VLMs' robustness by applying perturbations and distortions to the input images, such as blur or low contrast. Toward this goal, we propose BRUCE (Benchmarking Robustness Under Corruption Escalation, a multimodal reasoning fragility framework for scientific vision-language reasoning.
  State-of-the-art evaluation frameworks/studies primarily focus on clean-task accuracy and rarely analyze how reasoning stability degrades across robustness dimensions. Besides varying over a wide-range of input perturbations, BRUCE employs two novel metrics -- Robustness Corruption Index (RCI) and Traversal-RCI (T-RCI) -- to quantify how rapidly multimodal reasoning performance deteriorates in VLMs as visual corruption severity increases under progressive perturbation scaling.
