We evaluate BRUCE across chemistry and mathematical reasoning tasks for multiple datasets, while analyzing corruption-induced prediction failures in terms of four high-level reasoning domains: OCR-dependent reasoning, spatial reasoning, symbolic reasoning, and semantic failures, with each containing fine-grained corruption specific failure subtypes, thereby enabling an interpretable failure analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BRUCE框架，用于评估视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在不同图像质量扰动下的推理稳健性，通过新颖的指标量化推理性能衰减，并分析在多个数据集和不同推理领域下的模型失败类型。
AI.motivation: 当前主流评估方法只关注干净任务（高质量输入）的准确率，很少涉及模型在遭遇各类输入扰动时推理能力的稳定性。因此亟需系统分析VLM在现实世界低质量或有干扰图像下的鲁棒性问题，并给出量化评估。
AI.method: 提出BRUCE框架，在输入图像上施加不同类型扰动（如模糊、低对比度），并设计两项新指标——RCI和T-RCI，用于度量模型推理性能随扰动加剧的下降速率。以化学和数学任务为例，在多个数据集上评估模型表现，并将预测失败细分至四大推理域（如依赖OCR、空间推理、符号性推理和语义失败）及更细粒度的失效子类型，实现可解释分析。
AI.result: 实验证明，VLM在扰动升级时推理性能显著下滑，各推理类别在不同类型干扰下出现独特的失效模式。通过RCI和T-RCI指标，可以系统性跟踪和揭示性能退化过程。BRUCE实现了有针对性的模型脆弱性挖掘。
AI.conclusion: BRUCE为VLM稳健性分析提供了统一且细致的基准框架，有助于未来在多模态推理任务中提升模型稳健性和解释性。

title: Can We Optimize the Performance-Carbon Emission Break-Even Point?: The Quest for Greener LLMs
comment: 13 Pages, 6 Figures, Submitted to ARR Cycle
summary: The carbon footprint of any deployed Large Language Model (LLM) accumulates during inference, where repeated use of the model substantially exceeds the one-time cost of fine-tuning. Yet most efficiency interventions target either pre-training scale or post-hoc compression. We ask whether folding a calibrated, differentiable energy surrogate into the fine-tuning objective can produce inference behavior that gains task accuracy at zero or near-zero carbon cost, a break-even configuration. We propose a joint loss mechanism with a per-model carbon-emission parameter, a linear surrogate over parameter norm, FLOP proxy, and a memory proxy, fit from on-hardware energy profiling. We fine-tune three architecturally distinct families: Gemma-2 2B, Llama-3.1 8B, and Qwen-2.5 14B, and evaluate inference F1 and CO$_2$ emissions on three MMLU subjects: abstract algebra, philosophy, and formal logic. We discover from several outcomes that the carbon term behaves as either harmful interference or beneficial regularization depending on the task structure. We position calibrated carbon-aware fine-tuning as a lightweight, drop-in regularizer with a non-empty but model and task-dependent break-even region. This is an ongoing work, and we will release our codebase soon.

AI.tldr: 本文主要探讨如何通过在大模型微调时引入碳排放代理作为损失函数的一部分，实现模型在推理阶段既能保持任务精度，又达到近乎零碳排放增长的一种权衡。
AI.motivation: 当前大模型部署后主要的碳足迹来源于推理而非一次性的微调阶段，然而大多数效率提升方法关注的却是预训练规模或后期压缩，对于消耗主要发生在推理阶段的优化尚有不足。作者希望研究能否在微调过程中直接纳入能耗代理，以达到更绿色的AI推理。
AI.method: 提出在微调阶段，将一个基于参数规模、FLOP和内存的线性能耗代理与任务损失做联合优化，同时该能耗代理通过实际硬件能耗数据拟合。选取Gemma-2 2B、Llama-3.1 8B和Qwen-2.5 14B三类不同架构的模型，在三个MMLU子任务上比较F1分数和CO2排放变化。
AI.result: 实验证明，碳排放代理项在不同任务和模型下，可能作为有害干扰，也可能作为有益正则化。整体上，找到了一定的模型与任务相关的折中区间，实现了碳排放优化与精度保持的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 碳感知微调作为一种轻量级的正则策略，可在不影响性能的情况下降低模型推理碳排放，但具体收益依赖于模型结构和任务类型，相关代码将公开，未来有更多应用和探索空间。

title: Anchor-Based AI Approach for Pre-Crash Object Detection Utilizing Micro-Doppler Signatures in Automotive Radar
summary: Advanced automated driving presents significant potential to improve modern automotive safety systems, but it depends highly on the reliable activation of restraint systems. Forward-looking sensors are crucial for immediate and precise object detection. Recent developments in automotive radar technology enable detailed environment detection and the recognition of high-resolution features, such as micro-Doppler signatures. Combined with advanced AI techniques, these features significantly enhance object detection and improve the accuracy of kinematic parameter estimation. This is essential for the early and reliable activation of irreversible safety systems, such as smart airbags and adaptive seat belts. Therefore, an anchor-based AI model is presented, designed to process high-resolution radar data with an explicit focus on micro-Doppler signatures to improve pre-crash object detection. Furthermore, these signatures can improve the accuracy of kinematic object parameter estimation and reduce false negatives, especially in the critical near-field. To address the challenges of sparse and fluctuating radar point clouds, an innovative radar-image dilation technique on the feature input channels was developed to amplify local radar patterns, like micro-Doppler features. Therefore, this approach increases the system's reliability and increases its ability to detect objects in pre-crash scenarios despite radar multipath reflections and ghost objects. In order to investigate the applicability and compare the model's performance with advanced automotive radar tracking methods, a radar data set using series sensors and pre-crash relevant scenarios was recorded. The results demonstrate the advantages of the anchor-based AI model over established tracking approaches. It excels at estimating object parameters in dynamic scenarios and underscores its ability to process different data sets effectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于锚点的AI模型，专门处理高分辨率雷达数据中的微多普勒特征，以提升车辆主动安全系统中的前碰撞目标检测和运动参数估计准确性。模型通过自研的雷达图像膨胀技术优化特征提取，在多个实车场景数据集上展现出对现有方法的明显优势。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶安全对主动约束系统的可靠触发非常依赖，而当前雷达点云稀疏、波动大、存在鬼影等问题制约了前碰撞检测与识别的准确率。因此迫切需要提升汽车雷达对关键特征（如微多普勒信号）的提取与利用能力，从而实现安全系统更早、更可靠的激活。
AI.method: 利用最新的汽车雷达硬件，结合锚点机制的AI模型，重点提取和利用高分辨率雷达微多普勒特征。为对抗点云稀疏波动，提出雷达图像膨胀（dilation）技术，增强本地特征。通过采集多种预碰撞实际场景数据集，验证该方法在动态目标参数检测与识别中的表现，并和主流雷达跟踪方法进行对比。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该锚点AI模型在动态预碰撞场景下，对目标参数的估计更加准确，误检率降低，且对不同类型场景和数据具备较好适应性，优于传统的雷达跟踪算法。
AI.conclusion: 基于锚点的AI雷达信号处理方法与特征增强技术显著提升了前碰撞检测的可靠性与准确性，为智能安全约束系统的提前激活和乘员保护提供了技术基础。

title: LoRSA: Toward Generalizable Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Biomedical Downstream Tasks
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables the adaptation of vision foundation models to biomedical tasks under limited computational resources, but a single low-rank update can constrain all task-specific changes to one narrow parameter subspace. This restriction may prevent the model from simultaneously representing globally shared task structure and localized residual directions required for generalization to unseen imaging domains. We introduce LoRSA, a global--residual adaptation framework that jointly learns a dense low-rank component and a dynamically structured-sparse low-rank component. The dense component captures globally coordinated task adaptation, while the structured component provides complementary residual corrections whose support evolves during training. We characterize the representational capacity, approximation properties, rank structure, and singular-subspace complementarity of this decomposition. We evaluate LoRSA for four-class breast-density classification using DINOv3-Base, with VinDr-Mammo as the source domain and MammosighTR and RSNA as unseen external domains. LoRSA remains competitive on the internal validation set and achieves the best external macro-F1 on both target datasets, improving upon the strongest competing method by 2.15 percentage points on MammosighTR and 3.09 percentage points on RSNA. Weight-matrix analysis further shows that approximately $92\%$ of the energy of each adaptation component lies outside the bilateral singular subspace of the other, indicating that the two components learn largely complementary update directions. These results suggest that organizing adaptation capacity into distinct global and residual paths can improve the external-domain generalization of parameter-efficiently adapted biomedical vision models.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为LoRSA的新参数高效微调方法，可提升基础视觉模型在医学影像领域跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有参数高效微调方法（如单一低秩更新）受限于同一参数子空间，难以同时表征任务的全局结构与本地残差，限制了模型在未见领域上的泛化。
AI.method: LoRSA框架同时学习密集低秩分量和动态结构稀疏低秩分量，前者捕捉全局任务适应，后者动态微调残差，二者协同进化。通过理论和实验分析其表征能力和互补性。
AI.result: 在乳腺密度四分类任务中，LoRSA在内部验证集表现优秀，在两个外部测试集上（MammosighTR和RSNA）均取得最佳Macro-F1分数，对比最强方法提升分别为2.15和3.09个百分点。权重分析显示两分量互补性强。
AI.conclusion: 对微调参数空间的全局与残差分路组织有助于提升医学视觉模型在未见领域的泛化能力。

title: Multilingual Emotion Neurons in Large Audio-Language Models
summary: Emotion is central to human communication, and its expression varies across languages. Large audio-language models (LALMs) achieve strong performance on multilingual speech tasks, yet it remains unclear whether they encode emotion through language-specific correlations or language-agnostic representations. We present the first neuron-level interpretability study of this question. We define Multilingual Emotion Neurons (MLENs) as functional units exhibiting stable emotional selectivity and aligned causal effects across languages, and introduce Consistency-Regularized Fusion (CR-Fusion) to identify them. Across four modern LALMs and 12 typologically diverse languages, emotion-sensitive neurons identified independently per language show minimal overlap, and additional monolingual identification data saturates quickly without isolating more transferable units, motivating identification from pooled cross-lingual evidence. Causal interventions demonstrate that MLENs identified by CR-Fusion provide more precise and transferable affective control than monolingual neuron sets in both zero-shot and low-resource settings. Leave-one-out ablations further reveal asymmetric transfer: individual identification languages, including low-resource ones, contribute non-redundant evidence, while several low-resource languages benefit most from the resulting cross-lingual transfer. Together, our findings provide the first causal, neuron-level account of how LALMs encode emotion across languages, and establish multilingual neuron identification as an effective mechanism for understanding cross-lingual affective behavior.

AI.tldr: 本论文首次在神经元层面研究多语种大音频-语言模型（LALMs）如何编码情感，提出并证实了可跨语种迁移的多语种情感神经元（MLENs），并开发了新的识别方法。
AI.motivation: 虽然LALMs在多语种语音任务中表现优异，但尚不清楚它们编码情感时是依赖于特定语言相关性还是以语言无关的方式表达情感。论文旨在填补该领域的可解释性空白，探明跨语种情感表示的内部机制。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的神经元识别方法——Consistency-Regularized Fusion（CR-Fusion），并定义了Multilingual Emotion Neurons（MLENs）。论文在四个主流LALMs和12种类型多样的语言上，通过分别单语和多语分析其情感相关神经元的重叠度和可迁移性，并进行因果干预和去除实验验证方法效果。
AI.result: 发现单语言下独立识别的情感神经元重叠度极低，并且随着单语数据增多也难以获得跨语种可迁移的神经元；而基于跨语种融合后的CR-Fusion方法，发现了更精确且具可迁移性的MLENs。离群验证显示，低资源语言也可为跨语种迁移做出非冗余贡献，低资源语言自身从中受益最明显。
AI.conclusion: 首次在因果和神经元层面揭示了LALMs如何跨语种编码情感，证明了多语种神经元识别是理解跨语种情感表达的有效机制，对跨语种情感控制和低资源情感任务均具实际指导意义。

title: WA-SpecDec: World-Aware Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies generate robot controls autoregressively, making closed-loop latency dominated by repeated target-model forward passes. Speculative decoding reduces this cost by verifying blocks of draft action tokens in parallel, and recent VLA methods further relax token-level acceptance because small differences in action-token space often map to similar continuous controls. However, this relaxation remains scene-agnostic. A fixed token-distance tolerance treats the same action-token deviation as equally safe across states, although deviations that are harmless in free space can cause collisions or grasp failures near contact. We propose WA-SpecDec, a world-aware speculative decoding framework that injects world-model-derived physical scene awareness during the VLA prefill stage, producing shared world-aware prefill states for draft proposal and target verification without changing the relaxed acceptance rule. Across three state-of-the-art relaxed acceptance schemes, WA-SpecDec preserves higher task success under looser relaxation and enables longer accepted prefixes. At comparable-success operating points, WA-SpecDec achieves a 1.5x matched-success speedup over VLA speculative decoding alone and reduces near-contact failure (NCF) by 18.6% on average relative to the corresponding speculative baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向物理场景感知的推测解码框架（WA-SpecDec），通过引入世界模型信息，有效提升了机器人视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的生成速度和安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略在生成动作时需要多次推理，导致闭环延迟高。虽然推测解码（SpecDec）和松弛Token层级接受可加速生成，但这些方法对物理场景缺乏感知，可能在关键状态（如接触物体时）产生高风险动作。作者为了解决同样的动作偏差在不同场景下风险不同的问题，提出了基于世界模型的场景感知机制。
AI.method: 提出WA-SpecDec框架，在VLA生成前的prefill阶段引入世界模型推断获得的物理场景信息，为草稿动作和目标动作的验证提供世界感知的统一状态。在不更改既有松弛接受规则下，使推测解码对临近复杂物理状态更加敏感。此方法融合了三种先进的松弛Token接受方案。
AI.result: WA-SpecDec在三个先进松弛接受方案下，能在更宽松的Relaxation条件下维持更高的任务成功率和更长的通过动作片段。在可比成功率下，相较于普通VLA推测解码，WA-SpecDec加速了1.5倍，并能在接触临近状态下将失败率平均下降18.6%。
AI.conclusion: WA-SpecDec可在不牺牲任务性能的前提下大幅提升推测解码效率和安全性，特别适用于对物理场景敏感的机器人操作任务。

title: Multi-Task Consistency-based Detection of Adversarial Attacks
summary: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have found successful deployment in numerous vision perception systems. However, their susceptibility to adversarial attacks has prompted concerns regarding their practical applications, specifically in the context of autonomous driving. Existing defenses often suffer from cost inefficiency, rendering their deployment impractical for resource-constrained applications. In this work, we propose an efficient and effective adversarial attack detection scheme leveraging the multi-task perception within a complex vision system. Adversarial perturbations are detected by the inconsistencies between the inference outputs of multiple vision tasks, e.g., object detection and instance segmentation. To this end, we developed a consistency score metric to measure the inconsistency between vision tasks. Next, we designed an approach to select the best model pairs for detecting inconsistencies effectively. Finally, we evaluated our defense against PGD attacks across multiple vision models on the BDD100k validation dataset. The experimental results demonstrated that our defense achieved a ROC-AUC performance of 99.9% detection within the considered attacker model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的对抗样本检测方法，利用多任务视觉系统中不同推理任务之间的不一致性作为检测依据，在多个模型及数据集上实验取得了极高的检测精度。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在视觉感知系统（如自动驾驶）中已广泛应用，但其对抗攻击脆弱，现有防御方法成本高、难以实际部署，特别是在资源受限的场景下。
AI.method: 通过利用复杂视觉系统中的多任务推理输出（如目标检测和实例分割）之间的一致性，对对抗扰动进行检测；提出一致性评分指标，并通过选择最佳模型对来提高检测效果。
AI.result: 在BDD100k验证集、多种视觉模型和标准PGD攻击下，所提方法检测对抗攻击的ROC-AUC达到99.9%。
AI.conclusion: 多任务视角下一致性检测是一种高效、实用的对抗样本检测方法，实验验证其在实际视觉系统中具有优越性能和良好部署前景。

title: OmnilingualGAIA2: Evaluating the Multilingual Gap in Frontier AI Agents
summary: Agentic benchmarks aim to measure how well AI agents plan, search, execute, and recover within realistic multi-tool environments, but they are almost exclusively in English. As AI agents are globally deployed to a linguistically diverse user base, whether agentic competence measured in English transfers to other languages remains an open question. We introduce OmnilingualGAIA2, a machine-translated expansion (with partial human- expert validation) of the GAIA2 agentic benchmark, covering ten target languages spanning five writing systems, paired with a localised and human-calibrated multilingual verifier. Evaluating seven frontier and open-weight agents, we find a universal cross-lingual gap of 8.8-18.4 pass@3 points that is agent-asymmetric in magnitude, concentrates on tool-orchestration rather than quantitative reasoning, and does not close with model scale. A stratified error attribution decomposes the gap as predominantly model-driven (55%), with a bounded translation-contamination floor of only 6.4% of scenario-language pairs. Human-expert linguistic analysis further identifies morphological cue loss and amplified ambiguity as the primary failure mechanisms in non-Latin-script languages. Our results argue that multilingual agentic evaluation must become a standard part of the reporting protocol for globally deployed agents.

AI.tldr: OmnilingualGAIA2是对GAIA2代理基准的多语言扩展，用于评测AI代理在多语言环境下的能力，发现不同语言下AI表现存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体(agentic)基准几乎只用英语进行评测，但现实应用场景覆盖多种语言，尚不清楚英文评测结果能否泛化到其它语言。
AI.method: 作者通过机器翻译与部分人工校验，将GAIA2基准扩展到10种涵盖5种文字系统的语言，并配备本地化人工校准的多语言验证器，对7种领先和开放权重的代理模型进行评测，并对误差进行分层归因分析和语言专家分析。
AI.result: 所有模型在多语言评测下表现出8.8-18.4分的普遍跨语言差距（pass@3），主要体现在工具协作而非定量推理，模型规模增加并未弥合差距。误差主要由模型自身驱动（占比55%），翻译引入的噪声影响较低（仅6.4%）。对非拉丁文字，表现劣化主要归因于形态学线索缺失和歧义加大。
AI.conclusion: 要确保全球部署AI代理的公平性和实用性，多语言智能体评测应成为标准评测协议的一部分。

title: OnEvoMemory: Evolving Memory through Online Robot Rollouts for Pretrained Robot Policies
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a poster at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Embodied Multimodal Reasoning in Physical Environments (EMR)
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires policies to track completed subtasks and critical interaction events. However, existing memory mechanisms heavily rely on external models or predefined update rules. To address this, we propose OnEvoMemory, a value-guided memory module for pretrained robot policies. It maintains recent context, high-value experiences, and salient transitions, while learning which experiences should be retained from trajectory outcomes. Offline demonstrations initialize the memory prior, whereas successful and unsuccessful online rollouts refine memory selection, helping the policy recognize task-stage transitions and avoid repeating completed subtasks. Experiments on long-horizon manipulation benchmarks show that OnEvoMemory improves the performance of the base VLA policy through both offline initialization and online memory evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于机器人操作的新型价值引导记忆模块OnEvoMemory，能提升长时序任务的执行效果。
AI.motivation: 针对现有机器人操作中的记忆机制过分依赖外部模型或固定更新规则的问题，研究者希望打造一种能动态自我进化的高效记忆模块，以更好地跟踪任务阶段和重要事件。
AI.method: 作者设计了OnEvoMemory模块，可存储最近上下文、高价值经验和显著转变，实现预训练策略的记忆增强。该模块利用离线示范初始化记忆，并通过在线成功或失败的执行进一步优化记忆选择策略。
AI.result: 实验证明，在长时序操控基准任务中，引入OnEvoMemory的VLA策略比仅用基础策略表现更佳，无论是在离线初始化还是在线记忆进化阶段。
AI.conclusion: OnEvoMemory无需外部模型或预定义规则，能高效维护、优化机器人操作中的记忆，有助于策略理解任务进展并避免重复操作，提高长时序任务整体表现。

title: Rethinking 3D Segmentation from Individual LiDAR Scans: Incidence-Aware Sampling on the SIP Benchmark
summary: 3D scene understanding is increasingly important in construction, yet most methods are developed on curated datasets that do not fully reflect real site sensing conditions. In many workflows, individual LiDAR scans provide rapid local updates rather than complete scene representations, producing limited surface coverage, acquisition-driven density variation, and severe imbalance between dominant planar surfaces and sparse construction elements. Because large point clouds must be downsampled, sampling resolution and point allocation directly affect the balance between geometric detail and spatial context. This study evaluates these effects under a fixed per-fragment point budget and introduces an incidence-aware sampling strategy for individual LiDAR scans. The method maps points to a geometry-normalized manifold space for voxel-based selection while preserving original Euclidean coordinates for downstream learning. It requires only point coordinates and normals and no backbone modification. Using the Site in Pieces (SIP) benchmark, experiments with Point Transformer and PointNeXt show improved resolution-averaged segmentation performance, especially for non-planar elements and ladders, while reducing sensitivity to sampling resolution. The results show that acquisition-aware sampling can provide a more stable geometric representation and should be treated as an active component of individual-scan 3D segmentation rather than generic preprocessing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对单次LiDAR扫描的incidence-aware采样策略，提升了建筑场景中3D分割的稳定性和性能，特别是对稀疏和非平面元素。
AI.motivation: 当前大多数3D场景理解方法基于理想数据集，难以反映实际工地扫描条件。实际工作流常用单次LiDAR扫描，带来点云覆盖率有限、密度不均和表面类型分布严重失衡等问题。点云下采样过程中，采样方式对几何细节与空间语境之间的权衡非常重要。
AI.method: 在点数受限条件下，提出incidence-aware采样方法：将点映射到几何归一化流形空间，以体素为单位进行选择，但保留原始欧氏坐标用于后续学习。该方法只需点的坐标和法向信息，无需对深度学习骨干模型进行修改。
AI.result: 在Site in Pieces (SIP)基准数据集上，结合Point Transformer和PointNeXt模型，表现为整体分割精度提升，尤其对非平面构件（如梯子等）表现更优，并且降低了对采样分辨率的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 采集感知（acquisition-aware）采样不仅能提升单次扫描3D点云分割的表现和鲁棒性，还应被视为主动的数据处理环节，而非普通的预处理步骤。

title: Unsure but Certain: Uncovering the Representation-Confidence Gap in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models use broad context to create text, suggesting they might handle input noise better than standard models. Testing reveals this is only partially true. Internally, diffusion models detect text errors highly accurately. Externally, their reported certainty ignores this signal. As accuracy drops due to noise, confidence stays near its maximum and the ability to correctly rank answers degrades toward random chance. We call this mismatch the representation confidence gap. The visible concentration of high certainty scores is a misleading surface symptom. Standard math adjustments remove this concentration but fail to fix the underlying loss of ranking order. This ranking deficit favors standard models under noisy conditions and resists common remedies. Matching training recovers accuracy but not ranking, while score recalibration and input level error signals cannot reorder the final answers. However, the information needed to properly evaluate an answer survives in the hidden states. A lightweight extraction tool uses this signal to improve ranking. This approach is highly efficient because it leaves the base model completely frozen and requires zero additional text generation steps. We present this tool to prove the signal exists, while clearly noting its limits. Ultimately, certainty reliability is a more pressing limit than overall accuracy under noisy conditions.

AI.tldr: 扩散语言模型在处理包含噪声的输入时，虽然能够内部检测文本错误，但对外表现出的置信度却不准确，导致排序能力下降，这被称为“表征置信度缺口”。该文提出了一种无侵入性方法，能利用隐藏状态信息改善排序性能。
AI.motivation: 标准语言模型在处理噪声输入时表现不佳，而扩散模型因其利用更广上下文，被假设或许能更好地应对这些噪声。作者希望系统性研究扩散模型在噪声环境下内部和外部置信表现的分歧及其影响。
AI.method: 通过实验证明扩散模型虽然可以高精度检测输入文本错误，但其外部置信度反映不出实际的不确定性，关键指标为准确率下降而置信度却保持高位。论文同时测试了重新标定、训练匹配、输入级错误信号等传统优化方法，均未能解决最终答案排序能力下降的问题。随后设计了一种简单的隐藏状态信号提取工具，无需额外训练或文本生成步骤来提升排名。
AI.result: 实验证明，尽管常规调整技术无法恢复排序能力，但隐藏状态中仍然保留了排序信息，利用该信息可有效提升排序表现。该方法无需对基础模型进行微调，且效率高。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型对噪声的内部识别能力与其外部表现出的高置信度之间存在显著脱节，这种置信度失真成为模型在噪声下更大的限制因素。尽管可以利用隐藏信息部分弥补排序损失，但可靠的置信度输出仍待突破。

title: PEEL: Parallel Extraction for Long-Horizon Disassembly Planning via Scale-Invariant Sampling
comment: 15 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://peel-disassembly.surge.sh/
summary: Long-horizon multi-part object disassembly requires robots to compute feasible sequences of collision-free removal motions, even in the presence of tight, narrow escape corridors. To efficiently solve such disassembly problems, we propose Parallel Extraction for Long-Horizon Disassembly (PEEL), an algorithm which efficiently computes disassembly motions for object assemblies and feeds them to a robot manipulator for execution. PEEL uses sampling-based motion planning to compute single-object motions through the use of a scale-invariant sampling scheme, where the object scale is estimated in a burn-in phase and a subsequent directional sampler exploits the scale. This sampling scheme is integrated into a multi-arm bandit rapidly-exploring random tree (MAB-RRT) planner, which switches between different samplers depending on the reward signal received. Using MAB-RRT, the PEEL algorithm runs a batch of planners in parallel to obtain an ordered graph specifying the sequence in which object parts have to be removed. We show that MAB-RRT can efficiently solve single-part disassemblies with 100 percent success rate on 76 assemblies, and that it is robust to its parameters. By integrating MAB-RRT into PEEL, we solve four long-horizon disassembly problems using the Fetch manipulator robot involving 10 to 17 individual object parts.

AI.tldr: PEEL算法通过并行规划高效解决多部件长时间拆卸问题，能指导机器人将多部件安全有序地拆分。
AI.motivation: 长时间、多部件的物体拆卸任务对机器人路径规划提出了较高要求，尤其在存在狭窄出口路径时，碰撞规避和高效拆卸序列的计算变得复杂。需要新的算法提高求解效率及成功率。
AI.method: 提出了PEEL算法，融合了缩放不变采样方案用于单物体动作采样，并集成到多臂赌博机RRT（MAB-RRT）规划器中。MAB-RRT在多个采样器间根据奖励信号动态切换，并在并行批量的RRT中高效搜索部件移除序列。
AI.result: MAB-RRT在76组装任务中的单部件拆卸实验中成功率达100%，且对参数不敏感。PEEL算法集成后，在Fetch机械臂上高效完成了4个包含10到17个部件的长时间拆卸任务。
AI.conclusion: PEEL算法能在复杂、多部件场景中高效规划机器人拆卸动作，提升了自动化拆卸的可行性和鲁棒性。

title: XClipGS: Exact Half-Space Clipping for Medical Volume Gaussian Splatting
summary: Gaussian-splatting proxies enable interactive rendering of volumetric medical scans, but a clipping plane exposes anatomy not constrained by external-view training and intersects primitives that conventional splatting can only keep or drop whole. We present XClipGS (eXact Clipping), which treats these as two separate problems: the render-time clip operator and supervision of the hidden interior. Under the local affine model used by EWA splatting, the ray integral of a half-space-restricted Gaussian factorizes exactly into its ordinary 2D footprint and a conditional Gaussian CDF whose argument is affine in pixel coordinates. The resulting closed-form per-pixel operator introduces no learned clipping parameters or auxiliary network and remains differentiable with respect to the primitive and plane. We use multi-distance reference views with varied clipping-plane axes and offsets to supervise the interior through the same operator. We also introduce a paired clipped/unclipped cut-face protocol with difference-referenced cut error (CDE) and culled-side leakage (Leak), because global image metrics dilute errors near the plane. On eight CT and MRI volumes with plane offsets not used for training, XClipGS attains the highest PSNR on every volume (33.56 versus 32.34 dB for ClipGS) while rendering at over 650 FPS, far above real time, versus 278 FPS. On voxel-axis cut-face views, it raises average band SSIM from 0.809 to 0.860 and leaks roughly 40 times less. Without retraining, it also achieves the best average across all four metrics on arbitrary-normal planes; on a fixed interior, it matches RaRa's face fidelity with about 16 times less leakage. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/XClipGS/

AI.tldr: XClipGS提出了一种针对体数据渲染剪切的新方法，结合精确的数学建模和特殊的监督协议，实现了更高质量、更高效率的医学影像切面可视化。
AI.motivation: 目前基于高斯点代理的方法在医学体数据交互式渲染中表现良好，但剪切平面暴露的内部结构既缺乏训练约束，也难以精确剪切，现有方法难以兼顾精度、速度和差异化监督。
AI.method: 将剪切过程分为渲染时的精确剪切算子与针对内部结构的多视角差异化监督，数学上利用EWA高斯点在半空间中的闭式光线积分表达，开发了不含附加网络和学习参数的可微分剪切算子。同时引入成对切面/未切面误差与泄露量新度量指标。
AI.result: 在八个CT/MRI体数据集上，XClipGS在未见过的剪切位置上获得最高PSNR（33.56 dB），运行速度大幅领先（650+FPS），切面SSIM与泄漏量显著优于基线方法，无需重训练下在任意法向切面和固定内部均刷新四项指标表现。
AI.conclusion: XClipGS实现了无需增加模型复杂度的高效精确剪切医学体数据渲染，切面质量和速度均大幅领先，为体绘制与医学影像分析提供了有力工具。

title: Evidence-Calibrated Runtime Reconstruction for Agent Skills Across Heterogeneous Coding Agents
comment: 17 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Submitted to PROFES 2026. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/hellogxp/skill-runtime-intelligence
summary:
Agent Skills package reusable instructions and assets for tool-using language-model agents. Progressive loading creates failure boundaries poorly represented by session-, model-, or tool-centric traces: a Skill can be discovered but not activated, activated without instructions, or appear successful without an independently verified outcome. We present Skill Runtime Intelligence, a passive runtime-intelligence system that reconstructs supported Skill-lifecycle stages across heterogeneous harnesses while preserving unsupported stages as unknown. Its Run Panorama separates immutable events, deterministic relations, inferred diagnoses, and controlled outcomes with four evidence grades; optional trace import and OTLP/HTTP export support existing observability deployments.
  Across six frozen repository profiles, three coding agents, and seven clean or fault-injected conditions, all 126 executions preserve source worktrees and each correlates to exactly one source session. Yet adapters expose three distinct semantics: no Skill runs; complete runs but no failure-like events; or failure-like events in every operational-failure and clean session. In a seven-template diagnostic study, semantic aliases and Panorama localize the same six non-clean boundaries but differ in exact/status behavior; both Raw views emit a failure status on all 18 clean cases, while Panorama emits none. A known-rule graph conforms to 126/126 frozen contracts, whereas a second model completes only 228/378 calls. These observations motivate executable adapter qualification and show that event presence is not boundary fidelity, composite exact scores mask distinct errors, and model explanations must not overwrite deterministic facts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Skill Runtime Intelligence（SRI）系统，用于追踪和分析大语言模型（LLM）代理在调用技能包过程中跨多种环境的表现与失败边界。该系统重建技能生命周期状态，提升可观测性，并通过定量实验验证了区分边界与故障类型的能力。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM代理越来越依赖可复用技能包（Skill）来与外部工具或资产交互，精细地跟踪和分析这些技能包的加载与执行过程中的各种失败边界变得重要。传统会话、模型或工具为中心的追踪方式难以反映Skill在发现、激活、执行等具体生命周期阶段的复杂表现，亟需更细粒度、通用化的观测方法。
AI.method: 提出Skill Runtime Intelligence系统，对技能包执行的生命周期进行“被动”重建，不同于直接依赖模型输出，通过收集和区分不可变事件、确定性关系、推理诊断及受控结果，分四级证据归纳并输出各类边界。同时支持可选的trace导入及OTLP/HTTP导出，易与现有观测系统集成；在六组冻结代码库、三种编码代理、七种清洁或故障注入条件下，系统对全部126次执行全过程进行了分析对比。
AI.result: 适配器展现出三种不同工作语义：1) 无Skill运行；2) 完整运行但无故障事件；3) 所有情况均报告为故障。而不同诊断模板和视图对失败边界的定位各异，有的全部标记失败，有的全部不标记。已知规则图全部符合同步合同，另一模型仅部分完成调用。
AI.conclusion: 事件存在本身并不能准确反映技能边界的表现，得分合并会掩盖关键错误，模型解释不应覆盖确定性事实。该工作推动了Skill适配器可执行资格认证，对技能型LLM代理的观测与评价具有重要启示。

title: SG-WAM: Text-Grounded and Spatial-aware Semantic Guidance for World-Action Models
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation. However, most existing WAMs generate future videos and actions by relying mainly on visual cues rather than language instructions, since off-the-shelf text encoders embed instructions independently of visual observations. As a result, the videos predicted by these WAMs are often semantically misaligned with their corresponding language instructions, which degrades the accuracy of the predicted actions. To overcome this limitation, we propose SG-WAM, a semantic guidance method for world-action models that leverages a vision-language model (VLM) as a semantic planner to enhance the instruction-grounding capacity of world-action models. Specifically, we train a VLM-based planner to predict text-grounded and spatial-aware semantic foresight. The text-grounded semantic foresight grounds the instruction by identifying the correct target objects, and the spatial-aware semantic foresight provides the scene geometry for precise manipulation. We then inject this foresight into the world-action model as high-level semantic guidance, ensuring that both future-video generation and action prediction faithfully follow the language instruction. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate the superiority of our semantic guidance method, showcasing precise manipulation and strong instruction-following capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）作为语义规划器的世界-动作模型（SG-WAM），获得更强的指令理解和执行能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界-动作模型（WAMs）在机器人操作任务中主要依赖视觉信息，对语言指令理解不足，导致未来视频和动作与指令语义不对齐，从而影响操作准确性。
AI.method: 提出SG-WAM方法，将视觉-语言模型（VLM）作为语义规划器，训练其生成文本感知和空间感知的语义前瞻，分别用于识别目标对象和描述场景几何。将这些语义前瞻作为高阶语义指导信息注入世界-动作模型，指导其视频生成和动作预测遵循语言指令。
AI.result: 通过大量仿真和真实环境实验验证，SG-WAM相比传统方法展现出更精准的操作表现和更强的指令跟随能力。
AI.conclusion: SG-WAM有效提升了世界-动作模型基于指令的语义对齐和执行能力，对未来机器人操作系统的发展具有重要意义。

title: DINO-3DRA: Leveraging 2D Foundation Model Semantics for 3D Cerebral Aneurysm Segmentation
summary: Accurate aneurysm segmentation in 3D rotational angiography (3DRA) is hindered by extreme class imbalance, morphological similarity to vessels, and absent large-scale 3D pretraining. 2D vision foundation models encode dense structural priors from 1.7 billion images, yet naïve slice-wise transfer fragments anatomical continuity and destabilises optimisation. We propose DINO-3DRA, a dual-path framework achieving effective cross-dimensional semantic transfer by injecting frozen DINOv3 features into a 3D U-Net backbone via Room-Lite spatial mixing and calibrated residual fusion. On multi-centre 3DRA data, DINO-3DRA achieves state-of-the-art aneurysm segmentation (Dice: 0.758; HD95: 2.75 mm; +13% over nnU-Net) with only 5.72M trainable parameters. Ablation studies confirm that gains arise from structured cross-dimensional transfer rather than loss design alone, with bridged foundation features improving anatomical continuity between aneurysms and parent vessels. Without fine-tuning on CADA and SHINY-ICARUS, DINO-3DRA eliminates all catastrophic failure cases observed in baseline architectures, demonstrating robust generalisation across heterogeneous imaging protocols.

AI.tldr: 提出了DINO-3DRA框架，通过结合2D视觉基础模型DINOv3与3D U-Net，实现更精准的3DRA脑动脉瘤分割，并在多中心数据集上获得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有3DRA动脉瘤分割受极端样本不均衡、与血管形态相似、缺乏大规模3D预训练等限制，导致分割效果不佳。2D视觉模型虽蕴含丰富结构先验，但直接在切片上传递会破坏三维连续性，因此亟需实现有效的跨维特征迁移。
AI.method: 设计了DINO-3DRA双路径架构，将冻结的DINOv3特征通过Room-Lite空间混合和残差融合注入3D U-Net骨干，实现跨维结构信息转移，并用仅572万训练参数在3DRA上训练。
AI.result: 在多中心3DRA数据集上，DINO-3DRA取得Dice 0.758、HD95为2.75mm，比nnU-Net提升13%。消融实验表明性能提升源于结构化的跨维迁移。无需在CADA和SHINY-ICARUS等外部集上微调即可消除基础模型的严重失败案例。
AI.conclusion: DINO-3DRA有效提升了3DRA动脉瘤分割精度，提升了解剖连续性和泛化能力，为异构成像协议下的鲁棒分割提供新思路。

title: Instability of LLM Pre-Pretraining: It Doesn't Always Help. An Investigation on Multiple Languages
summary: Pretraining LLMs on artificial languages ("pre-pretraining") is a technique that could reportedly increase token efficiency by 33%, i.e., save up to 33% of training tokens needed to reach a certain performance. We validate this prior result for English on a larger set of natural languages across four language families, using two different tokenizers and varying model sizes. We also relate the observed gains (or losses) in token efficiency to quantified linguistic properties of the languages, such as sentence length, morphological richness, and features of dependency syntactic trees (tree depth, number of children, number of crossing dependencies). Our empirical results indicate that the reported gains depend heavily on the experiment setup and the choice of random seed, although we can confirm the trend of stable gains with 128-Dyck pretraining of small models with the Llama tokenizer for most of the examined languages. On a general note, we argue that multiple training runs should be carried out at least for a subset of experiments to avoid the community adopting unstable approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文验证了在大型语言模型（LLM）预训练中使用人工语言进行“预预训练”是否可提升令牌效率，结果发现收益依赖于实验设置和随机种子，并建议关键实验应多次重复以保证结果稳定。
AI.motivation: 此前有研究声称，先用人工语言预训练LLM能提高令牌效率（token efficiency），即减少训练所需令牌数约33%。本文旨在验证该方法在不同自然语言和实验条件下的通用性与效果。
AI.method: 作者在多种规模的模型、两种不同的分词器，以及来自四个语言家族的多种自然语言上，复现并扩展了之前的实验。他们还将令牌效率的变化与语言的句长、形态复杂性、句法依存树等特征进行相关分析。
AI.result: 实验证明，虽然少数组合（如Llama分词器下的小模型用128-Dyck人工语言预训练）能稳定获得提升，在大多数情况下提升效果高度依赖于实验设置与随机种子。
AI.conclusion: 预预训练能带来提升，但其不确定性较高。为提升研究的可靠性，建议关键实验需多次重复，以避免社区采纳不稳定的研究方案。

title: Hierarchical Topology-Aware Planning and Control of Underwater Vehicle-Manipulator Systems in Confined Environments
summary: This paper addresses autonomous intervention with an underwater vehicle--manipulator system (UVMS) in confined, cluttered, and partially known environments, where poor maneuverability, narrow passages, and uncertain execution may cause the robot to enter unrecoverable regions. We propose MANTA, a three-layer hierarchical planning-and-control framework that couples passage accessibility, manipulation feasibility, and closed-loop execution. The first layer performs global connectivity reasoning in a conservative reduced base space to extract traversable corridor candidates toward the task region. The second layer refines each candidate corridor by jointly optimizing the continuous base motion and arm trajectory, producing a collision-free base--arm trajectory. The third layer learns a reach-and-hold base policy using Gaussian-process model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) through MC-PILCO, enabling trajectory tracking and station keeping at the planned manipulation state. During execution, the framework monitors map updates and can trigger recovery and route repair when the active passage becomes infeasible. MANTA is evaluated in confined UVMS planning and closed-loop tracking experiments. Across 120 matched planning queries, it achieves higher task success than full-state sampling-based baselines while producing larger clearance margins and lower arm motion. The learned MC-PILCO policy further reduces position and yaw tracking errors on both training and unseen tube-like references. These results show MANTA as a structured and data-efficient framework for safe autonomous underwater intervention in caves, tubes, and cluttered subsea structures.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为MANTA的分层规划与控制框架，实现了水下机器人在复杂、狭窄环境下的高效自主操作，并在实验中优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 水下机器人在狭窄或杂乱环境中的自主干预任务面临机动性差、通道逼仄、环境不完全已知等挑战，传统方法容易导致机器人陷入不可恢复的困境，限制了其实用性。
AI.method: 提出MANTA三层分层结构：第一层在简化空间进行全局通道判断，提取可通过的通道候选；第二层对通道进行基座和机械臂联合优化，实现无碰撞的轨迹生成；第三层采用基于高斯过程的强化学习（MC-PILCO），训练基座跟踪保持策略，提升轨迹跟踪与定点保持能力；并可在执行中根据地图更新实现恢复与路径修复。
AI.result: 在120组规划实验中，MANTA相比全状态采样基线方法，任务成功率更高，轨迹宽裕度更大、机械臂运动幅度更小；在跟踪实验中，所学策略进一步降低了位置和偏航误差。
AI.conclusion: MANTA实现了高结构性和数据效率的水下自主操作，为洞穴、管道及复杂海底干预任务提供了更加安全可靠的解决方案。

title: SeqLoc: Beyond the Single Frame for Cross-View Geo-Localization in Feature-Sparse Scenes
summary: Cross-View Geo-Localization (CVGL) with OpenStreetMap (OSM) performs well in structure-rich urban environments but collapses in feature-sparse scenes such as rural roads. To study this failure mode, in this work, we introduce CV-FSS, a benchmark that pairs sequential panoramas from five rural regions with aligned OSM maps, on which single-frame methods degrade drastically. We then propose SeqLoc, an online test-time sequence aggregation mechanism that recursively maintains a log-belief volume with three key components: (1) Entropy-Tempered Uncertainty (ETU) tempers each incoming pose likelihood volume by its normalized entropy; (2) Map-Guided Relocalization (MGR) mixes a map-shaped recovery distribution into the belief so that a suppressed true pose can recover; (3) Peak-Anchored Smoothing (PAS) derives the final pose at sub-grid precision. Extensive experiments on CV-FSS and CV-RHO demonstrate that SeqLoc outperforms single-frame localization by a large margin, improving both position and orientation recall by over 50%. The benchmark and source code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了面向稀疏特征场景（如乡村道路）的跨视角地理定位（CVGL）基准CV-FSS，并设计了一种新颖的序列定位方法SeqLoc，显著提升了定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于OpenStreetMap的CVGL方法在结构丰富的城市环境下表现良好，但在特征稀疏的乡村区域效果较差。本工作为分析并解决该弱点提出了新基准和新方法。
AI.method: 提出CV-FSS数据集，包含五个乡村区域的全景序列及配准OSM地图。提出SeqLoc序列聚合机制，包含：1）基于归一化熵的ETU不确定性加权；2）MGR加入地图引导的重定位以恢复被抑制的真实位姿；3）PAS实现亚格点精度的最终估计。
AI.result: 在CV-FSS和CV-RHO上，SeqLoc相较于单帧定位方法提升了超过50%的定位与方向召回率，显示出明显优势。
AI.conclusion: SeqLoc解决了单帧定位在特征稀疏场景下的显著劣势，并推动了CVGL方法在乡村等复杂环境的应用与研究，相关数据集与代码将公开，有助于后续研究。

title: IDRAAK: From Multi-Agent NLP to Few-Shot Prompting for Semantic Drift Detection in Technical Requirements
summary: Translating technical requirements across languages can introduce semantic drift, altering numerical constraints, polarities, modalities, or other specification-critical meaning. IDRAAK is presented as an interpretable framework for detecting such drift using a language-independent Semantic Requirement Representation (SRR), with six detection workflows evaluated, ranging from deterministic comparison to multi-agent verification and few-shot prompting. On 890 synthetic perturbations across 300 requirements from 10 engineering domains, a single LLM call with six few-shot examples achieves MCC=0.888 and F1=0.983, outperforming the evaluated structured and multi-stage alternatives. Further evaluation on PAWS-X (805 pairs, 5 languages) and XNLI (700 pairs, 7 languages) exposes complementary strengths and limitations of structured and LLM-based approaches. Deterministic SRR comparison performs strongly on technical requirements (F1=0.898) but poorly on general-domain text (F1=0.012), while structured evidence improves performance on adversarial paraphrases. Post-hoc Platt scaling further improves confidence calibration. The results demonstrate that increased agentic complexity does not necessarily improve semantic-drift detection and that simple few-shot prompting can provide a strong and efficient alternative.

AI.tldr: IDRAAK框架利用语义需求表示(SRR)检测跨语言技术需求翻译中的语义漂移，多种检测方法中，简单的few-shot LLM方法表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 技术需求在跨语言翻译中容易发生语义漂移，影响数字约束、极性和其他关键信息，亟需有效检测漂移的方法，保障需求准确传递。
AI.method: 提出IDRAAK框架，通过与语言无关的SRR表示对需求进行语义建模，评估了六种检测流程，包括确定性比较、多智能体验证和few-shot提示等，并在多个数据集与结构化、LLM等方法对比。
AI.result: 在10个工程领域共300条需求的890个人工扰动上，基于few-shot LLM的单步调用（6个示例）取得MCC=0.888、F1=0.983，优于多阶段和结构化方法。结构化SRR比较在技术文本上F1=0.898，但在通用文本上仅0.012。现场标定（Platt scaling）可进一步提升置信度校准。
AI.conclusion: 复杂检测流程未必优于简单few-shot方法。对于跨语言技术需求，少样本大模型提示高效且强大，结构化证据适用于对抗性文本。

title: SHRIMP: Iterative Refinement of Robot Task Plans
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures, The 39th Annual ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology (UIST '26)
summary: As collaborative robots have entered domains such as manufacturing, agriculture, and healthcare, programming or adapting robot behavior typically requires robotic expertise that most end users lack. Natural language lowers this barrier. Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have made it feasible to translate natural language into robot task plans. However, language-based task specification suffers from semantic ambiguity, and generative models lack transparency for how language instructions become robot actions, making it difficult for users to validate the plan before execution. To address these issues, we introduce SHRIMP, a system that allows users to automatically generate a hierarchical robot primitive plan using natural language and iteratively revise their plan through re-prompting and explicit correction. At each revision, SHRIMP allows users to validate their plan in simulation, and once satisfied, execute it on the physical robot. Through a user study involving participants planning tabletop kitchen tasks (n=35), we validate that SHRIMP improves perceived control and enhances robot transparency. System videos and source code are available at https://wisc-hci.github.io/SHRIMP.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了SHRIMP系统，使用户能够通过自然语言生成并逐步修正机器人任务计划，并在仿真与实物中验证，提升了用户对机器人的控制感和透明度。
AI.motivation: 当前协作机器人在工业、农业和医疗等领域广泛应用，但大多数终端用户缺乏机器人专业知识，难以编程或调整机器人行为。尽管大语言模型能将自然语言转化为任务计划，但存在语义歧义和不透明等问题，用户难以在执行前确认计划正确性。
AI.method: 提出SHRIMP系统，允许用户用自然语言生成分层的机器人基础任务计划，并通过重新输入提示或显式修正进行迭代修改。每步修改后，用户可在仿真中验证计划，满意后可在真实机器人上执行。
AI.result: 通过桌面厨房任务的用户实验（n=35），研究验证了SHRIMP系统能提升用户感知的控制力与机器人决策的透明度。
AI.conclusion: SHRIMP有效降低了用户控制和适应协作机器人行为的门槛，增强了任务计划的可验证性和用户对机器人的信任感。

title: IRPol-Fuse: Energy-structure coordination for infrared polarization fusion under low visibility
summary: Robust perception under low-visibility conditions requires fused imagery that jointly preserves infrared thermal saliency and polarization-derived structural details. However, existing infrared-polarization image fusion (IPIF) methods often overemphasize dominant infrared responses, causing weak yet informative polarization textures in dark regions to be suppressed. To address this issue, we propose IRPol-Fuse, an energy-structure coordinated IPIF framework for challenging low-visibility scenarios. The proposed framework contains three key modules: Polarization Attention Fusion for adaptive infrared-polarization allocation, Infrared Highlight Injector for highlight-guided infrared preservation, and Polarization Texture Injector for polarization texture restoration and fine-detail recovery. We further construct LI-PI, a dedicated infrared-polarization evaluation dataset for low-visibility and visually concealed scenes. Experiments on LI-PI and the public LDDRS dataset demonstrate that IRPol-Fuse achieves favorable performance in thermal target preservation, structural detail recovery, and visual naturalness. Region-aware evaluation and downstream object detection further verify that the proposed energy-structure coordination strategy effectively preserves both infrared target saliency and polarization-derived structural information. Code is available at https://github.com/1hzf/IRPolar-Fuse .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为IRPol-Fuse的红外-偏振图像融合框架，专注于在低可见度下保留红外目标和偏振结构细节。
AI.motivation: 现有的红外-偏振图像融合方法容易忽略暗区中的偏振细节，导致重要结构被淹没，影响低能见度环境下的目标感知。
AI.method: IRPol-Fuse框架包含三大模块：偏振注意力融合（自适应分配红外与偏振信息）、红外高亮注入（增强红外高亮区）、偏振纹理注入（恢复偏振细节），并构建了针对低可见度的新评测数据集LI-PI。
AI.result: 实验证明IRPol-Fuse在自建LI-PI和公开LDDRS数据集上，在热成像目标保留、结构细节恢复和视觉自然性等方面表现优越。区域感知评估及下游目标检测也验证了其能有效协调红外与偏振信息。
AI.conclusion: IRPol-Fuse方案能有效兼顾目标热成像突显与结构细节保护，为低能见度下的目标感知提供了强有力的技术支撑。

title: Tevatron-Elastic: A Unified Abstraction for Training Elastic Retrievers and Rerankers
summary: A single model scale challenges the flexibility of a production retrieval system: some settings need it faster, others need a smaller index, and the right trade-off changes with the workload. In the context of information retrieval (IR), a transformer-based model can be made smaller in three ways---using fewer layers, passing fewer tokens through the upper layers, or producing a shorter embedding---and each way saves a different compute resource. These options have been studied one at a time, each as its own method with its own code and training setup, which makes them hard to combine or adapt to a new model. We present~\ours to bring all three under one simple abstraction: a single object names any size the model can run at, and a short schedule lists the sizes to train. Training then produces one checkpoint that serves all of those sizes, and at deployment the user picks any of them. The same abstraction covers both retrievers and rerankers and both encoder and decoder models, as it works through interfaces that Hugging Face transformers already expose; a new backbone is a configuration change, not new modeling code. Prior methods---Matryoshka embeddings, early exit, 2D~Matryoshka (e.g., Starbucks), and layerwise token compression---become special cases of our unified abstraction. The same interface also enables Matryoshka~LTC (MLTC), which jointly trains several token-compression ratios in one retriever checkpoint. To validate our framework, we train 20 checkpoints across three backbones and two tasks: the quality curves are smooth, one checkpoint costs little over a model trained for a single size, and a controlled study confirms the wallclock speedups. We release the framework and all checkpoints as a resource for building elastic retrieval systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一抽象的方法，可以灵活调整transformer模型在信息检索中的规模，同时兼容索引空间和速度等多种需求，仅需一次训练即可支持多种模型规模。此方法将原本分散的模型缩小技术整合为统一接口，便于实际系统按需切换并部署。
AI.motivation: 当前实际应用中的检索系统对模型大小和推理速度有不同要求，而传统方法针对减少层数、token数或嵌入维度分别提出单一优化，对应各自独立训练和代码实现，难以统一、灵活地适配新的需求或模型架构。亟需一种通用方法高效管理和部署多规格、可弹性调整的检索模型。
AI.method: 作者提出一种新的框架，把减少层数、token数和嵌入长度三种模型瘦身方式统一到一个抽象接口下。用户通过指定模型可运行的所有尺寸及训练计划即可，一次训练产出能够覆盖多种尺寸的通用checkpoint，部署时按需求选择。此抽象通过huggingface已公开接口运作，适配retriever/reranker与encoder/decoder模型，无需新增专门代码。原有分散方法皆为该接口的特例。
AI.result: 作者在三个主流backbone、两大任务共20组实验中验证了方法有效性：一份训练checkpoint几乎无性能损失即可覆盖多尺寸需求，推理质量变化平滑；与传统专一尺寸训练相比训练开销很小，推理速度显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为构建弹性、资源高效的信息检索系统提供了实用框架和工具，支持系统快速适配不同工作负载和资源约束。作者开放全部代码与checkpoint，推动可调检索模型的研究和落地应用。

title: Estimation of Spacecraft Inertia Tensor Using Attitude-Only Data from Torque-Free Motion
summary: We present an attitude-only framework for estimating a spacecraft's normalized inertia tensor from torque-free rotational motion. Our method supports both continuous single-arc observations and the joint use of multiple short torque-free arcs, while requiring neither gyroscope measurements nor known control torques. A Karush-Kuhn-Tucker formulation provides a fast linear initialization, which is refined by nonlinear shooting using the exact Jacobi-elliptic solution of Euler's equations and a Magnus-expansion quaternion map. Under controlled attitude noise, tests using a single 500-second arc reduced inertia-tensor error by approximately one order of magnitude relative to an Extended Kalman Filter initialized from the same estimate, while requiring nearly two orders of magnitude less computation. Joint estimation from three 100-second arcs provided a similar improvement in accuracy and remained more than one order of magnitude faster. Photorealistic proximity-operations simulations further evaluated both strategies using monocular image-derived attitudes. The 2000-second single-arc cases achieved sub-thousandth median inertia-tensor error and supported 10-hour attitude predictions with single-digit-degree median error. In three-arc cases using 30-300 seconds per arc, our method consistently outperformed the EKF refinement, with performance governed by rotational excitation and temporal sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种仅利用姿态测量、在无力矩自转状态下估计航天器归一化惯性张量的新方法，无需陀螺仪或已知控制力矩；与传统扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）相比，精度与效率均大幅提升。
AI.motivation: 现有惯性张量估计多依赖于陀螺仪数据或已知力矩，受限于仪器精度和操作复杂性。实际任务中，获取高精度、低成本估计方法非常重要，尤其是在资源受限或任务特殊的航天应用。
AI.method: 该方法通过Karush-Kuhn-Tucker（KKT）线性初始化，再结合Euler方程的Jacobi-elliptic精确解与Magnus展开方法进行非线性优化。支持单段或多段无力矩自转姿态观测，无需陀螺仪和控制力矩信息，并适用于基于视觉的单目姿态输入。
AI.result: 在模拟数据中，单次500秒弧段测试惯性张量估计误差较同起点EKF降低约一个数量级，计算量更低两个数量级。三段100秒弧段联合估计同样大幅提升精度与效率。真实场景下2000秒单弧段达到小于千分之一的惯性张量误差，并支持10小时姿态预测，误差仅为个位数度。
AI.conclusion: 所提姿态唯一方法在无陀螺仪、无力矩测量条件下可靠高效地估计航天器惯性张量，精度与计算效率均优于传统方法，适用于视觉导航等多场景。

title: Distilling CT Foundation Models into Editable Concept Bottlenecks for Lung Nodule Malignancy Prediction
comment: Submitted to SPIE Medical Imaging 2027 conference
summary: Foundation models provide transferable CT representations, but predictions based directly on these embeddings are difficult to interpret. We developed concept bottleneck models that map two frozen CT foundation-model representations to eight radiologist-defined pulmonary-nodule attributes and predict malignancy from the estimated concepts and nodule size. The models included CT-FM, a whole-CT self-supervised encoder using a 96^3-voxel nodule-centered patch, and FMCIB, a nodule-focused contrastive encoder using a 50-mm crop. Eight ridge-regression concept heads were trained on 2,610 LIDC-IDRI nodules. Malignancy models were trained on LUNA25 and evaluated on a held-out internal test set and the external DLCS cohort. Concept fidelity was assessed using five-fold cross-validated R^2, and malignancy discrimination was assessed using AUROC with 95% confidence intervals estimated by patient-grouped bootstrap resampling. Concept fidelity was modest but higher for FMCIB than CT-FM for subtlety (R2, 0.24 vs. 0.11), spiculation (0.17 vs. 0.08), texture (0.17 vs. 0.07), and lobulation (0.15 vs. 0.05). Internally, the CT-FM and FMCIB concept+size models achieved AUROCs of 0.86 (95% CI, 0.80-0.92) and 0.86 (0.79-0.92), respectively. Externally, AUROCs were 0.72 (0.68-0.75) and 0.73 (0.70-0.76), compared with 0.73 for nodule size alone and 0.60 and 0.67 for the corresponding embedding only probes. Additive predictions could be decomposed into feature-level contributions and modified through controlled concept interventions. Concept bottlenecks provided transparent malignancy predictions with discrimination similar to nodule size alone, while differences in concept fidelity suggest that concept recovery depends on the underlying foundation-model representation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于概念瓶颈的模型，实现了对CT基础模型表示的可解释恶性肿块预测，在多个数据集上表现与传统特征相当，且能进行特征级分解和干预。
AI.motivation: 尽管CT基础模型可以生成可迁移的特征表示，但这些表示直接用于预测时，缺乏可解释性，限制了其在医学影像分析领域（如肺结节恶性预测）的临床应用。作者希望通过引入中间人类定义的影像学特征（如结节的细度、纹理等）实现更透明的决策过程。
AI.method: 作者基于两种冻权重CT基础模型（CT-FM和FMCIB），通过ridge回归预测8个人工定义的结节特征，并进一步结合结构大小预测恶性的概率。模型在多个公开/外部数据集中验证，用R^2衡量中间概念拟合程度，用AUROC及其置信区间衡量对恶性的区分效果。此外，分析了模型对特征的可分解性和可控性。
AI.result: FMCIB模型在部分特征（如细度、分叶、纹理和毛刺）上的概念拟合优于CT-FM。结合结节大小后的恶性预测在内部集AUROC为0.86，外部集为0.72-0.73，与单用结节大小的表现相当，且显著优于直接用embedding预测。
AI.conclusion: 概念瓶颈模型实现了对良恶性预测的透明化，可将模型输出拆解到医学可读特征。不同基础模型对概念恢复能力有差异，说明基础表征对下游可解释性影响较大，提出了实现实际可解释AI应用的新途径。

title: Deployable Per-Instance Multi-Layer Activation Steering for Large Language Models
comment: 43 pages, 24 figures, 30 tables. Under review at ACL Rolling Review (August 2026)
summary: Activation steering edits the behaviour of a frozen language model by adding a learned vector to its residual stream, and current practice fixes the injection layers globally per task. We argue that the best layers are an instance-level decision, and we make per-instance, multi-layer selection both well understood and deployable. On two open-weight 8B models and six binary persona traits, a per-instance oracle over layer subsets shows that the best layers vary from one input to the next: on most trait-model pairs, no fixed global layer set recovers the per-instance benefit. A greedy rule that ranks layers by single-layer marginal effect recovers nearly all of the oracle's benefit, but both must score candidate layers against the gold answer, so neither can run at deployment; the rule instead becomes the target a prompt-only predictor is trained to reproduce. Our deployable recipe needs no label at inference: a per-instance layer ranker read off the prompt embedding, a classifier that infers the steering direction, and an adaptive gate that scores short steered passes against that inferred direction and steers no more layers than necessary. The recipe recovers most of the oracle's lift (the bulk on the stronger model, a clear majority on the harder one), never drives any trait-model pair below its unsteered alignment baseline on average, and largely avoids the fluency collapse that strong global selection incurs at higher layer counts. A mechanistic account, "direction over magnitude", explains the behavioural flip under a mis-directed global set, the output collapse from steering too many layers, and the ceiling of unsteerable inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，一种“按实例自适应多层激活注入”的方法，能更有效地利用激活steering提升大语言模型的个性化行为编辑能力，且在不破坏流畅性的前提下实现可部署。
AI.motivation: 现有激活steering方法通常在任务级固定注入层，但不同输入实例最优的注入层并不相同。为了获得最大化编辑效果，同时保证部署时的可用性和推理效率，亟需探索实例级、动态的层选择策略。
AI.method: 作者首先通过oracle和贪婪单层边际增益法，实证证明单一固定的注入层无法适配所有输入。然后设计了一套可部署机制：用prompt embedding预测实例最佳注入层排序，用分类器推断steering方向，并通过adaptive gate自适应调整注入层数，无需标签即可推理。
AI.result: 新方法在两个开放权重8B模型和六种人设二元属性任务上，能恢复大部分oracle增益效果，显著超越固定全局注入层，并大幅减少高层注入导致的流畅性崩溃问题。
AI.conclusion: 实例级多层自适应激活steering方案提升了大模型编辑能力且可真正部署，还揭示了单一方向/过多层注入导致行为异常或无效的机制解释。

title: From Operational Design Domain to Action: A Systematic Behavioral Taxonomy for Autonomous Driving
summary: Operational Design Domain (ODD) specifications describe where an automated driving system (ADS) is permitted to operate, but they do not prescribe what the ADS must demonstrably do once deployed within that domain. This gap between operating condition specification and behavioral validation represents a critical unresolved challenge in ADS safety assurance. This paper presents a structured, standards-grounded taxonomy of 21 behavioral competencies organized across three operational domains-Highway (HWY), Urban (URB), and Hub (HUB)-derived systematically from the PEGASUS six-layer model-based ODD. Each behavior is decomposed along longitudinal and lateral control axes and characterized against a four-property framework: Safety (gap maintenance, conflict avoidance, kinematic stability), Compliance (legal rules and behavioral norms), Comfort (rider dynamics and trust), and Efficiency (mission completion and product-level metrics). We further demonstrate that the crossing of ODD layer parameterizations with behavioral competency specifications yields concrete scenario families suitable for systematic behavioral testing and SOTIF coverage evidence. The taxonomy is grounded in AVSC00008202111, SAE J3237, and SAE J3016, and is validated as an operational specification layer through its deployment in a rule-enforced trajectory optimization system. The Hub domain is identified as a structurally distinct, underspecified domain warranting dedicated research attention.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一个系统的自动驾驶行为能力分类法，用于弥补ODD规范与行为验证之间的安全保障缺口。
AI.motivation: 虽然ODD规范定义了自动驾驶系统（ADS）的允许运行环境，但却没有规定ADS在其运行域内应具备哪些具体操作行为，这造成了自动驾驶安全验证的重要难题。
AI.method: 作者基于PEGASUS六层ODD模型系统性提出了21个行为能力，并划分在高速公路、城市和枢纽三大操作域中，每项能力沿纵向与横向控制轴细化，并用安全、合规、舒适、效率四大属性描述。进一步将ODD层级参数与行为能力结合，生成可系统化行为测试的场景集。该分类体系结合了多项行业标准（如AVSC00008202111、SAE J3237、SAE J3016），并通过实际部署在轨迹优化系统中进行了验证。
AI.result: 提出了适用于系统化行为测试和SOTIF（安全运行意图功能）覆盖的场景族。枢纽域被认为是结构独特且规范不足的领域，需要进一步研究。
AI.conclusion: 文中分类体系有效填补了自动驾驶行为验证领域的空白，对提升ADS的安全验证水平具有实际意义，特别是为枢纽域的未来研究指明了方向。

title: How Much Does It Cost to Answer My Question? Benchmarking Cloud VLM-based VQA Systems
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are becoming a practical backend for mobile visual question answering (VQA) systems, enabling smartphones and smart glasses to answer users' questions about the physical world. Since modern VLMs remain difficult to run on mobile and edge devices, VQA systems increasingly offload inference to cloud-based VLMs. This gives mobile devices access to stronger computation, but it also makes visual input preparation a key system variable: how the image is prepared before offloading affects not only answer quality but also payload size, token cost, and system latency. Proprietary APIs expose little control over model internals or serving behavior, leaving client-side preprocessing as the main practical optimization space for downstream developers. Many such techniques have been proposed for visual offloading, yet their cost-quality impact on commercial cloud VLMs has never been studied. To fill this gap, we present VQABench, the first systematic benchmark that treats client-side input preprocessing as a controlled variable for cloud-VLM-based VQA. We evaluate 12 preprocessing techniques across three VQA datasets and four commercial VLMs from three providers, totaling 95,168 API calls. Our results show that preprocessing is not universally beneficial: its effectiveness depends on the target model, API paradigm, provider token-accounting rule, and task formulation. A poorly selected preprocessing strategy can increase deployment cost or latency while degrading answer accuracy. Overall, our benchmark clarifies when preprocessing helps, when it fails, and why, providing insights to guide future research and real-world deployment of VQA systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VQABench基准，首次系统性地评估了视觉输入预处理对云视觉语言模型(VLMs)支持的视觉问答(VQA)系统性能与成本的综合影响。
AI.motivation: 随着视觉语言模型在移动视觉问答场景的普及，大多数推理过程需离线至云端执行以减轻移动端负担。但预处理方案众多，并无系统化评估其对云VLM性能、成本、延迟和准确性的综合影响，业界与开发者亦缺乏实用指导。
AI.method: 作者构建VQABench基准，设定视觉输入预处理为自变量，考察12种预处理方法，测试三类VQA数据集和四种来自三大主流供应商的商用VLM，累计调用API 95,168次，量化分析各方案在不同模型、API范式、计费规则及任务背景下的表现。
AI.result: 实验发现，预处理策略并非总能提升系统性能和性价比。其带来的正面或负面影响依赖于不同模型、API、供应商计费规则及具体任务。选错策略反而可使成本与延迟上升且答题准确度下降。
AI.conclusion: 本基准明确了视觉输入预处理何时有效、何时无效及原因，为后续学界研究和真实VQA部署场景提供了重要参考和实操指导。

title: Explicit Boundary Markers for Subword Vocabularies
summary: Subword tokenizers represent many common words twice in space-using writing systems, once with a leading space and once without. The two entries have separate embeddings in models, so occurrences of one word are divided across rows that are trained independently, and the two forms need not even segment the string the same way: " together" may be a single entry while the same word without a preceding space is tokenized as "to|gether". Capitalization divides a word further, into as many as six forms. We introduce an alternative to standard whitespace conventions using an explicit word boundary marker, which prevents such duplication. Words are delimited by the boundary markers, and spaces between words are represented as pairs of such markers. Two shift codes do the same for title case and upper case, allowing one internal representation of a word to be re-used across different settings. Switching to this convention mitigates the duplicate-entry issue, but does not improve tokenization compression: for both vocabulary-learning algorithms, the best marker scheme stays within one percent of the baseline in characters per token, averaged across six languages. It does result in better language modeling performance. Every marker scheme tested downstream reaches lower bits per byte than the baseline, suggesting that duplication carries a cost that compression does not capture.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出用显式词边界标记替代传统的空格分词方式，解决了子词分词器中常见词汇重复的问题，并验证这种方法可以提升下游语言建模的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有子词分词器（subword tokenizer）在以空格为界的分词系统中，会重复表示许多常见词（如同时有带空格前缀和不带空格前缀的词条），且这些不同形式分别训练，导致效率低下和表示碎片化。首字母大写也会进一步分裂词表示，产生多达六种形式。这种重复并未被压缩指标捕捉，却影响模型性能。因此，需要改进分词方式以减少词条重复。
AI.method: 作者提出显式词边界标记法：用专门的标记明确界定单词边界，空格用成对标记表示，大小写通过两个转换码实现，将同一词的不同语境形式映射为统一的内部表示。这种方案杜绝词条重复，且设计了适配主流词表学习算法的标记系统。
AI.result: 在六种语言上的实验显示，使用显式标记的系统在分词压缩（即字符数/每token）方面与基线几乎相同（变化不到1%），但所有测试的词边界方案在下游语言建模中取得了更低的bits per byte，表明重复词条对建模性能有负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 用显式词边界标记代替以空格为界的分词可有效解决词条重复问题，并切实提升语言建模性能。虽然对分词压缩改善有限，但对下游应用具有显著优势。

title: Personalized Lower-limb Exoskeleton Assistance via Preference-based Bayesian Optimization
summary: A significant challenge in exoskeleton robotics is the need to dynamically adapt control profiles to individual motion preferences, thereby ensuring both efficient and comfortable assistance. Currently, since user experience can serve as a comprehensive metric for evaluating the effectiveness of assistance, user preference-based optimization methods have been widely studied for parameter tuning. However, the existing methods rely heavily on extensive human-robot online interactions and suffer from slow optimization speed, which not only induces user fatigue but also compromises optimization effectiveness. Therefore, this paper aims to explore an efficient preference-based optimization framework for personalized exoskeleton assistance that can learn optimal parameters with minimal interaction. We propose a preference-based Bayesian optimization (PbBO) approach that can improve sample efficiency by leveraging knowledge about the sampling distribution of candidate sets. For optimizing six control parameters, PbBO can converge to user-preferred parameters with 90.7% validation accuracy via 20 iterations. Moreover, the hierarchical controller is designed to generate personalized torque for different tasks and achieve interaction torque tracking in real time. The results of treadmill and outdoor experiments demonstrate that the optimized parameters can reduce metabolic rate by 14.5%-15.4%, heart rate by 6.3%-7.6%, and muscle activation by 6.7%-31.5% compared to unassisted walking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的基于用户偏好的贝叶斯优化方法（PbBO），用于外骨骼机器人控制参数个性化，显著减少了人机交互次数并加快了优化速度。
AI.motivation: 当前外骨骼机器人需根据个人运动偏好动态调整控制参数，以提升舒适性和辅助效率。但现有的基于用户体验的优化方法人机交互频繁且优化速度慢，易导致用户疲劳，限制实际应用。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于偏好的贝叶斯优化（PbBO）框架，利用候选集合采样分布知识提升优化采样效率。该方法通过最少的迭代（20次）实现六个控制参数的个性化收敛。还设计了分层控制器，实现不同任务的个性化力矩生成和实时交互力矩跟踪。
AI.result: 在跑步机和户外实验中，优化后的参数使佩戴者新陈代谢率降低14.5%-15.4%，心率降低6.3%-7.6%，肌肉激活下降6.7%-31.5%，验证了方法的有效性和优化效率。
AI.conclusion: PbBO方法能以较少的人机交互高效地实现外骨骼控制参数的个性化，兼顾优化精度和用户体验，有助于外骨骼机器人在实际辅助中的推广应用。

title: LHSDet: High-Resolution AI-Generated Image Detection via Visual Question Answering
summary: Driven by advances in diffusion models and autoregressive models, the fidelity and resolution of AI-generated images now rival those of real images. However, existing AI-generated image detection methods often downsample the images, inevitably overlooking critical low-level texture details in high-resolution AI-generated images, therefore limiting their detection performance. In addition, the ceaseless emergence of unknown generative models makes large-scale pre-training datasets inaccessible. To address these challenges, we propose a novel high-resolution AI-generated image detector, termed LHSDet. Specifically, we formulate the AI-generated image detection task as a Visual Question Answering problem, leveraging a fine-tuned vision-language framework to fully exploit the complementary information between visual and textual modalities. Recognizing that the default visual encoder of existing vision-language models is not tailored for AI-generated image detection, we redesign a visual encoder to better capture both the low-level and high-level artifacts inherent in AI-generated images. Furthermore, we incorporate a semantic-level textual branch to enable multi-modal feature fusion and detection. Consequently, LHSDet employs a triple-branch architecture to extract complementary multi-modal features: a low-level visual branch that aggregates non-overlapping patches for local texture cues, a high-level visual branch based on SigLIP2 for global perception feature extraction, and a semantic-level textual branch that generates captions using BLIP-2. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that LHSDet achieves high detection accuracy and robust performance across diverse generative models, including both diffusion and autoregressive models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的高分辨率AI生成图像检测器（LHSDet），通过融合多模态信息，提高了检测AI生成图像的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: AI生成图像质量日益逼近真实图像，现有检测方法由于下采样会丢失关键低层纹理细节，且面对不断涌现的新型生成模型时缺乏大规模预训练数据，检测效果受限。
AI.method: 将AI生成图像检测任务转化为视觉问答问题，利用微调后的视觉-语言框架，重设计视觉编码器并引入语义级文本分支，三分支结构分别提取局部低层纹理、全局视觉特征和文本语义，实现多模态融合，提升检测效果。
AI.result: LHSDet在包括扩散模型和自回归模型在内的多种生成模型上，展现出高检测准确率和强鲁棒性，表现优异。
AI.conclusion: LHSDet能够有效捕捉高分辨率AI生成图像的低层和高层特征，超越传统检测方法，在面对未知生成模型时依然保持强大性能。

title: Conversation as Measurement in Clinical Encounters: Observable Phase Structure, Partially Observable Patient State
summary: Many modern AI systems analyze conversational traces to infer aspects of human interaction and state, implicitly assuming that such information is recoverable from conversation. We study observability: whether a target is recoverable from conversational transcripts alone. Observability is difficult to assess because transcripts may provide only a partial view of many targets, and large-scale analysis requires model-based annotation, making true limits of the conversational signal hard to distinguish from annotator error. We therefore study clinical encounters, where patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) provide an external anchor for patient state, and visits follow broadly structured patterns. We study observability of patient state and conversational phase structure using 439 real-world clinical encounter transcripts spanning 134 hours, including 245 ENT transcripts paired with 273 PROM surveys. We operationalize patient state using PROM scores for voice, cough, and swallowing; phase structure using conversational phase segmentation. To make these analyses credible at scale, we use a PHI-compliant GPT-5 deployment for transcript annotation and conduct 40 hours of manual validation, reducing the risk that apparent limits of observability simply reflect annotator error. Our core finding is an observability asymmetry: phase structure is observable and useful for characterizing clinical encounter organization, while patient state is only partially observable, even in a setting designed to elicit patient symptoms and experiences, cautioning against transcript-only inference of human state.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了会话记录能否准确恢复人类交互和状态。通过439份真实临床就诊转录，发现会话阶段结构能较好复原，但患者具体状态仅能部分恢复。
AI.motivation: AI系统广泛利用对话记录推测人类状态，前提是假设这些状态可以通过文本完全恢复。但实际文本文档或许只能部分映射真实状态，AI打标签又会引入误差，需要在真实环境中验证“可观测性”。
AI.method: 以耳鼻喉科临床会话为例，选取439份转录本和273份患者报告的结局量表（PROM）数据，通过GPT-5自动注解并辅以40小时人工复查。对患者状态（依据PROM得分）和会话相位结构（讨论环节）进行分析。
AI.result: 会话相位结构可以通过转录文较为准确恢复，有助于分析就诊过程结构。但患者实际体验状态，比如声音、咳嗽、吞咽，仅能部分从转录文本中恢复。
AI.conclusion: 不应完全依赖转录文本推断人类具体状态，尤其在临床等需要精准把握主观体验的场景中。AI分析对话文本可以可靠刻画流程结构，但推测细致的主观状态存在局限，需谨慎应用。

title: Latent World Models with Monotone Planning Costs for Image-Goal Navigation
summary: Image-goal navigation with latent world models requires not only accurate future prediction, but also a planning cost that reliably ranks candidate action sequences. We define the cost as the cosine distance between the predicted future embedding and the goal embedding, and show that poor cost ordering can mislead sampling-based planners such as Cross-Entropy Method (CEM). To address this, we propose a latent world model built on a frozen DINO-family encoder and train it with two complementary objectives. An autoregressive rollout loss reduces the gap between training and multi-step planning rollouts, while a Monotone Cost Ranking (MCR) loss directly encourages increasingly perturbed action sequences to receive higher planning costs. We also study InfoNCE-based action-contrastive training and find that temporal permutation negatives distort the latent geometry and degrade planning performance. On the GNM navigation dataset, our method outperforms Navigation World Models (NWM), DINO-WM, OmniVLA, and NoMaD, achieving state-of-the-art image-goal navigation performance while reducing orientation error by $2.7\times$ over the same-encoder DINO WM baseline. We also deploy the model zero-shot on a physical robot, where it follows goal-directed paths in unseen indoor and outdoor environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型的基于DINO编码器的潜在世界模型，在图片目标导航任务中，通过创新的训练损失实现了更精准的未来状态预测和更可靠的路径成本排序，从而在多个基准任务和机器人实际部署中获得了最先进的导航性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于潜在世界模型的方法在图片目标导航中，未来预测虽已较准确，但在行动序列规划的代价排序方面存在缺陷，容易误导采样式规划器（如CEM），导致次优路径选择。为提升排序能力和实际导航性能，提出了新的训练与代价设计。
AI.method: 模型基于冻结的DINO系列视觉编码器，联合了自回归滚动损失和单调成本排序（MCR）损失进行训练。前者优化多步预测与实际执行时的差距，后者通过对扰动路径应用更高代价，直接优化规划排序能力。还比较了基于InfoNCE的对比损失，并分析其负面影响。
AI.result: 在GNM导航数据集上，该方法超越了NWM、DINO-WM、OmniVLA和NoMaD等顶尖方法，不仅实现了最佳的图片目标导航表现，且在同一DINO编码器基础上将机器人朝向误差降低到原来的2.7倍。此外，模型还能零样本迁移部署到真实机器人，在未知室内外环境下表现出良好的目标跟踪能力。
AI.conclusion: 提出的潜在世界模型和训练策略有效提升了图片目标导航中的路径排序与执行性能，理论上和在真实场景中的实验验证均显示优于现有方法，为视觉导航和世界模型结合提供了可拓展的解决方案。

title: UniScale: Arbitrary-Scale Industrial Anomaly Generation
summary: Industrial anomaly inspection faces a major challenge due to the lack of real-world anomaly samples. While generative models are used to create anomaly data, existing methods still struggle when handling small-scale anomalies.This failure occurs because extreme downsampling in diffusion models causes the information of small anomalies to be lost in the latent space.To address this, we introduce UniScale, a unified training and inference framework for high-fidelity industrial anomaly generation across arbitrary scales.During training, we introduce an Error-Suppressed Multi-Scale Training (EMT) strategy, which enables the model to learn the rich location-aware textures of anomalies, while suppressing upsampling-induced interpolation errors in texture acquisition, ensuring the model is capable of learning small-scale anomalies, while remaining effective for regular scale anomalies.For inference, we propose Generation-then-Fusion Denoising. It decouples anomaly generation from background integration, preventing small anomalies from being overwhelmed.Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art competitors in both anomaly generation quality and downstream detection performance.It achieves a relative IS(a) improvement of 45.86\% (from 1.81 to 2.64) on VisA and 37.70\% (from 1.22 to 1.68) on MVTec AD 2, while also improving the downstream pixel-level IoU by 4.22\% on VisA and AUROC by 6.55\% on MVTec AD 2. Code is available at https://github.com/HUST-SLOW/UniScale.

AI.tldr: 提出了UniScale框架，提升了工业缺陷检测中小尺度异常生成与检测的质量。
AI.motivation: 工业视觉异常检测缺乏真实异常样本，现有生成方法难以合成小尺度异常，主要是扩散模型在极度下采样时导致小异常信息丢失。
AI.method: 提出UniScale统一训练与推理框架，在训练阶段引入误差抑制多尺度训练(EMT)，增强模型对小尺度异常的学习和插值误差抑制能力；推理阶段采用先生成再融合去噪的方法分离异常生成与背景融合，防止小异常被淹没。
AI.result: 实验表明，UniScale在生成异常质量与下游检测能力上均优于现有方法：在VisA数据集上IS(a)提升45.86%，像素级IoU提升4.22%；在MVTec AD 2数据集上IS(a)提升37.70%，AUROC提升6.55%。
AI.conclusion: UniScale能高质量合成全尺度工业异常，显著提升下游检测效果。代码已开源。

title: Position Bias in Ordinal Classification: A Systematic Evaluation
summary: Large language models are increasingly used for ordinal classification, yet semantically equivalent changes to prompt organization can alter their predictions. We conduct systematic experiments to characterize positional bias from label order, demonstration order, and demonstration placement. First, we apply the three probes to ten frontier LLMs on a common ordinal-classification task; every model is sensitive to all three positional sources, showing that the problem is pervasive. Second, we vary eight prompt-, task-, and model-level factors across five datasets; accuracy and stability are often misaligned, and only lower scale cardinality consistently improves both. Third, we compare pointwise, pairwise, and listwise inference, alternative aggregation and debiasing methods, and joint configurations; the tested corrections do not provide a reliable remedy, while a comparison-based listwise formulation offers the best balance but transfers unevenly across models and bias sources. These findings show that positional robustness depends on the full system configuration rather than the model alone. Ordinal-classification systems should therefore be selected jointly for predictive performance and stability.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析大语言模型在序数分类任务中因提示词组织顺序产生的偏差，发现多种因素影响模型的一致性和准确性，现有纠偏方法难以完全解决问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在序数分类任务中被广泛应用，但对于同义的提示词组织方式（如标签顺序、示例顺序和位置）的敏感性会导致模型输出不一致，影响其实用性和稳定性。作者希望深入理解和量化这些位置性偏差，为实际应用选择更鲁棒的系统配置提供参考。
AI.method: 作者设计了三类实验探针，系统测试了十个主流LLM在固定的序数分类任务上的位置性敏感性，探讨标签顺序、示例顺序和示例位置的影响。接着跨五个数据集，变动八种与提示词、任务、模型相关的因素，分析模型准确性和稳定性之间的关系。最后，评估多种推断方法（点式、对式、列表式）、集合与纠偏策略的效果。
AI.result: 所有测试的LLM对标签顺序、示例顺序和位置都存在显著敏感性。准确率和稳定性之间常常难以兼得，只有减小类别数量（cardinality）一项能对二者均有提升。多种校正和集合方法效果有限，列表式推理方法虽在多方面有较好平衡，但在不同模型和偏差类型间泛化性有限。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型的序数分类任务中，位置鲁棒性受整个系统配置影响，而非仅由模型决定。实际部署时，应综合考虑模型性能和稳定性，协同优化系统选择。

title: UnsDrive: Towards Robust End-to-End Autonomous Driving in Unstructured Scenes
summary: End-to-end planning has shown strong promise for autonomous driving, but most existing methods are designed for structured urban roads and generalize poorly to unstructured mining environments. In such settings, weak road structure, terrain-induced occlusions, degraded visibility, and large unobserved regions make safe planning particularly challenging. To address these challenges, we propose UnsDrive, an end-to-end planner designed for unstructured mining scenes. UnsDrive builds an unknown-aware occupancy representation that explicitly models occupied, free, and unknown space using multi-frame visibility cues, and conditions a flow-matching planner on this representation to generate multimodal future trajectories. To improve safety under partial observability, we further introduce an occupancy trajectory consistency loss and an uncertainty-aware trajectory scorer that penalize trajectories entering non-traversable or unobserved regions. We also present MineLoop, a mining-oriented closed-loop simulator for evaluating autonomous driving under irregular road geometry, degraded visibility, heavy-vehicle interactions, and mining-specific operational constraints. Experiments in both open-loop and closed-loop settings show that UnsDrive consistently outperforms strong baselines in trajectory accuracy, collision avoidance, and long-horizon driving robustness. These results demonstrate the value of explicit unknown-space reasoning for autonomous driving in unstructured mining environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对非结构化矿区环境的端到端自动驾驶规划方法UnsDrive，通过显式建模已知、未知和自由空间显著提升安全性和规划表现。
AI.motivation: 大多数端到端自动驾驶方法是为结构化城市道路设计的，在缺乏明显道路结构和能见度低下的矿区等非结构化场景中表现不佳，需要更适应复杂环境的规划方法。
AI.method: 1. 提出UnsDrive，通过多帧可视性线索构建显式考虑未知空间的占用率表示；2. 基于该表示，使用flow-matching生成多模态未来轨迹；3. 设计新的occupancy trajectory consistency损失及基于不确定性的轨迹评分方法，惩罚进入不可通行或未知区域的轨迹。4. 构建MineLoop仿真环境，专为矿区运营特点而设计。
AI.result: 在开放环和闭环仿真测试中，UnsDrive在轨迹精度、避障能力和长距离驾驶健壮性等方面，均优于主流基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式处理未知空间，结合定制化仿真环境，可显著提升自动驾驶系统在非结构化矿区环境下的规划安全性和鲁棒性。

title: Vision-Language Grounding as Bidirectional Concept Correspondence
summary: Vision-language grounding connects language to visual content, yet most existing formulations reduce grounding to a unidirectional localization problem: given a prespecified text phrase or category name, identify the corresponding image region. This setup assumes that the relevant linguistic unit is already known, overlooking a more basic challenge in grounded communication: determining which parts of the text are visually referential and how they correspond to entities in the image. We formulate grounding as $\textit{bidirectional concept correspondence}$ over an image-text pair. Given an image and its paired text, the goal is to recover all correspondences between visually referential text spans and instance-level image segments, without assuming that the relevant text spans are provided. This formulation unifies common grounding tasks, including phrase grounding, referring expression grounding, and open-vocabulary detection, by treating text segmentation, image segmentation, and cross-modal alignment as a single correspondence prediction problem. To address this task, we introduce $\textbf{ConCor-1}$, a grounding model built on top of a pretrained vision-language model. It uses learnable $\textit{bridge tokens}$ to represent candidate image-text correspondences and predicts, for each token, a text mask, an image mask, and a correspondence presence score. To train and evaluate this task, we convert diverse grounding and segmentation datasets into a unified correspondence format. Experiments show that $\textbf{ConCor-1}$ consistently outperforms baselines, improving correspondence F1 by 48% on the long-caption dataset and by 29% on zero-shot LVIS, where the large category list serves as the text input.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种新的视觉-语言对齐任务，即双向概念对应，实现文本片段和图像实例的全面配对，并引入了相应的模型ConCor-1，显著提升了各类数据集的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言对齐工作主要将定位任务设为给定文本定位图像区域，假定已知相关文本单元，忽略如何自动发现文本中的视觉相关片段与图像实体的对应，未能覆盖真实交流中的基本挑战。
AI.method: 作者将配对任务表述为图像-文本对上的双向概念对应，不预先假定给定文本片段。提出模型ConCor-1，基于预训练视觉-语言模型，采用可学习的桥接token，分别预测文本掩码、图像掩码及对应置信分数，并将多种数据集转化为统一格式以便训练与评测。
AI.result: 在长文本描述数据集上，ConCor-1对应关系F1提升48%，在LVIS零样本场景中提升29%，全面优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的双向概念对应任务及ConCor-1模型加强了文本与图像之间的语义对齐能力，统一了不同的视觉-语言下游任务，并在多个基准上实现显著性能提升，为后续相关研究奠定了基础。

title: Tied Trit-Planes: Constraining PTQTP to a Uniform Nine-Level Quantizer, with a Persistent Folded Format for Disk-Streamed Mixture-of-Experts Serving
summary: PTQTP decomposes LLM weight matrices into two ternary (trit) planes with two free per-group scales. Tying the scales to a fixed ratio of three collapses the decomposition into a single uniform nine-level quantizer, a known balanced-ternary identity. To our knowledge, at the time of writing, this work is the first to impose that identity as a constraint inside PTQTP's solver. The two trit planes then fold losslessly into one 4-bit code plane that we make the persistent serving representation: disk bytes, expert-cache bytes, and kernel input are the same 4.0625-bits/weight blocks, consumed in one integer dot pass. For this conjunction (ratio-3 nine-level code, CPU-SIMD kernels, SSD expert streaming, identical persistent bytes) we likewise found no precedent. We apply this to the routed experts of DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, a 284B-A13B mixture-of-experts model, quantizing in one shot from the released MXFP4 expert weights and streaming experts from SSD on a 64 GB laptop. Against a 4.5-bit Q4_K baseline, measured one process per fixture with an expert-lossless anchor arm as reference control, the tied model matches the official serving API on 5/5 fixtures at step 0 (Q4_K: 4/5) and 12/14 captured continuation steps (11/14), scores 86 vs. 84 on a 100-item MMLU subset, decodes 6.7% faster in decode phase, and ships 9% smaller files: no detected fidelity difference at these small evaluation sizes, and every fixture-level difference between the arms traces to a single measured near-tie cell. The tied fit nevertheless shows higher weight-reconstruction error and worse perplexity, a measured dissociation between proxy metrics and reference fidelity. A cumulative trunk-ternarization ladder and bitwise-pinned aarch64/x86-64 kernels complete the report. All code, formats, and evaluation artifacts are open source in the fucina inference stack.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的LLM（大语言模型）权重量化方法PTQTP，通过将权重矩阵分解为两组三值平面（每组有两个自由的尺度因子），并将尺度比约束为3，从而得到一个统一的九级量化器，实现4.0625bit/权重的紧凑存储与推理，且保持推理数据流一致。方法在DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731专家模型上测试，结果显示精度与速度均有提升，并开源了全部方案。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型量化技术存在权重存储成本较高、推理效率不高、统一数据流难以实现等问题。本工作旨在用创新量化方法，进一步压缩权重体积并提升推理效率，同时保证端到端一致的推理流程。
AI.method: PTQTP方法将LLM的权重矩阵分解为两组三值化（trit）平面，每组配有一个独立的尺度参数。通过限制尺度比例为3，得到九级平衡三值编码，这可以在解码时融为一个4-bit的编码平面，实现紧凑表示。所有权重按此规范进行一次性量化。推理时，权重以一致的4.0625bit块布局服务于CPU SIMD内核和SSD专家模型流式加载。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731（混合精度专家模型，参数规模巨大）上，用PTQTP一轮量化后，用Q4_K为基准、专家无损作为参考，模型在小样本MMLU测试集上得分提高2分；5次初测全部通过、14次后续推理中有12次表现优于基线，推理解码速度提升6.7%，模型体积减少9%。
AI.conclusion: PTQTP有效提升了大模型的权重压缩比和推理效率，对模型精度无检测到明显损失，虽然权重重建误差与Perplexity略变差，但整体参考保真与实际效果一致。方案适用于大规模专家模型、统一推理流程且已全部开源。

title: ROEVO: Robust Organized Edge Feature-based Visual Odometry Using RGB-D Cameras
summary: This work presents a visual odometry (VO) system that leverages image edge features. Edges are spatially expressive cues commonly present across diverse environments, offering rich textural and structural information. However, existing edge-based VO methods often fail to fully exploit this potential.
