To this end, we introduce a novel feature representation termed \textit{organized edges}, which transforms disjoint edge pixels into sequentialized clusters, enabling more effective retention and utilization of the underlying textural and structural information. Another nice property of this formulation is that organized edges can perform edge-level association across multiple frames, enabling the establishment of a co-visibility graph. To achieve precise and efficient pose estimation, we propose a range of particularly designed tracking and joint optimization methods based on the characteristics of organized edges. For tracking, we formulate edge-wise rather than pixel-wise residuals to achieve robust and accurate inter-frame registration. For joint optimization, we introduce a novel shape-preserving edge-fitting method and an organized edge-based Bundle Adjustment (BA) approach, which decomposes the traditional BA problem into fitting and registration to preserve the structural integrity. Based on these novel techniques, we develop a complete VO system that exclusively employs organized edge features, achieving efficient tracking and precise local mapping. Extensive experiments demonstrate its accuracy and robustness in indoor environments, outperforming or achieving comparable performance to state-of-the-art methods. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/liumingrui814/ROEVO

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图像边缘特征的新型视觉里程计系统，通过创新性地组织和利用边缘信息，实现了更高效、精确的位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 边缘常见且富含结构信息，但现有基于边缘的视觉里程计方法未能充分发挥其潜力，因此作者希望设计一种更有效利用边缘特征的方法。
AI.method: 提出“有组织的边缘”特征，把离散的边缘像素组织成有序簇，实现跨帧的边缘关联和共视图的构建。为此设计了模块化的跟踪和联合优化算法，包括采用边缘级的残差进行跟踪、创新的保形边缘拟合、以及基于组织边缘的Bundle Adjustment（分解为拟合与配准），以保持结构完整性。
AI.result: 构建了只用组织边缘特征的完整视觉里程计系统，在室内环境下进行大量实验，系统在精确性和鲁棒性方面优于或达到最新技术水平。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法有效提升了基于边缘的视觉里程计系统的性能，充分利用了边缘特征，具有广阔的实际应用前景。代码已开源，便于学界和业界复现和进一步研究。

title: DeCo: Zero-Shot Industrial Anomaly Generation through Decoupling and Recoupling
summary: Industrial anomaly inspection is severely hindered by the scarcity of real anomalous data.Zero-shot industrial anomaly generation addresses this by generating anomalies on specific products without requiring any of their real anomalous images. However, existing methods suffer from two critical limitations, i.e., inaccurate anomaly information acquisition and uncontrolled anomaly-product fusion.To overcome these challenges, we propose DeCo, which decouples the anomaly structure from its source product, and explicitly recouples it with the normal textures of the target product. During anomaly information acquisition,Dual-Routing Flow (DR-Flow) binds the texture-invariant anomaly structure to an abnormal token, while a parallel constraint, Product-Invariant Flow (PI-Flow), prevents the abnormal token from binding the source product. During anomaly-product fusion, we propose a hybrid injection to recouple the acquired anomaly structure with the target product, and Product Compatibility Correction (PCC) to compensate for the incompatibility between the acquired anomaly structure and the product. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeCo establishes a new state-of-the-art. Training downstream detection models on our generated data yields massive pixel AP improvements of 5.1\% on MVTec AD and 8.2\% on VisA. Code is available at https://github.com/HUST-SLOW/DeCo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出名为DeCo的方法，通过解耦与重耦技术实现工业零样本异常生成，提升异常检测数据的质量和实用性，并显著提升下游检测模型精度。
AI.motivation: 工业异常检测通常缺少真实异常数据，严重制约了检测模型的性能。现有零样本异常生成方法存在异常信息提取不准确和异常与产品融合不可控的问题，亟需更有效的生成方案。
AI.method: 提出DeCo方法，将异常结构与来源产品解耦，通过DR-Flow绑定异常结构和异常Token，并利用PI-Flow约束异常Token不与来源产品绑定。在与目标产品融合时，采用混合注入与PCC校正策略，实现与目标产品的有效适配。
AI.result: DeCo在产生异常数据方面表现优异，助力下游检测模型在MVTec AD和VisA数据集上分别提升5.1%和8.2%的Pixel AP，建立新的SOTA。
AI.conclusion: DeCo方法针对工业领域缺异常样本问题，有效提升了异常生成和检测的效果，为工业质量检测提供了新思路与实用工具。

title: Investigating Multimodal Informativity under Different Partner Visibility Conditions in Video-Mediated Dialogue
summary: Situated language use is multimodal and embodied. For example, gestures can carry information that is absent or underspecified in the speech signal, yet dialogue models typically rely on transcripts alone. We study how much referential information gestures and their combination with speech carry in multimodal dialogue under different partner visibility conditions. % We build models that identify the intended referent in a video-mediated referential communication game based on either the speech transcript, the skeletal representation of gesture, or both modalities. Our results show that gesture alone is predictive of the intended referent and that multimodal fusion is most beneficial when the transcript-based model is uncertain. Training-only alignment of learned representations with the referent image further improves the fusion model performance. % In a comparison with human interaction data, we further see pragmatic effects of interlocutor visibility on gesture production and informativeness as well as an entrainment effect in speech and multimodal, but not gesture, performance across rounds of repeated interaction. We thus make contributions to the technical modelling of multimodal information in human dialogue and the analysis of human interaction data via trained model representations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多模态对话中手势与语言如何共同传递指代信息，并通过实验量化了两者的互补价值。
AI.motivation: 传统对话模型大多只依赖文本转录，不关注实际对话中丰富的肢体语言与环境互动。作者希望厘清手势（尤其是在视频交流中）能否独立传递指代信息，并探究多模态融合提升模型对意图对象识别的能力。
AI.method: 设计视频媒介下的指代交流游戏，分别用语音文本、骨架化手势表示及二者结合建模，预测说话者所指代的目标对象。同时，利用与目标图片对齐的表征训练策略进一步提升多模态性能，对比分析了不同对话轮次与可见性条件下的表现。
AI.result: 手势单独即可有效预测说话者指代对象，融合模型在文本模型不确定时效果更好。对齐表征训练能进一步提升能力。人类数据分析显示，对话者可见性对手势丰富性和信息性有影响，语音和多模态存在顺应对话轮次的协同变化。
AI.conclusion: 本文丰富了多模态对话技术模型，为理解与生成具有人类互动特征的多模态交流提供了数据与实证基础。手势与文本互补性在对话建模中具有重要价值。

title: Trajectory Divergence Horizon Decision for Reliable Dual-Arm Surgical Subtask Manipulation
summary: Surgical robotic systems are increasingly being adopted as clinical workload rises, motivating autonomous solutions for repetitive manipulation subtasks. Learning-based controllers improve generalization compared with rule-based and analytic approaches, but most are trained for individual tasks and remain difficult to reuse across procedures. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a unified framework that integrates visual perception, language grounding, and action generation, offering a promising path toward more composable surgical autonomy. However, existing VLA policies rely on fixed-length open-loop action sequences, where changing scene conditions can lead to accumulated errors and potential risks in surgical manipulation. To mitigate this issue, we formulate surgical VLA deployment as an adaptive execution-horizon decision problem and propose Trajectory Divergence Horizon Decision (TDHD), a test-time mechanism that estimates step-wise action reliability by measuring the divergence between two flow-matching-generated trajectories under small noise perturbations and truncates execution using a dual-threshold rule to trigger timely replanning. We further establish a real-world da Vinci-like dual-arm benchmark with synchronized multi-view perception and language instructions, and collect 600 teleoperated demonstrations across needle (reach, pick, regrasp) and tissue (reach, lift, resection) manipulation suites. On real hardware with 20 trials per task setting, TDHD consistently improves performance over the latest VLA baselines: success increases from 55\% to 60\% for needle manipulation and from 55\% to 80\% for tissue manipulation, with the largest gains observed in the final manipulation stages. These results highlight the importance of adaptive execution control for reliable deployment of VLA models in surgical robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应执行机制（TDHD），提升了基于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在外科机器人操作任务中的可靠性，显著提高了针具和组织操作的成功率。
AI.motivation: 随着外科机器人系统在临床应用中普及，手术部分任务的自动化需求增加。现有基于学习的控制器虽有泛化优势，但缺乏跨任务复用能力。VLA模型为视觉、语言和动作的统一集成提供契机，但当前策略在动态场景下易积累误差，影响手术安全性。为此，需要一种在执行阶段具有适应性的机制。
AI.method: 论文将外科VLA模型部署过程建模为自适应执行跨度决策问题，提出TDHD方法，通过在执行时测量扰动下两条轨迹的偏差，估算动作可靠性，并采用双阈值规则及时截断和重新规划动作。此外，作者还建立了基于达芬奇双臂机器人的真实基准和多视角语言任务数据集进行验证。
AI.result: 在真实机器人硬件20次每任务的实验证明下，所提TDHD机制在针具操作任务中成功率从55%提升至60%，在组织操作中由55%提升至80%，尤其在操作后期提升最显著，优于当前主流VLA方法。
AI.conclusion: 自适应执行控制对于VLA模型在外科机器人操作中的可靠、安全部署具关键作用，本文的TDHD方法有效提高了整体任务成功率，具有较高的实际应用前景。

title: SegDem: Segmentation helps Demosaicing
summary: Image demosaicing reconstructs a full-color image from incomplete color measurements produced by a sensor covered with a color filter array (CFA). Most existing methods formulate demosaicing as pixel-level reconstruction and mainly rely on local textures, cross-channel correlations, and low-level image statistics. Our core insight is that reconstruction and visual understanding can be viewed as complementary views of shared scene structure: both are grounded in the same underlying physical world, and therefore the structural and physical information inferred from an image should remain consistent across the two tasks. We instantiate this idea with instance segmentation and propose \emph{SegDem}, a cross-task decoder representation transfer framework for demosaicing. SegDem first learns region- and boundary-aware representations through instance-aware structural pretraining and then transfers the decoder to RAW-conditioned reconstruction. Segmentation- and demosaicing-conditioned features are further anchored to a shared frozen DINOv2 representation space to preserve structural organization across tasks. We instantiate SegDem with convolutional, Transformer-based, and state-space backbones for unified Single- and Quad-Bayer demosaicing. Extensive experiments on synthetic, external, and challenging datasets demonstrate consistent improvements across different architectures and CFA layouts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种将实例分割与图像去马赛克任务结合的新方法SegDem，在多个数据集和网络架构下取得了优异的去马赛克重建效果。
AI.motivation: 现有去马赛克方法主要依赖像素级的纹理与颜色信息，缺乏对场景结构理解的利用。作者认为实例分割等高层视觉任务与去马赛克重建共享场景结构信息，相互补充，因此提出结合二者的信息，提高重建质量。
AI.method: 提出了SegDem框架，包含实例感知结构预训练与decoder迁移。具体做法：1）先在实例分割任务上进行结构感知的区域、边界特征预训练；2）将decoder迁移用于基于RAW的去马赛克重建；3）用DINOv2特征空间锚定分割和去马赛克的结构信息保持一致。框架可结合CNN、Transformer或State-space结构，并适用于Single/Quad-Bayer CFA。
AI.result: 在合成数据、外部和挑战性数据集上的广泛实验证明：SegDem框架在多种网络结构与CFA布局下都带来稳定且显著的去马赛克效果提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将实例分割的结构信息引入去马赛克重建，可以跨任务地增强重建效果，SegDem方法有效验证了结构信息的迁移带来的优势。

title: Same Question, Different Answer? Measuring and Mitigating Prompt Privilege for Equitable AI Access
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into healthcare, education, public services, and everyday decision making. They should provide comparable assistance regardless of a user's literacy, communication style, or prompt-engineering expertise. However, existing research on prompt robustness primarily focuses on adversarial attacks, prompt injection, and prompt optimization, while overlooking whether semantically equivalent requests receive different responses simply because they are phrased differently. We refer to this accessibility challenge as "Prompt Privilege": users with greater prompting expertise systematically obtain better model performance despite expressing the same underlying intent.
  To address this problem, we present a unified framework for measuring and mitigating accessibility disparities in LLM interactions. We introduce Prompt Equity Score (PES), a quantitative metric for evaluating performance consistency across user populations, and Prompt Equity Transformer (PET), an LLM-based agent that automatically transforms user requests into semantically equivalent, accessibility-oriented prompts while preserving their intent. PET shifts prompt optimization from the user to the AI system, functioning as an intelligent accessibility layer between users and foundation models. Experiments on the MedQA benchmark demonstrate measurable prompt privilege, with statistically significant performance disparities between low-literacy and expert-prompting cohorts. Applying PET eliminates these disparities while preserving semantic fidelity, demonstrating that accessibility-oriented prompt normalization can improve equitable AI access. By introducing prompt privilege as a new dimension of AI accessibility and PET as a practical solution, this work advances system-centered accessibility and provides a foundation for more fair, trustworthy, and inclusive AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了“提示特权”现象，并提出了度量和缓解方法，旨在提升大语言模型在不同用户之间的可及性和公平性。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在实际应用中，不同用户因语言表达或提示技巧不同，虽表达同一意图，却能获得截然不同的响应质量，形成了提示特权。这一现象被广泛忽视，影响了AI的公平和可及性。
AI.method: 作者提出Prompt Equity Score（PES）来量化不同用户群体间的模型表现一致性，并设计了Prompt Equity Transformer（PET），即利用LLM自动将用户提示转换成更具可及性但语义等价的表达，从而消除因提示能力差异导致的性能差异。
AI.result: 实验证明，不同提示能力用户在医疗问答任务上存在显著表现差异，应用PET后能消除这种差距，同时保持语义一致。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入提示特权的概念及PET方法，本文推动了AI系统可及性的发展，为更公平可信的AI应用奠定基础。

title: High Fidelity Capture, Reconstruction, and Transfer of Human Demonstrations for Robot-Assisted Bathing
comment: Accepted to Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2026. Official conference page: https://www.roboticsproceedings.org/rss22/p094.pdf
summary: Despite the demand for robots in high-value clinical tasks like bathing, contemporary systems still lack the safety and reliability required for complex, sustained physical interaction with humans. A key challenge hindering the development of such systems is that collecting, understanding, and effectively transferring highly dynamic, contact-rich human bathing demonstrations is difficult, even with modern motion and tactile sensing equipment. We present a straightforward, but effective framework for doing so with high fidelity by utilizing contact regions as a key processing primitive. We use our framework to build a dataset of bathing demonstrations performed by trained clinicians on human subjects. We then use this dataset to design and control an arm-mounted dexterous soft hand to perform bathing tasks on a mannequin using open- and closed-loop strategies. Our dataset is the first to provide high quality synchronized motion, shape, contact, and force during sustained, contact-rich human-human interaction, and our transfer strategies demonstrate effective use of these data across multiple levels of the robotics stack. All relevant materials will be publicly released to enable further advancements in physical human-robot interaction (pHRI) research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过以接触区域为核心处理单元的框架，成功采集和转移了临床复杂沐浴任务的人类示范数据，并用数据指导机器人软手完成相应任务，实现了高保真的人机物理互动。
AI.motivation: 机器人在执行如沐浴等高价值的临床物理交互任务中存在安全性与可靠性不足的问题，主要瓶颈在于缺乏高质量的、可转移的人类动态交互示范数据。
AI.method: 研究者提出以接触区域为重点的处理方法，采集了专业医生在真人身上执行沐浴时的高同步运动、形状、接触和力数据，建立起首个完整的数据集，并进一步在机械臂软手上，通过开环和闭环控制策略，实现机器人对仿真人体执行类似沐浴操作。
AI.result: 获得了临床高质量的示范数据集，实现了数据在机器人感知-决策-执行多环节间的有效传递，并验证了该策略在机器人真实任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以接触区域为核心的数据收集与迁移框架能极大推动人机物理交互研究的发展，提升机器人在复杂医疗交互任务中的实用性与安全性，并已计划公开全部材料促进学界后续进展。

title: Forged Peer Judgments Mislead Multimodal LLM Judge Panels: Source-Blind Anchoring and Panel-Consensus Verification
summary: Multimodal LLM judge panels can cross-reference peers, but a quoted peer judgment may itself be untrusted. We expose source-blind anchoring as a text-level attack surface in vision-language model (VLM) panels. Quoting independent visual judgments creates large anchoring gaps (19--26 percentage points) under both self and peer framing. A matched-content, label-only control changes the broken rate by only $-0.17$pp (95\% CI $[-0.68,0.35]$), showing that the self/peer label itself does not explain the effect. Under our tested construction, deliberately generated, concise wrong quotes overturn originally-correct verdicts 1.5--2.7$\times$ more often than naturally occurring wrong peer statements, with bootstrap 95\% CIs excluding parity across two datasets and seven VLM judges. Because the two statement populations differ in selection and form, this ratio measures differential damage under the tested attack rather than a provenance-only causal effect. We then introduce panel-consensus verification, which cross-checks a quote against independently collected blind votes. It blocks 84.9\% of fabricated attacks, cuts their net harm by 97.5\%, and preserves the positive but statistically inconclusive point estimate for genuine peer information under leave-one-out re-verification. These results identify a low-cost attack surface and a concrete defense for safer multimodal collaborative evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了在多模态大模型评审团中，源头不可见的引用行为（source-blind anchoring）构成了潜在攻击面，通过不可信的引语可显著影响评审结果。作者提出了一种防御机制，有效提升了多模态协作评审的安全性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型（如视觉-语言模型VLM）参与的评审团机制日益普及，这些模型会交叉引用彼此的判断。但当前评审团系统对引述内容的来源缺乏辨识，不可信的引用可能引发“锚定效应”，对评审结果造成误导。对此缺乏系统性研究和防御措施。
AI.method: 作者通过构建实验，在视觉-语言模型评审团中引入独立判断的引用，比较其对评审结果的影响，包括自我/同伴引用及内容匹配的标签对照。进一步设计并测试了一种可识别伪造引言的“panel-consensus verification”机制，即对引用内容进行独立、多票验证。
AI.result: 发现引用同伴判断会带来19-26个百分点的锚定效应，标签本身不解释该效应。蓄意伪造、简明且错误的引用相比自然错误引用更易颠覆正确判决（概率提升1.5-2.7倍）。提出的防御机制可拦截84.9%的伪造攻击，并减少97.5%的总危害，对真实引用信息影响较小。
AI.conclusion: 多模态评审团存在低成本的文本级攻击面，但“panel-consensus verification”方法可以大幅削弱此类攻击的危害，为多模态协作评审的安全性提供了切实可行的防护方案。

title: How Can Rhetoric Reward-Hack AI Reviewers? Dissecting Rhetorical Sensitivity in AI-Based Peer Review
summary: As large language models increasingly participate in scientific evaluation, we investigate a potential form of reward hacking: how rhetorical choices shape AI-review judgments when reported scientific content is preserved and how these effects vary across evaluation conditions. We construct a controlled corpus of 4,200 full-paper manuscripts derived from 120 anonymized ICLR 2026 submissions. Two LLM rewriters transform six rhetorical dimensions in opposing directions, and five LLM reviewers evaluate the resulting manuscripts under standard and strict protocols. We also test joint, recursive, and reviewer-guided rewriting. Our results show that rhetorical sensitivity is structured rather than uniform. Evidence framing and novelty stance produce the largest positive-negative contrasts in overall assessment, with scope framing forming a weaker second tier; the remaining dimensions have smaller or less stable effects. This hierarchy persists across human-assessed quality levels, but score movement depends strongly on the AI reviewer's original score: lower scores tend to rise, higher scores tend to fall, and directional contrasts are clearest in the middle ranges. More elaborate workflows do not reliably yield larger gains. Joint rewriting is strongly rewriter-dependent, reviewer guidance does not consistently outperform an unguided second pass, and repeated rewriting yields diminishing, configuration-dependent returns. Across conditions, the rewriter primarily determines the separation between opposing variants, whereas the reviewer determines the magnitude and sign of their score effects. Strict review lowers mean OA by 1.36 points without consistently changing rhetorical sensitivity. These findings identify when rhetorical presentation influences AI scientific review and motivate evaluation systems robust to content-preserving variation in scientific writing.

AI.tldr: 本论文探讨了在内容不变的基础上，科学论文的修辞方式如何影响大语言模型（LLM）自动评审的评分，并揭示了不同修辞维度和评审流程下的显著波动。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在科研评审中的作用日益重要，存在“奖励投机”现象，即通过修辞手法——而非科学内容——影响AI评审结果。因此，有必要系统研究修辞调整对AI评审评分的具体影响及其机制。
AI.method: 作者基于120篇ICLR 2026匿名投稿，构建了4200个完整手稿（通过LLM在六种修辞维度上进行对立修改），再由五个LLM评审员在标准与严格两种评审协议下打分。同时，测试了联合改写、递归改写和评审员引导下的改写流程。
AI.result: 结果发现，对证据表述和新颖性立场的修辞改动对总分影响最大，范围表述次之，其他修辞影响较小或不稳定。评审分数变动主要发生在原始中等分数区间，且较复杂的改写流程并不一定带来更大收益。修辞分离效果主要由重写者决定，具体分数变动则由评审者决定。严格评审平均降低1.36分，但对修辞敏感性影响有限。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了AI评审中修辞手法影响分数的具体情形，强调了构建对写作风格变化鲁棒的科研评估系统的重要性。

title: SpeedTuning: Speeding Up Policy Execution with Lightweight Reinforcement Learning
comment: 10 pages, 12 figures. Includes an appendix with qualitative simulation rollouts and additional ablations. Published at ICRA 2025
summary: While learned robotic policies hold promise for advancing generalizable manipulation, their practical deployment is often hindered by suboptimal execution speeds. Imitation learning policies are inherently limited by hardware constraints and the speed of the operator during data collection. In addition, there are no established methods for accelerating policies learned via imitation, and the empirical relationship between execution speed and task success remains underexplored. To address these issues, we introduce SpeedTuning, a reinforcement learning framework specifically designed to enhance the speed of manipulation policies. SpeedTuning learns to predict the optimal execution speed for actions, thereby complementing a base policy without necessitating additional data collection. We provide empirical evidence that SpeedTuning achieves substantial improvements in execution speed, exceeding 2.4x speed-up, while preserving an adequate success rate compared to both the original task policy and straightforward speed-up methods such as linear interpolation at a fixed speed. We evaluate our approach across a diverse set of dynamic and precise tasks, including pouring, throwing, and picking, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness in enhancing real-world robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了SpeedTuning框架，通过强化学习提升机器人操作策略执行速度，同时保持较高任务成功率。实验证明，SpeedTuning能在无需额外数据采集的情况下，实现2.4倍以上提速，优于传统加速方法。
AI.motivation: 目前类学习得到的机器人操作策略在实际部署中常因执行速度不佳而受限，且模仿学习易受硬件和采集数据时操作员速度影响，缺少有效的加速手段。快速且可靠的操作对实际应用至关重要，但相关研究较少。
AI.method: 提出SpeedTuning强化学习框架，能在不重新采集数据的前提下，动态预测操作动作的最优执行速度，与原有策略结合实现自动加速。通过与基线原策略及线性插值定速加速方法对比，在不同操控任务上进行评估。
AI.result: SpeedTuning显著提升了策略的执行速度，在保持合理成功率的同时，平均速度提升超过2.4倍，优于传统加速方法。在倒水、投掷、抓取等多类任务中均表现出高效与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SpeedTuning为基于模仿学习的机器人操作策略提供了有效加速方法，无需新增数据采集，即可优化速度且保证任务成功率，对现实动态与精细操作任务有重要意义。

title: SCoPE: Training-Free Audio-Visual Event Perception via Sparse Cross-Modal Prior Exchange
summary: Audio-visual event perception (AVEP) determines which events occur in a video, when they occur, and whether they are audible, visible, or both. Training-free methods query new event vocabularies by matching frozen audio and visual features with text-encoded event names. However, related labels share evidence. An incorrect label can then score at least as high as a correct one. We call this a false co-activation (FCA). No scalar cutoff can reject the incorrect label while keeping every correct one. Class-specific thresholds may prevent that label from becoming a final prediction, but the FCA remains in the underlying score vector. We introduce SCoPE, a training-free framework in which all queried labels compete for shared evidence and each modality guides event selection in the other. We derive an exact condition for when this competition removes an FCA in a two-label fit. With identical frozen CLIP+CLAP backbones on LLP, SCoPE improves Type@seg by 7.45 points and Event@seg by 5.04 points compared with the reported AV$^2$A values. The same fixed configuration transfers unchanged to OV-AVEBench and VGGSound-AVEL100k.

AI.tldr: 提出SCoPE框架，在多标签音视频事件识别任务中，通过让所有标签竞争共享的多模态证据，有效减少错误共激活现象，无需训练即可提升识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督/零样本音视频事件识别方法，采用冻结特征与标签名匹配，常因标签相关导致错误标签与正确标签得分接近（错误共激活，FCA）。传统阈值调节无法完全解决这个问题，因此需要新的方法抑制FCA。
AI.method: 提出SCoPE训练自由框架，让所有查询标签在多模态特征空间內相互竞争，并利用每一模态对另一模态的事件选择起指导作用。推导出在两标签匹配下，竞争消除错误共激活的严格条件。
AI.result: 在LLP数据集上，采用固定的CLIP+CLAP骨干，SCoPE在Type@seg和Event@seg上分别较AV$^2$A提升7.45和5.04分，并能直接迁移应用于OV-AVEBench和VGGSound-AVEL100k数据集，无需超参数修改。
AI.conclusion: SCoPE实现了无训练条件下多标签音视频事件精准识别，有效抑制了错误共激活问题，并具备极佳的可迁移性和鲁棒性。

title: How Far Do Foundation Models Transfer to Infant Signals? A Cross-Dataset Transfer Audit with a Unified Need Ontology
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures. Under review at AAAI 2027
summary: Public infant cry corpora are small, label-incompatible, and almost always evaluated one corpus at a time. We ask what this practice hides and what fixes it. Across four cry corpora screened by a multi-level leakage audit (byte-level and embedding-level deduplication plus a within-corpus train-test near-duplicate audit), we probe four frozen encoders and a handcrafted baseline under a unified five-class need ontology and shared task formulations. The audit exposes what single-corpus evaluation conceals: within-domain macro-F1 swings by 0.57-0.80 for the same encoder, cross-corpus transfer is negative on average (negative-transfer ratio 0.19-0.35, significant in 18 of 30 directed cells, BH-FDR), and 349 content-identical clip groups carry conflicting metadata labels across corpus distributions. The same audit, however, reveals a consistent way forward. Transfer into the noisiest corpus is consistently positive in effect size at matched training size and after near-duplicate removal, offering a practical recipe for small, noisy corpora. Frozen probes saturate at modest label budgets, while stabilized fine-tuning wins with full labels; domain-adaptive pretraining significantly beats stabilized fine-tuning at 5-10-shot (the 1-shot advantage is not robust to optimization-seed variance) but shows no significant advantage at 50-shot or beyond. In the tested binary, shared-label settings, ontology-mapped joint training wins in all four encoder-by-target combinations, whereas naively merging unmapped labels costs up to 37 F1 points. We release the ontology, mapping code, and audit pipeline, turning incompatible cry corpora into a usable joint-training resource.

AI.tldr: 本文对现有的婴儿啼哭语料库数据集面临的小规模、不兼容标签和评估孤立性问题进行了深入分析，提出了统一标签本体、严格的数据泄漏审计，并给出联合训练等具体改进方法。
AI.motivation: 公开婴儿啼哭语料库体量小、标签体系不一致，大多数研究只在单一语料上进行评估，导致难以推广、泛化及统一利用数据。作者关注目前评估和数据处理实践中隐藏的问题，意在找到可以让不同数据集共同利用的方法与流程。
AI.method: 引入多层次的泄露审计(包括字节级、嵌入级去重以及内部相似样本检查)，并对4个啼哭语料库、4种编码器及人工基线进行统一的五分类需求本体和共任务实验。测试了不同迁移、训练及标签统一方式对模型表现的影响。
AI.result: 泄露审计揭示单一语料评估隐瞒的现象：同一编码器在域内表现波动大，跨语料迁移平均为负；有大量内容相同但标签冲突的片段。与此同时，得出联合训练和标签映射显著优于直接标签合并的结论，提供了实际适用于小且嘈杂语料的正向迁移方案。
AI.conclusion: 本工作明确指出婴儿啼哭任务数据评估和利用的关键漏洞，并提供实用的多语料联合训练方案，发布了对应的本体、代码和流程，有助于社区更好地构建、利用和评估婴儿啼哭数据。

title: Particle-Based Conformal Prediction for Contact-Aware Uncertainty Calibration in Stratified Configuration Spaces
comment: 31 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at COPA 2026 (Conformal and Probabilistic Prediction with Applications). Project page: https://um-arm-lab.github.io/capture/
summary: Reliable uncertainty representation is essential for deploying autonomous systems that interact with their environment, as robots must reason about how uncertainty arising from both stochasticity and model mismatch is impacted by contacts with obstacles (e.g., when navigating through a cluttered environment or inserting a part into an assembly). We propose Calibrated Particle-sets for Trans-dimensional Uncertainty Representation (CaPTURe), a geometry-aware, conformal prediction-based algorithm that generates probabilistically valid prediction regions of the unknown future system configuration using particle-based models of arbitrary fidelity. While calibrated uncertainty predictions are essential for safe and efficient planning, analytical or learned motion models are often inaccurate - due to limited data, simplifying assumptions, unmodeled effects, etc. - which can lead to unsafe executions or task failure. Additionally, when a robot contacts an obstacle, the distribution of its future configurations can become multimodal or disjoint, or lie along manifolds of lower intrinsic dimension than the space of possible robot configurations. Our method uses a calibration dataset of system transitions to locally calibrate motion uncertainty estimates, constructing regions guaranteed to contain the future robot configuration at a user-set probability. Our calibration procedure captures how motion uncertainty varies between contact-rich and contactless motions, leading to sufficient coverage in both cases. We evaluate our method on two simulated planning tasks: controlling a marble around a labyrinth and performing tight-tolerance peg-in-hole insertion with a manipulator. Compared to relevant baselines, CaPTURe achieves the user-specified coverage requirement both in and out of contact and achieves up to a 30% absolute improvement in task success rate over the best baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了用于机器人运动不确定性表征的新方法CaPTURe，能在多种复杂环境下（如接触障碍物）提供更精确的概率性安全预测。
AI.motivation: 自主系统在与外部环境交互时需要对自身的不确定性进行准确建模，尤其是在存在障碍物接触的情况下。不准确的运动模型会导致安全问题或任务失败，急需可靠的不确定性估计方法。
AI.method: 提出基于几何和保序预测的校准粒子集方法（CaPTURe），用校准数据自适应局部调整不确定性估计，根据用户设定概率构建能覆盖未来状态的预测区域。
AI.result: 在两个仿真任务中（弹珠迷宫控制、机械臂插孔），CaPTURe在接触和非接触情况下都能满足精度要求，并对比基线提升任务成功率最高达30%。
AI.conclusion: CaPTURe能有效对机器人在复杂环境下的运动不确定性进行校准和表征，提高了计划的安全性与任务成功率，有望提升自主系统的实际应用可靠性。

title: SportsGrounder: Proposal-Aided Interleaved Grounding for Dense Sports Video Reasoning
summary: Sports video analysis is crucial for athletic analytics and broadcasting enhancement. Dense sports video reasoning, however, demands a fine-grained understanding of numerous small-scale, highly interactive, and visually homogeneous entities (e.g., players sharing identical uniforms, the ball) across long temporal contexts. Current Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) inherently struggle with such dense visual complexities. Due to the lack of fine-grained visual details, these models often over-rely on textual priors to guess answers, especially when distinguishing visually similar actions and players. To address this, we propose \textbf{SportsGrounder}, a framework that leverages an open-vocabulary visual expert to aid interleaved grounding specifically for dense sports video reasoning. To achieve precise spatial localization, we extract domain-guided object proposals and introduce an Interleaved Grounding Fusion (IGF) mechanism. The IGF frame-by-frame integrates explicit bounding box coordinates and implicit visual semantics with global grid features. This design preserves strict temporal alignment and prevents sequence length explosion. Furthermore, we design an Action-Aware Supervision (AAS) module that directly regularizes the model's hidden states, forcing the network to learn accurate motion representations rather than relying on language bias. Optimized with Mixed Preference Optimization (MPO) to better distinguish deceptive distractors, our extensive experiments on newly curated dense sports VQA datasets (derived from SoccerNet and FineSports) demonstrate that SportsGrounder significantly improves fine-grained reasoning and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SportsGrounder的系统，通过精准的时空定位和动作感知机制，有效提升了大型多模态模型在密集体育视频中的理解与推理能力，取得了领先表现。
AI.motivation: 当前大模型在体育视频分析（如球员、球等小目标密集、交互性强且视觉高度相似的场景）中表现欠佳，主要是因缺乏细致视觉细节，导致模型过度依赖文字推理、难以区分动作与个体。
AI.method: 提出SportsGrounder框架：（1）结合开放词表视觉专家，实现多模态密集事件的时空grounding；（2）设计了Interleaved Grounding Fusion (IGF)机制，将显式bounding box、视觉语义、全局特征融合，精准定位且保持时序一致；（3）引入Action-Aware Supervision (AAS)，直接对中间隐状态指导，避免模型只依赖语言偏见；（4）借助Mixed Preference Optimization (MPO)优化，强化区分扰动样本的能力。
AI.result: 在新构建的密集体育视频VQA数据集（基于SoccerNet和FineSports）上，SportsGrounder在细粒度推理和准确率方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: SportsGrounder显著提升了多模态模型在复杂体育视频理解中的时空对应和细致推理能力，为体育视频内容分析和应用带来更高水平的智能化支持。

title: ELICITED: EHR-grounded Longitudinal Interactive Conversations for Information-seeking Triage Evaluation and Decision-making
summary: Emergency-department (ED) triage requires clinicians to rapidly identify patients who need immediate attention, determine who can safely wait, and prioritize limited clinical resources. At presentation, however, information may be limited to a chief complaint and initial vital signs. Clinically important details, including symptom onset and progression, associated symptoms, medical history, and medication use, are often obtained through focused conversation. Effective triage therefore requires clinicians to identify information gaps, ask appropriate follow-up questions, and update their assessment as new evidence becomes available. Most existing ED benchmarks evaluate acuity prediction from a fixed clinical snapshot. Although this formulation measures predictive performance after patient information has been assembled, it does not capture the interactive process through which triage-relevant evidence is elicited and interpreted. Existing medical dialogue datasets support the study of clinical communication, but dialogue statements are not always linked to temporally ordered events in the electronic health record (EHR). We introduce EHR2Dial-Triage, an agentic conversation-generation framework and benchmark grounded in MIMIC-IV-ED. The framework constructs triage conversations under explicit role-based and temporal information boundaries. Each accepted patient disclosure is linked to its supporting EHR event and the first dialogue turn at which it becomes available. EHR2Dial-Triage enables controlled evaluation of information elicitation, evidence use, five-level Emergency Severity Index prediction, and patient-facing communication across models and patient personas. It provides a structured setting for studying conversational triage as a dynamic process of clinical information acquisition, reasoning, and communication.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了EHR2Dial-Triage，一个基于MIMIC-IV-ED数据集的急诊分诊对话生成框架和评价基准，用于研究和评测急诊分诊中的信息获取、推理和交流过程。
AI.motivation: 现有急诊分诊评价方法通常基于静态病例快照，忽视了临床信息动态获取与实时沟通的互动流程，缺乏能够连接对话与实时电子健康记录（EHR）事件的数据集与研究平台。
AI.method: 作者设计了EHR2Dial-Triage框架，建立了真实分诊场景下医生与患者的互动对话，每个患者信息披露都与支持它的EHR事件及首次被获取时点关联，严格限定角色权限和信息时序，为模型的信息获取、证据利用、分诊决策和患者交流能力提供可控的实验环境。
AI.result: EHR2Dial-Triage实现了对多模型多患者背景下，问询信息、使用证据、五级急诊严重性评估和患者沟通的系统性评测，揭示了对话式分诊中临床信息动态采集与推理能力的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为研究急诊分诊过程中临床信息获取、推理与沟通提供了结构化和动态的平台，有助于推动面向真实世界会话场景的智能分诊系统的发展。

title: SAIN: Structure-Aware Interactive Navigation with Active Dialogue Grounding for Mobile Robot
summary: Most existing vision-language navigation tasks assume that instructions are complete and unambiguous. However, real-world robots often encounter natural human instructions that are ambiguous, underspecified, or incomplete, requiring them to resolve such uncertainties through active questioning. Interactive Instance Goal Navigation (IIGN) requires an embodied agent to find the specific instance under an ambiguous category-level instruction through active dialogue. However, existing dialogue-enabled methods often consume oracle answers as transient textual context for immediate decisions, rather than persistent spatial or object-centric structured state. We present SAIN, a zero-shot framework that turns active dialogue into persistent navigation state. Instead of consuming oracle answers as one-step text hints, SAIN compiles them into target evidence, route-level corridor memory, and object-candidate labels. These states are stored in structured value, room, graph, and object memories, then consumed by a unified policy for frontier ranking and final target approach. On the VL-LN IIGN benchmark, SAIN improves SR from 20.2 to 25.4 and SPL from 13.07 to 14.17 over the strongest reported dialogue-enabled baseline, while requiring no task-specific policy training. The results support dialogue-to-state conversion as an effective zero-shot mechanism for long-horizon interactive instance navigation. Project website: https://zorattc.github.io/SAIN/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SAIN框架，将主动对话信息转化为机器人导航过程中的持续状态，实现了长时段零样本的互动导航能力。
AI.motivation: 现实场景下人类对机器人的导航指令往往含糊或不完整，现有方法通常只将对话答案作为即时决策的临时文本上下文，无法有效解决长期和复杂的导航任务。作者希望让机器人能够通过对话持久地积累知识，提升导航与目标识别能力。
AI.method: 提出SAIN（Structure-Aware Interactive Navigation）框架，将通过对话获得的答案转化为目标证据、路线记忆及目标候选标签，并以结构化的值、房间、图和对象记忆方式存储，最后由统一的策略网络指导导航和目标到达。整个流程无需针对任务进行特定策略训练，实现零样本迁移。
AI.result: 在IIGN基准下，SAIN在成功率（SR）和路径效率（SPL）等指标上分别提升到25.4和14.17，均超过最强已有的对话导航基线（分别为20.2和13.07），且无需额外训练。
AI.conclusion: 将主动对话信息结构化为导航状态是一种有效的长时段零样本互动导航机制，可显著提升机器人理解和执行复杂指令的能力。

title: FlexSplat: Flexible Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting without Point Cloud Correspondence
comment: Accepted to the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. Code: https://github.com/amir-sbg/FlexSplat
summary: We present FlexSplat, a feed-forward framework for novel view synthesis (NVS) from uncalibrated, object-centric multi-view image collections. A recent line of query-based methods reconstructs a compact set of 3D Gaussians by treating them as transformer queries that are refined with multi-view deformable attention; these methods, however, assume that camera poses are given. FlexSplat removes this assumption: a geometry transformer is trained jointly with the Gaussian decoder to predict per-image camera parameters and depth, which in turn ground a depth-guided Gaussian parameterization and a multi-view deformable cross-attention that aggregates evidence across all input views into a single, view-consistent set of primitives. An uncertainty-weighted depth-consistency objective lets the jointly trained geometry adapt to the reconstruction task, while the cross-view consensus formed during decoding absorbs the residual error of the estimated cameras and depth. The representation uses a compact Gaussian budget that is decoupled from the input resolution - unlike pixel-aligned methods, the primitive count does not grow with the image grid - and is not dictated by the number of views. On ShapeNet-SRN and Google Scanned Objects (GSO), FlexSplat matches or approaches posed state-of-the-art reconstructors while requiring neither camera poses nor ground-truth depth, and matches the best perceptual (LPIPS) quality among the compared methods on GSO. Our results indicate that a jointly trained geometry front-end is sufficient to bring calibration-free operation to query-based Gaussian reconstruction while staying within 0.7 dB PSNR of posed methods and matching their perceptual quality.

AI.tldr: FlexSplat是一种无需已知相机位姿的前馈式新视角合成方法，通过联合训练几何变换器和高斯解码器，实现对多视图图像对象的三维重建，表现接近当前已知位姿的先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于查询的方法能够利用Transformer和多视图注意力从多视图无标定集合中重建3D高斯分布，但普遍假设输入相机位姿已知。然而，在现实场景中，相机参数往往未知，因此亟需一种无需相机位姿的高效新视角合成方案。
AI.method: FlexSplat通过联合训练一个几何Transformer和高斯解码器，从每张图片中预测相机参数与深度。然后，利用预测的深度指导高斯参数化以及跨视图注意力机制，将多视图证据整合为一组一致的3D高斯基元。引入基于不确定性的深度一致性损失，使得几何预测可适应重建任务，同时在解码过程中跨视图达成一致性以吸收相机与深度估计的残差。该方法使用的高斯基元数量不会随着图像分辨率或视图数增加而变多，具备紧凑表征。
AI.result: 在ShapeNet-SRN和Google Scanned Objects(GSO)数据集上，FlexSplat无需真实相机位姿和深度即可达到与有位姿先验的先进重建方法相当甚至更优的性能，在GSO上其感知质量分数（LPIPS指标）达到所有对比方法最好。
AI.conclusion: FlexSplat证明了通过联合训练的几何前端，能够在无需相机标定的前提下，获得几乎趋近于已知位姿条件下同类方法的重建精度与感知质量，为查询驱动的高斯重建带来了无需相机标定的新路径。

title: Don't Scroll Back: Missing-Evidence Memory for Streaming Dialogue Summarization
summary: Users of modern platforms repeatedly need summaries of recent dialogue, but the window rarely contains enough context to be interpreted on its own. We formalize this setting as streaming dialogue summarization, where a system must summarize a current window using selective memory from an unbounded history under a fixed budget. We show that the central challenge is not how much history is accessed, but whether memory recovers the evidence that the current window presupposes. We construct a benchmark and evaluation protocol that separately assesses whether memory contains gap-resolving evidence and whether the generated summary reflects it. We propose ReMEMBER, a missing-evidence memory framework that conditions retrieval on unresolved window dependencies and refines retrieved chunks into evidence-dense memory under a fixed budget. Experiments on dialogues with histories up to 160K tokens show that ReMEMBER improves memory recall and gap-resolution completeness over memory construction baselines under the same budget.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了流式对话摘要的新框架和评测方法，并提出ReMEMBER模型，通过解决摘要上下文缺失证据的问题，实现更完整的对话摘要。
AI.motivation: 现代对话平台用户需要摘要，但单窗摘要缺乏足够上下文，导致摘要不完整。解决如何在固定内存预算下利用历史证据信息，是当前对话摘要系统的难点。
AI.method: 作者正式提出了流式对话摘要，并构建了关注证据恢复的基准和评测协议。核心方法是ReMEMBER框架：针对当前窗口未解决的信息依赖进行检索，提取并凝练成证据密集型的有限内存，指导摘要生成。
AI.result: 在拥有高达16万token历史的数据集上实验证明：ReMEMBER框架在相同内存预算下，能够有效提升历史证据召回率和摘要对信息空白的填补能力，优于现有记忆构建基线。
AI.conclusion: 在固定预算下，恢复和利用摘要所需的关键证据比历史窗口大小更重要，ReMEMBER能更好补全摘要所需的依赖信息，为大规模流式对话摘要提供更优解法。

title: Ultra-Low-Impedance Robotic Gripper for High-Bandwidth and Transparent Physical Interaction
summary: Conventional robotic grippers often use high-ratio transmissions to generate grasping torque and external force sensors to measure physical interaction. High-ratio transmissions increase friction, reflected inertia, and mechanical impedance, while external sensors add hardware complexity. To address these trade-offs, this study proposes a novel 9-DOF, three-fingered Differential Direct-Drive (DDD) gripper that combines DD motors with a low-ratio (1:2) differential transmission. The mechanism centralizes actuator mass at the base to minimize moving-link inertia, while the differential architecture couples two motors in parallel to amplify torque during flexion. Experiments show that the prototype delivers a nominal grasping force of approximately 18 N and a fingertip force of 4.7 N, while maintaining a low motor contribution to system inertia (0.236%) and low passive mechanical impedance, with a maximum measured value of 50.1 N/m when the motors are unpowered. The proposed hardware addresses the trade-offs among torque, physical transparency, and kinematic dexterity, providing a foundation for high-bandwidth interaction and sensorless proprioceptive force estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型9自由度三指差动直驱(DDD)机械手，兼具高扭矩输出、低惯量和高物理透明度，并简化了硬件结构。
AI.motivation: 传统机器人夹爪通常依靠高减速比传动和外部力传感器，但高减速比会增加摩擦、惯量和机械阻抗，外部传感器也增加了硬件复杂度。为解决这些权衡，提出新的机械手结构。
AI.method: 设计了一种9自由度、三指的差动直驱夹爪，将直驱电机和低减速比(1:2)差动传动结合，通过差动结构实现两台电机并联放大屈曲时的扭矩，并将驱动质量集中于基座以降低运动部件惯量。
AI.result: 实验显示，该原型夹爪可实现约18N的抓持力和4.7N的指尖力，电机对系统惯量贡献仅0.236%，且无源机械阻抗很低（最大50.1N/m）。
AI.conclusion: 新型结构在扭矩输出、物理透明性和运动灵巧性之间实现了良好平衡，为高带宽交互和无传感器的自身力感知提供了硬件基础。

title: LAD-COD: Language-Aligned Dense Perception for Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: Camouflaged object detection (COD) aims to segment objects that exhibit high visual similarity to their surroundings, which reduces foreground-background discriminability and weakens boundary evidence across appearance, texture, and structure. Such limitations motivate the use of instruction-conditioned semantics as top-down guidance for identifying which weak visual cues are relevant to the target. Recent segmentation systems built on large multimodal models (LMMs) demonstrate this possibility through instruction-conditioned target embeddings that guide mask decoding. However, in this language-to-mask paradigm, the generated target embedding conditions mainly the mask decoder, leaving the dense visual features that must preserve low-contrast boundaries and fine local structure without explicit guidance. We propose Language-Aligned Dense perception for COD (LAD-COD), a framework that aligns top-down semantic target guidance with bottom-up hierarchical visual features. Instead of fully adapting a large generic image encoder, LAD-COD learns a trainable hierarchical visual branch that captures camouflage-sensitive texture, boundary, and contextual information. To align these features with the target embedding, LAD-COD applies Language-Aligned Dual Visual Fusion (LADVF), which extends the embedding beyond sparse prompting to query patch-level language-aligned features and to gate their residual integration with the hierarchical features. This design allows semantic information to guide localization while preserving the fine structural details needed for camouflage segmentation. Experiments on CAMO, COD10K, and NC4K show that LAD-COD obtains the best reported value in all 12 dataset-metric comparisons.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了LAD-COD框架，通过语言对视觉特征的对齐，有效提升了伪装目标检测的分割表现，在多个基准数据集和指标上都取得了最佳成绩。
AI.motivation: 伪装目标检测任务因目标与背景极度相似，边界弱，视觉分离困难，导致现有方法难以准确分割目标。近期多模态大模型虽然引入语言指导，但大多只在掩码解码器层面进行条件控制，未充分利用语言在视觉特征提取过程中的指导价值。
AI.method: 作者提出LAD-COD框架，专门设计了可训练的分层视觉分支，捕捉对伪装敏感的纹理、边界和上下文信息；同时引入LADVF方法，将语言编码的目标特征与分层视觉特征对齐，通过补充的patch级语言对齐特征融合，引导精准定位和精细结构的分割。
AI.result: 在CAMO、COD10K和NC4K三个伪装目标检测数据集上，LAD-COD的方法在12项数据集-指标组合中均取得最优结果，显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入语言引导且和视觉特征紧密对齐的新框架，LAD-COD显著提升了伪装目标检测任务的表现，验证了从视觉特征提取到解码全流程的语义引导的重要性。

title: Tree-of-Experience: Hierarchical Experience Management for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Continual self-evolution requires LLM agents to transform environmental interactions into reliable and reusable experience. Existing methods typically refine individual trajectories or abstract shared knowledge from related trajectories, but their experience representations are often disconnected from the underlying reasoning process. This limits feedback attribution, cross-task transfer, and update and retrieval efficiency, particularly in complex reasoning tasks with outcome-level feedback. To overcome this limitation, we propose \textbf{T}ree-\textbf{o}f-\textbf{E}xperience (ToE), a structured experience-management framework that aligns experience organization with the hierarchical reasoning process of LLM agents. Specifically, ToE organizes the experience into a shared tree of analytical perspectives and reasoning paths, whose reliability is calibrated through environmental outcomes to support systematic updating, transfer, and efficient retrieval. The experimental results on \textsc{Game of 24} and \textsc{FinEvolveBench} show that ToE substantially improves both problem-solving performance and efficiency. On \textsc{Game of 24}, ToE achieves a 31.4\% relative improvement in accuracy over the experience-free ToT baseline. On \textsc{FinEvolveBench}, ToE improves tsIC by an average of 41.24\% over the experience-free pipeline across 12 evaluation settings, whereas conventional experience-management methods often underperform experience-free baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ToE（Tree-of-Experience）的经验管理框架，用于提升大语言模型智能体持续自演化能力，通过与推理过程结构对齐的方式组织和利用环境交互经验，显著提升了复杂推理任务中的表现和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有经验管理方法的经验表征与底层推理过程脱节，导致复杂推理任务中反馈归因、跨任务迁移以及高效更新和检索变得困难。
AI.method: 提出ToE框架，将经验按照推理树结构组织，对不同分析视角和推理路径上累积的经验进行环境反馈校准，使经验管理和推理过程高度协同，便于更新、迁移与高效检索。
AI.result: 在Game of 24和FinEvolveBench两个任务上，ToE明显提升了问题求解精度和效率。其中，在Game of 24上精度相对基础线提升31.4%，在FinEvolveBench上跨12个评测设置平均提升41.24%，优于传统经验管理方法。
AI.conclusion: ToE框架通过结构化经验与大语言模型推理过程对齐，可大幅提升LLM智能体在复杂推理与经验迁移任务中的表现和效率，优于现有经验管理手段。

title: Task-Oriented Formation Decision via Reinforcement Learning: Herding an Attacking Swarm
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
summary: Multi-robot systems can accomplish tasks that are difficult for a single robot by organizing into task-specific formations. Different from existing studies on multi-robot shape formation, we here study the task-oriented formation decision problem, with a focus on the herding task. This task is challenging due to the attackers' superior maneuverability and their unknown strategies. To address these challenges, we propose the following novel results. First, we encode the formation shape using a low-dimensional parameter vector. This parametric representation reformulates the formation decision as a parameter optimization problem, thereby resolving the limited flexibility of predefined shapes. By optimizing these formation parameters, the defenders' maneuverability disadvantage is mitigated through a formation shape that continuously adapts to task requirements. Second, we develop a reinforcement learning-based policy to regulate the formation parameters. Trained offline in simulations covering diverse attacking strategies, the learned policy can effectively handle adversarial unpredictability during online deployment. Comparative simulations against three baselines demonstrate that our method can successfully accomplish challenging herding tasks. Additional scalability simulations further verify its applicability to simulated scenarios involving dozens of robots. We also validate the practical feasibility of our method on a physical robotic platform with 3 attackers and 7 defenders.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多机器人系统的新型自适应编队方法，特别针对驱赶任务，通过参数化表示编队形状，并利用强化学习优化，实现对复杂对手策略的适应。方法在仿真和实体机器人平台上均验证了有效性和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 传统多机器人编队研究多集中于预定义形状，难以应对攻击者机动性强和策略未知的实际驱赶任务，因此需要一种能够动态自适应任务需求的编队决策方法。
AI.method: 将编队形状用低维参数向量编码，将编队决策转化为参数优化问题。通过强化学习训练调节形状参数的策略，该策略在涵盖多种攻击方式的仿真环境中离线训练，并在线部署以应对不可预测的对手行为。
AI.result: 提出的方法在与三个基线方法的比较仿真中表现优越，能够成功完成具有挑战性的驱赶任务，并通过可扩展性测试展示对数十个机器人场景的适用性。在实际七防御三攻击的机器人平台实验中也验证了可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够有效减缓防御者在机动性上的劣势，通过动态自适应的编队优化，提升多人机器人系统在复杂驱赶任务中的协作效率和实际应用可能性。

title: SynVAR: Synergizing Spatial and Semantic Alignment in Visual Autoregressive Model
summary: VAR has gained widespread popularity due to its next-scale prediction paradigm. However, it faces substantial performance bottlenecks when handling complex scenes with multiple objects and attributes. Existing diffusion-based enhancement methods fail to adequately address the unique challenge of cross-scale error propagation and accumulation in VAR. To this end, we propose SynVAR, the first training-free enhancement framework specifically tailored for the VAR paradigm, which introduces a spatial-semantic collaborative control strategy to effectively suppress propagation error and improve generation quality. SynVAR comprises three key components: (1) Global guidance to ensure reasonable spatial structure in the early stages, (2) Receptive field constraints to mitigate early-stage semantic confusion, (3) High-frequency compensation to recover fine-grained details. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the significant improvements in the ability of SynVAR to enhance the VAR's capability for complex scene modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种创新的VAR（基于自回归视觉生成）增强框架SynVAR，通过空间-语义协同控制，有效缓解跨尺度误差传播，提升复杂场景生成质量。
AI.motivation: VAR方法面临在复杂多目标、多属性场景中的性能瓶颈，现有扩散模型增强方案难以解决跨尺度误差传播和累积的问题。
AI.method: 提出SynVAR框架，通过训练无关方式增强VAR，包含三大模块：全局引导（保持空间结构合理）、感受野约束（减少语义混淆）、高频补偿（恢复细节）。
AI.result: 通过大量定量和定性实验，验证了SynVAR显著提升了VAR在复杂场景建模方面的能力和生成效果。
AI.conclusion: SynVAR为VAR提供了高效的增强方案，能更好地应对多目标多属性复杂场景，有效缓解跨尺度误差问题，提升生成质量。

title: Bridging the Gap Between Semantics and Reconstruction:Unifying Sign Language Translation and Production
summary: Recent advances in sign language (SL) research have shown a trend toward unifying multiple sign language understanding (SLU) subtasks, such as isolated sign language recognition (ISLR), continuous sign language recognition (CSLR), and sign language translation (SLT), within a single framework, leading to substantial progress. Meanwhile, sign language production (SLP), which generates sign sequences from text, has also attracted growing attention. This naturally raises an important question: can sign language understanding and production be unified within a single framework? Compared with unifying SLU subtasks, this problem is substantially more challenging. Existing SLU tasks largely share the same direction of mapping, namely from sign inputs to linguistic outputs, whereas SLT and SLP lie in opposite directions of sign-text mapping. A unified framework must therefore address two key challenges: (1) bridging the modality gap between continuous sign motions and discrete text tokens through a shared sign tokenizer that supports both linguistic abstraction and motion reconstruction; and (2) learning a single conditional autoregressive model that can take either sign or text as input and generate the corresponding target sequence in the opposite modality. To this end, we propose Uni-SLTP, a unified framework for SLT and SLP with two key components: (1) a shared sign tokenizer that converts sign sequences into discrete tokens and latent representations, capturing both semantic and reconstructive information; and (2) a unified autoregressive generation model that formulates both tasks as conditional sequence generation. Experiments on widely used public datasets show that Uni-SLTP achieves superior motion accuracy for SLP while maintaining competitive SLT performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Uni-SLTP框架，首次实现了手语理解和生成的统一，能够同时进行手语翻译(SLT)和手语生成(SLP)任务，并在公开数据集上取得了优异的实验结果。
AI.motivation: 手语理解(SLU)任务如识别与翻译已有一定进展，但“理解（手语到文本）”与“生成（文本到手语）”仍未统一，为实现手语多任务融合，推动实际应用，需提出统一框架。
AI.method: 提出了包含两个关键组件的Uni-SLTP：1）共享的手语分词器，将手语动作序列离散化为token，并兼顾语义抽象与运动重建；2）统一的自回归生成模型，将手语翻译和生成统一为条件序列生成任务。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，Uni-SLTP在手语生成（SLP）上的运动准确性显著优于现有方法，同时手语翻译（SLT）表现与主流方法持平，显示出统一框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次成功统一了手语的理解与生产任务，为手语技术的多任务集成和实际应用提供了新思路。

title: WorldSimProbe: Diagnosing Simulator Faithfulness in Action-Conditioned World Models for Embodied Manipulation
comment: 20 pages, 18 figures, and 10 tables, including supplementary material. Code and data: https://evophys.com/WorldSimProbe/
summary: Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) promise to provide embodied AI with scalable predictive simulators for planning, policy evaluation, and data generation. Realizing this promise requires precise action-conditioned transitions rather than merely plausible outputs. Yet their applicability remains difficult to establish because prevailing evaluations emphasize visual quality, task outcomes, or coarse rollout-level responsiveness without directly testing simulator fidelity. To address this gap, we evaluate ACWMs through the observable capabilities expected of physical simulators. Accordingly, we formalize Observable Simulator Contract, a minimal contract that any action-conditioned physical simulator should satisfy: supplied actions must induce corresponding agent motion, and environment responses must be grounded in that realized motion. To operationalize this contract, we introduce WorldSimProbe, comprising five controlled suites spanning local control sensitivity, global trajectory variation, source-diverse actions, interaction grounding, and dynamics. Suite-specific evaluators assess simulator-relative calibration, dense action-to-motion correspondence, false-interaction grounding, and primitive-level dynamics. We evaluate six open-source ACWMs on more than 18,000 instances across RoboTwin, ManiSkill, and LIBERO. World-SimProbe reveals systematic action-realization degradation across control variation, structured failures in interaction grounding and dynamics, and benchmark signals consistent with human judgments and downstream outcomes. Together, this capability-based framework provides a transparent, and standardized paradigm for diagnosing ACWM simulator fidelity beyond coarse, task-directed evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对动作条件世界模型（ACWM）评估的新标准与工具，通过具身AI需要的可观测特性来衡量模拟器真实度，而不是只关注视觉或任务结果。
AI.motivation: 现有ACWM的评估方法不直接测试模拟器的物理忠实性，只关注视觉质量、任务表现或整体响应，无法证明其在实际具身智能中的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出了“可观测模拟器契约”，明确要求模拟器输入的动作必须引起相应的运动，环境反应必须基于该运动；据此设计了WorldSimProbe评估工具，包括五个子测试套件（局部控制敏感性、全局轨迹变化、动作来源多样性、交互着地性和动力学），并制定了细致的评估指标。
AI.result: 在三个平台共18000+个案例上评测了六个主流ACWM模型，发现它们在控制变化、多样交互和动力学方面都有系统性精度下降和结构性失败，WorldSimProbe的评测信号也与人工及实际任务表现高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究为ACWM的真实性评估提供了可操作、透明和标准的框架，有助于推动高保真动作条件世界模型的开发及应用。

title: LIBAD: A Multimodal Anomaly Detection Benchmark for Li-Ion Battery Electrode Manufacturing
summary: Multimodal industrial anomaly detection has largely focused on discrete products using strongly correlated RGB and 3D observations, leaving continuous process manufacturing and weakly correlated sensing modalities underexplored. We introduce LIBAD, the first multimodal anomaly detection benchmark for Li-ion battery electrode manufacturing. Collected from real roll-to-roll production lines, LIBAD provides aligned double-sided visible-light imaging, high-resolution X-ray radiography, and inline-compatible low-resolution X-ray radiography. Electrode patches in LIBAD exhibit highly homogeneous material appearance, while defect evidence can be strong in one modality but weak or absent in another, resulting in pronounced cross-modal anomaly inconsistency. Benchmarks of representative methods under the inline-compatible visible-light and low-resolution X-ray setting exhibit limited transferability and consistently high false-positive rates. We therefore propose DA-Core, a memory-based method that jointly considers feature-space coverage and local density of normal features during coreset selection, allowing compact memory banks to better preserve fine-grained normal variations. With a coreset ratio of 0.05, DA-Core reduces FPR95 from 60.4% to 54.3% compared with standard farthest point sampling. At this ratio, DA-Core also outperforms the best standard coreset result (obtained at 0.20) while reducing inference time by 43.9%. These results suggest that both the data distribution of normal features and the modality relationship itself require explicit consideration when designing anomaly detection methods for process manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个针对锂离子电池电极制造过程的多模态异常检测基准LIBAD，并提出了更有效的DA-Core方法，显著降低了误报率和推理时间。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态工业异常检测主要关注离散产品且依赖强相关模态（如RGB与3D），但对于连续制程制造和弱相关多模态的检测研究较少。锂离子电池的电极制造存在模态相关性弱、部分缺陷仅在特定模态显著等难点，因此急需专门的数据集和方法。
AI.method: 作者建立了LIBAD数据集，包括对齐的双面可见光图像、高分辨率和低分辨率X射线数据，且针对实际生产线采集数据。评估了主流方法后，提出了DA-Core方法：基于记忆库，通过联合考虑特征空间覆盖度与局部密度来选择更紧凑有效的样本子集（coreset），提升对正常样本多样性的覆盖能力。
AI.result: 在相同子集采样比例下（0.05），DA-Core将FPR95从60.4%降至54.3%，显著优于标准方法（尤其在减少推理时延43.9%时仍能保持更好性能）。在更低采样率下DA-Core依然优于标准方法在高采样比时的结果。
AI.conclusion: 异常检测方法在过程制造领域时需显式考虑正常样本的分布以及多模态之间的相关性。LIBAD和DA-Core为电池制造等场景提供了新的基准和更优方法。

title: Measuring the Tokenization Premium: A Cost Audit for Underserved Language Communities
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as general-purpose educational and technical assistance systems, but their underlying infrastructure does not treat languages equally. One underexamined source of disparity is tokenization: semantically equivalent content can require substantially different token counts across languages, affecting API cost, latency, and usable context length before a model is invoked. We introduce the Tokenization Equity Audit (TEA), a reproducible benchmark for measuring tokenization premiums in technical tutoring content. TEA evaluates three widely used tokenizers, GPT-4o's o200k base, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B, on a 120-item Python debugging corpus translated from English into Bengali, Hindi, Arabic, Tamil, and Yoruba. Bengali and Hindi serve as the primary validated cases, while the remaining languages provide exploratory cross-script and cross-family comparisons. Across this corpus, Bengali requires (1.56\times) as many GPT-4o tokens as English, reducing a nominal 128k-token context window to an effective 82k-token English-equivalent capacity for the same semantic content. With the Qwen2.5 and Mistral tokenizers, Bengali requires up to (4.5\times) the English token count. Yoruba, despite using the Latin script, exhibits the highest GPT-4o tokenization premium at (2.37\times), indicating that tokenization inequity cannot be explained by script family alone. These results demonstrate that tokenization can create measurable economic and functional barriers, highlighting the need to treat tokenization as an equity-relevant infrastructure layer for underserved language communities, particularly where educational systems depend on low-cost or offline-capable AI tools.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Tokenization Equity Audit (TEA)基准，评估不同语言在大模型分词器下的token不公平性，发现如孟加拉语等非英语内容需要显著更多的token，带来实际成本和功能限制。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在教育和技术协助领域广泛部署，但目前分词基础设施对不同语言并不公平，不同语言在token消耗上的巨大差异被忽视，进而影响模型调用成本和实际上下文窗口长度。
AI.method: 提出Tokenization Equity Audit (TEA)基准，选取Python调试内容，翻译为英语、孟加拉语、印地语、阿拉伯语、泰米尔语和约鲁巴语，利用GPT-4o、Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B三种主流分词器，测量各语言token消耗对比。重点验证孟加拉语和印地语，其他语言做额外对照。
AI.result: 孟加拉语使用GPT-4o分词器时token数为英语的1.56倍，有效减少了模型可用上下文长度，Qwen2.5和Mistral分词器下这个比率最高达4.5倍。约鲁巴语在GPT-4o下的token溢价最高（2.37倍），且token数量差异不仅与文字书写系统相关。
AI.conclusion: 分词器的不平等导致经济和功能障碍，建议将tokenization视为影响弱势语言社区公平性的重要基础层，未来应改进以提升教育等实际应用中的语言公平性。

title: SAFE-CHEM: Uncertainty-Aware Policy Switching for Robust Robotic Chemistry
summary: The deployment of autonomous robotic systems in chemistry laboratories is accelerating experimental workflows and providing the foundational data for AI-driven scientific discovery. However, despite the success of data-driven methods in acquiring dexterous skills, safety remains a primary barrier to their deployment in high-risk domains, such as early-stage materials chemistry experiments. Specifically, learning-based policies frequently struggle to distinguish between safe and unsafe actions, leading to overconfident extrapolation and potentially catastrophic failures. To mitigate these safety risks, we propose SAFE-CHEM, an uncertainty-aware framework designed for robust, learning-based robotic chemists. Our approach leverages an ensemble of recurrent neural network-based imitation learning policies to quantify epistemic uncertainty online through the variance of action predictions. By characterising the success-conditioned density of this variance using kernel density estimation, we introduce a hybrid control architecture that autonomously switches from the learned policy to a deterministic, rule-based backup controller when uncertainty exceeds a calibrated safety threshold. We evaluate SAFE-CHEM across three fundamental laboratory manipulation tasks, where our empirical results demonstrate that this hybrid strategy improves overall task success rates and reduces critical safety violations compared to traditional single-policy baselines. Finally, we demonstrate the practical viability of the framework through zero-shot sim-to-real transfer onto a physical Franka Production 3 robot manipulator.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了SAFE-CHEM框架，提高了自主机器人化学实验安全性，通过不确定性感知在关键时刻切换控制，显著提升实验成功率和安全性。
AI.motivation: 自主机器人系统在化学实验室中日益普及，加快了实验进程，并为AI驱动的科学发现提供数据。但现有基于学习的策略难以辨别安全与不安全行动，会出现过度自信和灾难性错误，安全是推广的主要障碍。
AI.method: 引入SAFE-CHEM不确定性感知框架，基于RNN集成模仿学习策略，通过动作预测方差在线量化认知不确定性，并利用核密度估计建模成功任务下的方差分布。提出混合控制结构：当不确定性超过设定阈值时，从学习策略切换至确定性、规则驱动的安全控制器。
AI.result: 在三个基础实验室操作任务中，SAFE-CHEM混合策略相较于单一策略基线，大幅提升了任务成功率并减少关键安全违规。并在Franka Production 3机器人上实现了零样本仿真到现实的转移，验证其实用性。
AI.conclusion: SAFE-CHEM为高风险化学实验室机器人提供了一种兼顾学习能力与安全性的解决方案，有效推动了AI驱动科学实验的可靠性和实际应用落地。

title: Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models
summary: Streaming world models predict future visual states online while maintaining physically coherent dynamics over long horizons. However, their rollouts often violate basic physical constraints. A common approach distills pretrained bidirectional DiTs into few-step causal generators. However, this paradigm suffers from two fundamental limitations: generic bidirectional teachers acquire limited physical priors from visually oriented pretraining, and the limited priors suffer further loss during bidirectional-to-causal distillation. We present PhyS, a three-stage framework for distilling physical priors into streaming world models. To acquire physical priors from real-world interactions, we construct PhyS-120K, a dataset of 120K real-world physical-interaction videos spanning rigid-body dynamics, soft-body deformation, fluid phenomena, and phase transitions. Each video is annotated with structured descriptions of object properties and causal state transitions. Physics-aware supervised fine-tuning injects the physical priors into a bidirectional 14B DiT teacher, which we then distill into a lightweight 1.3B causal DiT for few-step autoregressive streaming generation. Finally, we use online reinforcement learning to incentivize the distilled model to generate physically plausible rollouts and further propose Temporal Credit Routing (TCR) to address temporal credit assignment. TCR evaluates physical consistency over overlapping temporal windows and routes the resulting group-relative advantages to temporally aligned denoising actions. On PhysicsIQ, PhyS improves the Wan2.1-14B teacher by 18.2\% and the Self Forcing, Rolling Forcing, and Causal Forcing by 23.7\%, 14.8\%, and 31.4\%, respectively. Results also improve the physics-aware video benchmarks VideoPhy, VideoPhy2, and PhyGenBench. The dataset, code, and more sample videos are available on our Project Page.

AI.tldr: PhyS提出了一种三阶段蒸馏物理先验至流式世界模型的方法，结合大规模物理交互视频数据集、物理感知微调与在线强化学习以提升模型在长时视觉预测中的物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有流式世界模型在长时预测中物理一致性较差，主流的通过蒸馏双向模型至因果生成器方法存在物理先验提取有限和先验损失的问题。该研究旨在提升世界模型对现实物理规律的理解和生成能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出PhyS三阶段框架：先构建包含12万条物理交互视频和结构化标注的数据集PhyS-120K。2) 通过物理感知监督对14B参数量的双向教师DiT进行微调以注入物理先验。3) 将物理感知先验蒸馏进1.3B参数量的因果DiT，借助在线强化学习优化其物理一致性，并引入TCR方法解决长时序归因难题。
AI.result: 在PhysicsIQ基准上，相比Wan2.1-14B教师，PhyS提升18.2%；对比Self Forcing、Rolling Forcing和Causal Forcing方法分别提升23.7%、14.8%和31.4%。在VideoPhy、VideoPhy2和PhyGenBench等物理视频基准上也实现了显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合大规模物理交互数据、物理感知微调以及在线强化学习，PhyS有效提升了流式世界模型的物理一致性和泛化能力，为物理推理相关任务提供了新的思路和实用工具。

title: Security and Privacy Taxonomy Generation from Mobile App Reviews
summary: Mobile app reviews are a rich, continuously renewing source of how users experience privacy and security, yet existing taxonomies of these concerns are hand-crafted and cannot keep pace with the evolving nature of the data. Automating taxonomy construction is the natural response, but scalability is the core challenge: current LLM- and clustering-based methods are developed for scientific corpora of a few thousand documents and do not extend to app review collections numbering in the hundreds of thousands. We address this gap in two ways. First, we filter app reviews for privacy- and security-related content, yielding a comprehensive corpus of over 600K reviews. Second, we introduce TaxoScale, a pipeline that handles taxonomy construction at this scale by extending an expert-defined taxonomy via Recursive Hierarchical Clustering and LLM-based node naming. TaxoScale outperforms strong automatic-taxonomy baselines on path, level, coverage, and novelty metrics, and discovers novel branches absent from prior taxonomies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一种大规模自动构建隐私与安全评论分类体系的方法，通过处理超过60万条移动应用评论，有效扩展了原有专家类目，并在多项指标上优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 现有针对隐私与安全的评论分类体系依赖人工构建，难以跟上评论数据规模和语义更新的速度，需开发可自动扩展的新方案。
AI.method: 作者首先筛选大量APP评论，构建涵盖60多万条评论的大规模数据集。随后提出TaxoScale流程，结合递归层次聚类和大模型命名，基于专家起始类目自动扩展和细化评论类型。
AI.result: TaxoScale在分类路径、层级、覆盖度和发现新类别等多项标准上均优于现有自动化基线，并发现了此前从未归纳的新类别分支。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的TaxoScale方法实现了对海量APP隐私与安全评论的高效自动分类，为大规模数据下的类别体系构建提供了新思路，推动了自动化语义分析发展。

title: DH-VLM: Dual-Horizon Cooperative Latent Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Large-scale language models for autonomous driving enable enhanced global understanding and long-horizon planning. However, when deployed in isolated vehicles, limited sensing range and occlusions restrict reliable decision-making, and the substantial computational and latency overhead makes on-board deployment impractical. Cooperative driving provides a potential solution by leveraging external agents for information exchange, but existing methods remain limited in semantic reasoning capability under practical constraints. To address these challenges, we propose DH-VLM, a dual-horizon cooperative latent reasoning framework that enables asymmetric semantic cooperation between the infrastructure and ego vehicle. The infrastructure aggregates multi-layer hidden states to form a global-reasoning horizon latent guidance, which is integrated into the ego model through an Infrastructure-Driven Latent Evolution mechanism for conditional latent refinement. This enables the ego vehicle to leverage long-range contextual understanding while preserving autonomous decision-making within its local planning horizon. Furthermore, we construct a cooperation-oriented question-answer (QA) dataset covering fundamental scene understanding and ego-personalized comprehension to support counterfactual and safety-aware reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DH-VLM achieves state-of-the-art planning performance, outperforming the previous state of the art by 14.6% in L2 error and 26.9% in collision rate. Compared with query-based end-to-end cooperative driving methods, our approach reduces the communication cost by 57.3% and GPU memory usage by 25.5%, while maintaining strong robustness against infrastructure guidance errors, providing a practical and robust paradigm for cooperative autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新颖的合作自动驾驶推理框架DH-VLM，在基础设施与自动驾驶汽车之间实现非对称、分层语义协作，提升全局感知和规划能力，同时降低通信和计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有大型语言模型虽然能提升自动驾驶车辆的全球感知与长时规划能力，但在车载部署时受限于感知范围与遮挡、算力和延迟；而传统的协作驾驶又存在语义推理能力受限等实际问题。急需一种既能提升全局理解，又能规避硬件瓶颈，并可在实际场景下稳健运行的新方法。
AI.method: 论文提出DH-VLM框架，在基础设施和自动驾驶车辆之间实现双时域（分层协同、条件推理）语义交流：基础设施端通过聚合多层隐状态生成全局推理指导，并通过“基础设施驱动潜变量演化机制”与车端模型交互，从而优化车辆本地的语义表示和决策。同时，作者构建了以合作为导向的QA数据集，涵盖场景理解和个性化推理以测试推理能力。
AI.result: DH-VLM在一系列实验中表现突出：较以往方法L2误差降低14.6%，碰撞率降低26.9%；较基于查询的端到端协作方法，通信开销下降57.3%、GPU显存降低25.5%，并在基础设施指导有误时仍具备强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DH-VLM为合作自动驾驶提供了一种实用且高效的新范式，有效平衡了全局与本地推理、算力与通信需求，显著提升了自动驾驶系统的性能与应用前景。

title: AdaDINO: Pair-Aware In-Backbone Adaptation of Frozen DINO for Efficient Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Vision foundation models (VFMs) such as DINO are pretrained for single-image representation, whereas remote sensing change detection requires reasoning over a bi-temporal pair. Existing VFM-based methods usually encode the two images independently and compare them only afterward, leaving the VFM backbone unaware of cross-temporal relations. To bridge this mismatch, we present AdaDINO, a pair-aware in-backbone adaptation framework that equips a frozen DINO encoder with bi-temporal interaction for efficient change detection. Its core component, Change-aware Gated Local Adaptation (CGLA), couples the two streams after selected frozen blocks and injects a shared temporal residual into them with opposite signs, enhancing genuine change responses while preserving the pair midpoint. Batch-Shared Chunk Selection (BSCS) further reduces feed-forward network (FFN) computation by retaining a batch-shared subset of channel chunks that can be executed as a compact dense FFN. A CGLA-Prior-Guided Refinement (CPGR) decoder reuses encoder-side change responses for coarse-to-fine prediction. Experiments on four remote sensing change detection benchmarks show that AdaDINO achieves competitive or superior performance against VFM-based baselines, with the largest gain on the category-agnostic SYSU-CD dataset. With 62.5% of the FFN hidden width removed, AdaDINO still achieves an F1 score of 85.29% on SYSU-CD while delivering a 1.41$\times$ throughput speedup. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaDINO框架，针对遥感变化检测任务对单帧视觉基础模型（如DINO）进行双时相适配，实现高效、精确的变化检测，同时显著提升运算效率。
AI.motivation: 主流VFMs如DINO仅对单张图片表征良好，但遥感变化检测需要对比时相对的两张图片。现有方法多独立编码图片后比较，忽略了时序间的互动关系，限制了变化检测性能。
AI.method: 提出AdaDINO框架，在冻结的DINO编码器内部引入Change-aware Gated Local Adaptation（CGLA）模块，使双时相图片在骨干网络内交互，通过残差机制增强真实变化响应。Batch-Shared Chunk Selection（BSCS）进一步精简前馈神经网络计算，提升效率。CGLA-Prior-Guided Refinement（CPGR）解码器利用编码器得到的变化响应，提供粗到细的预测。
AI.result: 在四个遥感变化检测基准上，AdaDINO表现优异，尤其在类别无关的SYSU-CD数据集取得显著提升。即使将FFN隐宽削减62.5%，F1分数仍达85.29%，且推理速度提升1.41倍。
AI.conclusion: AdaDINO有效提升遥感变化检测精度和效率，验证了在VFM基础上引入双时相编码与计算压缩机制的有效性及实用性。

title: When Confidence Fails: Overconfidence in LLMs under Uncertainty and Missing Clinical Information
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in medical question answering and clinical reasoning tasks. However, their reliability under uncertainty remains poorly understood which raises critical concerns for deployment in high-stakes clinical settings. In such environments, incorrect predictions are inherently risky, but confident incorrect predictions can be particularly harmful as they may mislead clinical decision-making. In this paper, we conduct a systematic behavioral analysis of LLMs under clinical information uncertainty. We propose an evaluation framework based on the MedMCQA dataset consisting of two complementary uncertainty settings. First, we introduce linguistic uncertainty cues through prompt modifications to simulate ambiguous clinical contexts. Second, we construct an answer removal setting, wherein the correct option is deliberately excluded mandating the model to recognize insufficient information and abstain. We analyze both model accuracy and confidence behavior using multiple calibration metrics including calibration gap, Expected Calibration Error (ECE), and Unsafe Confident Error Rate (UCER) across 500 medical questions. Our results reveal a consistent failure mode, i.e., although accuracy degrades under increasing uncertainty, model confidence remains misaligned with accuracy. This leads to a substantial increase in unsafe confident errors, indicating that model confidence remains largely insensitive to clinically meaningful information loss. Furthermore, we observe significant variation across models in their ability to abstain when the correct answer is unavailable, with some models persistently producing high confidence hallucinated answers. These findings expose critical limitations in the epistemic reliability of current LLMs and highlight the need for uncertainty aware evaluation methods prior to their deployment in clinical workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了大语言模型（LLMs）在面对临床不确定性信息时的行为表现，指出模型在高不确定性下往往自信但不准确，存在显著风险。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLMs在医学问答和推理任务中表现优异，但其在信息不确定下的可靠性尚未明确，而在临床等高风险场景中，过度自信的错误可能导致严重后果。
AI.method: 作者基于MedMCQA数据集设计了两种不确定性环境：一是通过修改提示模拟语言不确定性；二是故意移除正确答案，要求模型能识别信息不足并选择弃答。对模型准确率和置信度行为进行了标定分析，包括标定缺口、期望标定误差（ECE）和不安全自信错误率（UCER）。
AI.result: 在不确定性提升下，模型准确率下降，但置信度未同步调整，导致不安全自信错误大幅增加。不同模型在正确答案缺失时弃答能力差异大，有些模型依然自信地生成错误答案。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLMs在处理临床不确定性信息时的置信可靠性显著不足，需开发更具不确定性感知能力的评估方法，确保其安全应用于临床流程中。

title: JEPA-WAM: Learning Vision-Language-Action Policies with Joint-Embedding World Modeling
summary: Robust robot control benefits from explicitly modeling state transitions, but video-generation world action models (WAMs) introduce substantial deployment cost. Existing latent WAMs avoid explicit future generation, but often compress predictive representations or separate predictive modeling from the representations used for action generation. We introduce JEPA-WAM, a latent WAM built in a pretrained V-JEPA space, which couples latent transition prediction with continuous action generation through a shared predictor. JEPA-WAM predicts a spatially structured joint current-future target that captures task-shared visual temporal structure between current and future observations, while preserving dense patch-level correspondence. Through the shared predictor, transition supervision directly shapes the backbone, from which dedicated representations are extracted for action prediction. The same design can also be instantiated in pretrained VLA policies while preserving their original perception and action pathways. On LIBERO-Plus, JEPA-WAM achieves 79.2%, the best result without large-scale robot-policy pretraining, while its pretrained $π_{0.5}$ instantiation reaches 86.3%, achieving the best overall performance. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-world bimanual manipulation further demonstrate strong generalization under visual and spatial shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了JEPA-WAM，一种建立在预训练V-JEPA空间上的潜在世界动作模型，通过共享预测器耦合状态预测与动作生成，有效提升了机器人控制的预测能力与泛化性能，在多个平台上取得最佳或有竞争力的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成型世界动作模型部署成本高，潜在型WAM虽然避免了显式未来生成，但信息压缩和表征-预测脱钩等问题限制了控制性能，因此需要更高效、紧密结合预测与动作生成的WAM。
AI.method: JEPA-WAM在V-JEPA空间中，设计了共享预测器直接预测现在与未来的联合目标，保持视觉空间结构和patch级别对应，通过预测器直接影响Backbone特征，用于动作预测，并能无缝适配于现有VLA策略。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Plus等数据集上，无需大规模机器人策略预训练的JEPA-WAM获得79.2%准确率，预训练强化后的版本达到86.3%，实验也在RoboTwin 2.0和真实机器人双臂任务上表现出良好的视觉和空间泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: JEPA-WAM通过潜在空间建模、结构预测与动作生成紧密结合，实现了机器人视觉控制新的性能突破，为高效泛化机器人控制提供了有效的范式。

title: AgriField-40K: Adapting Vision Models to Agriculture With Efficient Continual Pretraining
comment: Accepted at the Computer Vision in Plant Phenotyping and Agriculture (CVPPA) Workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: Field-based agricultural computer vision is important for precision agriculture, yet it largely depends on expensive annotations and costly adaptation of large pretrained models. We introduce AgriField-40K, a field-centric dataset curated from 17 public resources and covering diverse crops, weeds, and field conditions. Building on this, we present AgriMAE, a parameter-efficient continual pretraining baseline that adapts a masked autoencoder pretrained on natural images by training only lightweight adapters. We further explore semantic feature reconstruction as an alternative pretraining objective and evaluate transfer across multiple tasks. AgriMAE consistently improves downstream performance and can match or even outperform full fine-tuning while using up to $9\times$ fewer trainable parameters, showing that AgriField-40K is a practical resource for continual pretraining in agricultural vision. Project page: https://dtu-pas.github.io/agrifield40k/

AI.tldr: 论文提出了AgriField-40K农业视觉数据集和高效的持续预训练方法AgriMAE，不仅显著降低了参数和标注成本，还能提升或超越全量微调的表现。
AI.motivation: 当前农业计算机视觉模型依赖昂贵的标注和庞大的模型参数，缺乏高效、低成本的解决方案，制约了精细农业的发展。
AI.method: 1. 构建自17个公开资源、包含多类作物和田间条件的数据集AgriField-40K；2. 提出AgriMAE方法，通过在自然图像上预训练的Masked Autoencoder基础上，仅用轻量adapter进行持续预训练；3. 探索语义特征重建等预训练目标，评估迁移到多项下游任务效果。
AI.result: AgriMAE能一致提升下游农业视觉任务表现，参数量最多可降低9倍，部分任务优于全量微调，验证方法高效且实用。
AI.conclusion: AgriField-40K和AgriMAE为农业视觉提供了低成本、高效率的持续预训练解决方案，为实际应用提供了有力支撑。

title: The Announcement Carries the Cue: Markup, Boundaries, and the Notation of Pre-Training Corpora
comment: 44 pages, 10 tables, 7 figures. Pre-registered protocols and their amendment history ship with the repository. Code, data, and instruments: https://github.com/emfreeburg/announcement-carries-cue
summary: How a document's arrangement is written down, its notation, is a training variable that no dataset card records. The field has established that text-extraction choices change model behaviour, and has never once measured the notation of what those choices put into the corpus. We define clean-window survival, a deterministic count of how much of a stream still demands the boundary inference, and measure notation on three fronts. What corpora carry: a census of thirteen public corpora, where survival falls to 0.153 in a vision-converted PDF slice against 0.889 in C4; the scarce resource is not unmarked text but long unmarked text; a pre-registered supply test finds what remains institutional, not consumer. Our own pre-registered prediction failed: converters do not fabricate structure on prose, and that null forced the reliability mechanism that survives it. What readers use: across five base models spanning 0.6B to 8.2B and two pipelines, deleting a structural announcement makes the following prose measurably harder to predict, while swapping its notation moves nothing. That zero does not make notation unimportant; it relocates the variable: the operative cue is the announcement, not the sigil. What writers impose: a bounded null. Base models do not impose the marked register above the authored baseline, and handed prose with every announcement deleted they do not put one back, at a rate indistinguishable from zero against an authored reference of zero. We ship the format those measurements imply: the pure frame, paragraphs in authored order, every announcement deleted into a reversible sidecar, mixed against the marked copy over announcement presence rather than notation. Choose format operators by the capability they train, not by the fidelity they preserve, and record extractor identity and survival on data cards.

AI.tldr: 本文关注文档排列（notation）的数据特性对语言模型训练的影响，首次提出并量化该特性，并对多个数据集和模型做实证分析，提出数据卡应记录相关特性。
AI.motivation: 尽管文档的排列方式（如结构标记、分段等）会影响训练模型的行为，但此前数据集卡片从未记录或度量这一特性的具体内容，导致模型行为解释存在盲区。
AI.method: 定义“clean-window survival”度量文档结构所需推断边界的比例，从三个维度考察：1) 多个主流公共语料的notation特性；2) 实验验证notation在文本结构预测和模型表现方面的作用；3) 检查模型是否会在文本中自动补全或恢复结构标记。
AI.result: 实证发现不同语料notation差别极大，例如PDF视觉切片与C4的survival分别为0.153和0.889，长无结构文本极为稀缺。对于结构提示的缺失，所有模型都变得更难预测后续内容，但notation样式本身变量作用微弱。基线模型不会主动生成或还原结构标记。
AI.conclusion: 建议数据卡记录提取器身份及survival，推动语料格式选择以适应所需能力训练（如结构推断），而非仅复现原文格式。文档结构提示对模型预测很关键，但标记样式本身影响较小。

title: Beyond the Plane: Coupling Planar Vehicle Dynamics with Three-Dimensional Road Geometry
summary: Simulation is crucial for developing and testing autonomous driving systems. In particular, the development of localization and control algorithms relies on an accurate vehicle dynamics simulation. However, most vehicle dynamics models are two-dimensional while real-world roads are three-dimensional. For example, effects from the three-dimensional road geometry on the Las Vegas Motor Speedway can increase the normal forces on the tires by more than 66% compared to the nominal load at standstill. As a result, even highly detailed planar vehicle dynamics models struggle to accurately reproduce the real vehicle's behavior. While solutions for three-dimensional vehicle dynamics exist, they are rarely adopted, computationally expensive, and complex. To address this issue, we present a novel method to couple planar vehicle dynamics models with real-world three-dimensional road geometry. We transform the planar vehicle state from the vehicle model's two-dimensional plane to its corresponding representation in three-dimensional space. Additionally, we calculate road-geometry-induced forces and moments and apply them to the planar vehicle model.
