This paper presents a highly flexible, wireless, 5G-based system that serves as a versatile experimental testbed for applications including remanufacturing, operator training, and user studies. To eliminate infrastructure barriers, the workcell integrates a novel battery-powered, multi-sensor platform prototype. Additionally, to support operator safety and system adaptability across environmental shifts, the system integrates a computer vision module for object detection and pose estimation, further augmented for robust hand recognition. Trained on synthetic and real data, the model reliably detects oriented grasping poses and human hands across varying lighting and background conditions (with an mAP@50-95 of 97.74 +- 0.10% and a mean inference time of 12.5 ms). Offloading these computationally intensive tasks to the edge via 5G, the proposed architecture contributes to resolving the bandwidth-latency trade-off. To demonstrate portability, the system was implemented in both Hungary and Norway, and was evaluated across a combination of public and private, Standalone and Non-Standalone 5G infrastructures. The performed network experiments produced results in round-trip response times down to 12 ms in case of compatible network-device pairings, suitable for safe, adaptive HRC. However, these measurements also revealed practical limitations related to interoperability in current 5G deployments that should be addressed in future works.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于5G的无线高灵活性系统，用于动态和高变环境下的人机协作，系统涉及电池驱动多传感器平台以及边缘计算下的视觉模块，实验在不同国家实现并评估其实时性能，揭示了当前5G互操作性的一些局限。
AI.motivation: 再制造等工业场景常面临工作单元频繁重组，但传统有线系统限制了灵活性和模块化，市面上适用于实时感知和安全协作的无线设备又极为有限，亟需更开放、可移植和适应性强的HRC系统。
AI.method: 设计了一个基于5G的无线测试平台，核心是新型电池驱动多传感器原型和边缘计算支持的计算机视觉模块，后者能够高效进行物体检测、姿态估算和手部识别，并通过5G网络将计算任务卸载至边缘服务器，兼顾实时性与安全协作需求。
AI.result: 系统在不同国家和多种5G基础设施下实现并成功运行，视觉模型在多种环境下检测精度高（mAP@50-95为97.74%），推理延时低（平均12.5ms），网络实验中部分场景的往返延迟低至12ms，验证了其用于安全、适应性人机协作的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 所提系统有效提升了工业环境下HRC的灵活性和实时性能，具备较好通用性和移植性，但现有5G部署在设备互操作性方面还存在一定局限，未来需进一步完善。

title: Compositional Cross-Modality Translation via Whole-Volume Multitask Latent Flow Matching
summary: Cross-modality medical image translation can reduce the burden of multi-modal acquisitions, yet the field remains constrained by two coupled limitations: methods operate on 2D slices or 3D patches rather than whole volumes, and train a separate model for each translation task. Both stem from a single cause, the absence of a sufficiently strong volumetric prior, which forces generative models to learn anatomical appearance and cross-modality mapping simultaneously, an ill-posed problem at the scale of available paired datasets. We propose to decouple these objectives. A large-scale pretrained 3D variational autoencoder provides a compact latent representation of volumetric appearance, reducing translation to a conditional flow-matching problem. This compression makes whole-volume processing tractable, while a resolution-aware sampling strategy preserves native anatomical scale. We train a single model jointly across inter-modality (MRI$\to$CT, CBCT$\to$CT) and intra-modality (MRI$\to$MRI) tasks over three multi-center datasets. Across all tasks, whole-volume processing outperforms its patch-based counterpart, and the multi-task model matches task-specific baselines while replacing $N$ networks with one. Crucially, joint training unlocks capabilities inaccessible to task-specific approaches: zero-shot generalization to anatomical regions unseen during training, within 0.15 SSIM of the fully supervised model, and compositional cross-dataset translation along paths never directly supervised. These results suggest that combining a strong volumetric prior with multitask training is a scalable route toward synthesis systems that generalize beyond their training distribution. Code is available at https://github.com/arco-group/Whole-Volume-Latent-FM.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种新的跨模态医学影像转换方法，通过预训练的3D变分自编码器获取体积先验，使得可以基于整个三维体积而不仅仅是二维切片或三维Patch进行转换，并利用单一模型实现多种转换任务。该方法能提升性能，扩展泛化能力且大幅简化模型部署。
AI.motivation: 现有的跨模态医学影像转换方法多数仅能处理二维切片或三维Patch，同时需要为不同任务分别训练多个模型，原因在于缺乏强大的体积先验，导致模型在小数据集上需同时学习解剖结构与跨模态对应，问题过于复杂。作者希望解决该方法泛化性差、效率低的问题。
AI.method: 作者提出使用大规模预训练的3D变分自编码器（VAE）先学习三维影像的解剖结构表示，再将影像转换任务转化为条件流匹配（conditional flow-matching）问题，实现数据压缩、全体积端到端处理，并采用分辨率感知采样策略以保持结构分辨率。最终实现多任务（跨模态与同模态）联合训练。
AI.result: 在三组多中心数据集上的多种翻译任务（如MRI→CT、CBCT→CT、MRI→MRI），全体积方法性能超过Patch-Based方法，且多任务单模型的效果与单独任务模型匹配，实现模型合并。同时，多任务模型可零样本泛化到训练未见的解剖区域，性能接近完全监督模型，并支持组合型跨数据集转换。
AI.conclusion: 结合强体积先验与多任务训练能够扩展医学影像转换模型的泛化能力，实现更可扩展的合成系统。该方法不仅提升了性能，还大幅简化了实际应用中的模型管理与部署流程。

title: Universal or Language-Family-Specific Script Unification for Cross-Lingual Transfer? A Case Study on Turkic Languages
summary: Closely related languages written in different scripts expose little surface overlap to multilingual models, limiting cross-lingual transfer. We compare two approaches to script unification: the general-purpose uroman romanizer and the family-specific Common Turkic Script (CTS). We train matched fastText models on transliterated Wikipedia corpora from 11 Turkic languages and evaluate them on WikiANN named entity recognition and Universal Dependencies part-of-speech tagging. CTS and uroman show no significant difference on NER, while both substantially outperform the official monolingual fastText baselines. POS results reveal no universal winner: language-specific differences are associated with the cross-lingual character n-gram coverage induced by each representation, while within-language coverage becomes more important when target-language supervision is available. Although CANINE-c achieves higher overall POS averages, the substantially simpler fastText-based systems remain competitive on several treebanks. Overall, the effectiveness of script unification depends on the language, the induced subword overlap, and the available supervision.

AI.tldr: 对比两种不同的转写方法（uroman 和 CTS）对多语言模型在处理多脚本突厥语时的影响，实验发现统一书写系统对任务效果提升明显，但实际效果还与具体语言和任务有关。
AI.motivation: 多语种模型在处理书写系统不同但语言相近的语言时，面临表层信息重叠少、迁移学习困难的问题，因此需要研究如何统一脚本来提升跨语言迁移能力。
AI.method: 采用两种脚本统一方法（通用的 uroman 转写器和针对突厥语系的 CTS），对11种突厥语维基语料做转写，并分别训练 fastText 模型，随后在 WikiANN 命名实体识别和UD词性标注任务上做评测。并与官方fastText单语模型对比，同时参考CANINE-c模型表现。
AI.result: 在命名实体识别任务上，uroman和CTS效果相当，且均显著优于单语fastText基线。词性标注任务无绝对优胜，表现与每种表征方式对跨语n-gram覆盖有关，而在有监督下，语言内部覆盖更重要。CANINE-c整体POS表现最佳，但简单的fastText在部分树库上也有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 脚本统一对提升跨语言迁移有效，但效果依赖特定语言、n-gram子词重叠量以及标注数据的可用性。

title: TAMS: Task-Aware Multi-View Adaptive Streaming for Wireless Telerobotic Manipulation
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Code available at: https://github.com/Dzxx623/TAMS
summary: Wireless telerobotic manipulation relies on timely multi-view video feedback, but the available uplink bandwidth is often limited and dynamic. This paper presents Task-Aware Multi-View Adaptive Streaming (TAMS), a system that allocates video bitrate according to the current manipulation phase. TAMS infers task phase from lightweight robot-side signals and prioritizes the camera view most relevant to the operator while preserving baseline visibility for secondary views. Experiments on a six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) teleoperation testbed under three constrained network conditions show that TAMS improves primary view Structural Similarity Index (SSIM), reduces task completion time, and increases trial success rate compared with equal and static allocation baselines. Under the most constrained bandwidth condition, TAMS reduces mean completion time from 68.9 s to 43.9 s relative to equal allocation and increases trial success rate from 48% to 71%. Code is available at: https://github.com/Dzxx623/TAMS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAMS系统，针对无线遥操作在带宽受限情形下，通过任务阶段感知自适应分配多视角视频码率，提高主视角视频质量与操作效率。实验表明该方法优于等分和静态分配方案。
AI.motivation: 无线遥操作任务中，操作者需实时获得多视角视频以完成精细操作，但无线网络上行带宽有限且波动，现有方案难以根据操作需求动态分配视频资源，影响任务效率与成功率。
AI.method: 设计了TAMS系统，通过机器人侧轻量信号推断任务正处于哪个阶段，动态优先分配带宽给当前操作者最关注的主视角，同时保证其他视角的基础可见性。该方法在6自由度遥操作平台、三类受限网络条件下评估，并与等分和静态分配方法对比。
AI.result: TAMS系统显著提升了主视角视频质量（SSIM）、缩短了任务完成时间，并提升了成功率。在最严苛带宽下，任务平均完成时间由68.9秒降至43.9秒，成功率从48%提升到71%。
AI.conclusion: TAMS针对带宽受限下的遥操作，能智能分配多视角视频资源，显著提升遥操作效率和成功率。代码已开源，便于后续研究和应用。

title: EFFEKT: Efficient Federated Knowledge Transfer to Foundation Models
comment: 12 main content pages, 8 appendix pages; 3 main figures, 9 appendix figures; 8 main tables, 9 appendix tables; 1 main algorithm, 4 appendix algorithms; accepted at TMLR
summary: Recent data protection laws have accelerated the adoption of Federated Learning (FL) for privacy-preserving decentralized training. Nevertheless, increasing model sizes impose substantial computational demands on client devices, limiting FL applicability in resource-constrained settings. We introduce a novel multi-domain federated learning framework in which lightweight client-side proxy models collaborate with a server-side Foundation Model (FM) to learn new concepts without sharing private data. Our approach, EFFEKT, enables efficient server-side training of domain-specific LoRA adapters while preserving feature-space alignment between the FM and proxy extractors via novel bi-directional cross-distillation strategies. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets and deployments on low-power edge devices demonstrate improvements over state-of-the-art baselines in most considered domains while maintaining lightweight computation at the client side.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型多域联邦学习框架EFFEKT，将轻量级客户端代理模型与服务器端基础模型协作，实现无需共享私有数据下的新概念学习，并且大幅降低了客户端的计算压力。
AI.motivation: 随着数据保护法规日益严格，联邦学习成为保护隐私的分布式训练方案。然而，随着模型规模变大，终端设备的计算能力成为限制FL应用的瓶颈。因此，亟需一种方法，在保障隐私的同时，降低客户端负担。
AI.method: EFFEKT框架中，客户端仅需运行轻量化代理模型，服务器端利用基础模型进行主导训练。通过设计的双向跨蒸馏策略，实现了服务器端自适应训练领域专属的LoRA适配器，以及客户端和基础模型特征空间的一致性。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集和低功耗边缘设备上测试，EFFEKT在多数领域均优于现有先进联邦学习方法，并且显著降低了客户端的计算需求。
AI.conclusion: EFFEKT为资源受限场景下的联邦学习提供了低计算、高性能的新方案，兼顾隐私保护和模型效能，对实际多域部署具有良好应用前景。

title: Temporal Misgrounding in Legal RAG: A Versioned-Corpus Benchmark for French Tax Law
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on AI for Law (AI4Law), Seoul. Code and data: https://github.com/rosecymbler/fiscal-fr-bench
summary: We identify and quantify temporal misgrounding: the systematic retrieval and citation of the currently in-force version of a legal article when the applicable version is an earlier or future one. Standard legal RAG treats the corpus as static; we argue legal question answering is a temporally-indexed retrieval problem. We introduce FiscalQA Pro, pairing a versioned corpus of 32,436 article-versions of the French tax code (93 years, 1938-2031) with an all-model-hard temporal-reasoning track: 209 scored, expert-reviewed questions across 33 CGI articles (221 released; twelve flagged out of the answerable scope). At selection time, no evaluated model recovered its date-applicable answer closed-book in any of four sampling draws, and the currently in-force text lacks the gold value for all but one of the scored questions. Answers are scored deterministically via atomic ground-truth "nuggets" (regex and numeric-with-tolerance), never LLM-as-judge: an LLM judge would inherit the temporal bias it is meant to score. Across eleven models (five frontier closed-API systems plus Gemini 2.5 Pro as a substitute entry, and five open-weight), parametric knowledge yields 3.0% mean strict accuracy and RAG over a static current-version corpus 2.7%. Static RAG retrieves the date-applicable version 0% of the time, confidently citing a real but inapplicable version. Our end-to-end retriever over a multi-version index, with no oracle, reaches 98.3% mean strict; an oracle-article ablation reaches 99.1%, locating the residual gap in first-stage recall, not version selection. We additionally release a version-aware jurisprudence dataset of 69,208 citation links, together with the corpus, benchmark, model responses, and pipeline code.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了“时间失据”现象，即法律检索系统常常检索到与问题发生时间不符的法条版本，并提出了针对时间感知的检索方法。基于法国税法近百年多版本数据，构建大型基准数据集FiscalQA Pro，并系统评估了主流模型的时序推理能力。实验表明，现有模型基本无法正确检索出时间适用的法规文本，而新提出的多版本检索范式有效解决了这一问题。
AI.motivation: 动机在于现有法律问答和Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) 系统普遍把法律文本视为静态，不考虑法条在时间维度的变迁，导致实际应用中特别是凭时效性检索法律规定时，高发检出“时间失据”，即检索/引用了当前版本而不是历史或未来适用版本。解决这一核心痛点对于提升法律AI工具的实际可用性至关重要。
AI.method: 1）建立了法国税法1938-2031年间32,436个法条版本的多版本结构化语料库和时序推理问答基准FiscalQA Pro；2）设计了覆盖全主流模型的全闭书式检索和生成评测，以及精细化的自动评测指标（原子“nugget”地面真值匹配）；3）系统比较了只用参数知识、常规静态RAG、多版本时序感知RAG等方法的检索和问答表现。
AI.result: 参数知识平均准确率仅3.0%，基于静态当前版本RAG准确率仅2.7%，且静态RAG从未检索到时间适用的正确版本，而新提出的多版本时序RAG检索准确率均值高达98.3%，消融实验显示瓶颈在于第一阶段的召回而非版本选择。
AI.conclusion: 法律问答与检索必须具备版本与时序感知能力，传统静态检索在时间敏感的法律情景下完全不可用。文中给出的新范式显著提升了在实际法律应用中的可用性与准确性，并随文发布了完整数据与工具，有助于推动法律AI研究和应用的进一步发展。

title: Efficient Real-World Online Reinforcement Learning for Robot Manipulation via Centralized Training and Critic Decomposition
summary: Real-world online reinforcement learning (RL) provides a promising approach for training robotic manipulation policies directly in the physical world, avoiding the sim-to-real gap and enabling continuous policy refinement through human-in-the-loop interaction. Recent methods have demonstrated sample-efficient learning through human intervention but remain limited to small randomization ranges and encounter challenges with the non-stationarity induced by concurrently training multiple agents. To address these limitations, we introduce a unified framework that combines centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) and a Hybrid Reward Architecture (HRA). This enables multiple actors to share a centralized multi-head critic. The critic is decomposed into task and grasp heads, corresponding to the sparse task reward and a potential-based grasping reward, respectively. We accordingly reformulate the critic and actor objectives to exploit the decomposed Q-values while explicitly accounting for the categorical action distribution of the discrete gripper policy. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework substantially improves both sample efficiency and policy performance. We validate our approach on two robotic arms and a simulated humanoid robot across tennis ball and banana pick-and-place, pot reset, and simulated block relocation tasks under dimension-wise domain randomization, approximately 5-25x larger than those considered in prior work. Compared with a state-of-the-art baseline, our method improves the success rate from 60% to 80% on tennis ball pick-and-place, from 60% to 90% on banana pick-and-place, and from 25% to 95% on simulated block relocation, while also successfully accomplishing a task where the baseline consistently fails. Videos and more details are available at our project website: https://hil-harc.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种结合中心化训练与去中心化执行（CTDE）、混合奖励架构（HRA）的强化学习框架，解决了多机器人在现实环境中学习效率低和非平稳性问题。实验在多种真实和仿真任务下大幅提升了成功率和样本效率。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的强化学习能绕开“从仿真到现实”的鸿沟，并允许人类介入持续改进策略，但现有方法受限于环境随机化幅度小、多智能体训练时环境不稳定。为此，需提升在更大环境变化下的高效学习能力。
AI.method: 方法上，提出CTDE与HRA相结合的统一框架。多个actor共享一个多头critic，critic被分为任务头和抓取头，分别对应稀疏任务奖励和基于潜力的抓取奖励。对critic和actor目标做了重新设计，并适配离散夹爪策略的动作分布。
AI.result: 实验证明，该方法在两个机械臂和一个仿真人形机器人上，涉及多个高度随机化（比前人高5-25倍）任务，均大幅提升了表现。例如，网球球抓取成功率从60%提升至80%，香蕉抓取从60%到90%，仿真方块搬运从25%到95%，还有任务在基线方法失败时亦能完成。
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架显著提升了真实世界机器人操作任务中的学习效率与成功率，能应对更大幅度域随机化和多智能体非平稳性，优于最新对比基线，显示出实际应用前景。

title: Learning Structural Illumination for Unsupervised Low-light Enhancement
summary: Existing unsupervised low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods often estimate illumination directly from the entire low-light input, without separating its spatially varying illumination pattern, termed relative illumination structure, from the absolute exposure level or preventing unreliable low signal-to-noise ratio regions from biasing the estimate. Moreover, fixed exposure targets impose a scene-agnostic enhancement criterion, limiting adaptation across diverse lighting conditions. Inspired by the spatial propagation of light, we propose a Relative Illumination Structure Estimation (RISE) framework that decouples relative illumination structure from absolute exposure and infers it from reliable bright regions, enabling interpretable and robust enhancement. For scene-adaptive exposure adjustment, we further propose a Dual-Metering Exposure Reference derived from each input, allowing RISE to adapt the enhancement strength to individual scenes and generalize across diverse lighting conditions. Extensive benchmark and real-world generalization experiments show that RISE achieves state-of-the-art performance among unsupervised LLIE methods while producing visually natural results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的无监督低照度图像增强框架RISE，通过分离相对照明结构和绝对曝光，并自适应调整增强强度，实现更自然和泛化性更强的增强效果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在增强低照度图像时，往往直接从整张图像估计照明，未能区分空间变化的相对照明结构和绝对曝光，且容易被低信噪比区域影响。固定曝光目标也限制了对多样场景的适应能力。
AI.method: 提出RISE框架，将相对照明结构与绝对曝光解耦，并主要依赖图像中较亮的可靠区域进行推断。此外，提出Dual-Metering Exposure Reference，使增强强度可根据每张图的实际需求自适应调整。
AI.result: RISE在基准测试和实际场景下均获得了当前最优的无监督低照度图像增强性能，同时产生了视觉上更自然的提升效果。
AI.conclusion: RISE框架通过更合理的照明估计和自适应曝光，显著提升了低照度图像增强的准确性和泛化能力，突破了现有无监督方法的局限。

title: Intent Speaks Louder: Controllable User Simulation Beyond Response Imitation
summary: User simulators are widely used as scalable environments for training and evaluating interactive assistants. Generating the next user turn is inherently one-to-many: the same profile and dialogue context may support multiple plausible continuations with different local interaction intents. A fluent response may therefore advance the dialogue through an inappropriate intent, such as acceptance rather than repair. Our key insight is that controllable user simulation should separate which local interaction intent the next user turn should realize from how that intent is expressed in language. We introduce UserIDA (User Intent-Directive Alignment), which exposes interaction intent as an explicit per-turn directive. UserIDA defines a six-way intent interface, learns directive-conditioned generation through supervised fine-tuning, and uses intent-calibrated policy optimization during group-based reinforcement learning. The reward preserves composite response quality while ensuring that intent-violating candidates rank below compliant alternatives in mixed groups. On LMSYS-USP, UserIDA achieves 86.6\% intent accuracy, outperforming the strongest dedicated user-simulator baseline by 24.3 percentage points while improving semantic and stylistic similarity. In within-context interventions, it realizes at least four of the six target intents in 91.7\% of evaluated dialogue states, compared with 22.9\% for the strongest external baseline. These results establish per-turn intent control as a complementary dimension to response fidelity in user simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出了UserIDA方法，通过分离用户意图和表达方式，极大提升了用户模拟器对多样响应意图的控制能力。实验表明该方法在意图准确性及多样生成方面大幅超越已有基线。
AI.motivation: 传统用户模拟器面对同一情境时，难以控制用户回复中的真实意图，容易产生语义流畅但意图错误（如不该同意时却同意）的状况。这限制了模拟器在对话系统训练和评估中的实用性。因此，提升对用户意图的精细控制，成为提升模拟器质量的重要课题。
AI.method: 提出UserIDA（User Intent-Directive Alignment）框架：显式以每轮对话指令决定用户意图，实现意图和表达方式分离。定义了六种意图接口，采用有监督微调进行意图指令驱动的生成学习，并结合意图校准的强化学习进行策略优化，确保意图违规的回复在候选中排序较低。
AI.result: 在LMSYS-USP数据集上，UserIDA实现了86.6%的意图准确率，超过最强基线24.3个百分点。此外，在具体对话场景下可实现至少4/6种目标意图的比例达91.7%，而最强基线仅22.9%；同时在语义和风格相似性上也表现更优。
AI.conclusion: UserIDA有效将意图控制作为用户模拟的新维度，与传统重视回复真实性的方法互补，显著提高模拟器对不同意图的灵活控制能力，对交互式助理模型训练与评测具有重要意义。

title: SLIM-0.5B: Learning Action-Grounded Predictive Latents for Robot Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action policies rely on large multimodal backbones to jointly perform perception, language conditioning, and action generation at every control step. Much of this capacity supports open-domain semantics, whereas continuous robot manipulation primarily requires compact representations of observations, actions, and the transitions induced by actions. Pixel-level world models provide another route, but predicting visual details irrelevant to control can be unnecessarily expensive. We propose SLIM (Self-supervised Latent Interaction Model), a compact 0.5B-parameter latent interaction policy. SLIM learns action-grounded predictive latents that capture both action-conditioned future transitions and the actions that explain observed changes. SLIM learns these representations through self-supervised masked trajectory prediction, combining action reconstruction with future-latent prediction. A compact Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone models interactions between observation latents and action tokens. The resulting policy is trained with flow matching for language-conditioned action generation. Across simulation benchmarks and real-world evaluation, SLIM matches or exceeds representative large-scale VLA and world-action-model baselines with fewer parameters, no additional embodied pretraining, lower inference latency, and substantially lower GPU memory usage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种紧凑的自监督学习视觉-语言-动作策略SLIM，在参数量和硬件资源占用更低的情况下，实现了与大型多模态骨干网络相当或更好的机器人操作性能。
AI.motivation: 当前主流视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略大多依赖超大规模多模态模型，这导致推理资源消耗高、不必要地学习过多与机器人控制无关的细节。论文动机是探索更紧凑但高效的策略网络，只学习对机器人操作真正重要的潜在表示。
AI.method: 设计了SLIM，一种仅有0.5B参数的潜在交互策略。通过自监督的trajectory预测（包含遮蔽、动作重建和未来潜在态预测），学习能描述动作和状态转移的潜在变量。采用紧凑的Mixture-of-Transformers骨干建模观测与动作间交互，并以flow matching进行训练以实现语言调控下的动作生成。
AI.result: 在模拟基准和真实机器人实验中，SLIM在参数更少、无需更多预训练、推理延迟和GPU内存消耗大幅减少的前提下，性能与典型的大型VLA或世界模型方法相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: SLIM证明了紧凑、低资源消耗的潜在交互建模方法可实现与巨型多模态模型相竞争的机器人操作能力，为高效机器人感知与控制提供新思路。

title: Wiener Representation Filtering for VLM Hallucination Suppression
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) excel at open-ended captioning and visual QA but often describe objects, attributes, or relations absent from the image, a phenomenon known as object hallucination. We propose a {training-free, post-hoc representation editing technique} that operates in the representation space of the language backbone. The method performs a lightweight, one-time offline calibration on a modest paired dataset to estimate the required covariance structures, using only forward passes and empirical second-order statistics with no gradient updates or fine-tuning, after which the correction is absorbed directly into the model's existing weights. By modeling hidden states as a superposition of truthful and hallucination-associated components, we derive a Wiener-type estimator whose optimal gains are given in closed form from the covariances of paired truthful and hallucinated representations. An eigendecomposition yields mode-wise attenuation that respects a stability criterion, i.e., the filter responds continuously to estimation noise. The correction is applied once to the feed-forward output projections of selected deeper layers, at inference time, the model runs unchanged and at the same speed. Experiments on LLaVA-1.5, MiniGPT-4, Gemma3, and mPLUG-Owl2 demonstrate consistent reductions in object hallucination on CHAIR, POPE, and MME while maintaining caption fluency and overall response quality. We further demonstrate the generality of our approach on the TempCompass video understanding benchmark and on discrete diffusion language models for grounded dialogue, showing that representation filtering reduces hallucinations even in temporal video reasoning and multi-step, sequence-wide denoising settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对视觉-语言模型（VLMs）去除幻觉对象（object hallucination）的方法，通过轻量的线下校准，将纠正操作融入模型权重，无需微调即可显著减少模型生成不存在物体、属性或关系的倾向。
AI.motivation: 现有VLMs在图像描述及视觉问答表现优异，但常常错误描述图片中不存在的内容，即幻觉对象。减少幻觉对于提升模型应用安全性与可靠性至关重要。
AI.method: 提出训练后、免微调的表示修正技术。利用真实与幻觉特征的协方差，对深层表征进行一次性权重校准，推断时不增加计算开销。通过Wiener滤波思想区分和抑制幻觉相关分量。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5、MiniGPT-4、Gemma3、mPLUG-Owl2等模型及CHAIR、POPE、MME等数据集上，显著减少模型幻觉生成，且保持描述流畅性和整体输出质量。对视频理解及扩散式对话模型同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 无需训练、可泛化的表示修正方法能高效抑制VLMs中幻觉对象的产生，为视觉-语言和多模态模型实际应用提供了高效实用的安全性增强手段。

title: Reducing Pretraining-Generation Mismatch in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Autoregressive language models align training and use: generation conditions on a clean prompt, and training predicts future tokens from clean left context. Diffusion language models offer parallel denoising, but native dLLM pretraining can randomly corrupt prompt and continuation tokens together, weakening the clean-prefix interface needed for prompt-conditioned generation. We identify this mismatch for prompt continuation and propose PCD (Prefix-Conditioned Diffusion), a pretraining objective that combines AR prefix supervision with no-shift suffix denoising. At the training-objective level, PCD changes the attention mask, corruption mask, and label construction in continued pretraining; it does not require an autoregressive decoder, verifier, or new inference mode. By supervising the clean-prefix side autoregressively and applying diffusion only to the unknown continuation, PCD makes the local training interface resemble how block-diffusion models are queried at evaluation time. We further separate intra-sample prefix conditioning from inter-sample objective mixing, allowing us to identify the local alignment signal separately from the optional batch-level mixing knob. Across LLaDA2-Mini and Qwen-1.7B backbones, PCD consistently improves over same-family native dLLM stable baselines, reaching a 4.2% relative gain on the main LLaDA2-Mini six-benchmark average (+2.56 points) and a 14.2% relative gain in the primary Qwen mechanism comparison (+4.86 points). These results suggest that aligning the pretraining context distribution with prompt-conditioned generation can recover a measurable part of the dLLM continuation gap without changing inference.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出一种称为PCD（Prefix-Conditioned Diffusion）的训练目标，用以解决扩散语言模型在生成任务中前缀与后缀腐蚀方式与自回归模型不一致的问题，提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（dLLMs）虽然具备并行去噪能力，但原生训练方式会随机腐蚀整个输入，导致模型在以干净前缀作为提示生成文本时，训练与实际推理的接口不一致，影响生成效果。作者识别并解决了前缀-后缀不一致的问题。
AI.method: PCD方法将自回归前缀监督与只对未知后缀去噪相结合，训练时仅腐蚀后缀，并调整注意力和腐蚀掩码，实现训练接口与推理阶段一致，无需更改推理方式或使用自回归解码器。
AI.result: 在LLaDA2-Mini和Qwen-1.7B模型上，PCD方法相较于同类原生dLLM基线，在六项基准测试中取得了4.2%的相对提升（+2.56分），在Qwen机制比较中达到14.2%的相对提升（+4.86分）。
AI.conclusion: PCD方法能够有效让预训练上下文分布更好地与提示条件生成对齐，无需修改推理流程，就可以缩小dLLM生成任务中的表现差距。

title: RoboSeg: Online Part-Level Semantic Reconstruction for Robotic Manipulation via a Single Eye-in-Hand Camera
summary: Robotic manipulation requires perception systemsthat identify actionable parts such as handles, rims, triggers,and tool tips, not merely object categories or point clouds. This paper presents RoboSeg, a part-level semantic reconstructionsystem that links vision-language model (VLM) functional-partdiscovery, asynchronous online RGB-D semantic reconstruc-tion, and task-oriented grasp generation without requiring CAD models or pre-scanned meshes. RoboSeg queries a VLM onthe initial RGB observation to obtain compact functional part prompts, then scans with two asynchronous streams: a high-frequency geometry thread for RGB-D odometry and truncated signed distance function (TSDF) fusion, and a keyframe-triggered semantic thread for SAM3 part masks. Projectedmasks are fused by voxel-level temporal voting into a persistentpart-labeled point cloud; RoboSeg uses this map to assign AnyGrasp 6-DoF candidates to semantic parts and select grasps consistent with the task-relevant part label. RoboSeg reaches 83.4% mean part intersection-over-union (mIoU) over manually labeled objects; in a 24-trial physical pilot across fourobjects and eight tasks, the selected grasp contacts the requestedpart in all trials and achieves 21/24 combined task successes.These results characterize RoboSeg as a semantic indexing layerfor task-conditioned manipulation, with AnyGrasp retained asthe proposal generator.

AI.tldr: RoboSeg结合了视觉语言模型、在线RGB-D语义重建和任务导向抓取，无需CAD模型，实现对物体功能性部件的识别和抓取。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人感知大多只能识别物体类别或点云，难以理解和区分对象可操作的具体部件（如把手、边缘等），不能很好支持下游机器人抓取和操作。
AI.method: 提出了RoboSeg系统：1. 首先用视觉语言模型（VLM）处理初始RGB图像，生成功能部件提示；2. 采用两条异步流并行工作：一条高频几何流实现RGB-D里程计和TSDF融合，另一条关键帧触发的语义流利用SAM3生成部分掩码；3. 掩码通过体素级投票融合成带有部件标签的点云；4. 基于该语义点云，系统将AnyGrasp生成的抓取候选与部件标签关联，实现任务相关抓取选择。无需先验CAD或网格模型。
AI.result: RoboSeg在人工标注物体上取得83.4%的平均部件mIoU。在物理实验中，24次抓取任务（4个物体、8种任务）均能在每次实验中抓取到指定部件，整体任务成功率达到21/24。
AI.conclusion: RoboSeg能够作为面向任务操控的语义索引层，与AnyGrasp抓取生成器结合，有效提升了机器人对功能部件的识别和分区抓取能力，为无需CAD的通用机器人操作提供支持。

title: BAP-MOS: Bandit-Based Adaptive Prompting for Boundary-Sensitive Multi-Organ Segmentation
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Source code available at https://github.com/SatvikPraveen/BAP-MOS
summary: Multi-organ ultrasound segmentation remains challenging when anatomically adjacent structures must be delineated jointly, as localized boundary errors can persist even when Dice scores are high. To address these challenges, we propose Boundary-Adaptive Prompting for Multi-Organ Segmentation (BAP-MOS), a closed-loop adaptive prompting framework. BAP-MOS formulates prompt selection as an organ-specific multi-armed bandit problem over box, point, and combined prompts. An outer Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) loop selects the prompt-selection parameter vector, while an inner UCB-Tuned loop adapts per-organ prompt preferences during fine-tuning using a bounded Dice--MSD--HD95 validation-probe reward. The framework further introduces an organ-scaled negative prompt ring to adapt sparse prompt geometry across anatomical scales, while keeping the image and prompt encoders frozen and updating only the mask decoder. We evaluate BAP-MOS on pooled prostate-region TRUS cohorts against U-Net, nnU-Net, MedSAM, fixed-prompt SAM/MedSAM, and adaptive policy variants. On this benchmark, BAP-MOS achieves Dice 0.982, HD95 0.482, and MSD 0.204, reducing HD95 by approximately 48% and MSD by 45% relative to the strongest conventional baseline. To verify the generalization ability of the framework, we tested it on the external PFUS1 pelvic-floor ultrasound corpus using MedSAM and its adaptive strategy variants, and the results were good. These results support adaptive prompt allocation as an effective mechanism for improving boundary-sensitive multi-organ ultrasound segmentation without modifying the foundation-model backbone. Source Code is available at: https://github.com/SatvikPraveen/BAP-MOS

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于多器官超声分割的边界自适应提示框架（BAP-MOS），有效提升了组织分界的分割准确性，尤其在边界细节处理方面表现突出。
AI.motivation: 当前多器官超声分割任务面临主要挑战在于相邻结构的精确分界，传统方法即使整体Dice得分高，却在组织交界处常有局部错误。作者希望解决这一难题，提升关键边界区域的分割精度。
AI.method: BAP-MOS方法将提示选择建模为多臂老虎机问题，对不同器官分别自适应选择box、point及其组合类型的prompt。方法包含外层TPE参数优化和内层UCB-Tuned自适应循环，每个器官独立调整提示类型。为适应解剖尺度差异，引入了器官尺度的负prompt环。网络结构方面，仅微调掩码解码器，冻结图片与prompt编码器。
AI.result: BAP-MOS在前列腺区域TRUS数据上对比U-Net、nnU-Net、MedSAM等先进基线，有大幅领先，Dice得分0.982，HD95和MSD分别降低约48%和45%。此外，在外部盆底超声数据集上也表现优秀，验证了其泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 边界自适应prompt选择机制在多器官超声分割中可显著提升组织分界的准确性，且无需改动主干基座网络，只需调整解码器即可，具备很好的实用与推广价值。

title: ZetaGPT: A Reference Implementation of Positional--Encoding--Free State--Space--Attention Language Models
summary: Transformer-based language models rely on self-attention, whose computation is permutation-equivariant and therefore lacks an intrinsic mechanism for representing token order. Existing architectures address this limitation by explicitly incorporating positional information through learned positional embeddings or hand-crafted positional encodings, such as rotary positional encoding (RoPE), treating positional information as an architecturally acquired capability rather than an inherent property of the model. Motivated by the pursuit of positional-encoding-free architectures, this work explores a language model architecture that integrates causal state-space equations to implicitly encode positional information before attention computation. Specifically, each model block applies a causal state-space equation before self-attention, allowing recurrent state dynamics to encode sequential information into token representations. Consequently, subsequent attention layers operate on position-aware representations without requiring explicit positional encodings while retaining the expressive modeling capacity of self-attention. We present \textsc{ZetaGPT}, a compact hybrid language model designed for research, rapid prototyping, algorithm verification, and educational applications. In addition to the proposed architecture, \textsc{ZetaGPT} provides a fully open-source, end-to-end training pipeline encompassing dataset construction, tokenizer training, pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning via pure reinforcement learning. To the best of our knowledge, \textsc{ZetaGPT} is the first open-source small language model without explicit positional encoding and establishes a compact, reproducible reference implementation for the development and empirical study of positional-encoding-free language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需显式位置编码的Transformer语言模型架构，通过引入因果状态空间方程在自注意力前隐式编码位置信息，提出并实现了ZetaGPT模型，为后续研究和应用提供开放源代码参考。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer架构在自注意力机制中无法内建位置信息，需通过各种显式位置编码方式（如学习式或手工设计的编码）补足，限制了模型的结构简洁性和泛用性。作者希望探索结构本身能隐式建模顺序信息的可能性，实现无需显式位置编码的语言模型。
AI.method: 每个模型块在自注意力前先应用因果状态空间方程（使模型的表示具备序列信息），再进行自注意力操作，从而获得具备顺序感知能力的表征。模型以ZetaGPT为实现平台，涵盖端到端的数据、分词、预训练、微调、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、链式推理等训练流程，全部开源。
AI.result: 实现了小型、无显式位置编码的开放源代码语言模型ZetaGPT，并配套完整的开发与实验流程，为类似架构的实证研究树立了技术基线和复现实例。
AI.conclusion: 因果状态空间与自注意力相结合后，可以无需显式位置编码就隐式获取位置信息。ZetaGPT是首个此类开源的小模型，为相关领域的研究、教学与原型开发打下基础。

title: WRAP: Wasserstein-Robust Adaptive Plug-in for Robot Localization
summary: Robotic localization under changing sensing conditions can suffer from biased errors and miscalibrated covariances. We present WRAP, an adapter-agnostic Wasserstein-robust plug-in for nonlinear extended Kalman filter (EKF) and error-state Kalman filter (ESKF) stacks. A causal module supplies time-varying effective process and measurement statistics; a mean-preserving Wasserstein local update then computes least-favorable covariances and a robust gain without changing the propagation model, residual, or retraction. This separates mean adaptation from covariance robustification and uses distinct radii for propagation and sensing. On 18 UWB--IMU sequences held out from adapter training, adapter-only and WRAP reduce mean 3-D position RMSE by $19.8\%$ and $27.4\%$ relative to the nominal ESKF; an isotropic ablation reaches $19.5\%$, linking the incremental gain to directional process-covariance redistribution. An in-sample GNSS--INS study shows that mean adaptation provides most of the accuracy gain, while DR improves consistency and mitigates over-tightened classical covariance estimates. The robust solve takes 0.05 ms for UWB and 2.92 ms for GNSS on a Jetson Orin Nano.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种称为WRAP的鲁棒性增强模块，可应用于扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）和误差状态卡尔曼滤波（ESKF），显著提升了在传感条件变化下的机器人定位精度。
AI.motivation: 在机器人定位过程中，传感环境变化可能导致偏置误差和协方差估计不准确，从而影响定位鲁棒性和精度，因此需要新的方法来增强卡尔曼滤波在不确定环境下的表现。
AI.method: 提出了WRAP模块，采用因果模块动态调整有效过程和观测统计量，并通过保持均值不变的Wasserstein本地更新，计算最不利协方差和鲁棒增益，不改变原有滤波消息的传播模型和残差结构。方法上将均值自适应与协方差增强分离，同时对过程和观测采用不同的分布半径。
AI.result: 在18组UWB-IMU测试数据上，WRAP和仅用自适应模块相较于标准ESKF分别降低了19.8%和27.4%的3D定位均方根误差；消融实验显示增益来自过程协方差的方向性调整。在GNSS–INS数据上，均值自适应贡献了主要精度提升，分布半径调优增强了解算一致性并防止协方差估计过于乐观。
AI.conclusion: WRAP模块无需改变原有滤波流程，即可显著提升机器人在多变环境下的定位精度和鲁棒性，运行速度快，易于集成，具有实际应用价值。

title: VTO: Visual Tool Orchestration for Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is a critical yet challenging task due to the complex and diverse nature of real-world scenarios. Traditional deep learning approaches are fundamentally limited by poor generalization across diverse scenarios. While multimodal agents offer a promising tool-learning paradigm for VAD, current systems relying on supervised fine-tuning struggle with complex orchestration, and standard reinforcement learning often causes premature termination due to coarse-grained outcome rewards. To address these challenges, we propose VTO, a process-supervised reinforcement learning framework. Moving beyond static tool usage, VTO enables the agent to dynamically explore and interact with the environment. Specifically, we introduce a foundation model-driven cognitive evaluator to provide context-aware semantic feedback, which is seamlessly integrated into a Process-Supervised Cognitive Alignment that delivers fine-grained, step-wise supervision. By explicitly penalizing logical truncation and rewarding complete causal chains, the agent optimizes its multi-step reasoning policy for interrelated tool orchestration. To support our proposed framework, we meticulously crafted VAD-Tool, a hierarchical visual tool set comprising 12 specialized vision tools spanning from entity tracking to high-stakes hazard detection, and established the corresponding benchmark for rigorous multi-step reasoning evaluation. Extensive experiments on VAD-Tool demonstrate that VTO significantly outperforms baselines, achieving up to a 10.2\% absolute accuracy improvement in tool scheduling. Code and data are available at https://github.com/MICLAB-BUPT/VTO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VTO方法，通过过程监督的强化学习，利用认知评估模型和细粒度反馈提升视频异常检测的多步工具编排能力，显著提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有视频异常检测(VAD)方法在复杂多样环境下泛化能力差，传统多模态系统依赖监督微调，难以高效编排工具，强化学习奖励粗糙易导致早停，亟需更智能的方法应对多步推理和工具协作。
AI.method: 提出VTO框架，通过过程监督的认知对齐机制，利用大型基础模型驱动的认知评估器，提供精准、上下文感知的逐步反馈，并通过奖励完整因果链、惩罚逻辑中断，引导agent优化多步推理和工具编排。为此构建了包含12个专业视觉工具的VAD-Tool套件及新的多步推理基准。
AI.result: 在VAD-Tool基准实验显示，VTO在工具调度准确率上比现有基线方法最高提升10.2个百分点，实现了更高效、更精准的多步推理能力。
AI.conclusion: VTO框架有效提升了VAD任务中的多步工具推理和编排能力，改善了泛化性和推理准确率，为复杂环境下的视频异常检测提供了新范式。

title: Learning Preference Adaptation for Large Language Model Personalization via Verbal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Natural language user preferences provide an interpretable interface for LLM personalization. However, universal preference summaries often contain information irrelevant to a particular downstream task. Directly supplying the full preference summary therefore wastes context capacity and introduces cross-task distraction, while manually designing task-specific preference views is difficult to scale. In this work, we study \emph{task-specific preference adaptation}: given a universal user preference summary and a downstream task, derive a task-conditioned representation that preserves sufficient decision-relevant evidence while removing redundant context. To this end, we propose \textsc{AlignXada}, a training-free meta-learning framework that induces reusable textual refinement policies for adapting universal preference summaries to task-specific ones. The refinement policy is iteratively optimized by a meta learner through verbal reinforcement learning. Across 13 tasks and three downstream models (39 task--model cells), \textsc{AlignXada} achieves an average gain of 3.82 points, improving 33 cells while retaining only 22.8\% of the original profile tokens and outperforming RAG in 36 cells. An extended faithfulness analysis further shows that the refined profiles remain largely grounded in the source preferences while preserving task-relevant personalization signals, suggesting that profile-side adaptation serves as a practical complement to universal memory construction for lifelong personalized agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种称为AlignXada的无训练元学习框架，能够将通用用户偏好摘要自适应地转换为特定任务相关的个性化表示，有效减少上下文冗余并提升任务表现。
AI.motivation: 直接使用通用用户偏好摘要作为大模型个性化输入会引入与任务无关的信息，浪费计算资源且干扰任务表现。人工为每个任务定制偏好视图又难以扩展。因此，需要一种能自动提取与任务相关联系的适配方法。
AI.method: 提出AlignXada，无需训练，通过元学习和口头强化学习，诱导出可复用的文本精炼策略，将通用偏好摘要适配为针对每个任务的个性化摘要。该策略自动优化保留决策相关的信息，去除冗余内容。
AI.result: 在13个任务和3个下游模型（共计39组实验）中，AlignXada平均提升3.82分，提升了33组实验，并在只保留原始偏好22.8%的token情况下，在36组中表现优于RAG。此外，细致的真实性分析发现，精炼后的偏好仍与源偏好密切相关，且很好地保存了与任务关联的个性化信息。
AI.conclusion: AlignXada方法显示，通过在个性化代理中依据任务动态调整用户偏好信息是可行且高效的，为个性化大模型提供了一条优于单一通用偏好存储的新思路。

title: Hierarchical Fast--Slow ReAct Agent for Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation
summary: Zero-shot object-goal navigation (ZSON) requires a robot to find a named object category in a building it has never entered. The prevailing approach scores frontiers with a vision--language \emph{value map}: every decision is another argmax over the map as it currently stands, and the evidence behind that score is discarded the moment it is taken. Systems that place a large vision--language model inside the perception--action loop typically query it on a fixed schedule from the current view alone; a room the robot walked through minutes earlier is never reconsidered, and a failed call has no defined fallback. We turn what the robot has already seen into the object of deliberation. Our hierarchical fast--slow agent leaves the value-map controller running at every step and writes a \emph{coordinate-anchored memory} as it moves: a semantic grid of room types and confirmed object instances, together with a bounded store of pose-tagged keyframes. A VLM screens each candidate detection before it is written. A deliberative layer reads this memory in a bounded reason--retrieve--act loop. It wakes on structural events the reactive layer computes, reasons first over text, and recalls a first-person view only for candidates that text alone cannot separate. Per-invocation and per-run caps bound its calls, a call-free first tier resolves the most frequent stall, and any failure returns control to the reactive controller. Our system reaches 68.75% SR on HM3D v1 \texttt{val} and 47.29% on MP3D \texttt{val}, the highest success rate among the zero-shot methods compared here. Choosing among far frontiers by argmax instead of deliberating costs 3.40 SR points in a paired comparison over all 2000 HM3D episodes (95\% CI [1.70, 5.05]); deliberating over every frontier does not recover them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的零样本目标导航（ZSON）方法，通过层次化的快-慢代理架构和带坐标锚定的记忆机制，有效提升机器人在未知环境中寻找指定对象的能力。该方法在主流数据集上达到了领先的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有ZSON方法仅基于当前视角做决策，并且在决策后就丢弃相关证据，导致信息利用不足；同时大型视觉-语言模型调用方式僵化，无法有效利用历史信息或处理失败情况。因此，需要一种高效、能充分利用历史观测和语义信息的导航策略。
AI.method: 提出了层次化的快-慢智能体架构：底层为持续运行的value-map控制器，并根据机器人运动写入坐标锚定的语义记忆（包含房间类型、已发现目标等）。高层为具有限定调用次数、可回溯关键帧的推理模块，仅在需要时唤醒，通过文本和第一视角影像检索进行推理。VLM辅助筛选检测结果，出错时返回底层控制。
AI.result: 在HM3D v1和MP3D数据集验证集上分别达到68.75%和47.29%的成功率，优于其它无训练（zero-shot）方法。消融实验表明，简单的argmax选前沿点比不加推理巡查高3.40成功率点（有统计显著性）。
AI.conclusion: 本文方法通过结构化语义记忆与层次推理，有效解决ZSON中信息利用不足和推理效率低的问题，在主流Benchmarks上取得了最优表现。

title: Ego-OSCAR: Egocentric Open source Stereo CAptuRe System
summary: We present Ego-OSCAR, an open-hardware, low-cost, head-mounted stereo-inertial capture device for egocentric data collection in the wild. EgoOSCAR pairs a hardware-synchronized global-shutter stereo camera with a 6- axis IMU, an embedded Linux SBC for on-device video encoding, and a realtime microcontroller for user feedback and watchdog functions. The complete bill of materials is under USD 200 per unit, using only commercially available components and 3D-printed parts. Alongside the device, we release a complete software stack (hardware-accelerated recording pipeline, IMU sampling daemon, time-synchronization tooling, and watchdog firmware) and roughly 550 hours of egocentric stereo video per camera with synchronized IMU, collected by a distributed contributor network across everyday indoor environments. The release is annotated rather than raw: free-form action captions cover essentially the entire recorded timeline with an open vocabulary, and per-frame 3D hand reconstructions ship alongside per-session stereo calibration. Ego-OSCAR does not aim to match the per-unit fidelity of research-grade systems such as Project Aria; it aims to be the cheapest defensible substrate for crowdsourced egocentric capture, and to lower the activation energy for any team that wants to collect egocentric data at scale. All hardware designs, software, and the dataset are open-sourced

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并开源了一套低成本、便携式、头戴式立体惯性捕捉设备Ego-OSCAR，用于在真实环境中收集第一视角数据。硬件和软件组件完整，数据集丰富，成本低于200美元，并且全部开源。
AI.motivation: 现有高质量头戴式数据采集系统成本高、获取难，限制了大规模第一视角数据的采集和研究。作者设计低成本方案，降低数据采集门槛，鼓励众包和开源协作。
AI.method: 设计并实现一款结合立体摄像头和IMU的头戴式设备，采用硬件同步与Linux嵌入式板，结合软件堆栈，实现高效录制与数据同步，并配套3D打印部件和开源组装说明。并组织分布式贡献者在日常环境中收集了大量注释好的数据。
AI.result: 推出成本低于200美元的可组装硬件，完整的软件处理链，以及550小时高注释质量的双目视频与同步IMU数据。所有设计与数据均开源，数据注释精细，包含3D手部重建与日常动作标签。
AI.conclusion: Ego-OSCAR极大降低了第一视角数据采集工具的成本和门槛，便于众包和学术/工业团队自主扩展相关研究。其开源属性促进了社区合作与创新。

title: Build it, Break it, Repeat: Benchmarking and improving LLM-manipulated disinformation detection in social media posts
summary: Detecting machine-generated disinformation on social media is increasingly difficult as large language models (LLMs) make it easier to generate and rewrite misleading content at scale. Static benchmark evaluations, measuring detector performance on fixed held-out datasets, do not capture how detectors behave when posts are deliberately transformed to evade classification. This paper adapts the Build it, Break it, Fix it framework into Build it, Break it, Repeat (BiBiR): iterative sessions designed to stress-test detectors' robustness under iterative adversarial conditions, evaluating whether models remain reliable when disinformation posts are systematically transformed to evade classification. Across five iterations, the findings show that the best adversarial breakers' transformations came from a combination of back-translation and LLM persona-based rewriting, with the best performing technique achieving a 95% label flip rate (LFR), whilst still preserving the meaning of the original posts. The best builders' model was a triplet contrastive model with a dynamic anchor switching (DASS) architecture, which achieved an average accuracy of 72.68%, outperforming the strong baseline (a fine-tuned e5-small-LoRA) by 15 percentage points on the most robust set of breakers' adversarial attacks. The results demonstrate that an iterative framework best exposes detector weaknesses and pushes robustness improvements; however, it may still require semantic preservation analysis to distinguish valid adversarial evasion from transformations that changed the original disinformation claims' meaning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一种新的迭代测试框架（BiBiR），用以评估社交媒体虚假信息检测模型在面对经过多步对抗性改写后的稳健性。实验发现，现有检测模型在强对抗攻防下准确率下降显著，但引入对比学习和动态锚点机制可显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型生成和改写虚假内容能力的提升，检测模型容易被规避。静态数据集测试无法揭示检测模型在实际对抗环境下的表现，因此亟需动态、迭代的评测方法来揭示和提升检测系统的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 作者将Build it, Break it, Fix it框架扩展为Build it, Break it, Repeat (BiBiR)，包含多轮对抗游戏，通过回译和LLM角色重写不断生成难以检测的虚假信息，并用这些样本反复评测和改进检测模型。提出使用三元组对比损失和动态锚点切换（DASS）结构，提高检测器对对抗样本的灵活性和准确率。
AI.result: 经过五轮迭代，对抗者结合回译与LLM重写，能使原检测标签翻转率高达95%，大部分保留原意。最佳检测模型（三元组对比+DASS结构）在最强对抗攻击下准确率为72.68%，比精调LoRA基线高15个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 迭代评测框架能够最大程度暴露检测器的弱点，也是推动其鲁棒性提升的有效方法。然而，区分真实语义规避与彻底改变原文含义仍需进一步的语义保留分析。

title: RynnValue: Scaling Robotic Value Foundation Models with Temporal Distance
summary: General-purpose reward models are increasingly the bottleneck for scaling robot learning, yet the recipe for learning value-related capabilities from large-scale heterogeneous corpora remains underexplored. Existing approaches tie supervision to task-internal anchors such as preferences or normalized progress, none of which transfer cleanly across embodiments and data sources. We introduce RynnValue, an open-source value foundation model for robotic manipulation that replaces these anchors with temporal distance, the directed cost-to-go from an observation to the language-specified goal. Because temporal-distance labels can be derived directly from timestamps, RynnValue scales to over 7,000 hours and roughly 3M instruction-conditioned clips without preference or progress annotations. To make temporal-value learning reliable at scale, we combine random temporal sampling, temporal-order shuffling, and value-isolation attention, suppressing shortcuts that would leave predictions insensitive to failures and regressions. Trained without preference labels, RynnValue attains an average Kendall's tau_a of 0.675 on RBM-EVAL-OOD, surpassing the fully preference-supervised state of the art (0.655) and more than doubling a progress-only counterpart (0.292), while generalizing zero-shot to unseen tasks, embodiments, and viewpoints. Converted into dense rewards via potential-based shaping, it raises real-world policy success from 52.5% to 72.5% online and from 63.8% to 82.5% offline. These results establish temporal distance as a scalable supervision target and practical reward interface for generalist robot policies.

AI.tldr: 提出RynnValue，一种无需偏好或进度标注、基于时间距离的通用机器人操控奖励模型，在多个任务上超越了现有方法，显著提升了机器人策略的实际成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人奖励模型依赖偏好或进度等人工标注，导致泛化性差且不易大规模扩展，需要新的方法来解决跨任务、跨数据源的奖励建模问题。
AI.method: RynnValue用时间距离（从观测到目标的有向步数）取代传统的监督锚点，通过直接从时间戳构建标签，结合随机时间采样、时间顺序打乱以及价值隔离注意力，从而实现大规模、无偏好标注的奖励学习。
AI.result: RynnValue无需偏好标注，Kendall's tau_a得分达到0.675，超过以偏好为监督的主流方法(0.655)和仅基于进度的方法(0.292)，还能零样本泛化至新任务和新视角。将其输出变为密集奖励后，机器人策略成功率也显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 时间距离是可扩展、实用的通用机器人奖励建模接口，RynnValue为大规模机器人智能奠定了基础，并推动了通用性机器人策略的发展。

title: What Irregularity Costs: CUDA C++, Rust, and Triton on a Hash-Blocked GPU Workload
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Includes a correctness result for TSDF fusion implementations: at hash load factors reached by ordinary depth trajectories, the Triton implementation silently discards blocks. Code, raw measurement CSVs and an interactive viewer: https://github.com/realitymatrix/what-irregularity-costs
summary:
GPU language comparisons are almost always run on tiled dense linear algebra, where every toolchain is good and the differences are small. We implement the same hash-blocked TSDF fusion kernel in CUDA C++, in Rust through NVIDIA's cuda-oxide, and in Triton, and measure it on a workload with the opposite character: an open-addressed hash table with compare-exchange insertion, data-dependent per-lane probe depth, and contended scatter.
  The result is a split. On the regular stage, which walks a truncation band and accumulates, all three languages land within a small factor of each other. On the irregular stage, which probes and inserts, Rust stays close to hand-written CUDA C++ while Triton is more than an order of magnitude slower. Language choice is nearly free on the work that is usually benchmarked and expensive on the work that is not.
  We attribute both gaps to specific things the languages cannot express, not to ratios. Triton's cost follows from a probe loop that must run to a compile-time bound and from tl.atomic_cas taking no mask, which forces a scratch structure with no counterpart in CUDA. Rust's cost was invisible in every instruction count: its kernel issues fewer instructions, fewer compare-exchanges and fewer registers at identical occupancy, yet was slower. Hardware counters located it in L1 residency. A GPU-scope atomic load must be coherent across SMs, no NVIDIA L1 is, so the type-correct way to read a shared location bypasses the cache on every access.
  Triton's bounded probe is also a correctness problem for fusion: at load factors an ordinary depth trajectory reaches, it silently discards blocks and the reconstruction loses patches of surface with nothing reported. We also report a defect found and fixed in cuda-oxide itself, now merged upstream: its scoped atomic load and store could not be called at all in the build mode that produces real kernels.

AI.tldr: 对比CUDA C++、Rust（通过cuda-oxide）和Triton三种GPU编程语言/工具链在实现复杂哈希表操作（TSDF融合）的性能，发现语言和工具链在常规密集线性代数任务时都表现接近，但在数据依赖性高、竞争严重的不规则任务上存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 目前GPU编程语言性能对比几乎都基于规则且易于优化的线性代数任务，并不能真实反映工具链在复杂实际任务中的表现。作者希望了解三种主流GPU编程方案在“极端不规则”数据结构和算法上的优劣和问题。
AI.method: 实现同一个哈希块TSDF融合kernel，分别采用CUDA C++、Rust（通过cuda-oxide）和Triton三种方案。在常规累加阶段和不规则哈希表插入阶段分别进行性能测试，并细致分析语言本身设计对性能和正确性的影响。
AI.result: 在规则的遍历累计阶段，三个语言/工具链的表现接近。但在不规则哈希表操作阶段，Rust几乎与手写CUDA C++持平，Triton则慢了一个数量级以上。性能差异主要由语言/编译器无法表达的特定机制导致，而非简单的内核指令数量差异。Triton的性能损耗由于编译期上界和原子操作缺陷，Rust虽在指令层无明显瓶颈，但因原子读cache一致性导致实际执行变慢。还发现Triton的设计缺陷会导致重建丢失表面块且无警告，cuda-oxide在原子操作支持上也修复了一个实际bug。
AI.conclusion: GPU编程语言/工具链在常规benchmarks下差异微小，但在高度不规则、数据依赖的实际复杂场景下，语言/工具链的表达力和硬件映射机制极大影响性能和正确性，这些不足被现有benchmark掩盖，因此评估标准应更贴近实际问题。

title: TCS-BENCH: Benchmarking State-of-the-Art Generative AI Theoretical Computer Science Research Ability
summary: We introduce TCS-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) on research-level Theoretical Computer Science (TCS) proof generation. TCS-Bench consists of theorem-proving tasks from papers published at top theoretical computer science venues (STOC, FOCS, and SODA). Each task provides the necessary context to derive a self-contained proof for a target result. We evaluate state-of-the-art models on this benchmark. We verify the correctness of generated proofs via a verification agent, and further benchmark the verifier against human-expert proof judgements on a set of target statements and generated proofs pairs. Our reference verifier achieves over 90% accuracy on the expert labeled set.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TCS-Bench基准，用于评估大语言模型在理论计算机科学证明生成方面的能力，并构建了自动及专家评审体系。
AI.motivation: 当前主流大语言模型虽然已在不同任务上取得进展，但缺少专门针对高难度理论计算机科学证明生成的基准和系统评价方法。
AI.method: 收集顶级理论计算机科学会议（STOC、FOCS、SODA）中已发表论文中的证明任务，构建包含自足证明要求的TCS-Bench数据集。利用验证代理自动评估模型输出，并通过人工专家对部分样本进行判断，对比验证质量。
AI.result: 最先进的模型在该基准上进行了评测。参考验证器在专家标注样本集上准确率超过90%。
AI.conclusion: TCS-Bench为验证大语言模型在理论计算机科学证明任务上的能力提供了新平台，证明了自动验证方案的可行性和高准确率。

title: Agentic Harnesses: LLM-Driven Verification Layers for Robot Autonomy
comment: 7 pages. Not yet finalized for conference submission
summary: Advances in advanced artificial intelligence tools have sparked research in robot autonomy, but the development of such systems has largely focused on execution rather than verifying the feasibility actions planning models propose. Like general-purpose LLMs, robotics planning models carry risks: biased toward user-specified goals, they may suggest actions misaligned with scientific ethics, they may be unsafe due to an inability to "remember" prior safety risks, or they may be vulnerable to adversarial attacks on the autonomy ecosystem. We propose a LLM-driven verification layer between planning and execution to evaluate action permissibility. Our LLM-as-a-Judge ensemble combines chain-of-thought reasoning across models and synthesizes those expert judge outputs, mirroring a combination of a mixture of experts and self-consistency approach. This layer serves as middleware, gating plans from the server's planning module before they reach the MCP server and therefore the robot's low-level controls: plans are approved, rejected for reformulation, or escalated for human review. With this system, we achieve near 85% precision across accept/escalate/reject categories 97% containment of adversarial attacks, with negligible errors between accepting and rejecting tasks, and errors mostly manifesting at the escalate boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的机器人决策验证层，用于在机器人执行前评估行动方案是否合法、安全，并能有效防御对自主系统的攻击。
AI.motivation: 目前机器人自主系统多注重于行动方案的执行，而忽视了行动模型本身方案的可行性和安全性验证，这可能导致伦理、偏差和安全等风险。鉴于大模型决策时存在与用户目标偏置、遗忘安全风险、易受对抗攻击等问题，有必要在执行前对方案加一道审核。
AI.method: 提出在机器人规划模块与低层控制之间加入LLM驱动的“法官集成层”，该层通过多模型推理和专家意见综合，实现方案批准、驳回或升级人工审核三种处理。方法结合了专家混合与自洽性思想，从而形成决策网关。
AI.result: 系统在判断接受/升级/驳回三类任务中达到了约85%的精度，对抗攻击遏制率达97%，在接受与拒绝的区分上几乎无误，主要误差集中在升级人工审核边界。
AI.conclusion: 该LLM验证中间层能够有效提升机器人自主系统的安全性和合规性，同时具备良好的抗对抗攻击能力，是机器人规划与执行之间的重要安全屏障。

title: Test-Time Prototype Adaptation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) repurposes a pretrained CLIP encoder for dense prediction without additional labeled supervision. Existing methods improve CLIP's spatial behavior either by redesigning its internal attention or by injecting features from auxiliary vision foundation models; both require access to the host's internal computation and are tailored to its specific forward pass. In this work, we propose Test-time Prototype Adaptation (TPA), a training-free plug-in that operates at the output level, leaving the host's forward pass and weights unmodified. By leveraging a lightweight transductive adaptation phase, TPA identifies confident anchor patches from the host's own output predictions on a small pool of unlabeled deployment-domain images, and aggregates their frozen DINO features into per-class prototypes; at inference, a single cosine similarity lookup against this frozen bank provides an auxiliary score fused linearly with the host's logits. TPA composes with five representative OVSS hosts spanning attention-redesign and VFM-injection designs, across three CLIP backbones, eight benchmarks, and multiple internal VFM choices. Under a single set of hyper-parameters and without per-host tuning or parameter updates, TPA consistently improves segmentation accuracy, with as few as approximately 10% of unlabeled deployment-domain images sufficing for effective bank construction on most benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需重新训练的新方法TPA（Test-time Prototype Adaptation），可在推理阶段直接提升开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）表现，且不需修改原有模型结构或权重。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇语义分割方法为弥补CLIP空间表现缺陷，通常需修改注意力机制或引入外部特征，限制了通用性和灵活性。作者希望实现一种无需修改主模型即可提升分割性能的方法。
AI.method: TPA方法是在测试时，从少量未标注的测试域图像中选取模型预测最自信的区域（anchor patch），用其凍結的DINO特征构建类别原型库。推理时，通过余弦相似度查表，对每个类别得到辅助分数，并与原模型logits线性融合，无需训练和调参，作为即插即用插件。
AI.result: 广泛测试了五种OVSS主模型、三种CLIP骨干网络和八个数据集，无需主模型调参，在多实验场景中TPA都获得了显著的分割精度提升。仅需大约10%未标注部署域样本即可取得有效提升。
AI.conclusion: TPA是一种灵活高效、无需训练且兼容多种主方法和主干的OVSS性能增强方案，为跨域迁移和实际部署提供了有价值的解决思路。

title: Mawqif-v2: An Arabic Benchmark Dataset for Cross-Target Stance Detection
summary: Publicly available Arabic datasets for target-specific stance detection remain limited, particularly for evaluating cross-target generalization. This paper presents the Mawqif-v2 Extension, consisting of 996 manually annotated Arabic tweets collected from three public targets: Women Driving, E-Cars, and Trimester System. Each tweet is annotated with stance, sentiment, and sarcasm labels following the original Mawqif annotation scheme. The released extension is intended as a held-out evaluation set for assessing model generalization to both semantically related and previously unseen targets, while the original Mawqif dataset is used for training and development. In addition, we establish baseline results using several Arabic and multilingual transformer models, as well as zero-shot large language models (LLMs), to facilitate reproducible evaluation. Together with the original Mawqif dataset, the Mawqif-v2 Extension provides a benchmark for evaluating cross-target generalization in Arabic stance detection.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布了面向目标立场检测的阿拉伯语推文数据集Mawqif-v2扩展，其中包含996条经过人工标注的推文，可作为跨目标泛化能力评测基准。
AI.motivation: 现有用于目标相关立场检测（stance detection）的阿拉伯语公开数据集非常有限，尤其缺乏针对“跨目标泛化”能力的评测数据。这阻碍了模型在新话题上的泛化能力研究和比较。
AI.method: 作者收集了996条阿拉伯语推文，覆盖三个公众话题：女性驾车、电动汽车、三学期制。每条推文人工标注立场、情感和讽刺标签，采用原Mawqif数据集标注方案。新扩展集专为测试模型在已知和新话题上的泛化能力而设计，并与原数据集（用于训练及开发）配套使用。同时，作者基于多种阿拉伯语和多语种transformer模型及零样本下的大模型（LLMs）设置了基线实验，方便可复现评测。
AI.result: 扩展集成功采集并公开，提供了不同模型在该数据集上的基线性能结果。
AI.conclusion: Mawqif-v2扩展集与原数据集一起，为阿拉伯语立场检测的跨目标泛化能力评估提供了新基准，有望促进该领域进一步发展。

title: Entanglement-Free Trajectory Planning for Tethered Mobile Robots with a Slack Tether
summary: In motion planning algorithms for tethered mobile robots, the entanglement state of the tether is a critical aspect to consider during the planning phase. This is particularly important in case of a slack tether, where the shape of the tether is not determined solely by the geometry of the environment and the location of the obstacles, but also by the dynamics of the tether, by the trajectory followed by the robot, and possibly by exogenous forces. In this scenario, preventing entanglement requires planning a robot trajectory that accounts for the entanglement definition and for the dynamics of the robot and of the tether. In this work, we propose a motion planning algorithm for tethered mobile robots with a slack tether that computes dynamically feasible entanglement-free trajectories to navigate through an environment with static obstacles. By considering the entanglement state during all the stages of the planning pipeline, we are able to compute safer trajectories that avoid entanglement during the motion of the robot. We achieve this through a three-step pipeline, which includes (i) the construction of a topological model of the entanglement-free configuration space of the tethered robot, (ii) the generation of a set of candidate paths using this model, and (iii) the computation of a dynamically feasible entanglement-free trajectory by solving a homotopy-constrained trajectory generation problem. The resulting trajectory can then be executed to lead the robot to its target location, while maintaining the tether in an entanglement-free configuration. We demonstrate the benefits of this algorithm in simulations, where we show how the planning algorithm avoids violations of the entanglement constraints, resulting in safer and more reliable trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对牵引绳松弛的移动机器人规划算法，能够动态生成无缠结的运动路径，确保机器人安全通过障碍环境。
AI.motivation: 牵引机器人在运动路径规划中，绳索缠结严重影响任务的安全与效率，特别是在绳索松弛、受动力学与环境影响下，缠结风险更高，因此需要能避免缠结的运动规划方法。
AI.method: 提出一个三步运动规划流程：(1) 构建无缠结构型空间的拓扑模型；(2) 基于该模型生成路径候选集；(3) 通过求解同伦约束下的轨迹生成问题获得动态可行的无缠结轨迹。该方法全面考虑机器人与绳索的动力学以及缠结约束。
AI.result: 在仿真实验中，该算法能有效避免缠结，规划出的路径更安全、可靠，体现了其在复杂障碍环境下的优势。
AI.conclusion: 本工作证明了在运动规划全流程中引入缠结状态建模可显著提升牵引绳机器人的导航安全性及可靠性，为实际应用提供了有力的方法支持。

title: Frequency-Domain Dual-Branch Fusion for Medical Visual Question Answering
comment: 7 Pages, 4 figures, under review at AAAI 27
summary: Medical Visual Question Answering (VQA) requires aligning subtle visual evidence, including lesion texture, boundary sharpness, and diffuse density changes, with clinical language. Existing multimodal fusion approaches operating in the spatial domain may not fully exploit complementary frequency information present in visual and textual representations. We introduce a dual-branch frequency-domain fusion module that conditions spectral filtering on the input question, enabling adaptive selection of global low-frequency structure and fine-grained high-frequency detail before reconstructing the spatial representation for answer generation. To provide a richer spectrum for filtering, we extract complementary features from early texture-sensitive and final semantic layers of a frozen BiomedCLIP encoder and align both with the question representation using a symmetric InfoNCE objective prior to staged joint training with a BioBART decoder. We pretrain the proposed model on PMC-VQA and fine-tune it on the VQA-RAD and SLAKE benchmarks, demonstrating that frequency-aware multimodal fusion improves medical VQA performance while maintaining a lightweight and efficient architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于频域融合的医学VQA方法，有效提升了视觉与文本信息对齐能力，取得了更好的VQA表现。
AI.motivation: 医学图像问答任务需要对视觉细节与医学语言进行精准对齐，如病灶质地、边界锐利度、密度变化等，但现有多模态融合方式主要在空间域操作，难以充分利用视觉和文本中的互补频率信息。
AI.method: 提出双分支的频域融合模块，通过根据输入问题条件化的谱过滤，自适应选取低频结构和高频细节。特征提取方面，采用冻结的BiomedCLIP编码器的早期纹理感知层和最终语义层，分别提取互补特征并使用对称InfoNCE目标与问题表示对齐，最后联合BioBART解码器进行分阶段训练。
AI.result: 模型在PMC-VQA上预训练，并在VQA-RAD与SLAKE数据集上微调，结果表明频谱感知的多模态融合方案能有效提升医学VQA性能，同时保持结构高效轻量。
AI.conclusion: 频域融合为医学VQA任务带来了准确性和效率的提升，为多模态医学AI应用提供了新的思路。

title: ELBench: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Education-Facing Large Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in education as tutors, teaching assistants, and content generators. These roles place demands that ordinary question answering does not: a usable education-facing model is supposed to be accurate, safe under sensitive prompts, instructionally useful, and aligned with pedagogical goals at the same time. Existing benchmarks evaluate these requirements largely in isolation, so none assesses education-facing suitability as an integrated profile. We introduce ELBench, the first benchmark to evaluate all four requirements (General Capability, Safety and Trustworthiness, Basic Education, and High-Level Cultivation) on the same models under a common protocol, combining curated public sources with newly synthesized safety and cultivation data. We evaluate nine models, seven frontier general-purpose systems and two education-specialized variants, and report three findings. First, module-level profiles are more informative than a single aggregate: the top six models are statistically indistinguishable on overall score, yet their module leaders differ substantially, and safety is anti-correlated with practical teaching (r = -0.83). Second, the Chinese-developed models lead the safety module, the most discriminative in the suite; this advantage is largest on region-specific normative content and narrows, but does not vanish, on universal-harm content. Third, the two education-specialized models lead neither education module, and on High-Level Cultivation all models share a systematic blind spot: on the structured judgment task they converge on the same non-reference option, favoring pedagogical style over fit to the stated goal, so the module scores uniformly low and does not separate models. This raises, but does not resolve, whether domain post-training keeps pace with frontier systems on education tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文引入了ELBench，是第一个同时评估大型语言模型在教育领域所需的准确性、安全性、教学实用性和教学目标一致性的综合基准，分析了主流模型在这些方面的表现与差异。
AI.motivation: 目前教育领域的AI模型需要同时满足准确性、安全性、教学实用性和教学目标一致性，但现有评测均各自为战，无法横向综合评判模型是否真正适合教育应用。为解决此痛点，作者提出要开发一个能一体化评估教育相关多项要求的基准。
AI.method: 作者提出了ELBench，涵盖通用能力、安全与可信性、基础教育、高阶培养四大模块，通过汇集公开数据及新合成的安全、培养数据，并对七个主流通用大模型与两个教育专用模型开展系统评测。
AI.result: 1）整体分数看似接近，但四大模块下各模型优劣显著不同，且安全与教学实用性存在负相关。2）中国开发的模型在安全性上表现领先，尤其在区域规范内容上优势显著，但在通用有害内容上差距缩小。3）教育专用模型反而未能领先任何教育子模块，所有模型在高阶培养任务上均存系统性盲点。
AI.conclusion: ELBench揭示了当前主流甚至专用教育模型在多项关键教育需求上的短板，尤其在高阶培养和安全性间的平衡难题仍未解决。该基准有望推动未来模型在教育领域的更全面健康发展。

title: Energy-Structured Latent World Models with Neural Time Fields for Physically Constistent Open-World Motion Planning
summary: Physically consistent motion planning remains a fundamental challenge in embodied AI, as generated trajectories must strictly conform to real-world execution dynamics. While latent world models offer a promising approach by predicting these dynamics, existing methods learn unconstrained future representations where absorbed physics remains implicit. Therefore, they fail to form reusable physical knowledge, which compromises reliability in unpredictable open-world navigation. To address this, we propose a novel Energy-Structured Latent World Model (ELWM). Our key idea is to structure the ELWM latent state to explicitly carry energy and momentum, ensuring strictly causal transitions via dissipation and control ports. Trained on multimodal RGB-D and inertial interaction histories, our model guarantees physically consistent predictions. We further implement this for motion planning by constructing Physics-Conditioned Neural Time Fields (PC-NTF), a key technical cornerstone that integrates ELWM into an arrival time field via the Eikonal equation to yield a physically-informed navigation policy. Across held-out scenes, our evaluation reveals significant improvements. Compared to generic latent models, PC-NTF reduces 0.8-s motion-prediction NRMSE from 0.36 to 0.29. Against Active Neural Time Fields, it improves navigation success from 81.3% to 89.7% and SPL from 0.64 to 0.73, while cutting the physical collision rate from 12.1% to 5.8% and the Eikonal residual from 0.083 to 0.031. Beyond these targeted gains, our results demonstrate that embedding explicit physical structures into latent spaces intrinsically bridges the gap between predictive world models and safe, dynamically feasible motion planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种能显式表达能量和动量的能量结构化潜在世界模型（ELWM），提升了物理一致性与导航可靠性，并通过与物理条件神经时间场（PC-NTF）的结合，显著优化了运动规划表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的潜在世界模型在预测动态时，其潜在空间中的物理规律表现为隐含和无约束，难以形成可复用的物理知识，导致在实际环境导航中可靠性不足，尤其是在开放、不确定的场景下。
AI.method: 提出能源结构化潜在世界模型（ELWM），其潜在状态中显式嵌入能量和动量，并通过耗散和控制端口确保物理因果一致性。模型在多模态RGB-D及惯性历史数据上训练。为运动规划设计物理条件神经时间场（PC-NTF），通过Eikonal方程将ELWM纳入到到达时间场，制定物理信息驱动的导航策略。
AI.result: 在多组场景测试中，PC-NTF相较通用潜在模型将0.8秒的运动预测NRMSE从0.36降至0.29、导航成功率从81.3%提升至89.7%、SPL从0.64提升至0.73，同时物理碰撞率从12.1%降至5.8%、Eikonal残差从0.083降至0.031。
AI.conclusion: 显式将物理结构纳入潜在空间能让世界模型更好地服务于安全且动态可行的运动规划，有效提升了运动规划的物理一致性和导航性能，显著缩小了世界模型预测与实际可行物理运动之间的差距。

title: Open-World Semantic Segmentation with Sensitivity Modeling
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP) Satellite Workshops
summary: Modern vision systems must operate in "open-world" settings, where models must recognize known categories and detect unseen or anomalous content. Conventional semantic segmentation models operate under a "closed-world" assumption, often producing overconfident misclassifications on novel content. We address open-world semantic segmentation, the joint task of segmenting known classes while detecting and grouping novel or anomalous content without additional supervision, by extending a dual-decoder baseline with a third, complementary decoder within a unified encoder-decoder design. The first decoder performs closed-set segmentation using Gaussian prototypes for known categories. The second uses contrastive feature learning to isolate unknown regions in embedding space. The third, our key contribution, is a sensitivity decoder that captures fine-grained texture irregularities and activation instabilities indicative of semantic uncertainty, which neither semantic prototypes nor contrastive norms can reliably detect. The three decoders provide genuinely complementary signals: class-level OOD distance in logit space, global feature energy in embedding space, and local activation instability across encoder scales. Experiments on Cityscapes and BDD-Anomaly show that our method improves anomaly segmentation and novel-class discovery while maintaining competitive closed-set accuracy, with gains of +2.4% AUROC and a 2.5 pp. reduction in FPR@95TPR on BDD-Anomaly over the baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的多解码器结构，用于在开放世界场景下同时进行已知类别分割和未知/异常内容检测，相较于现有方法在异常检测和新类别发现方面有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 传统的语义分割模型通常假设世界是封闭的，只处理已知类别，面对未知数据容易自信地犯错误。实际视觉系统需要识别已知类别同时还能检测到未知或异常内容，提升模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.method: 在统一的编码-解码架构下，设计并集成了三个相互补充的解码器：第一个以高斯原型进行已知类别分割，第二个通过对比学习在特征空间中区分未知区域，第三个（核心贡献）则为敏感度解码器，抓取反映模型语义不确定性的纹理异常和激活不稳定性。三者共同输出，不仅能分割已知类别，还能更好检测和分组未知或异常内容。
AI.result: 在Cityscapes和BDD-Anomaly数据集上实验，方法在异常分割和新类别发现上优于基线方案，具体为AUROC提升2.4%，在BDD-Anomaly数据集FPR@95TPR降2.5个百分点，同时保持对已知类别分割的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 提出的三解码器协同结构能有效补充传统语义原型和对比特征的不足，提升开放世界下的分割鲁棒性，为实际开放世界视觉系统提供更可靠的解决方案。

title: Pragmatic Attack Surface: Vulnerabilities of Implicit Context in Large Language Models
summary: In the era of large language models (LLMs), attackers often manipulate natural language to elicit unsafe or harmful outputs, creating a new natural language attack surface unique to LLM-based systems, where attacks directly exploit explicit linguistic cues in user prompts to bypass the safety mechanism of LLMs. However, such attacks can often be mitigated by existing safety alignment algorithms. On the other hand, human language is inherently grounded in pragmatics, necessitating typical context to interpret language, e.g., world knowledge, social norms. However, such contexts are often implicit because they are not directly expressed in human language and are not sufficiently leveraged in safety alignment, creating a fundamental mismatch between human language interpretation and safety alignment approaches. In this paper, we demonstrate that this mismatch exposes vulnerabilities in LLMs. We refer to this vulnerability as the pragmatic attack surface, which can be exploited to achieve high attack success rates. The experimental results demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms baseline attack methods across various open-source and closed-source models by a substantial margin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的针对大语言模型（LLMs）的攻击方式—语用攻击（pragmatic attack surface），并实验证明此方式能更有效绕过现有安全防护。
AI.motivation: 当前LLMs的安全对抗主要关注可见语言提示的直接利用方式，但人类语言理解还依赖隐含的语用上下文，这些部分往往未被现有安全机制有效覆盖。
AI.method: 提出并系统分析了语用攻击面，即通过语用（即隐藏在外部常识、社会规范等上下文中的隐含信息）操控模型，开展攻击。通过与主流攻击基线进行对比实验，评估了该方法在不同大模型上的效果。
AI.result: 实验证明，提出的语用攻击在多种开源和闭源大模型上成功率远超现有方法，展现了突出优势。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLMs安全机制在隐含语用信息保护上存在重大短板，未来需关注并加强对语用攻击面的防护。

title: RoSE: A Robotic Soft Esophagus for Endoprosthetic Stent Testing
comment: Author accepted manuscript. 31 pages, 13 figures, 3 tables. Published in Soft Robotics (2021). Project page: https://bhattner143.github.io/rose-stent.github.io/
summary: Soft robotic systems are well suited for developing devices for biomedical applications. A bio-mimicking robotic soft esophagus (RoSE) is developed as an in vitro testing device of endoprosthetic stents for dysphagia management. Endoprosthetic stent placement is an immediate and cost-effective therapy for dysphagia caused by malignant esophageal strictures from esophageal cancer. However, later stage complications, like stent migration, could weaken swallow efficacy in the esophagus. The stent radial force (RF) on the esophageal wall is pivotal in avoiding stent migration. Due to limited randomized controlled trials in patients, stent design and stenting guidelines remain incomplete. To address this knowledge deficit, we investigate RoSE by implanting two stents (A and B) of different radial stiffness characteristics, to measure stent RF and its effect on migration. Endoscopic manometry under peristalsis is also performed to study the impact of stenting and stent dysfunction on intra-bolus pressure signatures (IBPSs) and swallowing efficacy. Each implanted stent undergoes experiments with varied peristalsis velocity, wavelength, and bolus concentrations. The results show that stiffer stent B has a higher RF, whereas stent A maintains a lower RF profile due to lesser stiffness. High RF is necessary to minimize migration under prolonged peristaltic contractions in RoSE. For manometry, stent A slightly increases IBPS, but stiffer stent B significantly decreases IBPS, especially for higher-concentration boluses. If a stiffer stent buckles, it can reduce swallow efficacy and cause recurrent dysphagia. RoSE is therefore an innovative soft robotic platform for testing endoprosthetic stents and addressing clinical challenges in stent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了软机器人仿生食管（RoSE）作为内支架移植物的体外测试装置，用于研究不同刚度支架的径向力和迁移现象，并通过食管测压评估其对吞咽效率的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有食管支架用于治疗恶性狭窄所致吞咽困难，但支架迁移等并发症影响疗效。受限于临床试验条件，支架设计和指南不完善，需要体外平台模拟测试不同支架性能及其对吞咽的影响。
AI.method: 开发RoSE软体机器人仿生食管设备，植入两种不同径向刚度的支架，在模拟蠕动下测量支架径向力（RF）和迁移情况，并通过内镜测压研究不同蠕动条件和食团浓度对吞咽压力特征和效率的影响。
AI.result: 高刚度支架B具有较高径向力，可更好防止迁移，但极高刚度支架变形（弯曲）时可能反而影响吞咽效率。较软支架A径向力较低，对IBPS影响小，刚度过高的支架会显著降低IBPS，尤其对高浓度食团。
AI.conclusion: RoSE提供了一种创新的软机器人体外仿生食管平台，可系统测试和评估食管支架性能，辅助改进临床支架设计及相关治疗指南，推动食管癌相关吞咽障碍管理的发展。

title: Three Necessary Principles for Self-Supervised Visual Representation Learning
comment: Accepted at the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026) Workshops
summary: We argue that learning visual representations without labels requires a training signal jointly complete across three non-overlapping objectives: semantic invariance across augmented views, patch-level spatial prediction, and representational non-degeneracy. We formalize these as the observation, prediction, and regularization principles and prove (i) that combining observation and prediction without regularization admits the constant encoder as a global minimizer under negative-free alignment; (ii) that the two objectives are gradient-complementary and structurally non-conflicting at the encoder output; and (iii) that the momentum encoder converges to the same fixed point as the online encoder and provides no collapse guarantee at convergence. Contrastive alignment provides only self-limiting collapse resistance, formalized via an explicit gradient-decay argument. Dropping prediction withholds the spatial training signal by construction; dropping observation forfeits cross-view semantic invariance by construction; at the scale we study, no pair substitutes for the third. Every major self-supervised method is a special case of a single unified energy decomposition. We pair every theoretical claim with a controlled experiment, including a patch-retrieval evaluation for the spatial consequence of prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的理论框架分析无监督视觉表示学习，强调需要三种互补目标信号的联合：跨视图语义不变性、局部空间预测和非退化表征，并通过实验和理论分析证明其必要性。
AI.motivation: 无监督视觉表征学习通常依赖对比、自监督等不同目标，现有方法难以解释三类信号各自的作用及相互关系。动机在于找出学到有效表征的必要和充分条件，为表征学习提供统一理论解释。
AI.method: 作者提出观察、预测和正则化三大原则，分别对应跨视图语义不变性、局部空间预测和表征非退化。通过数学理论和对比实验，分析不同目标组合的表征性能和可能出现的退化现象，并用patch-retrieval实验验证空间预测分量的效果。
AI.result: 证明了观察和预测目标在无正则化条件下会导致表征退化，两个目标在梯度上是互补且结构上没有冲突；动量编码器和在线编码器收敛到同一个平衡点，不能独立防止表征坍缩。三类信号缺一不可。所有主流自监督方法都可视为他们提出的统一能量分解的特例。
AI.conclusion: 有效的无标签视觉表征学习需结合三类互补信号，没有单一目标或双目标可替代。论文的理论、实验统一了自监督学习各类方法并明确了其共同基础。

title: Se-DPO: Self-Evolving Token Credit for Direct Preference Optimization
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aggregates token-level log-probability ratios via uniform summation, implicitly treating all tokens as contributing equally to the preference signal. However, the contribution of individual tokens to the preference signal varies. We introduce token credit, which modulates each token's KL regularization based on its contribution to the preference outcome. We derive that effective token credit is proportional to the magnitude of each token's implicit reward, and observe that this quantity evolves substantially during training. This implies that static token credit becomes increasingly misaligned as training progresses. In this work, we propose Se-DPO (Self-Evolving Token Credit for DPO), a live mechanism that derives token credit from the model's own evolving internal signals during DPO training. Since the reward signal varies in reliability across positions, Se-DPO calibrates token credit based on both the strength and the confidence of each token's contribution. Se-DPO requires no external models, adding only a lightweight calibration network with minimal computational overhead. Experiments show that Se-DPO improves over DPO by up to 9.8 points on AlpacaEval~2 and 12.2 points on Arena-Hard.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种改进的偏好直接优化方法（Se-DPO），通过动态调整每个token的贡献权重，显著提升了模型效果。
AI.motivation: 传统DPO方法在对token级别的偏好信号做均匀处理，未能考虑各token对结果影响的差异，导致性能受限。
AI.method: 作者提出token credit机制，根据每个token对偏好结果的贡献，动态调整KL正则。并提出Se-DPO方法，利用模型自身的内部信号实时决定token credit，采用轻量化校准网络，无需额外外部模型。
AI.result: Se-DPO在AlpacaEval 2和Arena-Hard测试集上分别相比DPO提升了9.8和12.2分。
AI.conclusion: 引入自适应token credit机制的Se-DPO方法有效提升了偏好优化性能，且计算开销小，实现简单。

title: XPolicyLab: A Unified Standard and Open Ecosystem for Robot Policy Evaluation and Deployment
summary: Robot policy evaluation and deployment remain fragmented by model-specific software dependencies, data representations, and runtime interfaces, so that connecting N policies to M evaluation environments requires O(NM) separate integrations. We present XPolicyLab, a unified standard and open ecosystem that reduces this cost to O(N+M). XPolicyLab specifies common observation, action, and trajectory schemas together with a minimal adapter interface for observation updates, action prediction, batched execution, and episode reset, while a dependency-isolated client/server architecture separates policy inference from environment execution, so that each side retains its native software stack and may run locally or remotely. The ecosystem integrates 42 robot policies and standardizes their installation, debugging, serving, and evaluation workflows. Across these adapters, model-specific code varies by an order of magnitude while the environment-facing loop stays within a few lines of a fixed reference, confirming that the contract confines heterogeneity to the policy side. In a controlled study, conforming to the standard reduces the integration effort of a representative policy from over five hours to two hours, and packaged agent skills reduce it further to thirty minutes. The same adapters serve RoboTwin, RoboDojo simulation, and standardized real-robot evaluation through one interface. XPolicyLab is released as shared infrastructure for reproducible policy comparison and standardized deployment across simulation and physical platforms. Project website: https://xpolicylab.github.io/.

AI.tldr: XPolicyLab提出了一种统一的标准和生态系统，大幅简化机器人策略与环境集成难度。
AI.motivation: 当前机器人策略评估与部署存在软件依赖、数据表示和运行接口割裂的问题，导致策略与环境之间的集成工作负担以O(NM)级别增加，严重影响研究与实际落地效率。
AI.method: XPolicyLab制定了统一的观测、动作、轨迹标准，提供极简的适配器接口，并采用客户端/服务器架构将策略推断和环境执行分离。这种架构允许各方保留原生技术栈，无论本地或远程运行都能兼容。
AI.result: 集成42种机器人策略，显著简化安装、调试、服务和评估流程。实验证明，标准化后的集成时间从5小时降至2小时，进一步用现成技能包可缩短至30分钟，且只需微量环境侧代码改动。
AI.conclusion: XPolicyLab作为开源基础设施，实现了策略间公平复现、对比和跨平台标准化部署，推动机器人领域方法标准化和复用。

title: Your VLM Already Knows When: Training-Free Temporal Grounding by Asking Yes or No
summary: Multimodal LLMs that recognise events reliably still fail to say when they happen. Prompted for timestamps, strong VLMs reach as little as $3.8\%$ R@0.5 on Charades-STA, and $77$ to $80\%$ of their wrong predictions carry low output entropy: the models are confidently wrong, and entropy-based error detection stays below a random classifier. We show that this failure lives in the task interface, not in perception.
