Holding the weights fixed, replacing timestamp regression with a coarse-to-fine scan of binary questions, whose first-token probabilities are consumed only as a ranking, raises R@0.5 by $28$ to $50$ points across four frozen backbones. The residual failures decompose into two measurable axes: a perception axis that moves with the backbone, and a geometry axis that is analytically predictable from the ratio of the output-window and event widths. FV-Action, the training-free method built on this analysis, reaches $56.8\%$ R@0.5 on Charades-STA, above the same backbone's native grounding pipeline and the strongest training-free result on this benchmark; it surpasses every TVG-trained model evaluated zero-shot on TACoS, and improves over direct prediction on ActivityNet Captions and QVHighlights, with no temporal supervision at any stage.

AI.tldr: 本论文指出当前多模态大模型（如VLMs）能较好识别事件，但在确定事件发生的时间点（时间戳）时表现极差。作者分析问题根源，并提出一种无需训练的新方法，大幅提升了事件时间定位的准确率，在多个基准数据集上均超过现有方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态大模型在事件识别任务上取得重大进展，但在需要定位事件发生时间的任务（如视频理解中的事件时间戳检测）上表现不佳，且模型往往对错误预测信心十足。这表明现有方法在任务接口设计上存在不足，因此有必要提出新的方案以提升模型的时间定位能力。
AI.method: 作者提出将原本的时间戳回归任务转换为“由粗到细的二元问题扫描”，即用一系列二分类判断而非直接预测具体时间。具体做法是冻结主干模型权重，仅用输出首token的概率做排序，实现推理时间点的判别与定位。基于此分析，作者设计了无需训练的新方法FV-Action。
AI.result: 该方法在Charades-STA数据集上R@0.5达到56.8%，比同一backbone的原生方法提升28~50个百分点，并取得Charades-STA上最强的无训练结果。在TACoS等数据集的zero-shot评测中，优于所有经过TVG训练的模型，在ActivityNet Captions和QVHighlights等任务上也比直接预测方法表现更佳，且在任何阶段均未用到时间标注。
AI.conclusion: 文章证明事件时间定位中的性能瓶颈主要来自任务接口设计而非感知能力。通过新颖的二元问题分辨和排序思路，可大幅提升时间定位准确率，且无需重新训练模型，具备普适性和实用性。

title: MDB-Link: Hierarchical Schema Linking for Multi-Database Text-to-SQL
summary: Traditional Text-to-SQL research and benchmarks assume a known target database, overlooking settings in which a query must be routed within a large, heterogeneous database collection. We therefore study schema linking in a multi-database setting, where the system must first locate the target database and then construct a compact, SQL-relevant schema for generation. We propose MDB-Link, a hierarchical schema-linking framework that retrieves question-relevant columns from a global index, aggregates retrieval evidence to shortlist databases, and uses a budget-aware large language model (LLM) for database reranking, table selection, and column grounding. With Qwen2.5-14B, MDB-Link outperforms LinkAlign on MMQA, Spider2-Snow, and BIRD-dev in database localization and column selection while producing schema subsets close in size to the gold schemas. Exact match improves from 16.88 to 51.41 on MMQA, 2.50 to 9.17 on Spider2-Snow, and 12.52 to 38.01 on BIRD-dev. MDB-Link also runs faster than LinkAlign and AutoLink, demonstrating the effectiveness of hierarchical schema reduction for downstream SQL generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种适用于多数据库环境下的层次化模式关联方案MDB-Link，用于提升Text-to-SQL任务在数据库定位与高效模式生成方面的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL研究多假定已知目标数据库，未考虑在大规模、异构数据库集合中需要自动定位数据库并生成与问题相关的紧凑模式的场景。
AI.method: 提出MDB-Link框架，首先基于全局索引检索与问题相关的字段，然后聚合检索证据筛选数据库，再利用预算感知的大语言模型(LLM)进行数据库重排序、表选择与字段关联，实现层次化的模式约简。
AI.result: 在MMQA、Spider2-Snow与BIRD-dev等多数据库基准测试中，MDB-Link在数据库定位和字段选择任务上超过现有的LinkAlign方法，并能生成接近金标准大小的紧凑模式。各测试集准确率显著提升，且运行速度快于LinkAlign和AutoLink。
AI.conclusion: MDB-Link通过分层式模式约简，有效提升了跨数据库Text-to-SQL的性能与效率，为多数据库场景下的自然语言到SQL生成任务提供了新思路。

title: DAP-Pose: Deep Temporal Alignment and Physics-aware Cross-modal Sensor Fusion for Robust Pose Estimation
summary: Robust and accurate pose estimation with multi-modal sensors is fundamental for autonomous vehicles and mobile robotic systems in complex environments. In this paper, we propose DAP-Pose, a unified end-to-end model for robust multi-modal pose estimation. DAP-Pose introduces a Bi-level Cross-modal Fusion (BCF) module that captures complementary semantic and geometric motion cues from visual, inertial, and GNSS measurements. To handle temporal offsets, we designed a Deep Temporal Alignment (DTA) module that explicitly aligns asynchronous streams in latent space, enabling coherent motion modeling without strict hardware synchronization. Furthermore, we incorporate physics-aware constraints via manifold geometry and GNSS-guided absolute metric scale, enforcing motion consistency and mitigating drift. Experiments upon the public KITTI benchmark dataset were conducted to evaluate the performance of DAP-Pose against existing methods. DAP-Pose achieved the state-of-the-art performance, with the lowest average translation error ($t_{rel}$) of 1.31% and rotation error ($r_{rel}$) of 0.46$^{\circ}$. Furthermore, it accurately estimates poses and maintains robust performance under severe artificially injected temporal misalignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DAP-Pose的多传感器融合端到端位姿估计算法，结合了视觉、惯性和GNSS信息，通过创新性融合和对时间异步的处理，在KITTI数据集上实现了当前最优的定位精度，并具有强大的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶和移动机器人在复杂环境下对高精度和鲁棒的定位需求迫切，而多模态数据的协同处理与时间对齐存在挑战，尤其是异步问题和尺度漂移。
AI.method: DAP-Pose模型包括两大创新模块：（1）双层跨模态融合（BCF），融合视觉、惯性、GNSS信号的语义与运动信息；（2）深度时序对齐（DTA），对异步多源数据在特征空间内自动校正，无需严格时间同步。此外，引入了物理约束和GNSS引导的尺度约束，提升了一致性和抗漂移能力。
AI.result: 在KITTI公开数据集上，DAP-Pose取得了当前最低的平移误差（1.31%）和旋转误差（0.46°），在多人为注入严重时间错位情况下，也能准确估计位姿，表现出极强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DAP-Pose方法解决了多源数据异步融合和尺度一致性难题，显著提升了自动驾驶和移动机器人系统在复杂环境下的定位精度与鲁棒性，具备广泛应用前景。

title: A continually expandable foundation model for brain MRI
summary: Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is central to neuroscience and clinical assessment, but models are commonly developed for individual diseases, populations or imaging protocols. Foundation models promise more general representations, yet they are usually pretrained once and can lose earlier capabilities when updated with new data. Here we show that Alcmaeon, a three-dimensional brain MRI foundation model pretrained without manual labels on more than 425,000 volumes and derived imaging maps, can be expanded sequentially across clinical domains. Alcmaeon combines volumetric encoding and latent diffusion generation with Graph-Blueprint Pruning (GBP), which protects network modules important to earlier domains while leaving the remaining capacity trainable. Across expansion from healthy ageing and neurodegeneration to developmental, psychiatric and tumour imaging, GBP showed less forgetting than sequential adaptation and elastic weight consolidation across voxel-level reconstruction measures, with its largest advantage after adaptation to tumour imaging. The blueprints provided an inspectable record of how model capacity was protected and reused. Representations from different model levels supported image synthesis, disease classification, survival modelling and postoperative prediction, although no single representation was optimal for every task. These findings provide a route towards brain MRI foundation models that can grow with emerging data while retaining earlier capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可渐进扩展、能减轻遗忘效应的3D脑MRI基础模型Alcmaeon，并用无监督数据集对其进行预训练。通过Graph-Blueprint Pruning（GBP）方法保护模型对早期任务的能力，实现跨多种临床领域的迁移，无需丢失先前获得的知识。
AI.motivation: 当前脑MRI模型多针对单一疾病、群体或协议开发，缺乏通用性。基础模型虽然具备泛化潜力，但在用新数据增量更新时常遗忘先前能力，难以连续成长。因此，急需一种可随新数据和领域扩展且保留原有认知能力的医学影像基础模型。
AI.method: 作者开发了Alcmaeon模型，在425,000多个MRI及衍生图像上进行无监督预训练。模型采用体积编码和潜在扩散生成机制，并提出Graph-Blueprint Pruning（GBP），为模型划定关键模块蓝图，对重要模块加以保护，剩余部分则用于新领域训练，实现能力有选择的遗忘和保留。
AI.result: Alcmaeon可连续扩展至老年、神经退行、发育、精神和肿瘤等多领域临床任务。GBP法在各任务迁移后比常规顺序适应与弹性权重固化方法表现出更少的遗忘，优势在肿瘤领域最显著。不同层次表征支持影像合成、疾病分类、生存建模及术后预测，但未有单一表征在所有任务上最优。
AI.conclusion: Alcmaeon与GBP方法为医学影像基础模型提供可成长、可拓展、能力可持续的解决方案。该方法显著减少连续学习过程中的遗忘效应，可支持模型随新兴数据和临床需求不断进化，同时保留已获知识，具备推广价值。

title: Measuring the Wrong Thing: Internal Harmfulness Scores Anti-Rank Successful Jailbreaks
summary: Internal safety scores judge a prompt before any text is generated, and they are validated by how well they separate harmful prompts from benign ones. That separation is then read as evidence that the score will also catch the attacks that succeed. Harmful intent is a property of the prompt. Jailbreak success is an outcome produced later by a particular target model, decoding policy, and judge. A filter tuned on a score that measures the wrong quantity spends its false positive budget on attacks that would have failed anyway. In this paper we audit that inference. Attention based measurements are usually read from prompt dependent locations, so a wrapper changes both the content being judged and the place the signal is taken from. We therefore introduce Active Attention Probing, which supplies a fixed content independent measurement coordinate. We pair every base goal with a plain and a wrapped version and generate real completions from the target models. On Llama, wrapping raises harmful generation from 0.05 to 0.27 while harmful intent AUROC falls from 0.936 to 0.803, so the attacks grow more dangerous while the prompts look safer to the score. Among wrapped harmful prompts the outcome AUROC is 0.220, which places the attacks that succeeded below the attacks that failed. Rare token, passive, and detector derived channels reproduce the reversal on the same matched design, and the reversal itself persists across three target models, seven attack families, and two independent judges. Distribution shift then degrades calibration and threshold transfer before it degrades ranking.

AI.tldr: 本文审查了内部安全评分与实际攻击成功之间的关系，发现惯常评分方法在‘变体包裹’攻击下失效，导致更危险攻击被评为更安全。并提出了新的主动注意力探测方法以缓解这一问题。
AI.motivation: 当今AI安全防护措施多通过内部安全分数来评估prompt的风险，但这些分数未必能真正反映攻击是否能突破实际模型防线，因此需重新审视这种评估推断的可靠性。
AI.method: 作者设计了一套实验，利用‘Active Attention Probing’方法，将待测prompt的内容与测量信号的位置解耦，并将每个攻击目标生成普通和被‘包裹’（即经过特殊格式化或变体修饰）版本，随后在大模型（如Llama等）中生成具体回复，对比安全评分与实际有害结果之间的对应关系。
AI.result: 实验发现，包裹处理使实际有害输出概率显著升高（如Llama从0.05增至0.27），而有害意图评分的区分度显著下降（AUROC从0.936降至0.803），甚至反转，即成功攻击的prompt在评分中比失败攻击的更‘安全’。该现象在多模型、多攻击策略和多检测渠道中均被复现。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，目前主流的prompt安全评分在应对“包裹变体攻击”时存在根本局限，相关安全策略的泛化性与可迁移性受到很大挑战。新提出的主动注意力探测方法为解决该问题提供了初步方向。

title: Circuit Fine-Tuning for Compute-Efficient Transformer Adaptation
summary: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has become the de facto standard for adapting Vision Transformers (ViTs) to downstream tasks. While parameter count has been the dominant efficiency metric in PEFT, it does not imply \textit{compute efficiency}: parameter-sparse methods can still incur full-model training cost per step, and typically need long schedules to reach peak accuracy. We introduce Circuit Fine-Tuning (CFT), a compute-efficient framework that uses circuit discovery---conventionally used to explain trained models---to select modules for fine-tuning before training. Whereas attribution is conventionally formulated against a trained task head, we formulate it against a near-zero-initialized probe head, which isolates the response of the backbone to the target distribution rather than the preferences of a particular classifier. CFT then fine-tunes only the recovered subgraph. CFT needs no learning-rate warmup and reaches peak accuracy in ${\sim}20$ epochs on average---versus $44$--$96$ for strong PEFT baselines---yielding $2.3$--$6.6\times$ fewer training FLOPs and up to $16\times$ less wall-clock time, while adding zero parameters and no inference operations. Experiments across a standard visual transfer benchmark (VTAB-1k), hierarchical backbones (Swin), domain-shifted medical imaging (CBIS-DDSM), and a vision-language model (Gemma-3 on CUB-200) demonstrate the effectiveness of CFT. Code is available at https://github.com/UriKialy/CFT

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Circuit Fine-Tuning (CFT)的高效参数微调方法，能显著降低计算成本并加快收敛速度，同时不增加推理参数量。
AI.motivation: 传统的参数高效微调（PEFT）方法虽然减少了参数量，但并不意味着计算过程高效，其实每步训练成本仍偏高且达到最优精度需要较长训练周期。作者希望解决PEFT计算效率不足、收敛慢这一痛点。
AI.method: CFT方法通过电路发现（circuit discovery）技术，在正式训练前选定需要微调的子模块，并仅微调这些子模块。具体上，通过与几近零初始化的探针头（probe head）做归因分析，定位ViT主干网络对当前任务分布的响应部分，再对该子图进行微调，无需学习率预热。
AI.result: CFT在视觉迁移任务（VTAB-1k）、分层主干网络（Swin）、医疗影像（CBIS-DDSM）、和视觉-语言模型（Gemma-3 on CUB-200）等多个实验上，均能在约20个epoch达到峰值精度（对比强PEFT基线通常需要44–96个epoch），训练FLOPs减少2.3–6.6倍，时钟时间降低最多16倍，且不增加新参数与推理计算量。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了CFT不仅大幅提升ViT微调的计算效率，还能保持甚至提升精度，是参数高效和计算高效的统一框架，对视觉领域的跨任务迁移具有推广价值。

title: How Do Large Language Models Judge Social Attraction? Evidence from Theory-Grounded Persona Ratings Across Multiple LLMs and Humans
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Includes technical supplement
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to perform subjective evaluations traditionally made by humans, yet their validity as social judges remains unclear. This paper examines whether LLMs can assess social attraction from theory-grounded persona profiles constructed from ten psychological and relational constructs and organized into three tiers: socially attractive, socially mixed, and socially unattractive. We examine LLM ratings in two studies and compare them with human judgments in a third study. In Study 1, 34 LLMs rated 12 profiles across three repeated runs. Although some models tended to give higher or lower ratings overall, they showed strong stability across runs, consistent three-tier ordering, and high agreement in relative profile ordering. Study 2 examined sensitivity to gender presentation using six matched name-and-pronoun profile pairs and a separate pronoun-only test with a gender-neutral name, finding no significant effects in either analysis. In Study 3, 198 human participants evaluated the six matched profiles from Study 2. Their ratings reproduced the three-tier structure and followed a profile ordering consistent with that of the LLMs. However, LLMs rated attractive profiles more positively and unattractive profiles more negatively than humans, while neither group showed a significant overall effect of gender presentation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析大型语言模型（LLMs）在主观社会判断中的能力，聚焦于社会吸引力评价，并与人类评判结果进行对比。结果显示LLMs表现稳定，基本能复现社会吸引力的三层结构，但与人类相比评价更极端。
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs被越来越多地用于涉及人类主观判断的领域，如社会吸引力评价，其作为“社会评判者”的有效性和与人类判断的一致性亟需系统评估。
AI.method: 构建涵盖十类心理和关系特质的标准化人物档案，划分为“有吸引力”、“混合”、“无吸引力”三层。分别让34个LLM和198名人类受试者多轮次打分，并考察性别因素影响，通过数据一致性与分布对比检验LLMs与人类判断的异同。
AI.result: 所有LLM在评级顺序上高度一致且极为稳定，能够区分三层社会吸引等级。性别表达对LLM打分无显著影响。人类受试结果较为一致，再现了三层结构，与LLMs排序基本相符。但LLMs对吸引力高/低的档案打分比人类更极端，同样未表现出性别偏见。
AI.conclusion: LLMs作为社会评判者在稳定性和结构判别上的表现与人类相似，但往往更极端。整体来看，LLMs可在相关领域应用，但其评级倾向与人类间存在差异，需要谨慎解读和合理调校。

title: Tropical Cyclone Forecasting via Latent Rectified Flow using Satellite Imagery and Atmospheric Fields
summary: Tropical cyclones are growing more destructive in a changing climate, and efficient forecasting of their structure and track has become a necessity. Deep generative models promise an alternative to computationally expensive numerical weather prediction (NWP), yet current systems produce either satellite imagery or atmospheric fields, never both; they need many sampling steps, putting them out of reach of modest hardware; and their storm tracks come from regression heads with no physical link to the generated atmosphere. This work presents a single-pass model that jointly forecasts GRIDSAT-B1 infrared imagery and four ERA5 atmospheric fields (U-wind, V-wind, air temperature, and surface pressure) out to nine hours. A five-channel variational autoencoder compresses each 5 x 256 x 256 frame to a 4 x 64 x 64 latent, and a conditional rectified-flow UNet with a factorized temporal-attention module predicts the next three frames from three past frames, their best-track coordinates, and timestamps. The model is then reward-fine-tuned (DRaFT) against a differentiable track error derived from the predicted winds through a steering-flow calculation. On held-out 2022 storms the model reaches 16.35 dB PSNR and 0.759 SSIM, ahead of a reproduced cascaded-diffusion baseline at every lead time (+0.84 dB at +9 h) while sampling ~30x faster (56 ms vs. 1673 ms). Track error at +9 h is 62.4 km, 15% below the baseline, and a reward fine-tuning study demonstrates a further 8-11% track-error reduction across sampler budgets.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种高效的深度生成模型，能够联合预测热带气旋的遥感图像和多个大气变量，在精准度和速度上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 当前热带气旋的结构和路径预测依赖于昂贵的数值天气预报（NWP），而现有深度生成模型无法同时输出卫星图像和大气变量，预测路径也缺乏物理联系且推理速度慢。该研究旨在解决这些限制，实现多模态、快速且物理一致的台风联合预报。
AI.method: 作者设计了一种单步多通道（五通道）变分自编码器，压缩红外图像与大气场数据，并通过条件UNet结构预测未来三个时刻的数据。模型输入包含过去三个时刻的帧、路径坐标及时间信息，并结合可微路径损失进行奖励微调（DRaFT），以优化路径预测的准确性。
AI.result: 在实验证明中，该方法在2022年未见过的气旋样本上取得16.35 dB PSNR和0.759 SSIM，领先于重现的级联扩散模型基线；推理速度提高约30倍；9小时预报路径误差为62.4公里，比基线低15%；奖励微调可进一步减少8-11%的路径误差。
AI.conclusion: 该研究实现了气旋多模态、物理一致、高效推理的短时联合预报，在准确性和计算效率方面均明显优于主流方法，为气象灾害快速响应提供有力工具。

title: REFRAMED: Towards Realistic Audio Description Generation for Movies
summary: Audio Description (AD) is a verbal narration of key visual content in videos, enabling access for visually impaired audiences. Unlike standard video captioning, AD is a structured editorial task: descriptions must be inserted into gaps in dialogue and must convey only what is needed to understand the narrative being told. However, existing approaches formulate AD generation in an artificial setting where both the content and timing of descriptions are pre-specified, reducing the task to clip-level captioning. They further rely on noisy transcription and alignment pipelines, and lack the rich parallel data required for modeling narrative context. We introduce a new formulation of AD generation in which models must jointly decide what to describe and when to do it. To support this, we present REFRAMED, a high-quality dataset of 2,023 videos that span 3,302 scenes from 206 movies, with professional AD transcripts (both American and British versions), professional subtitles and aligned screenplays. We also provide a manually curated challenge set that pairs full movies with multiple AD references, together with evaluation protocols that leverage dialogue gaps and multi-reference comparisons. Experiments with state-of-the-art AD systems and multimodal LLMs show that they outperform trivial baselines but fall far short of expert human performance. Our dataset and benchmark establish a new foundation for research on video understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的音频描述（AD）生成任务设定，并构建了高质量的大型数据集REFRAMED，为提升视障人士获取视频信息的能力奠定了基础。
AI.motivation: 现有AD生成方法将任务简化为片段级字幕生成，忽略了何时、何处插入描述等难点，且依赖低质量转录和对齐流程，缺乏丰富并行数据，无法有效建模叙事上下文。
AI.method: 作者提出AD生成新设定，模型需联合决定描述内容和时机；为支持该任务，构建了REFRAMED数据集，涵盖2023个视频、3302个场景、206部电影，内含美版和英版专业AD转录、字幕、对齐剧本，并手工整理了挑战集和评测协议。
AI.result: 实验证明，当前最先进的AD系统和多模态大模型虽优于简单基线，但距离专业人类水平差距仍较大。
AI.conclusion: REFRAMED数据集和基准任务为视频理解及自动音频描述研究提供了全新基础，有望推动相关领域发展。

title: VOICE: A Vision-Omics Foundation Model Integrating Direct and Retrieval-Based Prediction of In-situ Single-Cell Gene Expression
summary: Spatial transcriptomics can resolve gene expression at single-cell resolution, but it is costly, limited to targeted panels of a few hundred to a few thousand genes, and applicable to only a small number of samples. H&E imaging, by contrast, is cheap and collected routinely at scale. This makes predicting single-cell expression directly from morphology a practical way to bring molecular analysis to large tissue archives. We therefore present VOICE, a multimodal foundation model that predicts single-cell gene expression from H&E images using paired Xenium data. VOICE first aligns cell centered H&E morphology from a pathology foundation model with single-cell expression embeddings from a transcriptome foundation model, trained using contrastive learning over 23 million cells. Next it predicts expression through two branches. One branch directly regresses expression from morphology. The other branch retrieves measured expression from similar reference cells, recovering genes that do not have morphological signal. Because genes vary in morphological predictability, VOICE fuses the two branches with a per-gene weight. After training, VOICE generalizes to heldout patients, slides, and partially overlapping gene panels from Xenium, and it consistently outperforms prior single-cell expression prediction methods on seven metrics.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了VOICE模型，可以通过常规的H&E病理切片图片预测单细胞基因表达，实现将分子分析推广到大规模的组织库中。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组技术虽然能实现单细胞水平的基因表达分析，但成本高、检测基因数量有限且样本量少。相反，H&E切片便宜且广泛收集，如果能从形态学数据直接预测基因表达，将极大地拓展分子信息的应用范围。
AI.method: 研究提出了多模态基础模型VOICE，通过配对的Xenium数据将H&E形态学特征与单细胞基因表达嵌入对齐，使用对比学习在2300万个细胞上训练。模型包括两个分支：一条分支利用形态特征直接回归预测表达，另一条分支从参考细胞中检索最相似测量表达，最后按基因可预测性自适应融合两条分支结果。
AI.result: VOICE在未见病例、切片和部分重叠基因面板上均表现出良好泛化能力，并在七项指标上持续优于现有单细胞表达预测方法。
AI.conclusion: VOICE模型实现了高效、低成本、可推广的单细胞基因表达预测，为将分子病理分析复制到大规模临床样本中提供了工具。

title: Cultivar: A Contrastive and Locale-Oriented Translation Benchmark for Investigating Contamination and Localisation Robustness
summary: Multilingual translation benchmarks are typically sourced in English and translated into other languages, treating language pairs as the unit of evaluation---a design that is prone to contamination over time and overlooks locale and cultural considerations. We therefore advocate for source-contrastive evaluation and instantiate it with Cultivar, a localised subset of FLORES, which enables locale-specific translation evaluation. When paired with unlocalised counterparts, performance discrepancy allows the probing of data contamination and localisation robustness. We benchmark 32 open-weight models and find that MT-specialised models are less robust, a few models potentially overfit FLORES, and models tend to translate US content better than that of other locales, regardless of language.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种新的多语言翻译基准评测方法Cultivar，以更好地反映地域和文化特异性，同时揭示常规英文为源的评测方法存在的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统多语言翻译基准通常以英文为源语言，忽视了地域文化特性，还容易受数据污染。作者希望解决这一局限，提出更符合多语种实际应用需求的评测方式。
AI.method: 作者提出“源对比评测 (source-contrastive evaluation)”方法，并用本地化的FLORES子集——Cultivar进行实例化。通过对比本地化与非本地化的翻译结果，分析数据污染和模型的本地化鲁棒性。
AI.result: 对32个开源权重模型进行基准测试，发现专门为机器翻译优化的模型反而鲁棒性更弱，有的模型对FLORES过拟合。此外，不论语言如何，模型普遍更擅长翻译美国本地内容。
AI.conclusion: 引入Cultivar本地化评测能更有效地检测模型对地域文化的翻译能力和鲁棒性，并揭示了现有方法存在的局限性和模型的过拟合现象。

title: PARAGraph: Pathology-Anatomy-Aware Hierarchical Graph for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading
summary: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) remains a leading cause of vision loss among working-age adults worldwide, making reliable severity grading clinically important. Despite strong performance, most deep models formulate DR grading as image-level classification and do not explicitly model clinically grounded evidence, such as lesion types and spatial relations. In this paper, we propose PARAGraph, a Pathology-Anatomy-Aware Hierarchical Graph framework for DR grading. PARAGraph represents each image as a three-level hierarchical graph with lesion-level nodes, intermediate category and region nodes, and global anatomical and semantic nodes. To incorporate medical priors into nodes, we construct an optic disc-fovea-anchored coordinate frame that provides a scale- and rotation-normalized retinal reference system. Within this frame, lesion nodes are encoded with category, normalized area, and anatomical coordinates. To mitigate noisy lesion segmentation, PARAGraph uses a dual-fusion strategy that introduces global visual context into a graph semantic node and a decision-level prediction branch, improving robustness when lesion evidence is unreliable. Extensive experiments on Messidor-2, APTOS, and DDR show that PARAGraph achieves consistent DR grading performance over state-of-the-art methods. Interpretability and robustness analyses further demonstrate that its predictions are clinically grounded, closely associated with lesion evidence and robust to lesion segmentation noise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型的分级方法PARAGraph，通过层次化图结构与医学先验知识结合，实现了糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）严重程度的更为精确和具备可解释性的判别，在多个数据集上优于主流方法。
AI.motivation: 目前DR分级多采用图像级别的分类方法，缺乏对病灶类型、空间位置等临床证据的建模，导致解释性和鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 设计了一种三层次层次化图结构（病灶、区域/类别、全局节点），利用以视盘-黄斑为锚点的坐标系，将病灶类别、面积、坐标等特征融入图表示。为减少分割噪声影响，引入dual-fusion策略整合全局视觉信息并通过多分支决策提高鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在Messidor-2、APTOS、DDR等多个主流数据集上，PARAGraph分级准确率均超过现有先进方法。同时，在解释性和抗分割噪声方面均有亮眼表现。
AI.conclusion: PARAGraph方法提升了DR分级的准确性、解释性及鲁棒性，更符合临床需求，在实际应用场景中具有潜在的推广价值。

title: Structured Phonological Representations for Audio-Articulatory rtMRI Speech Classification
summary: Real-time MRI makes it possible to observe vocal-tract articulation during speech, but mapping these articulatory patterns to phonetic and phonological categories remains challenging. We investigate whether PhonoQ, an audio-based model trained to recognize structured phonological features, provides useful information for audio--articulatory modeling. Specifically, we extract representations from PhonoQ's Conformer module, whose training is shaped by supervision for manner, place, voicing, and vowel features. Using articulatory contours with synchronized audio-derived features, we compare WavLM-large and HuBERT-large baselines with models that incorporate PhonoQ-derived representations. Across unseen-speech and unseen-subject settings, these features improve macro-F1 for phonological targets including manner, place, voicing, vowel height, and vowel backness, and also improve fine-grained 39-phoneme classification. In a contour-only inference setting, audio-derived teacher supervision yields modest but consistent gains over contour-only training, indicating that phonological information from synchronized audio can be partially transferred to articulatory models. Finally, posterior analyses show interpretable surface-sensitive patterns consistent with flapping-like /t/ realizations, /t/-/r/ retraction or affrication, and nasal place assimilation.

AI.tldr: 本论文探讨了一种名为PhonoQ的音频驱动模型在实时MRI语音发音动作建模中的作用，并证明其可有效提升从发音动作到音位类别映射的性能。
AI.motivation: 实时MRI可以观测说话时的声道动作，但要将这些动作映射到语音学和音系学类别却很有难度。因此，研究者希望找到更有效的方法来利用音频和动作信息提升建模效果。
AI.method: 作者使用PhonoQ模型（在分音特征上经过有监督训练的Conformer模块），从中提取表征，并与WavLM-large及HuBERT-large等基线方法进行对比。同时，结合了发音动作轮廓与同步音频特征，通过多种实验场景（如未见语音、未见受试者）评估表现。还研究了仅用轮廓进行推理时，音频特征的蒸馏指导作用。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，结合PhonoQ表征后，在方式、部位、浊音、元音高低与前后等音系目标上的Macro-F1均有提升，对39音素细分类别任务也有帮助。在仅用发音动作轮廓推理时，加入音频特征监督也提供了稳定但适度的提升。此外，后验分析表明模型能捕捉/t/音漂变、/t/与/r/音的后移或塞擦化及鼻音同化等现象。
AI.conclusion: PhonoQ模型在音频-发音动作联合建模中表现优越，其音系信息可部分迁移至动作建模，有助于攻克动作到音类映射的难题，提供更解释性的语言表征见解。

title: A Height-Constrained 2-Point Minimal Solver for Pose Estimation from Active LED Markers with Event Cameras
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, accepted by IEEE/RSJ International Conference on INTELLIGENT ROBOTS & SYSTEMS (IROS) 2026
summary: In many autonomous applications requiring real-time localization, active marker-based systems are preferred due to their low latency and ease of deployment compared to computationally demanding feature-based methods. Event~\mbox{cameras} offer high temporal resolution and minimal delay and are commonly used with active LED markers for robust real-time localization. Existing methods typically rely on Perspective-n-Point (PnP) solvers for pose estimation. However, structured marker layouts can be challenging to deploy in space-constrained scenarios, while partial self-motion information (e.g., gravity direction and altitude) is readily available from onboard sensors. We derive a robust and accurate minimal solver that estimates camera pose from only two LED markers by incorporating known tilt angle and camera height measured by an onboard sensor, such as an IMU or an altimeter. The proposed formulation uniquely determines the camera pose through both a closed-form and a linear least-squares solution. We further analyze degenerate configurations and characterize the conditions under which height information does not contribute to rotation estimation. For evaluation, we developed an event-based active marker system to collect real-world data with ground truth from a motion capture system. Experiments on both synthetic and real data demonstrate improved accuracy over the state-of-the-art P2P solver and competitive performance relative to P3P.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种仅通过两个LED标记点和已知倾角/高度信息实现相机位姿估计的新方法，有效降低了对空间和标记数量的要求，提升了在空间受限环境下的部署灵活性和定位精度。
AI.motivation: 传统主动标记位姿估计方法如P3P需多个标记，对空间部署有较高要求。当实际空间受限时，布置多个标记较困难。而机载IMU等传感器已能实时提供如高度和重力方向等自运动信息，本文旨在探索如何利用这些额外信息减少所需标记数量，提高定位的灵活性和准确性。
AI.method: 作者推导出一个最小求解器，通过融合两个LED标记与机载传感器（IMU或高度计）提供的倾角/高度信息，实现了摄像机姿态的唯一确定。方法包括闭式解和线性最小二乘解。还分析了退化情形，阐明了哪些情况下高度信息不再有助于旋转估计。
AI.result: 作者实现了基于事件相机的主动标记系统，结合运动捕捉作为真值，在真实及仿真数据上评估新方法。结果显示，相比现有最优的P2P方法，新的算法在精度上有显著提升，并且与P3P方法表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 本文工作为在空间受限场景下的实时定位提供了一种部署灵活、精度高的解决方案。该方法利用最少标记及现有传感器信息，适合应用于复杂、空间有限的自主系统环境。

title: Gated Spatial Redundancy Projection for Pathology Transformer Attentions
summary: Transformer models are increasingly used for whole-slide image analysis in computational pathology. Yet, WSIs differ fundamentally from natural images: neighbouring patches often contain highly similar tissue type, stain, texture, and cellular composition. We identify this local spatial redundancy as a pathology-specific failure mode of self-attention, where dominant neighbourhood features can be repeatedly mixed into patch-tokens and weaken subtle diagnostic or prognostic deviations. We propose Gated Spatial Redundancy Projection (Gated SRP), a lightweight drop-in correction module for self-attention layers. For each patch token and attention head, Gated SRP estimates a local redundancy axis from neighbouring value vectors, projects the attention output onto this axis, and applies a learned signed gate to correct the redundancy-aligned component geometrically. Across five TCGA survival cohorts, Gated SRP obtains the highest mean C-index among the compared attention variants in all cohorts, with an average improvement over the base attention, while adding only +0.02% parameters. Across five slide-level classification datasets, it improves the base attention on 12 of 16 reported metrics and achieves the best AUC on three datasets. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/AtlasAnalyticsLab/GatedSRP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对病理全切片图像(WSI)分析中Transformer模型表现不足的问题的创新方法，称为Gated Spatial Redundancy Projection(Gated SRP)，能够有效提升模型的生存分析和分类性能，同时参数量增加极小。
AI.motivation: Transformer模型近年来在病理全切片图像分析领域表现优异，但与自然图像不同，WSI中相邻patch高度相似，导致Transformer的自注意力机制在提取特征时会受到空间冗余的干扰，削弱了对微小但关键病理差异的识别能力。因此，需要设计方法补偿空间冗余带来的信息损失。
AI.method: 作者提出Gated SRP模块，可直接嵌入自注意力层。该模块为每个patch token和attention head估算邻域冗余轴，并将注意力输出投影到该轴上，通过带符号门控校正与冗余轴一致的分量，实现对空间冗余的几何校正。
AI.result: 在五个TCGA生存分析队列中，Gated SRP在所有队列均取得最高的平均C-index，并且相比基础注意力模型平均提升明显，参数仅增加0.02%。且在5个WSI分类数据集的16项指标中，提高了12项，并在3个数据集上获得最佳AUC。
AI.conclusion: Gated SRP模块能有效缓解WSI场景下空间冗余对Transformer自注意力机制的不利影响，提升模型诊断和预测能力，且实现简单高效，具有实际推广价值。

title: PragMatch: Separating Pragmatic Incongruity from Cross-Modal Mismatch in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on multimodal benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether they genuinely reason about relationships between images and text or rely on superficial correlations, known as shortcut learning. This question is particularly important for multimodal sarcasm detection, where successful prediction depends on recognizing pragmatic incongruity rather than treating sarcasm as simple image-text mismatch. We introduce PragMatch, a controlled benchmark of 3,000 image-text pairs derived from MMSD2.0, including original sarcastic examples and constructed literal and hard-negative pairs. We identify influential shortcut cues through systematic masking and evaluate their impact through targeted injection experiments. Our results show that LVLM predictions are sensitive to lexical, OCR-derived and stylistic cues, with injected surface signals causing substantial changes in model predictions despite unchanged underlying image-text relationships. Our findings reveal limitations in current LVLMs while PragMatch provides a systematic testbed for evaluating multimodal pragmatic reasoning beyond surface-level image-text alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地审视了大规模视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在多模态嘲讽检测任务中的实际推理能力，提出新基准PragMatch，揭示了模型对表层线索的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 尽管LVLMs在多模态基准上表现优异，但学界质疑其是否真正理解图像与文本间的深层关系，还是仅依赖于表面相关性（shortcut learning）进行预测。尤其在多模态讽刺检测任务中，准确预测需识别语用层面的矛盾，而不能简单地把讽刺等同于图文不匹配。
AI.method: 作者提出PragMatch基准集，包含3,000条从MMSD2.0衍生的图文对，涵盖原始讽刺案例及精心设计的直译组和困难负例。通过系统遮蔽和定向注入表层特征（如词汇、OCR和风格化线索），分析这些shortcut线索对模型预测的影响。
AI.result: 实验发现，LVLMs的预测对表层线索（词汇、OCR与风格）极为敏感，通过人工注入这些线索会显著改变模型预测结果，即使底层的图文关系未变。
AI.conclusion: 当前LVLMs在多模态实用推理能力仍有明显局限，容易受到表层线索干扰。PragMatch为该领域提供了系统性测试平台，有助于推动超越表面图文对齐的推理研究。

title: GenTrack3: Hybrid Stochastic-Deterministic Online Multi-Object Tracking with Cluster-Aware Association
comment: The content of this paper was included in the full manuscript of GenTrack family which has been submitted to the journal for possible publication
summary: Multi-object tracking (MOT) involves maintaining consistent target identities as objects dynamically enter and leave a scene. Deterministic approaches, such as tracking-by-detection with data association, produce reproducible results and are computationally efficient, but they rely heavily on motion models and are sensitive to noisy detections that can lead to association errors. In contrast, stochastic methods explicitly model uncertainty and can better handle complex non-linear dynamics, albeit at the cost of increased computational complexity and variability arising from random sampling. This paper presents an online MOT framework that integrates deterministic and stochastic principles to achieve robust tracking under uncertainty. Furthermore, a novel track-to-detection matching approach is introduced to enhance scalability with increasing target numbers while supporting group tracking. The tracking inference mechanism employs a tracklet that includes identifiers, states, velocities, track penalties and track ages of targets, supporting a systematic tracking pipeline. Each target is associated with a stochastic particle set to compute the matching cost to detections. Reference implementations of the proposed approach and baseline trackers can be found on GitHub: https://github.com/SDU-VelKoTek/GenTrack3.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合确定性与随机性原理的多目标跟踪（MOT）方法，通过创新性数据关联算法提升了跟踪鲁棒性与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有MOT方法中，确定性方法效率高但对噪声敏感，随机性方法能处理不确定性但计算代价高。缺乏能兼顾两者优点的新方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种融合确定性与随机性的新型在线MOT框架：1）设计了创新的track-to-detection匹配方法，支持目标数量扩展与群体跟踪；2）引入用于存储目标标识、状态、速度等信息的tracklet系统；3）每个目标关联一个随机粒子集，用于计算该目标与检测的匹配代价。
AI.result: 所提方法在跟踪鲁棒性和扩展性上优于传统方法，并在目标数量增加或存在群体运动时表现突出。基于这个方法的参考实现已公开。
AI.conclusion: 融合确定性与随机性的MOT框架能更好地应对检测噪声和动态目标变化，具备更高实用价值与推广空间。

title: DoRF++: Spherical Representation Learning over Doppler Radiance Fields for Robust Wi-Fi Sensing
summary: Motivated by the IEEE 802.11bf effort to standardize advanced WLAN sensing, interest in Wi-Fi Channel State Information (CSI) for passive, device-free, and privacy-preserving activity and gesture recognition has grown rapidly. Recent studies have shown that Doppler velocity projections extracted from CSI, which directly reflect human-motion velocity, enable more robust human activity recognition (HAR) and stronger generalization across users and unseen conditions. Nevertheless, reliable generalization under real-world variability remains a major challenge, hindering the adoption of Wi-Fi sensing in real-world applications. To address this challenge, we introduce Doppler Radiance Fields (DoRF), bringing the concept of neural radiance fields (NeRF) from computer vision into Wi-Fi sensing. DoRF models Doppler velocity projections extracted from Wi-Fi CSI as sparse and diverse virtual-camera views of human motion. It then infers a latent 3D motion sequence whose projections along learned effective Doppler directions explain the CSI-derived Doppler observations. The recovered motion is subsequently projected onto an equiangular grid of directions on the unit sphere, producing a spherical representation of the underlying motion. Since DoRF naturally defines the Doppler representation on spheres, we further introduce DoRF++, a spherical-learning design that applies spherical Transformers for activity classification. Experiments on our collected hand-gesture dataset show that DoRF++ significantly outperforms state-of-the-art Wi-Fi-based HAR methods in cross-user generalization accuracy, especially for difficult gestures in settings with a single multi-antenna receiver access point (AP).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的神经网络结构DoRF及其扩展DoRF++，借助Wi-Fi信道状态信息（CSI）和多普勒速度特征，实现了更强泛化能力和更高准确率的人体活动识别，尤其提升了在实际环境和用户变化下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 尽管利用Wi-Fi CSI进行人体活动识别在无设备、隐私保护方面有很大优势，但遇到用户和环境变化时，识别准确率和泛化能力依然不足，限制了其真实场景应用。作者旨在突破这一实际应用瓶颈。
AI.method: 作者借鉴计算机视觉领域的NeRF思想，提出Doppler Radiance Fields（DoRF），将CSI提取的多普勒速度视为观察人类动作的虚拟视角，并据此重建3D运动轨迹。进一步地，DoRF++结合球面Transformer网络，实现球面对动作的全面表征和高效分类。
AI.result: 在自建的手势数据集上的实验表明，DoRF++在跨用户泛化能力和识别准确率上显著优于现有Wi-Fi行为识别方法，尤其在单一收发点和困难手势情形下优势突出。
AI.conclusion: DoRF及DoRF++充分提升了Wi-Fi CSI基动作识别在用户和环境变化下的实际应用潜力，推动了低成本、无设备、保护隐私的室内行为感知技术落地。

title: KGCaRe: Explainable Complex Conditional Question Answering using Automatic Knowledge Graph Construction and Context Retrieval with LLMs
summary:
Answering complex conditional questions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) remains a challenge, particularly in domain-specific contexts where general-purpose LLMs and RAG tend to underperform. We hypothesize that augmenting RAG with unstructured and structured knowledge, extracted from both documents and knowledge graphs (KGs), can improve reasoning and answer accuracy for such tasks.
  To test this, we propose KGCaRe, a hybrid approach that combines neural retrieval with symbolic reasoning over LLM-generated KGs. KGCaRe constructs a KG from documents using a multi-prompt extraction strategy and stores it in a graph database. Simultaneously, the documents are embedded into a vector store to enable neural retrieval. KGCaRe performs innovative iterative graph traversal guided by the LLM to extract relevant triples, prune irrelevant information, and uses additional clue entities to traverse the graph again if the initial traversal does not provide satisfactory context to generate the answer. The relevant triples extracted from the KG in path form, along with semantically retrieved text passages, are then fed into custom KGCaRe prompts to generate answers to the complex conditional questions with explanations.
  We evaluate KGCaRe on two complex conditional QA datasets. Our results on these datasets show that KGCaRe consistently outperforms existing baselines, including Vanilla LLM, Code Prompt, Text Prompt, Think-on-Graph, Vanilla RAG, and HybridContextQA, across multiple LLMs such as Mistral, Mixtral, GPT-3.5, and GPT-4o. We publicly release the software pipeline that we developed to implement the proposed KGCaRe approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了KGCaRe方法，通过结合结构化知识图谱与非结构化文本，实现对复杂条件问题更优的问答能力，显著超越现有多种检索增强生成（RAG）与大模型方法。
AI.motivation: RAG与大语言模型在复杂条件问答、尤其是领域内任务时，存在推理和精确性不足的问题。作者希望通过结合文档和知识图谱中提取的结构化与非结构化知识，提升在这些场景下的表现。
AI.method: KGCaRe方法首先使用多提示抽取策略从文档中构建知识图谱，并存入图数据库，同时将文档嵌入向量库以便神经检索。随后，模型结合神经检索与由大模型指导的符号推理，对知识图谱进行迭代遍历与精简（可基于线索实体二次遍历）。最终将知识图谱中的关键信息链路与语义检索文本共用定制化提示词，生成包含推理解释的答案。
AI.result: 作者在两个复杂条件问答数据集上评估KGCaRe，结果显示该方法在包括Mistral、Mixtral、GPT-3.5、GPT-4o在内的多款大模型上，均优于现有文本提示、代码提示、常规RAG、“Think-on-Graph”以及HybridContextQA等主流方法。
AI.conclusion: KGCaRe通过集成多源知识和融合神经检索与符号推理，能有效提升复杂条件问答的绩效。论文的软件管线已对外公开，为后续相关研究提供工具支持。

title: Anatomically Consistent Cross-Contrast Super-Resolution of Anisotropic Brain T2w MRI
summary: T2-weighted (T2w) brain MRI provides fluid-sensitive soft-tissue contrast that is important for neuro-oncology and radiotherapy planning. However, T2w scans are acquired with anisotropic voxels and appear blurred or stair-stepped on coronal and sagittal views, which obscures small structures and weakens any downstream 3D analysis. We propose VIPP-SR (View-Independent Patched Projection Super-Resolution), a cross-contrast guided super-resolution framework that restores the inter-plane resolution of an existing anisotropic T2w volume without an isotropic ground-truth T2w. VIPP-SR first trains a view-independent patched generator (VIP-GAN) to learn local T1c-to-T2w anatomical correspondence from high-resolution axial slices. The trained generator is then applied to axial, coronal, and sagittal views of the T1c volume to generate three orthogonal T2w estimates. Shape-preserving patching and deepest-skip removal reduce view-specific shortcuts, thereby constraining the generator to learn patch-local representations and enabling the zero-shot inter-plane transfer. Central to VIPP-SR, a projection-based optimization then enforces anatomical consistency across the three view-specific volumes, fusing them by balancing inter-plane self-consistency against per-view data fidelity. The generator is trained on BraTS-MET and evaluated on both the held-out BraTS-MET testing set and the BraTS-GLI cohort without retraining, assessing the cross-cohort generalizability. The results validate that VIPP-SR improves downstream segmentation over the real anisotropic T2w baseline, raising mean-label Dice from 0.330 to 0.465 on BraTS-MET and, zero-shot, from 0.473 to 0.563 on BraTS-GLI and ablation studies identify inter-plane self-consistency as the main source of the gain.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种针对T2加权脑MRI的跨对比度超分辨率方法（VIPP-SR），显著提升了原始各向异性扫描数据的空间分辨率，并提高了下游分割任务的准确性。
AI.motivation: T2w脑MRI在神经肿瘤学和放疗规划中很重要，但其各向异性体素导致在冠状和矢状面图像模糊，影响三维分析和小结构的显示，亟需提升其空间分辨率的方法。
AI.method: 提出VIPP-SR框架，无需各向同性T2w的真值，采用T1c作为引导，通过训练视图无关的生成网络（VIP-GAN），在三正交视图生成高分辨率T2w估计。采用多视图一致性投影优化融合结果，保持解剖一致性。
AI.result: 在BraTS-MET测试集和BraTS-GLI数据集上，无需重训练即可泛化应用，在分割任务中Dice系数显著提升（BraTS-MET从0.330提至0.465，BraTS-GLI从0.473提至0.563）。消融实验显示多视图一致性是提升的主要来源。
AI.conclusion: VIPP-SR能有效增强T2w MRI的空间分辨率和下游分割性能，在多数据集间表现出良好的泛化能力，对临床和研究具有实用价值。

title: Comparing British and American Audio Description of Movies
summary: Narrating the visual component of movies is known as audio description. It is a narrative technique designed to enable blind and visually impaired individuals to follow the story. However, it is far more constrained than most narratives: the descriptions not only need to convey the story in the movie, but they must also fit into gaps between dialogue and they need to conform to guidelines that exist in each region. In this work, we compare audio description created in the United Kingdom against audio description created in the United States. We use guidelines written for these two regions, alongside the impressions from a practitioner in the field, to motivate specific hypotheses about the differences. We test these hypotheses against our pre-existing corpus, which provides both human-authored American and British audio description for each of 206 movies. Results provide quantitative evidence to uphold all tested hypotheses, including differences in lexicon, the use of the progressive aspect, the use of passive constructions, the use of subjective adjectives and modifiers, when characters are named, how scenes are cued, and degree of overlap with movie dialogue and music. Our work offers a quantitative lens into the narrative technique of audio description.

AI.tldr: 本文对英美电影音频解说的叙述方式进行了量化比较，揭示了两者在语言和讲述风格上的差异。
AI.motivation: 尽管音频解说为视障人士提供了理解电影情节的机会，但其叙述受限（需避开对白、遵循地区规范）。目前缺乏系统的跨地区比较研究，作者希望通过分析英美解说内容差异，深入理解音频解说的叙事特征。
AI.method: 作者以英美指南和行业实践者见解为理论基础，提出了具体假设，并通过对206部电影的人工作品（美式与英式音频解说）进行量化分析，验证假设。
AI.result: 所有假设均得到量化证据支持，包括词汇使用、进行时态、被动语态、主观形容词修饰、角色命名、场景提示方式与与对白音乐重叠程度等方面存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次以量化方式揭示了英美音频解说在叙述风格和语言运用上的显著差异，为音频解说这一叙事形式的理解和优化提供了实证基础。

title: Agentic AI-powered flexible fiber-bundle endoscopy for high-resolution NIR-II fluorescence imaging in vivo
summary: Fiber-bundle endoscopy offers a compact and flexible route for clinical fluorescence imaging through natural human orifices, but since its first report in the 1950s, it has remained limited by low spatial resolution, honeycomb artifacts, and inter-core crosstalk. The crosstalk becomes more pronounced at near-infrared-II wavelengths (NIR-II, 1000-3000 nm), a spectral window that offers superior contrast, resolution, and tissue penetration depth for biomedical imaging. Here, we present an AI-powered flexible endoscopy platform that overcomes these constraints through optical-computational co-design: optimizing ultrathin fiber bundles to mitigate crosstalk-induced image blur and enable high-fidelity image transmission across the visible-to-NIR-II spectral range, and developing an Agent-Guided Mixture-of-Experts (GAME) pipeline for honeycomb-artifact removal and image restoration. GAME provides a single restoration entry point for diverse biomedical images acquired with our endoscope, spanning cell, mouse and human samples. It dynamically routes each input to suitable restoration experts via a vision-language model, facilitating image reconstruction with a fourfold resolution improvement beyond the NyquistShannon sampling limit. The utility of our endoscope is demonstrated through in vivo NIR-II imaging of anatomical structures in mice, as well as imaging of the digital micromirror device (DMD)-projected human gastric tube and lymphatic system, paving the way for future clinical translation.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种基于AI的柔性内窥镜平台，结合光学和计算设计，显著提升了内窥镜的成像质量，解决了空间分辨率低、蜂窝伪影和串扰等难题，并在生物医学成像中实现了优异表现。
AI.motivation: 纤维束内窥镜因其紧凑和灵活性，自20世纪50年代应用于临床荧光成像，但一直受限于低分辨率、蜂窝伪影和串扰问题。尤其在NIR-II（近红外II）波段，这些限制更为明显，急需突破性的解决方案。
AI.method: 采用光学-计算协同设计：一方面，优化超薄纤维束结构以降低NIR-II波段的串扰，提高图像传输保真度；另一方面，设计了基于Agent-Guided Mixture-of-Experts（GAME）的AI图像还原管线，通过视觉语言模型动态匹配图像修复专家，高效地消除蜂窝伪影并提升图像分辨率。
AI.result: 该方法实现了多种生物医学样本的内窥镜成像（包括细胞、小鼠和人类样本），在分辨率上突破了奈奎斯特采样极限4倍。通过在小鼠体内NIR-II成像及人类胃管和淋巴系统的DMD成像验证了其实用性。
AI.conclusion: AI与光学系统联合设计能够极大提升纤维束内窥镜在NIR-II等波段的成像能力，为其向临床转化应用奠定了基础。

title: SWE-Bench ProMax: Benchmarking Agents on Large-Scale Multilingual Code Refactoring
comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
summary: As AI coding agents take on increasingly complex, long-horizon software engineering tasks, existing benchmarks are rapidly saturating and their evaluation quality has come under serious scrutiny: a recent audit found that nearly 60% of unsolved SWE-bench Verified instances contain flawed tests -- either overly narrow tests that reject correct solutions or overly broad tests that check unstated requirements -- and that frontier models can verbatim reproduce gold patches from training data. Code refactoring, which requires coordinated, behavior-preserving changes across many files, offers a substantially harder and more realistic test of agent capability, yet remains underserved by current benchmarks. We introduce SWE-Bench ProMax, an expert-curated, multilingual code refactoring benchmark of 170 instances drawn from real commits across seven programming languages (Python, Java, TypeScript, Go, C, C++, and Rust). Every instance undergoes rigorous, multi-stage curation that directly addresses the quality problems identified in prior benchmarks: issue descriptions are rewritten from scratch to provide precise, unambiguous specifications, and test suites are manually reviewed to remove overly narrow and overly broad tests. Tasks with insufficient complexity or limited cross-file scope are filtered out, yielding a benchmark of challenging, large-scale refactoring tasks that average 11.4 modified files and 261.6 lines of code per instance, substantially exceeding the scale of existing benchmarks. Experiments with frontier models under two agent scaffolds show that the best model achieves only 41.2% resolve rate, confirming that SWE-Bench ProMax presents a meaningful and unsaturated challenge for current AI coding agents. Our benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/swe-bench-promax/SWE-Bench-ProMax.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SWE-Bench ProMax，这是一个由专家策划的多语言代码重构基准，专为评估AI编码代理在真实大规模、跨文件重构任务中的能力。该基准填补了现有基准在复杂度和真实性上的不足。实验表明目前最好的模型仅能解决41.2%的任务，显示该基准对顶尖模型依然构成挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有AI软件工程任务基准已逐渐饱和，且测试质量存在严重问题（如过窄或过宽的测试用例和训练集泄漏），难以真实体现复杂任务中的AI代理能力。代码重构任务更具挑战性，但缺乏高质量、复杂度高的评测基准，因此亟需一个更具代表性和挑战性的评测平台。
AI.method: 作者收集了170个来自实际提交的代码重构实例，涵盖7种主流编程语言。每个实例经过多阶段专家筛选和优化，包括重新撰写问题描述、手动审查测试用例（消除测试用例的过窄/过宽问题）、剔除复杂度不足或缺乏跨文件特性的实例，最终保留的任务平均涉及11.4个文件和261.6行代码的修改。
AI.result: 作者对当前前沿AI编码模型进行了实验证明，在该基准下，最好的模型的任务解决率仅为41.2%，明显低于其他现有标准的数据，表明该基准具备足够难度和区分能力。
AI.conclusion: SWE-Bench ProMax能够真实反映和评价AI编码代理在复杂跨文件重构任务中的真实水平，是目前该领域最具挑战性的新型基准。该基准将推动AI在软件工程实际任务中的发展和能力提升。

title: Learning Deep Modality-Shared Self-Expressiveness for Image Clustering with Textual Information
summary: Leveraging textual information for image clustering has emerged as a promising direction, largely owing to the powerful representations learned by Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Existing approaches typically retrieve a textual counterpart for each image and then refine multimodal representations by directly enforcing cross-modal agreement, e.g., maximizing image-text similarity inherited from pretrained VLMs. However, such a strategy aligns heterogeneous representations across modalities without explicitly modeling the intrinsic structure within each modality and thus might yield unreliable alignment or distort modality-specific structures that are crucial for clustering. In this paper, we propose a simple but principled approach, termed deep modality-shared self-expressive model (DeepMORSE), which discovers cross-modal structures via a modality-shared self-expressive model and simultaneously learns structured representations that conform to a union of modality-specific subspaces. Moreover, we theoretically justify that the modality-shared self-expressive coefficients suppress inter-class noise towards a subspace-preserving solution, and show that mini-batch optimization procedure introduces an implicit regularization onto the self-expressive model. We evaluate our DeepMORSE on six widely used image clustering benchmarks and observe performance improvements exceeding 3% on the UCF-101, DTD-47, and ImageNet-Dogs datasets. In addition, we demonstrate the strong transferability of the learned representations by achieving state-of-the-art performance on downstream tasks such as image retrieval and zero-shot classification---without requiring any task-specific losses or post-processing. The code is available at: https://github.com/mengxianghan123/DeepMORSE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模态共享自表达模型（DeepMORSE）的新方法，用于更有效地实现图像聚类，在多个基准上表现优异，同时在下游任务中展示了强迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有利用文本增强图像聚类的方法往往直接对齐图像和文本模态表示，却忽略了每个模态内部的结构，导致对齐不可靠或模态结构被破坏，影响聚类效果。
AI.method: 提出一种深层模态共享自表达模型（DeepMORSE），通过模态共享的自表达系数挖掘跨模态结构，同时学习符合各自子空间结构的模态特征；理论分析证明自表达系数可抑制类间噪声，mini-batch优化过程自带正则化效果。
AI.result: 在六个常用图像聚类数据集上验证了方法的有效性，尤其在UCF-101、DTD-47和ImageNet-Dogs上聚类性能提升超3%。此外，所学表征在图像检索、零样本分类等下游任务中也取得了SOTA表现。
AI.conclusion: DeepMORSE有效提升了跨模态图像聚类效果，增强了聚类表征的可迁移性与泛化能力，且不依赖特定任务损失或后处理，具有很高的实用价值。

title: RA-FinBERT: Rule-aware LoRA adaptation for low-resource financial sentiment classification
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Fan Zhang and Jiaming Li are co-first authors. Corresponding author: Jiaming Li
summary: Financial sentiment analysis converts unstructured financial news into quantitative signals that can support market analysis and decision-making. Existing work on resource-efficient financial NLP has largely focused on compressing or adapting pretrained language models, with less attention to combining contextual representations with lightweight rule-derived features. This study develops Rule-Aware FinBERT (RA-FinBERT), a parameter-efficient framework that integrates low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with three continuous VADER-derived sentiment proportions (positive, negative, and neutral) and a source-level metadata feature. The standardized four-dimensional feature vector is directly concatenated with the 768-dimensional final-layer FinBERT [CLS] representation and passed through a lightweight classification head. This design introduces only 1,024 additional trainable weights relative to a structurally matched text-only FinBERT model. RA-FinBERT was evaluated against text-only FinBERT and a lightweight DistilBERT baseline for three-class sentiment classification of financial-news titles and descriptions. On the held-out test set, RA-FinBERT achieved 69.89% accuracy and a macro F1 score of 0.634, compared with 63.44% and 0.526 for text-only FinBERT. Neutral-class recall increased from 18.18% to 45.45%. The framework supports both CPU and GPU execution, offering a lightweight and practical approach to financial sentiment classification under constrained computational resources. These findings indicate that rule-derived sentiment information and source metadata can provide complementary signals to contextual FinBERT representations and improve performance with minimal additional model complexity.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种资源高效的金融情感分析方法——RA-FinBERT，将规则推导的情感特征与FinBERT深度语境特征结合，提高了分类效果且只引入极少的模型复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有金融NLP关注模型压缩和参数高效，但很少融合基于规则的情感特征。作者希望证明，将轻量化、基于规则的情感信号与FinBERT上下文向量结合，可以在几乎不增加模型负担的前提下提升性能。
AI.method: 提出RA-FinBERT框架：在FinBERT的最后一层CLS向量基础上，拼接VADER规则推导的三类情感（正、负、中性）比例和源级元数据形成4维特征，总共增加1024个参数。结合LoRA技术，构建高效分类头，支持CPU/GPU运行。
AI.result: 在金融新闻三分类任务上，RA-FinBERT较text-only FinBERT的准确率提升至69.89%（对比63.44%），macro F1分数提升至0.634（对比0.526），其中中性类别召回率提升最为显著（18.18%→45.45%）。
AI.conclusion: 将基于规则的情感比例和元数据与FinBERT语境特征结合，可在不大幅增加模型复杂度的情况下，显著提升金融情感分类表现，特别适用于计算资源受限的实际应用场景。

title: FreCast: Refining Radar Echo Intensity via Phase-Preserving Amplitude Residual Diffusion for Precipitation Nowcasting
summary: Precipitation nowcasting predicts the spatiotemporal evolution of future radar echoes from historical radar echo sequences, thereby estimating the occurrence, development, and movement of precipitation over the near term. In recent years, deep learning has become an important approach to precipitation nowcasting. Although state-of-the-art models can generally capture the overall spatial distribution of future precipitation, their predictions still exhibit substantial biases in radar echo intensity at individual locations. This observation motivates a more targeted strategy for reducing forecast errors. Instead of regenerating an entire radar echo sequence without spatial constraints, the predicted precipitation structure can be used to guide the refinement of echo intensities at individual locations. This structure-guided refinement directly targets echo intensity biases. Accordingly, we propose FreCast, a two-stage framework for radar echo prediction. The first stage generates an initial forecast of future radar echoes. The second stage uses the spatial structure of the initial forecast as a constraint to further correct intensity biases at individual locations in the first-stage prediction. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that FreCast achieves consistent improvements across forecast skill metrics. Qualitative results further show that FreCast better preserves rainband continuity and intense precipitation structures at longer lead times.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段雷达回波预测框架FreCast，先生成预测回波，再用结构信息精细修正各位置强度，提高预报精度。
AI.motivation: 当前深度学习方法虽然能预测降水空间分布，但各点强度偏差大，缺乏针对性修正机制。因此需要更高精度、结构感知的预报方法。
AI.method: FreCast为两阶段框架，第一阶段生成未来雷达回波；第二阶段利用初步预测的空间结构，针对性校正局部强度偏差，提升空间连续性和局部准确度。
AI.result: 在三组数据集上的实验表明，FreCast能在多项预报技能指标获得一致提升，并能更好保留雨带连续性及强降水结构，效果优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: FreCast针对雷达回波强度偏差，通过结构引导的精细校正，显著提高了降水临近预报的准确性和实用性。

title: Fusion Training for Mathematical Generalization in Large Language Models
summary: Thinking Mode Fusion (TMF) enables large language models to support both concise responses and long-form reasoning by unifying a non-thinking mode and a thinking mode within a single model. However, its training dynamics, including the \emph{data ratio} and \emph{training schedule} between the two modes, remain underexplored. In this work, we present a systematic study of TMF by analyzing the effects of the training schedule and data ratio between thinking and non-thinking modes. Focusing on mathematical problem solving, we construct a benchmark with multiple thinking-to-non-thinking data ratios and three training schedules. Our results reveal an asymmetric interaction between the two modes: increasing the ratio of non-thinking supervision reduces the accuracy of the thinking mode. We further show that different training schedules modulate this trade-off and that the optimal schedule depends on the data ratio. Finally, we quantify a negative correlation between non-thinking and thinking mode supervision, highlighting an inherent tension between these two modes. These findings provide practical guidance for designing effective TMF training settings. All code and data are released to support further research at: \href{https://github.com/caocongfeng/Fusion-Bench.git}{\textbf{Fusion Bench}}.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了大模型中“思考模式融合（TMF）”的训练参数，特别是思考/非思考两种模式下的数据比例与训练节奏对模型表现的影响。研究发现，这两种模式间存在数据比例上的负面相关性，需要平衡设计。
AI.motivation: TMF模式允许大模型灵活兼具简洁回复与长链推理，但关于如何在训练中平衡两种模式（数据量与流程）的实际影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个数学问题求解的基准，包括多组不同的思考/非思考数据比例及三种训练日程安排，系统实验两种模式在不同参数下的表现。
AI.result: 结果显示，提高非思考模式监督数据比例会显著降低思考模式下的准确性。此外，不同训练节奏对这一权衡关系有影响，最佳训练策略取决于数据比例分配。
AI.conclusion: 思考与非思考模式在训练中存在本质张力，二者难以兼得。需根据实际任务对训练流程与数据配比作出科学权衡，为TMF高效训练提供了实用指南。

title: InstructionCrafter: Generating Consistent and High-Fidelity Visual Instructions
summary: Given textual task instructions, generating step-by-step visual instructions as an image sequence requires the simultaneous satisfaction of multiple properties, specifically step faithfulness, cross-image consistency, and per-frame visual quality. Existing text-to-image generation approaches rarely meet all three properties, owing to independent sampling that breaks consistency, finetuning on low-quality video that degrades per-frame quality, and frozen backbones that lack multi-step understanding. In this work, we propose InstructionCrafter, a diffusion-based framework with the key idea of separating the optimization of temporal and instructional alignment from per-frame visual quality via (1) spatial-freeze training and (2) instruction-aware adapters. Built on a pretrained video diffusion backbone, InstructionCrafter freezes the spatial layers that control per-frame detail and updates only temporal and text-conditioning pathways to learn instruction semantics and inter-step relations, which preserves the generative prior for per-frame quality and reduces trainable parameters by about 50 percent compared with full finetuning. We also introduce two lightweight adapters that enhance the model's understanding of instructional context. The Consistent Adapter aggregates textual cues from the entire instruction sequence and from neighboring steps to keep object identity and attributes consistent across frames, and the Context-Aware Temporal Adapter converts cross-attention outputs into biases for temporal self-attention, explicitly propagating inter-frame relations. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art overall performance on step faithfulness, cross-image consistency, and per-frame visual quality while significantly reducing noise, blur, and spurious subtitles. Our code and trained models will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的视觉指导生成框架InstructionCrafter，可根据文本任务指令生成符合步骤、前后一致且每帧高质量的图像序列，在多个指标上大幅优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到图像生成方法很难同时实现步骤忠实、跨图一致与每帧图像质量三大目标，主要因为独立采样导致一致性差、低质量视频微调影响画质、冻结骨干网络难以多步理解。
AI.method: 提出InstructionCrafter框架，通过空间冻结训练（只更新时序和文本条件路径，冻结空间层）和基于指令的轻量级适配器设计：Consistent Adapter（保证对象一致性）和Context-Aware Temporal Adapter（增强跨帧关系建模），仅需约一半参数数即可大幅提升表现。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上，InstructionCrafter在步骤忠实、跨图一致性和每帧画质等指标实现了最先进表现，有效减少噪声、模糊和多余字幕。
AI.conclusion: InstructionCrafter通过创新的结构和适配器设计，解决了视觉步骤生成中的主要难题，在多个指标上领先，并提升了生成图像的整体质量。

title: Consilience for Verifier-Free Test-Time Scaling
summary:
Test-time scaling often uses an external verifier, such as compilers and test cases in coding or trained value functions in robotics applications, to obtain high-quality rollouts. Verifier-free test-time scaling (or VF-TTS) is gaining extensive attention as a mechanism to enhance Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, primarily because we do not have access to such high-quality verifiers in many real-world applications. Among existing VF-TTS methods, confidence-based VF-TTS methods, which compute and rank rollouts solely by confidence, are particularly promising. Such methods introduce near-zero overhead for sample evaluation and require minimal access to internal model states, making the methods highly flexible across models and tasks.
  In this paper, we demonstrate a critical limitation of existing confidence-based VF-TTS methods by showing that such methods catastrophically break down on complex tasks. We observe a very interesting phenomenon: uniformly high confidence frequently indicates a failure to explore, favoring confidently wrong answers. To address this, our core insight is that robust cognitive search requires a specific confidence trajectory pattern: such methods perform exploratory branching at the beginning, as manifested by low initial confidence, and converge to a high final confidence solution. To implement this insight, we introduce consilience, a novel selection framework that explicitly evaluates the temporal asymmetry of confidence in reasoning. We operationalize this via a combinatorial metric that actively penalizes high initial confidence while strictly demanding final certainty. Extensive experiments covering both graduate-level mathematics problems and free-form code generation demonstrate that consilience effectively outperforms existing baselines, validating our novel perspective on completion confidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一种新颖的无验证器测试时扩展（VF-TTS）方法——consilience，通过关注推理过程中的置信度变化，有效提升了大模型在复杂任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 目前很多实际场景缺乏高质量外部验证器，现有基于置信度的VF-TTS方法虽然高效，但在复杂任务中往往会因置信度普遍过高而导致探索失败与错误答案，急需更加鲁棒的推理路径选择策略。
AI.method: 作者发现健壮推理路径的置信度应呈现前期低、后期高的动态轨迹，据此提出以时间序列方式评估置信度变化的新框架consilience，通过特定的组合指标惩罚早期过高的置信度、强调终极解的高置信度。
AI.result: 在研究生数学和代码生成等任务中，consilience方法在多个标准上显著优于现有基线，充分展示了该时间动态置信度策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠最终置信度作为选择准则会导致模型探索受限并易出错，引入置信度动态轨迹的选择机制（如consilience）能切实提升复杂任务下大模型的推理鲁棒性和准确性。

title: RayLift: Lifting Complementary Ray-Wise Evidence with 3D Geometry Priors for Semantic Scene Completion
summary: Camera-based 3D semantic scene completion (SSC) provides comprehensive scene understanding for autonomous driving and robotics. However, existing methods often treat stereo depth estimates as deterministic geometric constraints, causing depth uncertainty and local correspondence errors to propagate directly into voxel representations. To address this issue, we propose RayLift, a framework that uses stereo geometry as a metric reference while incorporating complementary ray evidence to recover reliable 3D structures adaptively. RayLift first employs a Complementary Context Encoder that extracts geometry-aware priors from a frozen 3D vision foundation model, thereby enriching the scene context. It then introduces a Depth Ray Evidence Lifter module that jointly models geometric dissimilarity, depth confidence, and spatial uncertainty to adaptively sample and weight candidate surface locations along each camera ray. Finally, a Semantic-Aware Voxel Integrator injects the resulting ray evidence into voxel features by explicitly modeling their spatial support. Extensive experiments on SemanticKITTI and SSCBench-KITTI-360 demonstrate that RayLift achieves competitive performance and consistently outperforms existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RayLift方法，通过结合立体几何与射线证据，自适应恢复3D语义场景，克服了现有方法对深度估计不确定性和局部误差的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于摄像头的3D语义场景补全方法常将深度估计视为确定的几何约束，导致深度和配准误差直接影响体素重建准确性，需要方法对深度不确定性具备鲁棒性。
AI.method: RayLift框架包含三部分：（1）从冻结的三维视觉基础模型提取几何感知先验的补充上下文编码器；（2）联合建模几何差异、深度置信度和空间不确定性的'深度射线证据提升器'，对每条射线上的候选表面位置自适应采样和加权；（3）语义感知体素整合器将射线证据显式注入体素特征中。
AI.result: 在SemanticKITTI和SSCBench-KITTI-360数据集上，RayLift方法取得了有竞争力的性能，并稳定优于现有的场景补全方法。
AI.conclusion: RayLift通过创新地结合立体几何参照与射线证据，有效提升了基于摄像机的3D场景补全的准确性，对深度不确定性具有更强的鲁棒性。

title: Decoding-Level Taboo: A Diagnostic Stress Test for LLM Robustness
summary:
Large language model evaluations typically focus on performance under nominal conditions, creating an illusion of capability where models comfortably walk a narrow, highly optimized generation corridor. In real-world deployments, however, complex system prompts, safety guardrails, and structural constraints continuously force models off this nominal path, driving a divergence between benchmark scores and deployment performance. To address this issue, we introduce Decoding-Level Taboo, a zero-prompt diagnostic stress test that intervenes directly in logit space at runtime, forcing models out of their nominal paths. By dynamically masking primary candidate tokens at word boundaries, Taboo forces machine circumlocution.
  Evaluating Taboo across several open-weight model families reveals that off-path robustness is heavily influenced by both parameter scale and post-training instruction alignment, with robustness generally improving with model size and alignment. Beyond the results presented in this paper, Taboo provides a novel primitive for generating diverse synthetic datasets, stress-testing runtime safety guardrails, and auditing model reliability prior to real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有大语言模型评测方式存在局限，提出了一种新的解码级测试方法 Taboo，通过干预 logits 空间，使模型脱离常规轨迹，用以评估模型在真实部署时的健壮性。
AI.motivation: 传统评测主要测模型在理想情况（标准 prompt 下）表现，但实际部署中复杂 prompt、安全机制、结构约束等因素让模型经常走出理想路径，导致基准分数与真实效果脱节。因此需要能真实反映部署健壮性的方法。
AI.method: 作者提出 Decoding-Level Taboo 测试：在模型输出时动态屏蔽（mask）主要备选 token（通常在词边界处），让模型必须用变通（circumlocution）方式生成内容，直接考察模型偏离常规路径下的表现。主要干预发生在 logits 空间，属于零 prompt 测试。
AI.result: 实验表明，不同开放权重模型在 Taboo 测试下的健壮性取决于参数规模和后期指令微调，模型规模越大、alignment 做得越好越健壮。
AI.conclusion: Decoding-Level Taboo 不仅揭示了模型在非标路径下的表现差异，还为生成多样化数据、测试实时安全机制、部署前的可靠性审计等提供了新工具。

title: RenderMatte: Exact-Alpha Rendering and Group-Relative Alignment for Image Matting
summary: Image matting is an essential enabling technology for modern visual content production, where foreground extraction determines the realism and editability of downstream creation workflows. However, precise alpha estimation in open-world scenes remains challenging because real foregrounds exhibit highly diverse appearances and opacity patterns. This makes existing methods struggle with semantic ambiguity and fine-grained opacity variation, especially in sparse boundary regions that are fragile and difficult to supervise. To address this gap, we present RenderMatte, a trimap-guided matting framework that adapts FLUX.1 Kontext through full-parameter fine-tuning, leveraging image editing priors for structure-preserving alpha prediction. During supervised adaptation, an alpha-edge objective preserves the latent flow-matching signal while strengthening pixel-space boundary supervision. We further introduce group-relative alpha alignment for post-training. It compares multiple mattes sampled under the same trimap condition using matting-specific rewards for alpha accuracy, boundary fidelity, trimap compliance, and compositional consistency. To overcome the lack of precise edge annotations, we construct the RenderMatte dataset, a large-scale synthetic dataset combining 3D-rendered RGBA foregrounds with diverse multi-source assets. It features exact strand-level alpha annotations and diverse background composites. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance across all benchmarks, demonstrating a scalable path toward high-fidelity matting in open-world scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RenderMatte，一个基于trimap的图像抠图框架，通过对FLUX.1 Kontext模型全参数微调，结合新设计的损失和合成大规模精准标注数据集，实现了在开放场景下高质量前景分离。
AI.motivation: 现有抠图方法难以处理开放世界场景中前景外观多样性和细粒度透明度变化，尤其是在稀疏边界区域表现不佳。主要难点在于语义歧义与精细边界监督不足。
AI.method: 1）提出RenderMatte框架，基于trimap, 对强大的图像编辑基础模型FLUX.1 Kontext进行全参数微调；2）在有监督训练中，引入alpha-edge目标，同时增强像素级边界监督和保留潜在流匹配特征；3）设计group-relative alpha alignment作为后训练策略，通过多样奖励机制提升整体表现；4）构建大规模合成数据集RenderMatte, 提供高精度头发丝级alpha标注和多样背景。
AI.result: 在所有主流抠图基准测试上，RenderMatte均取得了最优表现，特别是在边界精度和整体alpha准确度上显著超越现有方法。
AI.conclusion: RenderMatte展示了在开放世界场景下实现高保真图像抠图的可扩展方案，有助于提升视觉内容生产的真实性和编辑灵活性。

title: From Values to Benchmarks: Evaluating Large Language Models for Governmental Use in Dutch
summary: Large language models are increasingly being deployed in governmental settings, yet few existing evaluation frameworks jointly reflect the values of public administration and the linguistic requirements of non-English contexts. We present the "Grip on LLMs" framework, a systematic evaluation suite for Dutch governmental use developed in collaboration with domain experts from a major Dutch municipal organisation. Through an advisory board process, user research, and a survey of the users of a civil-servant chatbot, we identify six evaluation dimensions (factuality, honesty, social bias, energy consumption, cost, and training data transparency) and operationalise them into a benchmark suite covering more than 30 multilingual and Dutch-specific models. Our results reveal that no single model excels across all dimensions, and that trade-offs are unavoidable: higher quality consistently comes at greater environmental impact and financial cost, while bias remains largely independent of both. We further find that factuality (whether a model answers correctly) and honesty (whether a model acknowledges what it does not know) are governed by distinct properties, with high factuality not implying high honesty. To make these findings actionable for non-technical audiences, we release a publicly accessible, user-friendly model overview designed for the full range of stakeholders involved in governmental LLM selection, from engineers to policymakers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了“Grip on LLMs”评估框架，针对荷兰政府场景，对多种大模型在六个维度上系统评估，揭示了模型能力之间的权衡与独立性，并为政府相关决策提供了实用工具。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在政府中的应用日益广泛，现有评估体系难以兼顾公共管理价值与非英语环境的语言需求，因此需要更贴合实际应用场景的评估框架。
AI.method: 联合荷兰大型市政组织的领域专家，通过顾问委员会、用户调研和公务员聊天机器人问卷，确定六大评估维度（事实性、诚实性、社会偏见、能耗、成本、训练数据透明度），并构建涵盖30余种多语种及荷兰语特定模型的基准测试套件。
AI.result: 无任何模型在所有维度表现最佳，各项能力间存在不可避免的权衡，如高质量模型常伴随更高的能耗和成本，偏见程度则与此无关。同时，事实性与诚实性反映不同模型特性，二者并不相关联。
AI.conclusion: 面向各类政府相关方，论文提供了直观易用的模型综览工具，有助于不同背景用户在选择及监管大型语言模型时做出更有依据的决策。

title: Linguistically-Aligned and Visually-Grounded Preference Optimization for Clinically-Augmented Medical Report Generation
summary: Despite significant advances in Medical Report Generation (MRG), the reliability remains constrained by the prevalence of factual errors. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as a promising post-training paradigm to enhance the performance of Supervised Fine-Tuned (SFT) MRG models, existing DPO-based MRG methods typically adopt a naive preference construction that directly pairs model-generated reports with ground truth reports. This strategy inadvertently entangles critical clinical findings with clinically irrelevant linguistic characteristics, and fundamentally lacks explicit vision-language alignment. To address these challenges, we propose DPO-Clin, a novel post-training framework that focuses preference optimization on clinical findings and cross-modal alignment. First, we introduce the Entity-level Clinical Diagnostic (ECD) module to perform a precise entity-level factual diagnosis. ECD guides the generation of linguistically-aligned report preference pairs, isolating clinical discrepancies from linguistic variations. Second, to achieve fine-grained cross-modal alignment, we develop M$^2$DPO, a retrieval-augmented multi-modal DPO variant that enforces textual preference inversion triggered by visual context switches. Third, we locate correct yet highly uncertain predicted entities and apply counterfactual modifications to construct targeted preference data for latent risk mitigation, thereby further enhancing the model reliability. Extensive experiments on two public chest X-ray datasets (MIMIC-CXR and IU X-Ray) and an in-house endoscopy dataset demonstrate that DPO-Clin significantly improves the SFT baselines on clinical-aware metrics. Furthermore, it achieves superior performance over existing DPO-based MRG methods, exhibiting robust generalizability across distinct baseline architectures and diverse medical imaging modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DPO-Clin的新型医学报告生成后训练框架，通过实体级诊断与多模态对齐显著提升了报告的临床事实可靠性。
AI.motivation: 当前医学报告生成（MRG）虽已取得进展，但因事实性错误导致可靠性受限。现有DPO范式在偏好构建时混淆了临床关键信息和语言特征，并缺乏显式的视觉-语言对齐，因此急需更细致、临床导向的优化方法。
AI.method: 提出DPO-Clin框架：1）引入实体级临床诊断（ECD）模块，分别处理事实诊断与语言特点，引导偏好数据构建。2）开发多模态DPO变体M$^2$DPO，结合视觉上下文实现细粒度文本偏好反转。3）定位正确但不确定的实体并通过反事实修改，生成用于风险缓释的针对性偏好数据。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-CXR、IU X-Ray及自有内镜数据集上实验证明，DPO-Clin在临床感知指标上显著优于SFT基线与现有DPO方案，展示了跨架构、跨模态的强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: DPO-Clin不仅有效提升了医学报告事实正确性和可靠性，还具有良好的泛化能力，是提升MRG领域模型性能的有效后训练策略。

title: Towards Adaptive Super-Resolution and Quality Assessment via Test-Time Adaptation
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables, 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia, Accepted as Doctoral Symposium Track
summary: This paper presents doctoral research on adaptive video super-resolution and perceptual quality modeling under real-world conditions. Existing video super-resolution (VSR) methods struggle to generalize under unknown degradations arising from heterogeneous devices, codecs, and network environments. We address this challenge through test-time adaptation (TTA), a unified paradigm that improves robustness and perceptual quality without retraining or high-quality supervision. Specifically, we: 1) propose a TTA-based framework for no-reference video quality assessment (VQA), where adapted quality predictions provide perceptual guidance for VSR under unseen distortions; 2) develop a transformer-based architecture for screen-content super-resolution that preserves text clarity and structural fidelity; and 3) introduce a region-aware TTA strategy that selectively refines text and non-text regions without requiring high-resolution ground truth. Experimental results across diverse benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in perceptual quality and readability. We also outline ongoing work toward fully adaptive video enhancement systems capable of generalizing across unseen domains.

AI.tldr: 本文针对现有视频超分辨率（VSR）模型在面对真实复杂退化时泛化能力不足的问题，提出了以测试时自适应（TTA）为基础的一体化视频增强与感知质量建模方法，无需重新训练或高质量监督即可提升鲁棒性和感知质量。
AI.motivation: 现有VSR方法难以应对设备类型、压缩方式、网络环境等带来的未知退化，导致在实际应用中质量降低。因此，需要一种无需高成本重新训练即可提升模型实际表现的方法。
AI.method: 1. 基于TTA提出无参考视频质量评价（VQA）框架，将质量预测结果用于指导VSR感知优化；2. 设计了Transformer结构以实现屏幕内容的超分辨，增强文本清晰度与结构保真；3. 提出区域感知TTA策略，无需高分辨真值即可对文本/非文本区域自适应精细增强。
AI.result: 在多种数据集和基准上进行实验，结果显示上述方法能稳定提升视频的感知质量和可读性。
AI.conclusion: TTA为核心的自适应增强框架，可在无需额外数据和泛化监督的情况下改善VSR模型在未知场景下的效果，为未来自适应视频增强系统的实现奠定了基础。

title: eBIRD: Event-based Intensity Image Reconstruction Using Controllable Diffusion Models
summary: Intensity-image reconstruction from event streams remains a challenging problem due to the binary, sparse, and asynchronous nature of event data. This work proposes eBIRD, an event-guided reconstruction framework that combines a DDPM with ControlNet-based conditioning. We analyze generic and specialized diffusion learning strategies for handwritten digit (N-MNIST) and face (RGBE-Gaze) reconstruction using 33ms event windows. On N-MNIST, the general model achieves the best reconstruction quality (MSE 0.0052, SSIM 0.8982, PSNR 23.34dB), whereas the specialized model performs best on RGBE-Gaze (MSE 0.0161, SSIM 0.7605, PSNR 19.08dB). These preliminary results suggest that controllable diffusion models are a promising approach for event-guided intensity-image reconstruction, while highlighting that the preferred learning strategy depends on the reconstruction domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了eBIRD框架，利用扩散模型和ControlNet来重建事件流的强度图像，并在手写数字和人脸数据集上取得了较好效果。
AI.motivation: 由于事件相机数据是二值、稀疏且异步的，从中重建高质量强度图像具有很大挑战。当前方法的效果有限，缺乏灵活可控的新型方法。
AI.method: 引入eBIRD框架，将扩散概率模型（DDPM）与ControlNet调控机制结合，探讨了通用与专用扩散学习策略，对N-MNIST（手写数字）和RGBE-Gaze（人脸）数据集进行33ms事件窗口的重建实验。
AI.result: 在N-MNIST上，通用模型重建质量最佳（MSE 0.0052，SSIM 0.8982，PSNR 23.34dB）；在RGBE-Gaze上，专用模型性能更好（MSE 0.0161，SSIM 0.7605，PSNR 19.08dB）。
AI.conclusion: 可控扩散模型适用于事件引导的强度图像重建。最佳学习策略依赖于具体重建领域。

title: A Combined Feature-Based Framework for Disguise and Spoofing Detection in Face Recognition Systems
summary: Face recognition systems face two distinct, commonly-separated failure modes: spoofing, where an impostor presents a photograph or video of an authorized user, and disguise, where a legitimate user is rejected because their appearance differs from their enrolled template due to accessories, facial hair, illumination, or pose. This paper proposes and compares five combined feature-extraction and classification pipelines that address both problems within a single framework: PM (PCA and Minimum Euclidean Distance, MED), LPM (Local Binary Patterns with PCA and MED), HPM (Histogram of Oriented Gradients with PCA and MED), SM (Speeded-Up Robust Features with MED), and HM (Harris corner features with MED). Each pipeline follows a common two-phase process comprising pre-processing, feature extraction, feature filtering, and classification. The methods were trained on 115 subjects drawn from the FEI, Disguised Faces Database, and NUAA databases and evaluated on six test conditions covering mixed appearances, frontal faces, dark illumination, left- and right-turned poses, and photo-spoofing attempts. The HOG-based pipeline (HPM) achieved the most consistent performance across conditions, with 94.59% accuracy on mixed-appearance disguise, 81.5-93.2% across pose and illumination variants, and 91.67% on spoofing, while the LBP-based pipeline (LPM) achieved the highest spoofing-detection accuracy (93.2%) but weaker robustness to pose change. These results reveal a measurable trade-off between spoof sensitivity and disguise robustness among classical feature representations, motivating the deep-learning and cross-database extensions discussed in the concluding sections.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出并比较了五种特征提取与分类方法，用于同时处理人脸识别中的伪造攻击与伪装拒识两大难题，并在多个测试条件下进行了实验评估。
AI.motivation: 人脸识别常见两类失败：伪造攻击（如照片攻击）和真实用户因外观变化被错拒。现有方法多分开处理，如何在一个框架下同时提升对两类问题的鲁棒性，是推动实际系统应用的重要动机。
AI.method: 构建了五条处理流水线：PM（PCA+最小欧氏距离）、LPM（局部二值模式+PCA+MED）、HPM（方向梯度直方图+PCA+MED）、SM（SURF+MED）和HM（Harris角点+MED），均包含预处理、特征提取、筛选与分类模块。方法在三大公开库（FEI, Disguised Faces, NUAA）共115人样本上训练，并在多种场景下测试，包括不同外观、姿态、光照及伪造攻击。
AI.result: HPM（HOG方法）在各条件下表现最稳定，变外观条件下达94.59%准确率，姿态和光照变化81.5%-93.2%，伪造检测91.67%；LPM（LBP方法）在伪造检测上最高（93.2%），但姿态鲁棒性较低。
AI.conclusion: 传统特征法在防伪与防伪装表现有权衡关系，推动了进一步向深度学习和跨库泛化方向研究。

title: ERF-GS: Reconstructing Fast Motion from Disjoint Event-RGB Viewpoints
summary: Deep learning-driven representations such as neural radiance fields (NeRFs) and 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) have revolutionized the field of dynamic 3D scene reconstruction with improved visual precision and scalability. However, the reconstruction of fast-moving objects remains a challenge; existing methods based on conventional frame-based videos often struggle in scenarios such as sports events and animal videography. We propose an event-RGB fusion Gaussian splatting (ERF-GS) framework that integrates event information into both optimization and densification stages of the Gaussian splatting pipeline, taking advantage of novel event sensors with high frame-rate. Unlike many other event-assisted scene reconstruction methods, ERF-GS was developed using realistic simulation settings and realizes event-based learning detached from RGB inputs. This design enables its application beyond straightforward synthetic data into the realm of natural video with complex layout, low frame rates and severe motion blur. Our experiments show that ERF-GS outperforms both the 4DGS baseline and the concurrent E-D3DGS on different variants of the Neu3D and Nvidia datasets which include blurry RGB frames and disjoint RGB-event viewpoints. Our code is available at https://github.com/andrewbxy/ERF-GS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合高帧率事件相机与RGB视频的3D高斯溅射重建新方法（ERF-GS），显著提升了对快速运动物体的三维场景重建效果。
AI.motivation: 尽管NeRF及3DGS在3D场景重建上取得进步，但现有方法在处理高速运动物体时仍易受限于传统帧率的RGB视频，导致运动模糊和重建不准确，尤其在体育和动物拍摄场景下更为突出。
AI.method: 作者提出『事件-RGB融合高斯溅射(ERF-GS)』框架，将高帧率事件相机的信息引入高斯溅射的优化与密集化阶段，并实现事件信息与RGB输入解耦，从而能处理复杂布局、低帧率和严重运动模糊的自然视频。采用仿真数据以及Neu3D、Nvidia等真实数据集进行实验评估。
AI.result: ERF-GS在Neu3D和Nvidia数据集的多种变体上，相较于4DGS及E-D3DGS等先进方法，实现了更优的重建精度和鲁棒性，尤其是在含运动模糊和视角不一致的RGB-事件输入条件下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: ERF-GS显著提升了运动物体的动态3D重建能力，为事件相机与三维重建结合打开新方向，在复杂实际场景下具备广阔应用前景。

title: Rethinking Attention Locality in Spiking Transformers
summary: Spiking Transformers provide a promising paradigm for efficient visual processing with spike-driven computation, yet their Softmax-free Spiking Self-Attention (SSA) struggles to establish spatially localized token interactions. Although existing locality-enhanced SSA methods improve accuracy, it remains unclear whether they consistently induce spatial locality across layers and different Spiking Transformer architectures. Through Mean Attention Distance (MAD) analysis, we reveal that computational locality does not necessarily translate into spatial locality and show that uniformly applying the same locality enhancement overlooks architecture-dependent deployment requirements.
