Specifically, we present MGN-AIR, a novel pixel-level restoration framework for all-in-one image restoration. Our approach first learns to estimate a pixel-level visual prompt. Then, it leverages both textual and visual prompts to provide global and local degradation cues, guiding the model on where to look and how to restore at each pixel. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple all-in-one image restoration benchmarks, covering a wide range of tasks including denoising, deraining, deblurring, dehazing, desnowing, and low-light enhancement. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed method consistently and significantly outperforms existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的像素级一体化图像修复框架（MGN-AIR），在多种退化图像恢复任务中取得了优于现有方法的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有一体化图像修复方法通常对整幅图像采用统一的修复策略，忽略了不同区域受到的退化类型及严重程度可能不同，导致细粒度恢复能力有限。因此，亟需能针对图像中不同区域特点进行分层次精细修复的新方法。
AI.method: 作者提出MGN-AIR框架，创新性地估算每个像素的视觉提示，并融合视觉和文本提示，分别提供局部和全局的退化信息，引导模型对每个像素进行更精准的修复。
AI.result: 在去噪、去雨、去模糊、去雾、去雪及低照度增强等多种一体化图像恢复基准上，MGN-AIR方法均显著优于主流现有方法。
AI.conclusion: MGN-AIR实现了像素级细粒度图像修复，在多领域图像退化任务中展现出较强的通用性和优越性能，推动了一体化图像修复技术的发展。

title: GeoRoute: Geometry-Aware Hybrid Inference for Traffic Future-Frame Prediction
comment: accepted to the ECCV 2026 AI City Challenge Workshop
summary: Long-horizon future-frame prediction is important for autonomous driving, traffic surveillance, and intelligent transportation systems, yet remains challenging due to temporal ghosting, geometry drift, and inconsistent object motion. Recent latent video diffusion models have achieved impressive visual quality, but directly applying them to structured traffic scenes often leads to unstable geometry and degraded temporal coherence over extended horizons. We present a training-free inference framework that stabilizes reliable static structure in pretrained video predictions through multi-frame temporal context and view-conditioned routing. For front-camera videos, our method refines generated futures with a multi-frame depth-layered renderer that projects static geometry from observed history frames while preserving dynamic regions from the generative base model. For heterogeneous traffic views, a frozen vision-language model infers a coarse camera group from the observed clip and selects a specialized motion-based predictor. The framework requires neither retraining nor fine-tuning of the underlying video model and can be applied directly to pretrained generators. We validate the proposed framework on the AI City Challenge Track 5 benchmark, where our final system achieves competitive performance among the top-ranked teams. These results demonstrate that geometry-aware inference-time refinement and view-conditioned hybrid inference can improve static-geometry stability and low-level structural fidelity without changing the original model architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需重新训练即可改进长时未来帧视频预测结构稳定性的推理框架，特别适用于交通场景，提升了静态几何一致性和时序连贯性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于潜在扩散的视频生成模型在交通等结构化场景下进行长时未来帧预测时，常出现几何漂移、运动不连贯等问题，影响实际应用（如自动驾驶）。
AI.method: 设计了一个无训练推理框架：对于前视摄像头视频，利用多帧深度分层渲染器，将历史观测帧中的静态几何投影到未来帧，同时保留生成模型产生的动态区块；对于多样化视角的数据，利用冻结的视觉-语言模型判断摄像头类型，并动态选择合适的时序预测器。整个过程针对预训练生成器，无需重新训练或微调。
AI.result: 在AI City Challenge Track 5基准测试上，系统取得了靠前的成绩，表现与顶尖团队相当，验证了方法对结构稳定性和低级结构细节的改进作用。
AI.conclusion: 基于几何感知的推理时优化与视角条件混合推理能够在不改变原始模型结构的情况下，显著提高长时未来交通视频预测中的静态几何稳定性和整体结构还原。

title: SwissCrop25: A National Multi-Year Benchmark for Operational Crop Mapping
comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop TerraBytes II. To appear in the workshop proceedings
summary: Operational crop mapping requires models that generalise across years, resolve fine-grained crop taxonomies, and distinguish cropland from surrounding landscapes. However, existing crop mapping datasets enable evaluation of these requirements only in isolation. We therefore introduce SwissCrop25, a national-scale crop mapping benchmark dataset spanning seven growing seasons (2019-2025). SwissCrop25 combines Sentinel-2 time series, daily temperature observations, a fine-grained 73 crop taxonomy including grassland management types, and 5 explicit non-crop land cover classes. To evaluate realistic deployment conditions, we define a leave-one-year-out protocol with joint cropland delineation and crop classification for benchmarking representative crop mapping architectures. Evaluating U-TAE (convolutional temporal-attention model), TSViT (transformer-based spatio-temporal model), and Galileo (EO foundation model) reveals differences between architectures hidden by conventional benchmarks. In this setting, domain-specific models outperform Galileo, with TSViT achieving the best overall performance and a 12 pp macro-mIoU advantage over U-TAE. SwissCrop25 also exposes substantial interannual distribution shifts and shows that incorporating temperature-derived phenological information improves robustness. Finally, in-season evaluation reveals a trade-off between models, with U-TAE performing better early in the season and TSViT gaining an advantage later through improved rare-class discrimination. SwissCrop25 provides a challenging testbed for evaluating crop mapping systems under realistic operational conditions and is publicly released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/EOA-team/SwissCrop25 .

AI.tldr: 论文提出并公开了SwissCrop25，一套覆盖2019-2025年、适用于多模型对比和现实部署的高分辨率作物制图基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 目前的作物制图数据集未能在同一平台上全方位评估模型在跨年份泛化、精细作物分类及农田与其他地貌区分等现实问题。
AI.method: SwissCrop25数据集结合了Sentinel-2时序影像、日温数据、73类细致作物（含草地管理类型）及5类非农地覆盖。采用留一年评估方案，统一测试农田分割及类别判别，并比较了典型模型（U-TAE, TSViT, Galileo）。
AI.result: TSViT在整体表现最好，比U-TAE高12个百分点macro-mIoU。和通用模型Galileo相比，领域模型更优。数据集揭示了模型在年份分布变化中的鲁棒性和温度信息对稳健性的提升。不同模型表现随作物生长期变化，U-TAE前期优、TSViT后期区分稀有作物更佳。
AI.conclusion: SwissCrop25为作物制图提供了一个现实、苛刻且全面的测试平台，有助推动该领域模型的实际应用发展。

title: XFeat Revisited: Reproducibility and Evaluation of a Lightweight Image Matcher
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures. Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR); Reproducibility Certification
summary: We present a reproducibility study of XFeat, a lightweight local feature extractor and matcher designed to identify corresponding points across images efficiently on resource-constrained hardware. We re-implement the architecture based on the paper and supplementary material, re-evaluate the authors' released checkpoint alongside our re-implementation, and conduct additional architectural ablations to examine design choices that were not fully justified in the original work. This distinction between re-evaluation and reproduction is important, as the paper, supplement, and public code differ in several implementation details, including the backbone layout, fusion block, and training losses. Empirically, our reproduced models closely match and, in some cases, outperform the re-evaluated original checkpoint on MegaDepth-1500 and ScanNet-1500, supporting the main claim that XFeat provides a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off for standard image-matching benchmarks. Our ablations provide a more nuanced view of two architectural arguments from the original paper. In particular, the parallel keypoint branch is important for semi-dense matching, but its benefit is less pronounced than originally claimed, while the evidence for the specific placement of the single skip-connection remains inconclusive. Finally, we reproduce the original downstream evaluations and find close agreement for homography estimation, while Aachen visual localization remains below the reported results, even for the released checkpoint, suggesting sensitivity to underspecified evaluation details. We then extend the analysis to zero-shot out-of-distribution and cross-modal matching across retinal, thermal-visible, and multimodal remote-sensing imagery, where XFeat remains effective in some settings but degrades sharply under severe modality shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文对XFeat本地特征提取与匹配方法的可复现性进行了全面评估，并对模型结构设计做了深入剖析和消融实验。
AI.motivation: XFeat是一款专为资源受限硬件设计的高效本地特征点提取与匹配方法。原始论文在结构与实验细节上存在一定模糊和差异，复现性和部分设计动机尚未被充分检验。本文旨在厘清实现细节、检验原作者性能声称，并探究部分结构选择的合理性。
AI.method: 作者基于原论文和补充材料重新实现了XFeat架构，对原作者发布的模型和自实现模型在公开基准上进行再评估，同时做了架构消融实验分析关键组件的作用。还复现了下游任务评测，并扩展到跨模态与零样本分布外匹配测试。
AI.result: 复现模型在MegaDepth-1500和ScanNet-1500等标准基准测试中与原作者模型表现接近甚至略优。结构消融发现keypoint分支对半稠密匹配有用但效果不如原文声称，跳连选择的正当性证据不足。下游任务部分结果吻合但视觉定位结果低于原报告。跨模态和分布外场景下效果部分维持，但遇严重退化。
AI.conclusion: XFeat在准确性与效率间依然保持良好权衡，核心结构大体有效，但部分设计动机尚待进一步证实。论文强调严格复现和细节透明性对评估新架构的重要性，揭示了评测环节中潜在的敏感点与未充分指明的问题。

authors: Jose M. D. S. Rodrigues Neto
title: TriView-YOLO: Early Multi-View Fusion for Ground Penetrating Radar Cavity Detection in Soft, High-Water-Content Soils
summary: Automated detection of subsurface cavities from Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) is most difficult in soft, high-water-content ground, where conductive, water-saturated soil attenuates the signal and degrades cavity reflections, yet this is also the condition under which cavities most readily form. This paper proposes TriView-YOLO, a multi-view YOLOv12 detector for road cavity screening in such ground. Three co-registered views (longitudinal B-scan, horizontal C-scan, and cross-section B-scan) form a 9-channel input fused by a TripleInputConv layer that replaces the YOLOv12 stem; the rest of the network is unchanged, and bounding boxes are required on the longitudinal view only. Training used 1,600 expert-verified field samples, principally metropolitan road surveys of Bangkok, Thailand, acquired with a vehicle-mounted multichannel three-dimensional GPR mobile mapping system, with surveys over the firmer subgrades of Japan added to training and validation only. The test set comes exclusively from the Bangkok surveys, over soft marine clay with 80-140% water content and a water table at 1-2 m depth, a ground condition for which no dedicated deep learning cavity-detection evaluation has been reported. On this unaugmented, field-only test set, split randomly within surveys, the proposed model attains mAP50 of 0.558 +/- 0.028 over three seeds at 23.6 GFLOPs and 3.1 ms per image. Ablations show that removing the auxiliary views lowers mAP50 and recall, whereas public and synthetic training images, DINOv3 features, larger model scale, and COCO pretraining bring no gain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为TriView-YOLO的新型多视角深度学习方法，用于在含水量高的软土地基中利用探地雷达自动检测地下空洞。通过结合三种不同视图，模型检测精度显著提升。
AI.motivation: 在高含水量、软土地基中，探地雷达信号被严重衰减，导致地下空洞难以自动检测，但这类地基又极易形成空洞。现有深度学习方法在此类复杂条件下缺乏有效的应用与评估。
AI.method: 提出TriView-YOLO方法，将纵剖面B扫、水平C扫和横剖面B扫三种共注册视图，作为9通道输入，并通过TripleInputConv模块实现深度融合，替换YOLOv12原始输入层，其余结构保持不变，仅在主视图上标定空洞位置。模型使用1600份曼谷和部分日本路段多通道三维GPR实地样本进行训练和验证。
AI.result: 在曼谷软海相黏土高含水量实地数据集（未扩增，真实采集，测试集随机划分）上，新方法平均mAP50达到0.558±0.028，单张图片推理速度约为3.1毫秒（23.6 GFLOPs）。消融实验表明，去除辅助视图会显著降低检测精度和召回率，而使用公开或合成样本、DINOv3特征、放大模型规模或COCO预训练均无助于提升性能。
AI.conclusion: TriView-YOLO多视角输入结构有效提升了复杂高含水软土地基下探地雷达自动空洞检测的准确性，显示出在实际复杂土壤条件下的显著优势，适用于实际路面空洞筛查。

title: Towards Expressive and Faithful Audio-to-Image Generation: A Unified Multimodal Dataset and Synthesis Framework
summary: As an important subfield of cross-modal generation, synthesizing static visual content in the form of images from audio, namely audio-to-image (A2I) generation, has attracted increasing research attention in recent years. Nevertheless, despite the remarkable visual quality of modern text-to-image (T2I) models, the performance of A2I remains fundamentally limited by traditional datasets, which often lack both high-fidelity images and precise cross-modal alignment. As a result, existing methods still struggle to achieve high-quality audio-to-image generation through finetuning strong T2I models, thereby constraining practical applications in this area. Motivated by this gap, we introduce A2I-Set, a unified, high-quality tri-modal dataset consisting of 323K paired audio, images, and detailed text captions, specifically designed for audio-visual research, including audio-conditioned image generation. Besides, we developed a new mixed-source test set for the A2I task through human supervision. We further propose an A2I model, AudioCanvas, fine-tuned on our A2I-Set. Experiments show that AudioCanvas achieves more visually expressive as well as cross-modal alignment results that generally outperforming existing approaches. Our dataset and source code are available at https://github.com/gdx012/A2I-Generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个高质量的三模态（音频、图像、文本）A2I-Set数据集，并基于此开发了新的音频到图像生成模型AudioCanvas，有效提升了A2I任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 尽管文本生成图像（T2I）取得极大进展，但音频生成图像（A2I）受限于传统数据集局限，图像质量和跨模态对齐性不足，现有方法难以借助强大T2I模型实现高质量A2I生成。因此作者希望通过改进数据集和模型方法，推动A2I领域的发展。
AI.method: 1）构建A2I-Set数据集，包含32万对音频、图像和详细文本注释，促进音频与视觉内容的对齐；2）开发了带有人工监督的新A2I混合源测试集；3）提出了在A2I-Set上微调的AudioCanvas模型，实现高效的音频到图像生成。
AI.result: 实验表明，AudioCanvas在视觉表现力和跨模态对齐方面都优于现有方法，实现了更高质量的音频到图像生成。
AI.conclusion: A2I-Set数据集和AudioCanvas模型大幅提升了A2I任务的水平，为音频驱动的图像生成提供了可靠的资源与方法，对跨模态生成研究具有推动作用。

title: DocPure: Prompt-Free Unified Document Restoration via Degradation-Aware Structure-Guided Wavelet Modulation
comment: 19 pages, 15 figures. Lingming Su and Wanglong Lu contributed equally to this work
summary:
High-quality document images are pivotal for information archiving and downstream automatic processing. However, they are frequently compromised by diverse degradations during uncontrolled acquisition and transmission. While unified document restoration techniques have been proposed to restore images from multiple degradations, they often struggle with training multiple degradation-specific models, reliance on manual task-specific prompts, or cross-task data pairing. To address these limitations, we propose DocPure, a prompt-free unified framework that achieves degradation-aware document restoration.
  We design a degradation-aware structure auto-encoder with degradation-informed routing regularization to predict clean structural priors from degraded inputs. The model is prompt-free at inference, and degradation labels are only used as auxiliary supervision for the routing regularization during training.
  Furthermore, we introduce a structure-guided wavelet interaction mechanism to bridge frequency-domain features and spatial semantics. Within the structure-guided wavelet interaction mechanism, a cross-frequency adaptive modulation utilizes low-frequency sub-bands to modulate high-frequency recovery, ensuring structural consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DocPure achieves strong performance compared with state-of-the-art methods across various tasks, including deblurring, denoising, compression artifact reduction, and deshadowing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需额外提示的统一文档图像恢复框架DocPure，能够针对多种退化任务（如去模糊、去噪、压缩伪影去除、去阴影）实现高质量文档图像的自动恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有文档恢复方法通常需要针对不同退化类型训练专用模型、依赖于人工指定任务提示或特殊的数据对，存在泛化性不足、实际应用不便等局限。作者希望设计一种无需提示，能处理多种退化类型的统一文档恢复方法。
AI.method: 提出DocPure框架，包括退化感知结构自编码器（带有退化信息路由正则化）用于从退化图像推理出洁净结构先验，仅在训练阶段使用退化标签；同时引入结构引导的离散小波交互机制——通过频域和空间语义相互作用，利用低频恢复提升高频细节的一致性。
AI.result: 大量实验结果显示，DocPure在去模糊、去噪、去压缩伪影、去阴影等多种任务中都超越了现有先进方法。
AI.conclusion: DocPure作为一种提示无关、统一的文档恢复方法，不仅提升了图像恢复质量，还极大提升了实际应用中的泛化性与易用性。

title: Towards Collaborative Joint Perception and Prediction: Framework, Baseline Evaluation, and Deployment Perspectives
comment: 28 pages, 4 figures, post-publication of conference paper, accepted at journal SN Computer Science
summary: Connected Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) increasingly exploit Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication to exchange multi-source sensor information, enabling advanced Collaborative Perception (CP) capabilities. Extending beyond these capabilities, this work focuses on Collaborative Joint Perception and Prediction (Co-P&P), a paradigm that unifies CP with motion prediction to mitigate two persistent challenges: the accumulation of perception errors and visual occlusions. We present a conceptual framework for Collaborative Joint Perception and Prediction (Co-P&P) that improves motion prediction of surrounding road users, thereby enhancing situational awareness in complex and dynamic traffic environments. Building upon our preliminary study, this extended version compares the performance of different fusion strategies and establishes baseline performance for a modular design of perception and prediction. Experimental results show that prediction-level fusion leads to a decline in overall system performance compared to detection-level or tracking-level fusion. We further implement a minimal end-to-end Co-P&P prototype that couples collaborative point-cloud sharing via the RENO neural codec with joint detection-forecasting via FutureDet, showing that collaboration improves forecasting accuracy while neural compression preserves this benefit at roughly 34x lower communication bandwidth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了协同联合感知与预测（Co-P&P）框架，提升自动驾驶车辆在复杂路况下的环境感知与目标运动预测能力，并通过多种融合策略比较，展示了端到端的高效原型系统。
AI.motivation: 传统协同感知（CP）主要增强感知能力，但仍受感知误差累积和视觉遮挡的影响。自动驾驶车辆亟需突破上述难题，从而实现更高水平的交通安全与决策能力。
AI.method: 提出了协同联合感知与预测（Co-P&P）理念，将多源传感数据融合和目标运动预测结合。系统性比较了不同层级（检测、追踪、预测级）融合方案，并实现了基于RENO神经编解码器的点云协作共享和FutureDet联合检测-预测的端到端原型。
AI.result: 实验表明，仅在预测级别做信息融合会降低整体系统性能，而在检测级或追踪级融合表现更佳。此外，采用神经压缩后通信带宽降低约34倍但预测准确率仍有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 协同联合感知与预测方法能有效提升自动驾驶车辆在复杂交通场景中的感知与预测能力，优化融合层级选择和高效通信压缩是实现该目标的关键。

title: PressureMesh: 3D Human Mesh Estimation from Multi-Device Pressure Images
summary: Human pose monitoring is crucial in fields such as rehabilitation assessment and human-computer interaction. Due to its privacy-preserving nature, pressure-based human pose monitoring has become a primary approach for unobtrusive sensing. However, existing methods are generally limited to a single device, which restricts the effective monitoring range. To address this limitation, we propose MDP-Net, an end-to-end network capable of directly estimating human meshes from temporal pressure data across multiple devices. We introduce a multimodal fusion mechanism inspired by the Mixture of Experts (MoE) framework to achieve effective complementarity and enhancement of cross-device pressure information. To support the training and evaluation of MDP-Net, we constructed MDP, a high-quality multi-device temporal pressure dataset that includes various pose labels such as 2D/3D joints and human meshes. Experimental results demonstrate that MDP-Net achieves a joint position error of 12.6 cm on the MDP dataset. These results prove that fusing multi-device pressure information is an effective and promising new solution for daily human pose monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多设备压力数据融合的人体姿态估计网络MDP-Net，并构建了相应的数据集，实验结果显示其在姿态监测上有较高精度。
AI.motivation: 现有压力传感为基础的人体姿态监测方法多局限于单设备，受限于监测范围，无法满足实际中大范围、隐私保护和精确需求。
AI.method: 提出MDP-Net端到端网络，能够直接从多个设备的时序压力数据估计人体网格。创新性地引入基于MoE（Mixture of Experts）框架的多模态融合机制，实现跨设备压力信息的互补和增强，并自建了包含2D/3D关节及人体网格姿态标签的多设备压力数据集MDP用于训练和评估。
AI.result: 在MDP数据集上，MDP-Net实现了12.6厘米的关节位置误差，显著提升了多设备压力信息在姿态估计中的效果。
AI.conclusion: 多设备压力数据融合是实现无侵入、高精度人体姿态监测的有效新方案，MDP-Net的提出推动了该领域的发展。

title: From Semantic Grounding to Decision Optimization: A Unified Framework for Long-Horizon UAV Vision-Language Navigation
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)
summary: UAV vision-language navigation (UAV-VLN) focuses on enabling an aerial agent to follow natural-language instructions in open 3D environments from egocentric visual observations. Current approaches suffer from three coupled issues: weak grounding of instruction-relevant landmarks in visual observations, insufficient exploitation of long-horizon history, and unstable decisions under local traps or repeated exploration. To address these issues, we propose a unified semantic-to-decision framework. First, we present an instruction-grounded semantic enhancement module that injects object-level semantics and relative spatial cues into the current observation state. Subsequently, we develop a relevance-aware dynamic temporal aggregation strategy that reweights the full history buffer while converting a few high-relevance frames into structured landmark prompts for the decoder. Finally, we devise a topology-aware decision method that combines local-optimum cognition with group-relative policy optimization under progress, goal, semantic, and path-compliance rewards. Experiments on the widely used AerialVLN and OpenFly benchmarks clearly demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的语义到决策框架，有效提升了无人机视觉-语言导航（UAV-VLN）的性能，在AerialVLN和OpenFly基准数据集上取得了最新最优结果。
AI.motivation: 当前UAV-VLN方法存在三个主要问题：指令相关地标的视觉锚定能力弱、对长时间历史信息利用不足、在陷阱或重复探索场景下决策不稳定。为解决这些挑战，本文提出新的方法。
AI.method: 方法包括三个创新点：1）设计基于指令的语义增强模块，将物体级语义和相对空间信息融入到当前视觉状态中；2）提出相关性感知的动态时间聚合策略，对历史信息进行重加权，并将部分高相关帧转为结构化地标提示输入解码器；3）设计算法考虑环境拓扑结构，将局部最优与组相对策略优化结合，基于进度、目标、语义和路径合规性多重奖励优化决策。
AI.result: 在AerialVLN和OpenFly两个主流基准数据集上，该方法显著优于现有技术，实现了最先进的导航性能。
AI.conclusion: 统一的语义到决策框架能够有效提升UAV-VLN系统对语言指令的理解和执行能力，为无人机在复杂三维环境中进行准确导航提供了新的解决思路。

title: VideoVIBE: A Video-Grounded Diagnostic Benchmark for One-Shot Interactive Website Generation
summary: Natural-language-driven "vibe coding" enables the one-shot generation of visually rich and interactive web applications, yet reliable assessment of their quality has not kept pace. Existing evaluations often score isolated artifacts or final task outcomes, offering limited evidence about which failures occur and why. We introduce VideoVIBE, a video-grounded benchmark that transforms human-operated webpage recordings into fine-grained diagnostic tasks. It contains approximately 1.7K diagnostic Video QA instances derived from 6,338 verified failures across generated webpages, spanning semantic-logical, visual-motion, structural-temporal, and functional failures. Diagnoses are grounded primarily in recorded presentation and behavior, with webpage source code used as complementary context. We further propose V2Lens, a training-free, evidence-grounded multi-agent system that challenges and selectively refines initial video-based diagnoses through targeted visual and source-code verification. Across thirteen closed-source and open-weight Video MLLMs, Gemini-2.5-Flash is the strongest standalone model with a score of 64.54, while V2Lens reaches 71.72, an improvement of 7.18 points. Together, our results show that video-grounded evaluation can move beyond isolated artifacts and aggregate outcomes toward a behaviorally faithful and diagnostically informative account of generated application quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VideoVIBE，一个基于视频记录的网页质量评测基准，以及V2Lens多智能体诊断系统，提升了自然语言驱动网页生成应用的评测精度和可信度。
AI.motivation: 当前自然语言生成网页技术品质提升迅速，但评估方式落后，尤其难以细致诊断具体故障类型和原因，评测信度有限。作者需求更全面、细化的评估体系。
AI.method: 构建VideoVIBE数据集，将人工操作网页的视频转化为细粒度的问题和诊断任务，涵盖多类失败类型，并结合网页源代码辅助分析。同时提出V2Lens多智能体诊断框架，无需训练地通过多智能体验证提升诊断准确率。
AI.result: VideoVIBE包含约1700个视频QA实例，覆盖6338个已验证的网页生成失败。评测了13个主流视频多模态大模型，Gemini-2.5-Flash单模型最高分64.54，V2Lens诊断系统可达71.72分，提升7.18。
AI.conclusion: 基于视频的评估方式实现了对生成网页行为的更真实、具诊断性的质量评测，有助于促进智能网页生成技术的发展和落地。

title: MSP-Net: Manifold-Guided Spectral Prompt Network for Hyperspectral Object Tracking
summary: Hyperspectral object tracking leverages abundant spectral information to provide unique advantages for target discrimination in complex scenes. However, existing methods typically treat hyperspectral images as multi-channel extensions of RGB images, performing feature fusion in fixed band order. This approach leads to models dependent on specific sensor configurations while neglecting manifold relationships between bands, making generalization to heterogeneous sensors difficult. Moreover, the discriminative contribution of bands dynamically changes with target attributes and scene variations, further limiting the representational capacity of static fusion strategies. To address this, we propose the Manifold-Guided Spectral Prompt Network (MSP-Net). This network first reconstructs band relationships and forms adaptive spectral grouping through graph-driven manifold routing, then jointly integrates grouped spectral statistics with template appearance to construct target-related dynamic conditional prompts, enhancing target features while suppressing background interference. Furthermore, as tracking progresses, spectral conditions continuously evolve based on intermediate target representations, enabling target prompts to adapt in real-time to appearance and scene changes. Meanwhile, reliable historical states are used to constrain target localization and scale fluctuations, significantly improving temporal stability in cross-sensor tracking. Experiments on HOT2020 and HOT2023 demonstrate that MSP-Net achieves AUC and Precision exceeding 0.80 and 0.96, respectively, exhibiting exceptional robustness under heterogeneous sensors, target deformation, and complex background conditions. The code will be released at https://github.com/GGML668897/MSP-Net.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MSP-Net网络，通过流形引导对高光谱图像波段关系进行自适应分组，并动态融合以提升跨传感器跟踪的稳健性，实现了在多样场景与异构传感器上的高精度目标跟踪。
AI.motivation: 现有高光谱目标跟踪方法主要将波段按固定顺序堆叠，导致模型对特定传感器依赖性强、泛化性弱，且静态融合无法适应目标属性及场景变化下各波段判别能力的动态性。
AI.method: 作者提出Manifold-Guided Spectral Prompt Network（MSP-Net），利用图驱动的流形路由重建波段关系，自适应分组统计并与模板外观特征结合，构建动态条件提示（prompt），在跟踪过程中实时调整并利用历史状态约束目标位置和尺度，提高跨传感器时序稳定性。
AI.result: MSP-Net在HOT2020和HOT2023数据集上，AUC和精度分别超过0.80和0.96，在异构传感器、目标形变和复杂背景下表现出极高的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MSP-Net突破了传统高光谱跟踪的传感器依赖和静态融合局限，实现了更强的泛化能力和时序稳定性，有望作为复杂场景下高光谱目标跟踪中的新一代技术方案。

title: You Only Flow Once: Calibrated and Real-Time Radar Pose Estimation with Multi-Hypothesis Normalizing Flows
comment: Accepted at the Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027
summary: Sparse and noisy millimeter-wave radar point cloud observations often correspond to multiple plausible human poses, making deterministic pose estimation fundamentally ill-posed. Yet existing radar methods remain deterministic, collapsing this ambiguity into a single estimate. Diffusion-based alternatives can model multi-hypothesis distributions but require costly sequential denoising for each distribution sample and lack calibrated uncertainty. We propose Multi-Hypothesis Normalizing Flow Pose Generator (MH-NFPG), which models pose distributions from radar point clouds using a conditional normalizing flow. Specifically, we combine a spatiotemporal transformer backbone with a normalizing flow that transforms a Laplace base distribution into an expressive posterior, generated in parallel through a single forward pass. Leveraging this efficiency, we outperform diffusion-based alternatives in calibration across three radar benchmarks (MM-Fi, mmRadPose, mRI), improve pose accuracy on two, and match it on the third, while achieving over 20x faster inference for applications and reducing calibration error by up to 85%. We find that calibration degrades substantially for diffusion models, whereas our flow-based approach maintains reliable coverage, also in cross-environment settings. These results demonstrate normalizing flows as a practical alternative to diffusion models for real-time, uncertainty-aware radar pose estimation. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于条件正态流（Normalizing Flow）的毫米波雷达点云人体姿态估计算法（MH-NFPG），能够平行化建模多模分布，同时兼顾不确定性校准和推理效率。实验在多个基准数据集上取得了优于或者媲美扩散模型（Diffusion Model）的效果，并大大提升了推理速度和校准能力。
AI.motivation: 毫米波雷达点云由于稀疏和噪声问题，导致人体姿态具有多解性，传统的确定性估计方法无法反映这种本质的不确定性。现有的扩散模型能捕捉多样性，但效率低且不确定性校准表现差，亟需一种高效、易于校准的方法应对实际需求。
AI.method: 提出了MH-NFPG，将时空Transformer骨干网络与条件正态流结合，将拉普拉斯分布映射为姿态的后验分布。该方法支持单次前向即可并行生成多个可能解，提高效率，并可准确建模不确定性分布。
AI.result: 在MM-Fi、mmRadPose和mRI三大雷达姿态数据集上，MH-NFPG在姿态估计精度上显著优于或等同于扩散模型，并实现了20倍以上的推理提速，同时校准误差降低高达85%。跨环境实验也显示本方法具备更优的不确定性覆盖能力。
AI.conclusion: MH-NFPG利用正态流提供了一种实际高效且具备良好校准能力的雷达姿态估计新选择，优于主流的扩散模型，更适用于实时和需要不确定性度量的雷达应用场景。

title: TeaMatch: Teachable Cross-Modal Representation Learning for 2D-3D Matching
summary: Learning reliable correspondences between images and point clouds is fundamental for 2D-3D matching. Despite recent progress in detection-free methods, existing approaches primarily optimize matching within a single model and often struggle to maintain reliable correspondences under challenging conditions such as noisy inputs, low overlap, and ambiguous structures. In this work, we propose TeaMatch, a novel framework that introduces teachability as a criterion for cross-modal representation learning. We define teachability as the ability of a representation to be effectively recovered by weak learners under degraded inputs, reflecting its structural consistency and robustness. To this end, we construct a set of task-specific weak students that simulate common failure modes and train them to imitate the teacher on a training split while evaluating their recoverability on a disjoint meta split. The teacher is then optimized to improve the students' ability to recover reliable correspondences, guided by correspondence-level and geometry-aware constraints. Our framework can be seamlessly integrated into existing coarse-to-fine matching pipelines without additional inference cost. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TeaMatch improves matching robustness and achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging 2D-3D matching benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TeaMatch框架，通过引入可教性(teachable)作为跨模态特征学习的标准来提升2D-3D匹配的可靠性和鲁棒性，尤其在噪声、高错位和结构模糊等场景下展现出优越的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有2D-3D匹配方法在遇到噪声、低重叠、结构模糊等复杂条件时，匹配的可靠性大打折扣，难以保持稳定的跨模态对应关系。本文旨在通过提升特征的结构一致性与鲁棒性，解决现有检测无关方法鲁棒性不足的问题。
AI.method: 提出TeaMatch框架，引入“可教性”概念，通过训练一组模拟常见失败场景的弱学生模型，模拟噪声和结构退化下的弱特征恢复能力。用教师模型引导学生模型，从而提升特征在各类失真下的恢复能力。整个训练流程基于分割训练和元学习思想，训练时通过教师优化学生的可恢复性能，并结合点对点和几何约束，无需在推理阶段增加推理成本。
AI.result: TeaMatch无缝集成到现有的粗到细2D-3D匹配框架中，无需增加测试时间开销。大量实验结果表明，TeaMatch在多个具有挑战性的2D-3D匹配基准数据集上显著提升了匹配鲁棒性，并创造了新的SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: TeaMatch基于可教性的新颖设计，提升了跨模态2D-3D匹配在噪声、低重叠和模糊等极端条件下的鲁棒性和精度，为相关领域的应用提供了更可靠的基础方法。

title: Illusion or Integrity? Geometrical Consistency Metric for AIGC Video Quality Evaluation
summary: Recently, AI-driven video generation has attracted considerable attention. This surge increases the demand for reliable video quality assessment (VQA) metrics to evaluate AI-generated content (AIGC) videos and guide model optimization. Existing studies assess video quality through visual harmony, video-text consistency, and domain-specific alignment, yet lack quantitative metrics for measuring fidelity to physical laws. To address this limitation, we present a novel benchmark that evaluates the quality of AIGC videos based on their compliance with physical principles by quantitatively measuring geometric consistency across frames extracted from generated sequences. This serves as a proxy for estimating the extent to which generated videos conform to real-world physical rules. Specifically, GeoCon-Bench captures global motion through translation estimation, fits homography or fundamental matrix models using background correspondences, and reports complementary metrics, including inlier ratio and geometric error. We also release a dataset containing 20 scenes across six motion categories. Experiments on state-of-the-art AIGC models demonstrate the reliability of GeoCon-Bench as a video quality assessment metric.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个用于衡量AI生成视频物理规律吻合度的新基准——GeoCon-Bench，通过评估生成视频的帧间几何一致性，为视频质量评估提供了新的定量测度。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI视频质量评估（VQA）方法主要关注视觉效果和文本一致性、领域一致性等，但缺乏能反映物理规律真实性的定量指标。物理规律性对于评估AI生成内容（AIGC）的真实性非常重要。
AI.method: 作者提出GeoCon-Bench基准。其方法是提取生成视频序列中的各帧特征，量化帧间几何一致性作为物理规律符合度的代理。具体实现包括：估计全局运动（如平移）、使用背景点对应关系拟合单应性矩阵或基础矩阵，并通过内点比率、几何误差等指标进行评价。
AI.result: 作者建立了涵盖6种运动类别、20个场景的新数据集。在主流AIGC模型上的实验表明，GeoCon-Bench评分能较为有效、可靠地反映生成视频遵循物理规律的程度。
AI.conclusion: GeoCon-Bench为AIGC视频质量评估提供了物理一致性新的定量标准，弥补了现有方法的不足。其开源的数据集和评价方法有助于推动AI视频生成技术与质量评测的进步。

title: ResemBrick: Brick Reconstruction from Photographs with Perceptual Fidelity and Buildability
summary: Producing a hand-buildable, colored brick model of a 3D object from a few casual photographs is a clean testbed for a broader challenge: generating 3D content that meets hard physical-assembly constraints under a discrete, budget-limited voxel grid. On a coarse lattice, visual resemblance and structural stability pull against each other, yet prior brick pipelines address only one side and treat voxelization as fixed preprocessing rather than a variable to optimize. We present ResemBrick, which couples the two. Budgeted occupancy completion reframes discretization as allocation: given a target occupied-voxel count, a single resolution-conditioned network decides in one feed-forward pass which surface voxels to fill for best appearance, one weight set spanning 13 resolutions. Buildability by construction then combines support- and look-ahead-aware greedy placement with a deterministic, provably terminating repair that grounds every floating component. Under a matched budget, ResemBrick surpasses existing voxel selectors in perceptual fidelity while uniquely reaching zero floating and zero unstable bricks on unfiltered held-out objects; as a complete pipeline, it attains the best perceptual fidelity among prior brick-construction systems. Our results point to treating discretization and assembly as tightly coupled stages rather than independent ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ResemBrick系统，可以根据少量非正式照片生成结构稳定且外观相似的积木（如乐高）3D模型，并同时优化离散化与搭建约束，达到当前最佳感知保真度与可搭建性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于积木的3D建模方案难以兼顾外观（和原物体的视觉相似性）和结构稳定性，且通常将体素化视为预处理固定过程，缺乏优化和联动。本文旨在解决“在有限体素预算下，如何联合提升结构搭建性和视觉保真”的难题。
AI.method: 提出了ResemBrick方法，将体素化视为“体素分配”问题。核心是构建分辨率条件化网络，一次前馈决定在预算内优选哪些表面体素还原外观（13种分辨率通用），接着用兼顾支撑与前瞻的贪婪拼装策略，并在拼装后用确定性修复算法解决悬空和不稳定积木。
AI.result: 在相同体素预算下，ResemBrick比已有选择器在视觉保真度方面表现更好，同时唯一实现了零悬空、零不稳定结构，并在未见过的新对象上也能达成。作为整体流程，ResemBrick在同行方案中达到最佳视觉保真。
AI.conclusion: 体素分配（离散化）与实体组装应被视为紧密耦合的一体化流程而非独立环节；ResemBrick证明了这种“耦合优化”带来明显优势。

title: Structure-Enhanced Features and Quality-Aware Dynamic Anchor Scoring for Robust Lane Detection
summary: Lane detection requires recovering thin, elongated, and frequently occluded lane structures under challenging driving conditions. While anchor-based detectors provide efficient candidate generation, their performance is limited by two coupled issues: backbone features often lose structural continuity along partially visible lanes, and classification confidence may decouple from line-level localization quality, allowing inaccurate anchors to persist before non-maximum suppression (NMS). We propose a structure-enhanced and quality-aware framework that improves lane representation and dynamic-anchor scoring while preserving the inference pipeline of the Anchor Decomposition Network (ADNet). Specifically, a Gated Horizontal-Vertical Token (GHVT) module enhances mid- and high-level backbone features via lightweight directional token interactions with a learnable residual gate. In parallel, Line-Quality-Aware Dynamic Anchor Scoring (LQAS) calibrates existing classification logits using quality supervision, hard-negative suppression, and pairwise ranking without adding inference branches. On the VIL-100 dataset, our method improves ADNet-R34 from 89.97 to 91.28 in F1 score at the 0.5 intersection-over-union threshold (F1@50), reducing both false positives and false negatives. Additional experiments on CULane and TuSimple datasets, extensive ablations, score-distribution diagnostics, and runtime analysis confirm complementary structural and ranking improvements with minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结构增强和质量感知的车道检测框架，有效提升了ADNet在多个数据集上的检测精度，且计算开销极小。
AI.motivation: 现有anchor-based检测器在处理部分可见或被遮挡的车道时，骨干网络的特征连续性受损，分类分数与定位质量脱钩，误检较多。改进这两个问题可显著提升车道检测性能。
AI.method:
1. 提出Gated Horizontal-Vertical Token (GHVT)模块，以轻量级方向性token交互和可学习残差门控，增强骨干特征的结构感知能力。
2. 提出Line-Quality-Aware Dynamic Anchor Scoring (LQAS)，通过质量监督、困难负样本抑制和成对排序校准分类分数，无需增加推理分支。整个方法嵌入ADNet推理流程，确保高效。
AI.result: 在VIL-100数据集上，F1@50由89.97提升至91.28，有效降低了误报和漏检；在CULane和TuSimple等数据集上亦取得了性能提升，消融和分数分布分析证明方法有效，且额外计算负担极小。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知与分数校准机制对anchor-based车道检测器显著有益，可在保持高效推理的同时实现更高精度与更低误检。

title: Marrying Optimal Transport and ODEs for Unified Continuous-Time 4D Reconstruction and Tracking
summary: Existing unified 4D reconstruction and point tracking approaches typically rely on heuristic interpolations or just predict at integer timestamps, lacking kinematic coherence and failing to model dynamics at any arbitrary timestamp. In this paper, we propose Uni4R, a framework that unifies these tasks by learning continuous velocity fields through the synergy of Optimal Transport (OT) and Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE). Importantly, this continuous velocity field acts as a kinematic prior that mutually benefits both 4D reconstruction and point tracking. Specifically, we propose the Flow Matching Guided Decoder (FMGD). A global velocity branch first extracts anchor features that capture the global dynamic state of the sequence. Then, FMGD leverages Flow Matching (FM) theory to formulate a probability path defined by OT on the anchor feature manifold, instantiating it as FM-guided velocity features for velocity prediction. This establishes a robust kinematic inductive bias. Meanwhile, a point reconstruction branch provides geometric features. The local velocity prediction module then joint above features and time embeddings, to decode velocities at arbitrary timestamps. To overcome the absence of high-quality ground-truth velocities in fractional frames, we propose an integral-consistency training strategy. This strategy uses an ODE solver to integrate velocities to recover target pointmaps, enabling the model to be supervised end-to-end directly from integer timestamps. Experimental results demonstrate that Uni4R achieves SOTA performance in both 4D reconstruction and point tracking, and achieves SOTA in our new kinematics-aware benchmark at continuous time.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种新的4D重建和点追踪统一框架Uni4R，通过学习连续速度场，在任意时刻实现动力学一致的重建和追踪，取得了最新最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法大多只在整数时间点预测或依赖启发式插值，无法实现动力学一致且任意时刻的预测，限制了4D重建和点追踪的准确性和通用性。
AI.method: 作者提出Uni4R框架，利用最优传输（OT）与常微分方程（ODE）联合学习连续速度场，作为动力学先验。主要包括：全球速度分支提取动态锚点特征，基于流匹配理论生成概率路径，实现速度预测；点重建分支获取几何特征，局部速度模块融合上述特征与时间编码，实现任意时刻速度解码。为克服分数帧速度无高质量标注，提出积分一致性训练，用ODE积分速度恢复目标点云，实现端到端监督。
AI.result: 实验显示，Uni4R在4D重建与点追踪均达到了SOTA表现，在新提出的连续时间运动学基准上也达到了最优，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Uni4R方法实现了动力学一致、任意时刻的4D重建和点追踪，提供了统一视角，推进了该领域的研究与应用。

title: LoRA-based Adaptation Alone Is Not Enough: Understanding the Limits of Foundation Models for Face Presentation Attack Detection
comment: accepted at ECCV 2026 Workshop on Foundation and Generative Models in Biometrics
summary: Face presentation attack detection (PAD) aims to reliably detect a wide range of presentation attacks. While PAD methods achieve strong performance within individual datasets, their performance degrades under cross-dataset evaluation. Variations in sensors or lighting conditions can reduce the effectiveness of detectors from near-perfect to nearly random. Foundation models (FMs) have emerged as a promising alternative because typical PAD datasets, such as the MCIO benchmarks (MSU-MFSD, CASIA-FASD, Replay-Attack, and OULU-NPU), are small relative to the scale used for web-based pretraining. However, existing PAD systems primarily focus on CLIP-based foundation models, while overlooking other FMs with different architectures and training procedures. This study addresses this question by systematically evaluating 32 FMs. Zero-shot prompting achieves performance near chance across model families and scales. The vision encoders, when low-rankadapted (LoRA) with fewer than 1% trainable weights, achieve below 2% intra-dataset ACER in most cases, while cross-dataset ACER is substantially higher. LoRA primarily refines the decision boundary within a dataset, suggesting that pretrained representations and the adaptation dataset play a larger role in cross-dataset generalization than the evaluated lightweight adaptation strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了32种基础模型在面部攻击检测任务中的泛化能力，发现当前轻量适配方法（LoRA）在跨数据集下表现有限。
AI.motivation: 现有面部攻击检测方法在单一数据集内表现优秀，但在跨数据集测试中性能严重下降。使用基础大模型（FMs）尤其是CLIP外的其它架构能否解决泛化问题仍未被充分研究。
AI.method: 作者系统测试了32个不同架构/预训练流程的基础模型，并通过零样本推理和LoRA低秩适配（训练参数小于1%）测试其在主流小型PAD数据集上的表现，分别评估其在单数据集（intra-dataset）及跨数据集（cross-dataset）下的性能。
AI.result: 零样本推理各模型仅接近猜测水平。经LoRA适配后，模型在单数据集下ACER小于2%，表现优异；但在跨数据集时ACER显著升高，泛化能力不足。
AI.conclusion: LoRA主要提升模型在适配数据集内的判别边界，对跨数据集泛化作用有限。预训练表示和适配集选择对于提升泛化能力比轻量适配重要。

title: NeuroRefiner: Morphology-Aware Multi-Agent Refinement for 3D Fluorescence Microscopy Neuron Segmentation
summary: Accurate 3D neuron segmentation in fluorescence microscopy is critical for neuroscience. However, the sparse and elongated morphology of neurons poses significant challenges to existing segmentation methods. These methods struggle to preserve both local details and global topology, leading to fragmented results. To address this, we propose NeuroRefiner, a multi-agent system that formalizes the human expert workflow involving iterative global observation and local editing. Specifically, NeuroRefiner comprises three collaborative agents dedicated to diagnosing topological errors, generating correction instructions, and validating refinement quality. To facilitate agent instruction-guided segmentation refinement, we propose TopoRefineNet, a dedicated 3D U-Net-based tool that leverages cross-modality feature fusion to generate refined masks. Through multi-round agent reasoning and voxel-level editing, NeuroRefiner produces topologically more accurate segmentations with enhanced interpretability. Experiments on the BigNeuron, CWMBS, and ZBFWB datasets demonstrate that NeuroRefiner outperforms state-of-the-art methods, notably achieving a 3.02% improvement in F1 score on the challenging ZBFWB dataset.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为NeuroRefiner的多智能体系统，通过模拟人类专家在神经元精确分割中的工作流程（全局观察结合局部修正），显著提升3D神经元分割的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有3D荧光显微镜神经元分割技术面临神经元形态稀疏细长、结构易碎片化的问题，难以兼顾局部细节和整体拓扑完整性。研究者有必要提出新方法提升分割的连贯性与解释性。
AI.method: NeuroRefiner由三个协作智能体组成，分别负责诊断拓扑错误、生成修正指令和验证修正质量。系统集成TopoRefineNet（基于3D U-Net，融合多模态特征）实现指令驱动的分割改进，并通过多轮推理与体素级编辑不断细化分割结果。
AI.result: 在BigNeuron、CWMBS及ZBFWB数据集上，NeuroRefiner分割质量优于现有主流方法，在具有挑战性的ZBFWB数据集上F1得分提升3.02%。
AI.conclusion: 通过模拟人类分割工作流程及多智能体协作，NeuroRefiner可生成拓扑更完整、可解释性更高的神经元分割结果，推动神经科学数据分析工具发展。

title: DUET: A Diversity-Quality Duet of Distillation Experts for Two-Step Video Generation
summary: Diffusion models have enabled high-quality video generation in recent years, but the high cost of iterative sampling hinders their practical deployment. Few-step distillation alleviates this cost, yet exposes a quality--diversity trade-off between its two dominant paradigms: trajectory-level distillation (e.g., sCM) favors diversity, whereas distribution-level distillation (e.g., DMD) favors quality. Targeting extreme two-step video generation, we introduce DUET, which reconciles the two paradigms through a noise-level duet of experts: an sCM expert takes the high-noise step to lay out diverse structure, and a DMD expert takes the low-noise step to refine appearance detail. Since the two experts are trained independently with their native objectives, DUET sidesteps the optimization difficulties of loss-level combinations and delivers quality and diversity jointly rather than trading one for the other. We further identify the relay interface and the high-noise stage as the remaining bottlenecks, and address them with RL-guided expert adaptation, yielding DUET+. With the Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone, DUET lifts the two-step quality of sCM close to the level of DMD while retaining nearly all of its structural diversity---about twice that of DMD---and DUET+ further improves overall quality while preserving this diversity advantage. Together, these results establish noise-level expert specialization as a simple, effective paradigm for reconciling diversity and quality in two-step video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DUET的新方法，通过在生成视频时分阶段引入两类专家（sCM和DMD），在两步采样内兼顾高多样性与高质量，有效突破了传统扩散模型在生成质量和多样性之间的权衡瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 传统视频扩散生成模型虽然效果好，但采样开销大，几步蒸馏法虽然降低了成本，但存在质量与多样性的明显权衡：trajectory-level（如sCM）偏多样性，distribution-level（如DMD）偏高质量。因此需有新方法兼顾两者。
AI.method: 提出DUET方法，将sCM专家用于高噪声阶段负责结构多样性引导，DMD专家用于低噪声阶段细化画面细节，两者各自独立训练，避免了混合损失带来的优化困难，并探索引入RL引导专家自适应形成DUET+版本。
AI.result: 在主流Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B模型上，DUET能使两步采样下的生成质量接近DMD水平，同时几乎保持sCM的结构多样性（约为DMD的两倍），DUET+则在保证多样性的前提下进一步提升了整体质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过噪声分级专家分工，这一简单而高效的范式实现在快速视频生成任务中兼得高质量与高多样性，对扩散视频生成领域具有重要参考价值。

title: EgoHieraLoc: A Cortically Inspired Hierarchical Segmentation-Guided Framework for Egocentric Visual Query Localization
summary: Visual query localization (VQL) aims to retrieve and re-localize a queried object in egocentric videos, yet remains challenging when object boundaries are ambiguous and global context cannot effectively guide fine-grained localization. Human vision handles such ambiguity through a hierarchical process: it rapidly screens foreground candidates, selectively attends to the target despite distractors, refines perception via feedback between global context and local detail, and, when a single view is unreliable, integrates evidence across viewpoints according to its credibility. Inspired by these competencies, we propose \textbf{EgoHieraLoc}, a unified framework for VQL-2D and VQL-3D. A Discriminative Parsing Module first extracts foreground-aware query representations using segmentation priors; a Query-Aware Module then performs robust target localization through discriminative correlation filtering with deformable modeling; and a Regional Adaptation Module feeds multi-scale context back into local regions to recover precise object boundaries. To extend this perceptual hierarchy to 3D localization, we introduce Geometric-Semantic Joint Confidence (GSJC), which multiplicatively couples segmentation confidence with local depth consistency, multi-view back-projection consistency, and triangulation-baseline quality, so that a viewpoint contributes to the 3D estimate only when it is credible both semantically and geometrically. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on both VQL-2D and -3D benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出EgoHieraLoc框架，结合分层视觉机制与模块创新，显著提升了自中心视频中查询物体的2D与3D定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉查询定位（VQL）在自中心视频场景下，常因物体边界模糊及全局-局部上下文脱节，导致难以精准定位。人类视觉可借助分层处理与反馈策略克服歧义，激发了该工作的研究动机。
AI.method: 作者提出EgoHieraLoc统一框架，包含三大模块：1）判别解析模块借助分割先验提取前景感知的查询特征；2）查询感知模块结合可变形判别相关滤波器以提升目标辨识及定位；3）区域自适应模块将多尺度上下文反馈于局部区域以精确恢复物体边界。此外，针对3D，提出GSJC置信机制，将分割置信度与深度一致性、多视角回投一致性及三角测量基线质量相乘，仅可信视角参与3D融合。
AI.result: 在VQL-2D和VQL-3D主流基准上的大量实验表明，EgoHieraLoc方案在准确率等核心指标优于现有方法，达到了最新水平。
AI.conclusion: EgoHieraLoc充分借鉴人类分层视觉能力，结合创新模型设计，显著提升了自中心视频物体的2D和3D定位能力，为模糊和复杂场景下的精准视觉理解提供了有效方案。

title: CIFA: Contextual-Intersectional Fairness Auditing for Hidden Subgroup Discovery in Face Analysis
summary: Fairness evaluation in computer vision commonly relies on aggregate accuracy and demographic subgroup analysis. However, visual models are also sensitive to contextual factors such as illumination, blur, image quality, facial accessories, and appearance attributes. These factors may interact with demographic characteristics, producing hidden subgroups in which performance degrades substantially despite strong aggregate accuracy and apparently acceptable demographic fairness. To address this, we propose the Contextual-Intersectional Fairness Auditing Framework (CIFA), a structured framework for identifying subgroup vulnerabilities arising from interactions between demographic and contextual attributes. CIFA performs demographic, contextual, and contextual-intersectional auditing, followed by worst-group discovery to identify and rank the most vulnerable attribute combinations. We evaluate CIFA on gender classification using ResNet-50 \cite{he2016deep} and ViT-B/16 \cite{dosovitskiy2020image} across FairFace \cite{Karkkainen2021}, CelebA \cite{Liu2015}, and UTKFace \cite{Zhang2017}. Our results show that aggregate accuracy and demographic-only evaluation can mask substantial contextual-intersectional disparities. We further assess several established mitigation strategies through an audit--mitigate--reaudit protocol and find that, although some worst-group disparities are reduced, no single strategy consistently eliminates them across datasets and architectures. These findings establish contextual-intersectional auditing as an important component of fairness evaluation and provide a reproducible framework for discovering, prioritizing, and reassessing hidden subgroup risks in face analysis systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为CIFA的框架，以系统性地发掘视觉模型在不同人口统计和上下文因素交互下的隐性公平性问题。实验证明，仅凭总体准确率和传统的群体分析会忽略很多细分群体的不公平现象。
AI.motivation: 传统的计算机视觉公平性评估主要关注总体准确率和基于人口统计学（如性别、种族）的群体分析。然而，现实中图像的上下文因素（如光照、模糊、配饰等）同人口属性发生交互时，可能会导致某些隐性子群体的模型性能大幅下降，而这些在传统分析下容易被忽视。
AI.method: 作者提出了Contextual-Intersectional Fairness Auditing Framework（CIFA）。该框架包括：人口统计分析、上下文分析、上下文-人口交互分析，并可发现和排序最脆弱的子群体组合。在实际中，使用ResNet-50和ViT-B/16在多个人脸数据集上对性别分类任务进行了实验验证。
AI.result: 实验发现，仅用总体准确率和人口统计属性不能有效揭示上下文-人口交互下的显著不公平现象。评估了多种公平性缓解策略，发现没有任何单一方法能稳定解决所有数据集和架构下的最不公平群体问题。
AI.conclusion: 上下文-人口交互公平性审计对公平性评估至关重要。CIFA框架为发现、优先排序、重新评估面部分析系统中的隐性子群体风险提供了系统和可复现的方法。

title: MPISuperRes-PnP: A Super-Resolution Zero-Shot Plug-and-Play Reconstruction Algorithm for Magnetic Particle Imaging
summary: Magnetic Particle Imaging (MPI) is an emerging medical imaging modality. MPI is based on the non-linear response of magnetic nanoparticles to an applied magnetic field and avoids ionizing radiation. The measured signal is the voltage induced in receive coils by the particles' response. Reconstructing the particle concentration from the signal constitutes the imaging task. Even using state-of-the-art measurement-based reconstruction, the associated spatial grid is very coarse, hence super-resolution (SR) techniques are important. In this work, we propose an approach for SR in MPI inspired by energy minimization. Different methods have been proposed for SR in MPI, ranging from upscaling of the associated system matrix to interpolation of the reconstruction. Here we incorporate SR into the reconstruction task via an energy minimization formulation. Following the plug-and-play approach to energy minimization we derive a splitting scheme and a SR method for MPI where the arising Gaussian denoising task is treated with a pre-trained learned Gaussian denoiser in a zero-shot fashion. This way, we incorporate benefits of deep learning without training and avoid the need of training data. Further, we provide a quantitative and qualitative evaluation of the proposed method. Hyper-parameter are selected via an extended parameter search. The found parameters are applied for reconstruction on real data. We show the applicability of our method on synthetic and on real data (MPIData: EquilibriumModelWithAnisotropy and 2D-OpenMPI Data). The proposed method employs a deep-learning denoiser without training -- thus it does not require presently scarcely available MPI training data. The denoiser behaves conservatively, i.e., no hallucination artifacts were observed. The SR approach is generic such that it can be applied in future MPI contexts involving different regularizers or different imaging tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对磁性粒子成像（MPI）超分辨率问题，提出了一种无需训练数据的深度学习去噪器能量极小化SR方法，能够提升MPI重建分辨率并避免伪影。
AI.motivation: 现有MPI重建空间分辨率较低，超分辨率是提升成像质量的关键，但传统或深度学习方法需训练数据，然而MPI训练数据稀缺，因此需要一种无需训练数据且有效的超分辨率方案。
AI.method: 本文借助能量极小化思想，将超分辨率整合至成像重建过程，并采用Plug-and-Play分裂方法，引入预训练的、高斯去噪深度网络以零次训练（zero-shot）方式实现超分辨率，不依赖任何特定于MPI的训练数据。
AI.result: 通过定量与定性实验，作者在合成和实际MPI数据集（如EquilibriumModelWithAnisotropy及2D-OpenMPI）上验证了方法有效性，表明无需训练亦可实现高质量重建且无伪影产生。
AI.conclusion: 本方法无需MPI训练数据即可应用于MPI超分辨率重建，并具备方法泛化能力。深度去噪器在实际中表现稳健，为未来不同正则化及成像任务提供可移植、高性能工具。

title: Thinking With Tools, Not With Pixels: Tool Calls as Text Scaffolds for Visual Reasoning
summary: Tool-augmented vision-language models increasingly "think with images": they call crop, zoom, or code tools and reason over the returned pixels. However, recent work using blind tests, gain decompositions, and attention analyses has shown that returned images contribute little, raising the question: if pixels do not carry the gain, what does? We hypothesize that the load-bearing signal is the structured text emitted before any returned pixel arrives: tool name, coordinates, target description, and intent. This textual scaffold encodes where to look and what to find. We introduce TextCall (call-but-no-return) to test this: it keeps the scaffold but replaces returned images with the text placeholder [Image output skipped]. Three studies support the hypothesis. (i) Non-necessity of returned pixels: across LoRA, full fine-tuning, and RL, TextCall matches or exceeds full thinking-with-images; under RL it preserves tool use at the reported checkpoint, avoiding the failure mode where, under matched settings, seeing the returned image causes the model to stop calling tools and answer directly. (ii) Sufficiency of the scaffold: on matched training queries, scaffold-only input yields equivalent accuracy to returned-image input. (iii) Component specificity: decomposing the scaffold into reasoning text and spatial code shows both components contribute, with the dominant one varying by task. Together these results support the Tool-Call Scaffold Hypothesis: in current thinking-with-images distributions, the active signal is the structured text emitted at tool-call time; the returned image is a redundant carrier. TextCall preserves accuracy while reducing latency by 29-46% and eliminating tool-execution API calls. Our claims hold for current thinking-with-images benchmarks; constructing tasks where pixels are genuinely load-bearing remains an open direction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出，当前视觉-语言模型在调用工具时，真正承载推理的信号不是返回的图像像素，而是工具调用时生成的结构化文本（如工具名、坐标、目标描述和意图）。
AI.motivation: 虽然工具增强的视觉-语言模型能够调用各种视觉工具辅助推理，但近期研究显示返回的图片像素对于决策贡献甚微，因此作者希望弄清楚模型推理的真正关键是什么。
AI.method: 作者提出“TextCall”方法，在保留工具调用时的结构化文本描述的同时，用‘[Image output skipped]’文本替代实际返回图片。通过三项实验分析结构化文本的作用及其与返回图片的对比。
AI.result: 结果表明，仅用结构化文本（而非真实图片像素）可以获得与原方法相当甚至更优的准确性，同时大幅减少推理延迟与API调用。此外，细分结构化文本不同组件对性能的贡献发现，不同任务依赖不同类型的结构化信息。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实了“Tool-Call Scaffold Hypothesis”：在现有Think-with-images场景中，结构化文本才是真正承载推理的信号，返回的图像只是冗余载体。这可以提升效率，但需要新任务验证在像素信息不可替代时模型的表现。

title: Diffuse the object, keep its label: curating detector training data from a few unlabeled photographs via VLM-built 3D vegetation scenes
comment: Accepted at the Curated Data for Efficient Learning (CDEL) Workshop @ ECCV 2026
summary: Labeled images of small objects hidden in vegetation are scarce, and detectors trained on them generalize poorly across sites. Rather than reusing labels collected at another site, we synthesize labeled training images from a handful of unlabeled photographs of the deployment site itself. A vision--language model generates a coarse 3D vegetation scene from one photograph; placing 3D object meshes in the scene yields bounding boxes, segmentation masks, and per-instance occlusion directly from the scene geometry, without manual annotation. A lightweight adapter fine-tuned on the photographs conditions a diffusion pass that re-textures the renders, and a graded mask-lock sets how much diffusion may touch the object itself. In our runs this grade was the most influential curation choice: lightly diffusing the object improves minority-class recall over fully protecting its pixels, while unrestricted diffusion dissolves it. Trained on these images, a standard detector matched or exceeded its counterpart trained on a larger labeled dataset of real images from a different site, consistently across seeds on a humanitarian-demining benchmark; the comparison is thus unsupervised site adaptation from a handful of photographs against conventional cross-site label reuse. In our ablations the gains were largely insensitive to the photograph and crop budgets, and in-domain accuracy did not predict cross-site performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用目标部署现场的少量无标签照片，通过合成带标签训练图像来替代传统跨站点标签复用，从而有效提升了小物体（如植被中隐藏物体）的检测效果。
AI.motivation: 在植被中隐藏的小物体标签数据稀缺，且现有检测器跨场景泛化能力差。人工为新环境标注样本成本高且不现实，因此需要一种无需人工标注就能提升跨站点检测性能的新方法。
AI.method: (1) 利用现有的视觉-语言大模型，从现场一张无标签照片生成粗糙3D植被场景；(2) 将3D物体模型放入场景，实现自动生成bbox、分割掩膜和遮挡信息；(3) 用轻量化适配器微调照片特征，并用受控扩散模型对渲染结果重绘纹理，通过分级mask锁定控制目标绘制强度；(4) 以合成图片训练常规检测器。
AI.result: 实验中，基于上述方法生成的合成数据训练的标准检测器，在人道排雷基准测试上，表现与用更大规模、人工标注的跨场站真实图片训练的模型持平或更优，并且表现出良好的种子一致性。消融实验发现，合成图片流程对照片数量不敏感，域内精度无法预测跨域性能。
AI.conclusion: 从少量无标签照片合成、自动标注的训练图片，可实现无需人工标注、优于传统跨站标签复用的小目标跨场景检测，为低资源场景自动适应检测提供了有效途径。

title: LookAgain: Closed-Loop GUI Grounding with Visually Grounded Reflection
summary: Recent graphical user interface (GUI) grounders have significantly advanced single-shot accuracy on standard benchmarks, yet their performance degrades sharply on small targets, densely packed controls and out-of-distribution interfaces. We attribute this gap to a paradigmatic limitation shared by existing approaches: none of them treats a produced coordinate as a hypothesis to be reflected upon and revised under new visual evidence. This manifests as three coupled issues: 1) Lack of post-hoc reflection. The prediction is frozen at the moment of emission, leaving no internal mechanism to challenge or refine it. 2) Visual evidence decoupled from the prediction. The auxiliary visual evidence is gathered to support the upcoming coordinate rather than to scrutinise the one already committed to. 3) Refinement over views, not over predictions. The iterative zoom-in refines the inspected region instead of inheriting a previous coordinate as a spatial prior to be corrected. In this paper, we propose LookAgain, a closed-loop GUI grounder driven by post-prediction visual reflection. LookAgain reformulates grounding as a multi-turn predict-look-again-refine process with two primitives: "locate" posts a coordinate hypothesis, renders a marker on the image and appends a local patch of the predicted region. It anchors the next reasoning step to the previous prediction as a spatial prior; "confirm" accepts or reject the hypothesis and terminates the procedure. We train the LookAgain grounder with SFT on constructed reflective trajectories as a cold start, followed by GRPO with terminal grounding correctness as the sole reward. Extensive experiments show that LookAgain consistently improves performance on both refusal-aware and general GUI grounding benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art results. Comprehensive ablations further verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为LookAgain的GUI定位方法，引入后验反思机制，多次修正预测，大幅提升了细粒度和难例下的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI定位方法在小目标、高密集控件和分布外界面上的性能显著下降，原因在于缺乏预测结果的后验反思和修正机制，导致模型无法有效纠正错误预测。
AI.method: 提出LookAgain框架，一种闭环GUI定位模型。其核心流程为多轮“预测-查看-再修正”，每步先生成坐标假设并在界面中标记，再根据新的可视证据修正假设。训练过程包括SFT和基于终止正确性的GRPO强化学习。
AI.result: 在多项GUI定位基准与拒识场景上取得了SOTA表现，通过消融实验证明所提反思机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LookAgain打破了传统单步预测的局限，通过后验反思闭环大幅提升了GUI定位的准确性和泛化能力，为该领域方法设计提供了新范式。

title: World Tokens: Enhancing Embodied Policies with Training-Time World Modeling
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are a widely adopted paradigm for embodied policies. They excel at efficient closed-loop control but do not explicitly model how physical scenes evolve as a task unfolds. Recently emerging world-action models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video world models to capture spatiotemporal evolution, yet retaining future generation or a large video backbone in the control loop substantially increases inference cost. We introduce World Tokens, an embodied policy architecture built around a World Adapter that bridges visual-language understanding, world-dynamics modeling, and action generation. It uses world modeling during training to enhance the action policy while preserving efficient deployment. Specifically, the World Adapter transforms VLM features into a fixed set of world tokens, which condition a jointly fine-tuned future-video denoiser and simultaneously serve as the action expert's sole visual-language context. This shared conditioning allows gradients from future-video denoising to directly shape the representation used for action prediction, while exclusive routing prevents the policy from bypassing that representation. At deployment, the world-model branch is removed, leaving only the VLM, World Adapter, and action expert, with no online video-model inference. With a 2B backbone and no embodied action pretraining, World Tokens is highly competitive on LIBERO, attains the best reported averages on SIMPLER, substantially improves real-world R1 Pro success over a matched action-only baseline, and generates each action chunk at VLA-level latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出World Tokens方法，通过引入World Adapter实现视觉-语言-世界建模-动作生成一体化，训练时利用世界建模强化动作策略，部署时保持高效。方法无需在线视频建模推理，性能和效率兼具。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型未显式建模物理场景随任务展开的变化，限制了模型对时空演化的理解；而直接引入视频世界建模虽提升效果，但推理成本高。需兼顾高效部署和世界理解两者。
AI.method: 提出World Tokens结构，引入World Adapter模块，将视觉-语言模型(VLM)特征转化为一组固定的world tokens。这些tokens在训练时联合条件化未来视频去噪器和动作专家，将世界动态建模信息融入动作决策表示。部署时去掉世界建模分支，只保留VLM、World Adapter与动作专家，从而规避高昂的视频建模推理。
AI.result: World Tokens方法在未进行具身动作预训练的前提下，使用2B规模backbone，在LIBERO任务上表现竞争力，在SIMPLER基准上获得当前最好平均性能，并在真实机器人平台上显著超过动作-only基线，动作生成效率与VLA方法持平。
AI.conclusion: World Tokens解决了效率与世界动态建模的平衡难题。通过创新结构在训练阶段注入世界建模能力，部署时依旧保持极高推理效率，验证了其实用性与前景。

title: HandSplatter: Automated Digital Goniometry from Neural Rendering
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 48th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC 2026), Full Paper #1985
summary: Hand and finger disorders are leading contributors to musculoskeletal disability, creating a clinical need for precise methods to quantify joint motion. Range of motion (ROM) serves as the metric for diagnosis, rehabilitation monitoring, and evaluating surgical outcomes. Currently, the goniometer is the standard tool for assessing finger flexion and extension. However, manual goniometry is labor-intensive and suffers from inconsistent inter-rater reliability due to variations in examiner technique. While digital alternatives exist, current software-based approaches often lack the necessary accuracy for clinical usage. To address these limitations, we present a novel pipeline for 3-D hand joint location and pose estimation using neural rendering. Unlike previous methods, our approach combines 2-D feature extraction with view synthesis to significantly improve accuracy and clinical viability. Furthermore, we introduce a discrete density hill climbing algorithm that facilitates the meaningful correction of projected landmarks in 3-D space. This system overcomes the inefficiencies of manual measurement and the inaccuracies of existing software, providing a robust tool for objective functional assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合神经渲染的全新3D手部关节定位与姿态估计算法，能更精确地量化手指活动范围，克服传统和现有数字测量的不足。
AI.motivation: 当前手和手指活动障碍评估依赖传统量角器，手动操作耗时且因操作者不同导致一致性差，现有数字方法精度不足，难以满足临床需求。
AI.method: 提出融合2D特征提取和视图合成的神经渲染管线，并创新性引入离散密度爬山算法来矫正3D空间中的标志物投影，提高手部姿态和关节定位的准确性。
AI.result: 新方法实现了高准确度的3D手部关节定位和姿态估计，相较于手动量角和以往软件，显著提高了临床可用性和客观性。
AI.conclusion: 该系统有效克服了传统手动及现有数字评估的弊端，为手指功能评估和康复监测提供了更为精确、可靠的工具，具备广泛临床应用前景。

title: Disentangling Co-Occurring Retinal Pathologies with Saliency-Guided Sparse Expert Routing
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing
summary: Retinal fundus images frequently exhibit multiple co-occurring pathologies, yet standard deep learning classifiers apply static, identical computation to every image regardless of the underlying disease distribution. We propose a novel architecture that resolves this via sparse conditional computation, pairing a Guided Context Gating (GCG) spatial attention front-end with a sparsely-routed Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) block operating over feature tokens. Crucially, this routing yields an interpretable, data-driven decomposition. Expert allocation is significantly disease-dependent (p < 0.001), with the healthy Normal state and morphologically distinct pathologies (e.g., ERM, AMD) isolating to dedicated experts. On a five-class, patient-disjoint 5-fold cross-validation benchmark, our model achieves 0.912 +/- 0.008 macro AUC and 0.653 +/- 0.014 macro F1. Furthermore, Grad-CAM++ and post-MoE t-SNE visualizations confirm that expert routing aligns with localized lesions and geometrically maps co-occurring cases between their constituent clusters, positioning sparse MoE as an interpretable approach to multi-disease retinal screening.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合稀疏条件计算的深度学习架构，用于视网膜多疾病筛查，通过可解释分解实现更好的诊断性能和解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统的深度学习分类器对所有视网膜眼底图像统一计算，无法针对不同疾病分布自适应处理，且对多疾病共存情况的可解释性差。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的网络架构，前端采用Guided Context Gating(GCG)空间注意力模块，后端引入以特征token为基础的稀疏Mixture-of-Experts(MoE)模块。MoE实现了基于疾病特点的专家路由分配。
AI.result: 在五类别、病人不重叠、5折交叉验证基准上，模型取得宏AUC 0.912±0.008，宏F1 0.653±0.014。专家分配与疾病高度相关，且可通过可视化技术验证分配合理性。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏MoE方法在多病共存视网膜筛查中不仅有优越性能，还具备较强可解释性，为多疾病自动诊断提供了有效途径。

title: C$^2$A: Coupling Spatial Evidence with Clinical Priors via Co-occurrence Aware Class Attention for Multi-Label Chest X-Ray Classification
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing
summary: Thoracic pathologies rarely occur in isolation, yet standard multi-label classifiers rely on shared global descriptors, discarding \emph{where} findings lie and \emph{how} they co-occur. We propose \textbf{C$\mathbf{^2}$A} (Co-occurrence Aware Class Attention), a classification head that explicitly couples spatial evidence with clinical priors. First, C$^2$A casts pooling as an expectation over learned per-class spatial attention maps, yielding localized descriptors for each disease. Second, it couples these descriptors via a learnable graph warm-started from empirical label co-occurrence. A single residual message-passing step shares evidence among related findings, proving to be a bounded perturbation of the identity where co-occurrence enters each logit through an explicit bilinear interaction. On CheXpert, C$^2$A achieves a superior $0.895$ macro-mean AUROC, outperforming advanced context-gating baselines. Crucially, gains concentrate on highly co-occurrent classes with ambiguous spatial evidence (rescuing Atelectasis by $+1.5$ over GCG), demonstrating the prior's regularizing effect with a negligible overhead of one linear projection and a $C\!\times\!C$ edge matrix.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为C^2A（Co-occurrence Aware Class Attention）的新型多标签胸部病变分类方法，将空间证据与临床共现先验结合，实现更准确的多病变识别。
AI.motivation: 胸部疾病在影像里常常不是单独出现，但目前主流多标签分类器只用全局特征，忽略了病变的具体位置和它们之间的共现规律。这导致分类性能受限，尤其在疾病共现且定位模糊时表现不佳。
AI.method: C^2A方法包含两个核心创新：1）利用每个类别独立学习的空间注意力图，通过期望池化得到每类病变的局部化描述；2）再用一个可学习的图，借助历史标签共现初始化，实现残差消息传递，通过双线性交互将共现信息注入每个类别输出中。整个过程只需一次消息传递，计算开销极低。
AI.result: 在CheXpert数据集上，C^2A取得了0.895的宏平均AUROC，优于最新的上下文门控（context-gating）方法。提升主要体现在高度共现且定位模糊的类别，比如Atelectasis，性能提升1.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: C^2A有效结合了空间定位和临床先验共现关系，显著提升了多标签胸部疾病识别性能，尤其在难区分类别上表现突出，同时计算开销极小，具备临床部署潜力。

title: NTIRE 2026 Low-light Enhancement: Twilight Cowboy Challenge
summary: This paper presents a review of the NTIRE 2026 Low-light Enhancement: Twilight Cowboy Challenge. The objective of the competition was to merge a set of misaligned smartphone images in the raw domain, captured in low-light conditions, into a single, clean image. Introduced setup simultaneously addresses two problems of low-light photography: visual degradations such as high noise and mixed scene illuminants, and the geometric inconsistencies caused by hand movement during multi-frame capture. To advance research in low-light and nighttime computational photography, a challenging dataset was collected comprising 585 real-world scenes, spanning indoor low-light and outdoor nighttime conditions, for training and benchmarking participant solutions. The competition employed a three-stage evaluation protocol: automatic validation via the CodaBench platform in stages one and two, followed by blind assessment on a private test set for the final ranking. Ten teams surpassed the established baseline, achieving improvements of up to +6.49 dB in PSNR and +0.0101 in SSIM, thereby establishing new state-of-the-art performance for burst-based low-light image enhancement. These results demonstrate significant progress in handling real-world noise, motion, and illumination variability in the low-light setting. Comprehensive results, leaderboards, and additional information are publicly available at https://nightimaging.org.

AI.tldr: 本论文回顾了NTIRE 2026 Low-light Enhancement挑战赛，旨在推动移动设备弱光图像增强技术的进步。比赛聚焦于多帧原始低光图像的合成，解决噪声、光照不均与运动误差难题，并采用大型真实数据集和多阶段评测进行算法比拼。若干团队刷新了性能基线，推进了领域技术水平。
AI.motivation: 低光环境下，手机拍照常出现噪声大、光照混杂及拍摄动作导致图像错位等问题。传统单帧或对齐多帧处理手段效果有限，促使开发者需要更优方法来提升弱光图像质量。通过举办公开挑战赛，集合多团队智慧寻求应对真实场景复杂弱光拍摄难题的突破。
AI.method: 比赛要求参赛者将多张错位的原始弱光手机图片合成一幅清晰的图像。数据集包含585组室内外弱光实景，作为训练及验证。三阶段评测包含自动化平台与闭集人工验收。各团队基于融合、去噪、配准等技术展开算法创新，力图在实际弱光条件下提升图像质量。
AI.result: 有10支队伍在性能上超越官方基线方案，最高PSNR提升6.49 dB，SSIM提升0.0101，显示了在抑制真实弱光噪声和应对帧间错位、光照变化方面的重大改进，刷新了多帧增强领域的最佳水平。具体结果、排名及数据对外公开。
AI.conclusion: 本次挑战赛推动了弱光强化领域算法在真实应用条件下的进步。公开的数据集和评测机制使得成果具备广泛可比性，显著提升了多帧原始弱光图像增强的可用性和实际效果，对夜间及弱光移动摄影技术发展具有重要推动作用。

title: ADOPD: Reference-Privileged On-Policy Distillation for MLLM-Based Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD) requires identifying fine-grained deviations from normal visual patterns. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can improve recognition accuracy by comparing query images with references at inference time, but these benefits rely on additional retrieval and processing. We investigate whether the benefits of reference comparison can instead be internalized in the model parameters. Access to references during training allows a reference-aware teacher to supervise a query-only student. However, the teacher may favor plausible responses based on query cues or language priors rather than valid visual information. We propose ADOPD, a reference-privileged on-policy distillation framework. The teacher evaluates student-generated rollouts under matched and mismatched references. The matched-reference teacher-to-student log-ratio defines the token-level learning direction, specifying what the student should learn. The likelihood gap between the two reference views estimates reference-specific support and calibrates the sequence-level weight. ADOPD achieves 77.31% average accuracy on the MMAD benchmark under zero-shot inference, improving the Qwen3-VL-4B backbone by 6.14 points and outperforming its one-shot setting by 2.64 points. Experiments show that ADOPD learns a fine-grained anomaly inspection strategy from reference comparison. The project will be available at https://github.com/withTai/ADOPD.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的蒸馏框架ADOPD，通过在训练阶段利用参考信息，使模型在测试时仅凭查询能够实现更高精度的工业视觉异常检测。
AI.motivation: 现有工业异常检测方法通常依赖多模态大模型的推理阶段参考对比以提升准确率，但推断时的额外检索和处理导致效率低下。作者希望能将参考信息“内化”于模型参数，让模型不用实时参考，单凭查询实现高性能检测。
AI.method: 提出ADOPD框架：在训练阶段利用带参考的teacher模型对只用查询的student模型进行蒸馏监督。teacher会基于匹配与不匹配的参考对student输出打分，二者对数比指导student的每个token学习方向，二者似然差调整整个序列的学习权重。
AI.result: 在MMAD基准上，ADOPD在零样本推理条件下平均精度77.31%，比基础模型（Qwen3-VL-4B）提升6.14%，也优于该模型的一次样本设置（超出2.64%）。
AI.conclusion: ADOPD能让模型学习基于视觉参考的细粒度异常检查策略，有效提升了只用查询输入时的检测能力。

title: Modern Backbones Improve Multi-task DETR for Mammography Classification and Lesion Localization
comment: Medical Imaging with Deep Learning 2026 - Short Paper Track
summary: Joint exam-level prediction and candidate-region localization may improve the usefulness of AI support in mammography. We study this setting using a multi-task DETR framework, where shared representations support both image-level malignancy prediction and lesion localization, and evaluate its performance on OPTIMAM and a biopsy-confirmed SGM1k cohort. Across both datasets, modern backbones consistently outperformed older ResNet-style features, with ConvNeXtV2 and DINOv3 giving the strongest overall results, whereas MambaVision was less competitive. On OPTIMAM, ConvNeXtV2 achieved the best overall performance, reaching 97.96% AUC, 99.89% sensitivity, 25.08% mAP@.5, and 74.38% recall@.25. On SGM1k, DINOv3 gave the strongest overall results, with 90.97% AUC, 86.28% sensitivity, 82.00% specificity, 27.04% mAP@.5, and 77.32% recall@.25. These findings suggest that backbone quality is a critical factor in effective multi-task mammography, with ConvNeXtV2 emerging as a particularly strong and well-matched CNN backbone for mammography in this framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将图像级恶性预测与病灶区域定位联合建模的新方法，在多任务DETR框架下，利用共享特征实现两任务协同。实验对比了多种主流骨干网络，结果显示新型骨干ConvNeXtV2和DINOv3在乳腺影像AI诊断中表现突出。
AI.motivation: 传统乳腺X线AI模型通常将病变检测和恶性预测分开，难以同时兼顾诊断性能与定位解释性。联合预测可望提升AI辅助诊断的实际临床价值。
AI.method: 采用多任务学习思路，基于DETR架构，设计模型既能判别图像整体的恶性概率，也能定位具体疑似区域，主干网络测试包括ConvNeXtV2、DINOv3、MambaVision等。实验在OPTIMAM和SGM1k（活检确认）两个公开数据集上评估。
AI.result: ConvNeXtV2和DINOv3骨干均优于经典ResNet结构。OPTIMAM上ConvNeXtV2取得AUC 97.96%、灵敏度99.89%、mAP@0.5为25.08%、召回@0.25为74.38%；SGM1k上DINOv3达到AUC 90.97%、灵敏度86.28%、特异性82.00%、mAP@0.5为27.04%、召回@0.25为77.32%。MambaVision竞争力较弱。
AI.conclusion: 骨干网络表现对多任务乳腺AI诊断模型至关重要。ConvNeXtV2作为CNN架构在该框架下展现极强的优势，推荐在乳腺影像AI辅助诊断中重点采用。

title: MedPixel: A Unified Pixel-Language Model for Medical Reasoning and Segmentation
summary: Reliable medical image understanding requires models to connect clinical language and visual reasoning with pixel-level grounding. Yet medical vision-language models often lack precise localization, whereas medical segmenters typically rely on explicit target categories or precise spatial prompts. This divide is reinforced by a supervision mismatch: segmentation datasets provide precise masks but little language supervision, whereas medical vision-language data rarely pair language with dense spatial annotations. To address this gap, we present MedPixel, a unified medical pixel-language model built around a shared language--mask interface. To provide scalable supervision, we introduce MedPLG-440K, comprising approximately 440K pixel-language task samples constructed through a clinically motivated synthesis process without external LLM annotation. MedPixel is trained with joint multi-task supervised fine-tuning followed by Pixel-Level Preference Optimization, which uses ground-truth masks as offline verifiers to derive response preferences from mask quality. MedPixel supports a broad spectrum of tasks spanning explicit grounding, implicit reasoning, spatial interaction, grounded explanation, and medical VQA. Across this task spectrum, MedPixel achieves strong performance in both pixel-level prediction and response generation, together with effective zero-shot transfer to external grounding benchmarks and robustness to imperfect spatial prompts. Code and model checkpoints will be released at https://github.com/yhy-whu/Medpixel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MedPixel，一种统一的医学像素-语言模型，通过共享的语言-掩码接口来弥合医学视觉-语言模型与医学分割模型之间在空间定位和语言监督上的差距，并设计了MedPLG-440K数据集，促进多任务学习。
AI.motivation: 当前医学视觉语言模型缺乏精确的定位能力，而医学分割模型又过度依赖目标类别或空间提示。由于监督数据的分割，存在语言和空间标签之间的断层，导致能力不能兼顾。
AI.method: 作者提出MedPixel模型，设计了基于语言与掩码共享接口的学习机制。为获取规模化监督，合成了一个包含约44万例像素级任务样本的数据集MedPLG-440K，并采用多任务联合微调加像素级偏好优化方法，利用掩码质量作为偏好信号提升模型表现。
AI.result: MedPixel支持多种任务，包括定位、推理、空间交互、可解释性和医学视觉问答，表现出色，能够实现像素级预测和合理文本响应，并展现出良好的零样本泛化能力和对不完美空间提示的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过新的模型、接口和数据合成机制，MedPixel实现了医学图像分割与视觉-语言理解的跨任务融合，拓展了医学像素-语言模型的可用性和适应性，对医学人工智能领域具有重要意义。

title: From Diagnosis to Correction: Benchmarking and Improving Real-World Table Parsing
summary: Recent document parsers achieve table TEDS scores above 93 on OmniDocBench v1.6, yet community feedback and our audit reveal persistent failures on complex real-world tables. To quantify this gap, we introduce TableParseMap, a diagnostic benchmark of 916 real-world tables organized into five challenging scenarios and nine failure types. The strongest evaluated parser achieves only 85.03 TEDS, showing that aggregate benchmark scores conceal substantial weaknesses. Our analysis attributes these failures to three complementary limitations: large tables exceed the reliable processing scale of a single pass, weak or ambiguous visual cues hinder structure perception, and the reconstructed table may remain visually inconsistent with the image. We therefore propose DEC (Decompose--Enhance--Correct), a visual-consistency-guided agentic framework that improves frozen table parsers without retraining. DEC uses a general VLM as the controller: Decompose partitions large tables along structure-aware boundaries, Enhance exposes weak visual evidence and reparses transformed views, and Correct diagnoses and repairs residual errors. A Visual Consistency Gate (VC-Gate) selectively triggers intervention, while a Visual Consistency Ranker (VC-Ranker) verifies candidate updates and supports rollback without ground-truth HTML at inference time. We further derive a 1,977-table Consensus-Hard Set from 4,556 candidates through offline metrics and cross-model consensus. Across three frozen parsers, DEC improves TEDS by 1.57 points on average; on TableParseMap, gains reach 1.89 points overall, 2.62 on structural errors, and 5.66 on large tables.

AI.tldr: 当前文档解析器在标准数据集上取得高分，但在真实复杂表格上表现依然有限。本文提出TableParseMap新基准，并通过解耦增强纠错（DEC）框架显著提升解析器在困难案例中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有表格解析器虽在常规基准测试（如OmniDocBench v1.6）上获得高分，但现实中遇到复杂或特殊表格时仍会频繁出错，社区用户反馈和作者自查均证实该问题，急需一个针对真实场景的细粒度评测工具和针对性提升方法。
AI.method: 1）构建TableParseMap诊断基准，包括916个真实世界的复杂表格，涵盖5类挑战场景和9种失败类型，用于揭示解析器在真实场景的短板。2）提出DEC框架：基于VLM视觉大模型的控制器实现Decompose（按结构切分大表格）、Enhance（加强模糊线索、增广视图重解析）、Correct（检测修复残留错误）；利用VC-Gate和VC-Ranker机制在无真值标签情况下指导与验证干预效果。3）构建新的高难度表集用于脱离式评测。
AI.result: 最强基线解析器在TableParseMap上TEDS分数仅为85.03，显著低于传统基准。DEC方法在三个主流冻结（不开微调）解析器上平均提升TEDS 1.57分，其中在结构性错误、大型表格等难点场景提升尤为显著，分别达到2.62和5.66分。
AI.conclusion: （1）传统基准难以反映应用中解析器的真实短板；（2）通过引入更具挑战性的评测集和“解耦-增强-纠错” agentic 框架，可以在无需重新训练的前提下，明显提升各类解析器在复杂表格场景下的性能。

title: Sci-VBench: Evaluating Knowledge- and Reasoning-Intensive Video Generation in Science Domains
summary: We introduce Sci-VBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating knowledge- and reasoning-intensive video generation across scientific domains. It contains 1,253 expert-annotated examples spanning 60 subjects across four core disciplines: Natural Science, Healthcare, Humanities & Social Sciences, and Engineering. Each example requires models to generate temporally rich videos that demand scientific reasoning and knowledge-grounded synthesis, going beyond surface-level visual plausibility. We further establish a rubric-based evaluation protocol. Our analysis shows that, under this protocol, both non-expert human evaluators and MLLM-as-Judge systems can achieve relatively high agreement with expert judgments, supporting reproducible evaluation at scale. We benchmark 16 frontier proprietary and open-source models and find that, while automatic perceptual-quality scores cluster tightly across systems, performance on Prompt Grounding and Scientific and Causal Correctness varies substantially, with a pronounced proprietary-open-source gap. These findings show that advances in visual realism have not yet translated into reliable modeling of scientific and causal dynamics.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了Sci-VBench，这是一个跨科学领域、针对知识与推理密集型视频生成的基准测试集，并对现有前沿模型进行了评测。
AI.motivation: 当前视频生成领域虽然取得了视觉逼真度的进步，但在知识推理和学科内容还原方面缺乏系统性可评测的基准，阻碍了科学领域相关视频生成模型的进一步发展和公正比较。
AI.method: 作者构建了包含1,253条、涵盖60个学科的人工标注数据集，分属自然科学、健康、社科和工程4大类别。每个样例均要求生成需要科学推理与知识支撑的时序丰富视频。论文还设计了基于评分细则的评测协议和流程，并分析了人类非专家与MLLM自动打分与专家评价的一致性。
AI.result: 对16个前沿（包含开源与专有）的模型进行基准测试后发现：各模型在视觉质量得分上趋于一致，但在题意契合和科学/因果正确性上表现差异巨大，且专有模型与开源模型之间有明显差距。
AI.conclusion: 视觉逼真性的提升尚未带来科学与因果内容建模能力的同步提升，Sci-VBench为相关模型提供了更具挑战性和科学评测意义的标准。

title: Financial Numerical Prediction and Allocation as Token Generation
summary: Financial prediction typically relies on task-specific regression, ranking, or policy heads, separating the language model from the numerical object ultimately evaluated. We investigate whether a causal language model can instead represent forecasts and decisions directly through constrained token generation. FinATOM introduces a unified, head-free interface for three-step stock-return forecasting and dynamic five-ETF allocation. The forecasting model autoregressively emits volatility-standardized return tokens and is trained with ordinal and ranking supervision followed by a one-epoch token-level policy stage. The allocation model generates normalized long-only weights; supervised fine-tuning imitates a causal mean--variance anchor, and DAPO-augmented GRPO optimizes realized 21-day Sharpe subject to anchor consistency. In 2023--2025 ETF tests, the allocation policy improves pooled gross Sharpe from 1.428 to 1.529 and net Sharpe under a 5-bp transaction-cost model from 1.394 to 1.494. The multimodal allocation input attains the highest three-period mean Sharpe of 1.540, with its clearest advantage in 2025. On FinTexTS, the SFT and policy strategies achieve 73.52\%/2.68 and 73.72\%/2.69 cumulative-return/Sharpe, respectively. These results support the feasibility of direct language-model token generation for financial numerical prediction and decision-making, while motivating broader tests across assets, regimes, and random seeds.
